title.zh: 下龙湾 – 宁平 – 岘港 – 会安 10天9晚之旅

summary: Coming to Ha Long, tourists will experience on a 5-star cruise, or visit the Ninh Binh spiritual tourist area, then take you to Da Nang to admire the beauty of My Khe beach, Ba Na, Ngu Hanh Son, ... to the town with ancient mossy houses, rows of red lanterns, to the West to visit the floating market, and visit fruit-laden…

itinerary.title: Welcome to Ha Noi-Ha Long Bay-Lan Ha Bay ( Kayaking/swimming( B, L,d)
itinerary.html:
Upon arrival at Ha Noi Airport, pick up you and go to Halong bay ( driver only), then pickyou up go to hotel near airport have breakfast ( no early checkin), after go to Ha Long bay by private car.

11:30 – 12:00 AM: Arrive at Tuan Chau harbor, check in at the waiting room.

12:00 – 12:30PM: Get on Tender Boat to Cruise and enjoy Welcome drink, meet the captain, crew to get a brief introduction about cruise and safety guidelines. Complete check-in procedure.

01:00 PM – 01:15 PM Enjoy Vietnamese seafood and vegetarian lunch, while cruising in the magnificent Halong –

  • Lan Ha Bay, admiring the fascinating rock formations in the bay.

3:00 PM: You can choose to relax on the sundesk or explore Ba Trai Dao – Tra Bau area and the natural lagoon of Lan Ha Bay and experience kayaking here.

5:30 – 6:00 PM: Come back to our Cruise and participate in our Sunset party. Take photos and relax.

7:00 PM: Dinner is served at the restaurant. After dinner, you can join the squid fishing program, relax on the sundesk, enjoy a glass of wine at the bar…

itinerary.title: Lan Ha Bay-Tuan Chau ( B,l)
itinerary.html:
6:15 -7:00AM: Have breakfast. Morning view of bay’s landscape with a cup of tea or coffee.

7:00 AM: Visitors Dark and Light Cave. Here you can freely kayak or bamboo Boat to explore the landscape, or immerse yourself. in the cool, clear blue water of this place.

9:30 AM: Back to your cabin, take relax and check carefully all the luggage before leaving your cabin.

10:00 AM: Check-out from the private cabin and enjoy a fantastic cruise on the bay for room service. Complete check-out procedure. Enjoy lunch at the restaurant while the cruise is returning to the harbour.

11:00 AM: You take the high-speed canoe back to Tuan Chau port. Return to Hanoi by bus

15:30 PM – 16:00PM: Back to Hanoi and checkin hotel

Special notes: Itinerary maybe changed due to bad Weather, tidy or others issues. Timing on it same to be not absolutely fixed.

itinerary.title: CITY HANOI ( B,L) join tour
itinerary.html:
8.00- 8.30: Get picked up by our friendly guide and start to explore Hanoi City

08.45: Arrive at Tran Quoc Pagoda located on Golden Fish IsLand in West Lake

It is the oldest pagoda in Ha Noi built in the 6th century.

09.30: Visit Ho Chi Minh complex, you have a chance to see the embalmed body of Ho Chi Minh then walk around the garden to see 2 houses where he lived & worked from 1954 to 1969. Then visit One Pillar Pagoda where worships the Godess of Mercy – It is the most unique padoga in the world.

  • Should dress modestly by covering from shoulders to knees when visiting Ho Chi Minh mausoleum, temples, pagodas…
  • Ho Chi Minh’s Mausoleum is closed on Mondays and Fridays.
  • Ho Chi Minh’s Mausoleum is closed at least 2 months (15thJune -15thAugust) for the annual maintaining but still can take picture Mausoleum and visit around that area

11.15: Visit Vietnam Ethnology Museum to learn about the culture of 54 ethnic groups living in the whole country of Vietnam

  • Special Note : we will visit Women Museum instead of Ethnology Museum closed on Mondays

12.45: Have lunch at our restaurant. You have an opportunity to enjoy Vietnamese cuisine .with 8 delicious dishes.

14.00-14.15 : Continue to visit Temple of Literature – the first university of Vietnam, established in the 11 century

15.15: Leave for Hoa Lo Prison Museum which originally used by the French colonists in Indochina for political prisoners, and later by North Vietnam for U.S. prisoners of war during the Vietnam War. During this later period, it was known to American POWs as the “Hanoi Hilton

16.15 -16.30: Tour finishes. Back to hotel

Evening: the car and guide ( private car and guide) pick you up visit water puppet show, rail track…

Overnight at Ha Noi

itinerary.title: Ha Noi-Ninh Binh-Hoa Lu-Trang An ( B,l) Join Tour
itinerary.html:
07:00 – 07:30 – Our guide will meet you at your hotel/stay and start a 110km modern Bus-journey through the verdant landscape of the countryside. A short break during the route.

10:00 Arrive Visit Hoa Lu Ancient Citadel, the location of the Ancient Capital of Vietnam dating back to the 11th century. Having been eroded over the millennia, the ruins have nearly been absorbed by the spectacular scenery creating a mystical atmosphere that will be sure to titillate your imagination. Nearby are the two temples of Dinh and Le Emperors. Restored in the 17th century but the temples are believed to be built on the original foundations of the old palaces from the 11th and 12th centuries.

12:00 – Enjoy lunch at our restaurant with great local cuisine.

13:30 – Leave for the Trang An Grottoes, an outstanding natural beauty of majestic limestone massif at 20 square kilometers rise dramatically out from rice paddy fields. Deep into the linked chains of towering mountains are pristine places of mystical valleys, numerous freshwater ponds, and jungle. Embark on a traditional sampan gently rowed down the exquisite river through numerous caves: Lam Cave, Vang Cave, Dai Cave, Thanh Truot Cave,…and Cao Sơn Temple, Suoi Tien Temple, Vu Lam Temple…

17:15 – Return to our bus and then come back to Ha Noi.

19:30 – Drop you off at your hotel/stay. The trip ends.

DAY 5 : HA NOI-DA NANG ( B) private tour

Have breakfast and go to airport fly to Da nang ( driver only).

Uppon Da Nang, diver pick you up go to hotel, checkin and relax.

Afternoon guide and car pickyou up ( private tour) visit Coconut forest+ Hoi An night market, Lamp Lantern Boat, Night Mkt

Overnight at Da nang

itinerary.title: BA NA HILLS-Golden Bridge- DRAGON BRIDGE ( B) join tour
itinerary.html:
Morning:

7:30 – 8:30: Car and tour guide pick up you at the hotel/meeting point in Da Nang (central hotel, station, airport…)

8h30: Departure to Ba Na Hills along Nguyen Tat Thanh tourist route, the most beautiful sea route in Central Vietnam. See Thuan Phuoc suspension bridge (the longest suspension bridge in Vietnam), Thanh Binh beach, Red Beach beach (where the French colonialists first landed in Da Nang).

9:00: Arrive at Ba Na – Suoi Mo cable car station. Board the cable car to DeBay station. See Mo stream with white foaming waterfalls, primeval forests and red-leaved trees.

9h30: Visit the Golden Bridge, visit Le Jardin Area with French relics such as: Tinh Tam Garden, French horse-binding area, nearly 100-year-old pomelo tree, traces of ancient villas. Visit Linh Ung Ba Na Pagoda to admire the 27m-high statue of Shakyamuni Buddha, visit Loc Uyen Garden, Quan Am Cac.

Continue to Gare Debay take the 2nd cable line to the top of Ba Na.

12h00 – 14h00: Conquering the top of Nui Chua – the roof of the city, taking pictures at the 1,487m high landmark. Enjoy the panoramic view of Da Nang city and Da Nang bay when hidden, sometimes under a sea of white clouds. Leaving the top of Chua mountain, follow the trail to visit the ancient villa ruins in the forest, the ruins of the outdoor Opera house, the Debay Suspension Bridge…

Tour guide takes the delegation to visit: The world third largest indoor amusement park called FANTASY PARK (Love wheel, SKIVER pilot, Fire race track, Tramcar crash, Haunted house, Mortar). Windmill, Spider-Man, Free-falling Tower…

15:00-15:30 Get off the cable car back to Da Nang, visit dragon Bridge and Asia par k until 10 PM

Overnight at Da nang

itinerary.title: VINWONDER NAM HOI AN ( join tour) - CITY DA NANG ( B)private tour
itinerary.html:
• After breakfast visit VinWonders Nam Hoi An is a cultural and entertainment complex that offers a variety of attractions and activities for visitors of all ages. Here are some highlights of what you can do at VinWonders Nam Hoi An:
  • Explore the five themed zones: Giao Thoa Port, Folk Culture Island, River Safari, Adventure Land, and Water World. Each zone has its own distinctive features and attractions that showcase the cultural diversity and heritage of Vietnam and the world.
  • Enjoy the shows and events that take place regularly at the park, such as the water music show, the 3D mapping show, the folk art performances, and the cultural festivals.
  • Experience the other activities and services that the park provides, such as dining, shopping, spa, and hotel. You can find a variety of cuisines, souvenirs, and relaxation options to suit your preferences and needs.
  • VinWonders Nam Hoi An is a great destination for a fun-filled and memorable day with your family and friends. You can book your tickets online or at the park entrance. Don’t miss the chance to experience the colorful world of VinWonders Nam Hoi An!
  • Then visit Son tra pennisuala, Linh Ung pagoda, Mable mountain,Han river, Golden brige, Fire Show in evening ( private tour)….

Overnight at Da nang

itinerary.title: Da Nang-Ho Chi Minh ( B)
itinerary.html:
After having breakfast, head to the airport. You will arrive at Ho Chi Minh city. Upon Ho Chi Minh, checkin hotel

  • Afternoon visit Cu chi tunnels ( join tour) is an underground zigzag network of over 200 Km, is a symbol of the
  • will and the creativity of the Vietnamese. Located about 60 Km from Saigon, Cu Chi was a fierce battlefield during 1960- 1972.

  • Visiting Cu Chi, you will see how guerrillas drug, lived and fought the tunnel, you will learn how the strength of will is against sophisticated weapons. You will watch the documentary films and see self-made weapons, bamboo traps,…And crawl in the tunnel as you like. We will also know how the locals make rice – paper and rice – wine. Ever wonder what it feels like to fire Ak- 47. Visit Cuchi Tunnel you have a chance to find out.

itinerary.title: Mekong Delta ( B,L) join tour
itinerary.html:
Morning

  • An unforgettable way of seeing the Mekong Delta is to drive along the provincial roads in the Southern region of Vietnam through paddy rice- fields, pineapple plantation, orchard, and small hamlets. (one and a half hour driving).

7:30The tour guide and bus pick up you from the hotel then drive past rural area roads.

9:00 AM arrive in My tho city, the local motor boat will take you to go along Dragon Island, Unicorn Island, Phoenix Island, and Turtle Island. On the way, you can see the fishing port, Rach Mieu bridge, stilt house, and boat building workshop. We will stop at the famous Unicorn Island. Then you take a short trek to see the fruit gardens. You can also enjoy tropical fruits, natural honey tea, and wine at a bee farms and Vietnamese traditional music shows by the locals.

  • A rowing boat carries you slowly through the canals which cover a peaceful air and full of water- coconuts tree. After that, you continue your motor boat trip to Ben Tre province. Then transfer to a small motorboat and travel along the lush, green canals. Have lunch with India food

Afternoon

Moving to a local restaurant for Vietnamese lunch. After lunch You can ride the bikeBoat will take you back My Tho city. Then the bus will drive you back to Ho chi Minh city. On the way we stop at BONSAI garden to visit and have more experience. around the village and visit crocodile farm or take a rest on hammock.

itinerary.title: CITY HO CHI MINH- Flight HOME ( Meal B) private tour
itinerary.html:
• Have breakfast and go to Ho Chi Minh city visit Independence Palace, also known as the Reunification palace, which was built on the sight of the former Norodom palace. The Independence palace is a widely known landmark of Ho Chi Minh City and was designed by the architect Ngo Viet Thu.

  • Continue seeing the beautiful structures from the French. Colonial times such as the Notre Dame Cathedral, and the historic Central Post Office. Followed by the remarkable site of the War Remnants Museum the museum has a vast display of both the Indochina wars.

Then head to the airport. End of the trip.

zh.summary: 来到下龙湾，游客将体验5星级游船，或游览宁平心灵圣地；随后前往岘港，欣赏美溪海滩、巴拿山、五行山等美景……走进满是苔痕古屋、红灯笼成排的古镇，再到越南西部游览水上市场，参观硕果累累的…
route: 欢迎来到河内 – 下龙湾 – 兰夏湾
兰夏湾 – 巡州岛
河内城市游
河内 – 宁平 – 华闾古都 – 长安
巴拿山 – 金桥(佛手桥) – 龙桥
南会安VinWonders乐园
岘港 – 胡志明市
湄公河三角洲
胡志明市城市游 – 搭乘航班回国

itinerary.title: 欢迎来到河内 – 下龙湾 – 兰夏湾（皮划艇/游泳）（含早、午、晚餐）
itinerary.html:
抵达河内机场后接机前往下龙湾（仅含司机），先送您到机场附近的酒店享用早餐（不含提前入住），之后乘专车前往下龙湾。

11:30 – 12:00：抵达巡州岛码头，在候船室办理登船手续。

12:00 – 12:30：乘接驳船登上游船，享用迎宾饮品，与船长和船员见面，听取游船简介和安全须知。完成入住手续。

13:00 – 13:15 一边在壮丽的下龙湾 –

  • 兰夏湾巡游，一边享用越南海鲜及素食午餐，欣赏海湾中奇妙的岩石景观。

15:00：您可选择在日光甲板上休息，或探索兰夏湾的Ba Trai Dao – Tra Bau区域和天然潟湖，并在此体验皮划艇。

17:30 – 18:00：返回游船参加日落派对，拍照留念、放松身心。

19:00：在餐厅享用晚餐。晚餐后，您可参加夜钓鱿鱼活动、在日光甲板上休憩，或在酒吧品一杯美酒……

itinerary.title: 兰夏湾 – 巡州岛（含早、午餐）
itinerary.html:
6:15 – 7:00：享用早餐。手捧一杯茶或咖啡，欣赏海湾晨景。

7:00：游览明暗洞。在这里您可以自由划皮划艇或乘竹筏探索美景，或畅游于清凉碧蓝的海水中。

9:30：返回船舱休息，离开船舱前请仔细检查所有行李。

10:00：退房离开私人船舱，继续在海湾中享受美妙的航程。完成退房手续。游船返回码头途中，在餐厅享用午餐。

11:00：乘高速快艇返回巡州岛码头，乘巴士返回河内。

15:30 – 16:00：返回河内，办理酒店入住。

特别提示：行程可能因恶劣天气、潮汐或其他原因而调整，具体时间仅供参考，并非绝对固定。

itinerary.title: 河内城市游（含早、午餐）拼团
itinerary.html:
8:00 – 8:30：热情的导游接您出发，开始探索河内。

08:45：抵达位于西湖金鱼岛上的镇国寺。

这是河内最古老的寺庙，始建于6世纪。

09:30：参观胡志明纪念区，您有机会瞻仰胡志明主席的遗体，然后漫步花园，参观他在1954年至1969年间生活和工作过的两座房屋。随后参观供奉观音菩萨的独柱寺——世界上独一无二的寺庙。

  • 参观胡志明陵、寺庙、佛塔等场所时，请着装得体，遮盖肩膀至膝盖。
  • 胡志明陵每周一和周五闭馆。
  • 胡志明陵每年至少闭馆2个月（6月15日至8月15日）进行年度维护，但仍可在陵外拍照并参观周边区域。

11:15：参观越南民族学博物馆，了解生活在越南全国的54个民族的文化。

  • 特别提示：民族学博物馆周一闭馆，届时将改为参观越南妇女博物馆。

12:45：在我们的餐厅享用午餐，品尝8道美味的越南菜肴。

14:00 – 14:15：继续参观文庙——越南第一所大学，建于11世纪。

15:15：前往火炉监狱博物馆。这里最初被法国殖民者用来关押印度支那的政治犯，越南战争期间又被北越用来关押美军战俘，那段时期被美军战俘称为“河内希尔顿”。

16:15 – 16:30：行程结束，返回酒店。

晚上：专车和导游（私人专车及导游）接您观看水上木偶戏、游览铁路街……

夜宿河内

itinerary.title: 河内 – 宁平 – 华闾古都 – 长安（含早、午餐）拼团
itinerary.html:
07:00 – 07:30 – 导游到您的酒店/住处接您，乘坐现代化巴士行驶约110公里，穿越青翠的乡村风光，途中短暂休息。

10:00 抵达并游览华闾古都，这里是越南11世纪古都所在地。历经千年侵蚀，遗迹几乎已融入壮丽的山水之中，营造出神秘的氛围，定会激发您的无限遐想。附近有丁先皇祠和黎大行皇祠，两座祠庙于17世纪重修，据信建在11、12世纪古宫殿的原址之上。

12:00 – 在我们的餐厅享用午餐，品尝地道的当地美食。

13:30 – 前往长安岩洞群。这片占地20平方公里的雄伟石灰岩山体从稻田中拔地而起，自然风光绝美。在连绵高耸的群山深处，是神秘的山谷、众多淡水池塘和原始丛林等纯净之地。乘坐传统舢板，沿着秀美的河流缓缓划行，穿过众多溶洞：Lam洞、Vang洞、Dai洞、Thanh Truot洞……以及高山庙、仙泉庙、武林庙……

17:15 – 返回巴士，回程河内。

19:30 – 送您返回酒店/住处，行程结束。

第5天：河内 – 岘港（含早餐）私人团

早餐后前往机场，搭乘航班飞往岘港（仅含司机）。

抵达岘港后，司机接您前往酒店办理入住并休息。

下午导游和专车接您（私人团）游览七亩椰林及会安夜市，体验放河灯、乘灯笼船、逛夜市。

夜宿岘港

itinerary.title: 巴拿山 – 金桥(佛手桥) – 龙桥（含早餐）拼团
itinerary.html:
上午：

7:30 – 8:30：专车和导游在岘港的酒店/集合点（市中心酒店、车站、机场……）接您。

8:30：沿着越南中部最美的滨海公路——阮必成旅游路线前往巴拿山。沿途可见顺福大桥（越南最长的悬索桥）、清平海滩和红滩（法国殖民者最初在岘港登陆的地方）。

9:00：抵达巴拿山Suoi Mo缆车站，乘缆车前往Debay站。沿途可见白浪翻涌的Mo溪瀑布、原始森林和红叶树。

9:30：游览金桥(佛手桥)，参观Le Jardin花园区的法国遗迹，如静心花园、法式拴马区、近百年的柚子树和古别墅遗迹。参观巴拿山灵应寺，瞻仰高27米的释迦牟尼佛像，游览鹿苑和观音阁。

继续前往Debay站，乘坐第二条缆车线路登上巴拿山顶。

12:00 – 14:00：征服被誉为“城市屋脊”的Chua山顶，在海拔1,487米的地标处拍照留念。俯瞰岘港市和岘港湾全景，时而隐没于茫茫白云之海。离开Chua山顶后，沿小径游览林中古别墅遗址、露天歌剧院遗址、Debay吊桥……

导游带领团队游览世界第三大室内游乐园——FANTASY PARK（爱情摩天轮、SKIVER飞行员、火焰赛道、碰碰电车、鬼屋、迫击炮等），以及风车、蜘蛛侠、自由落体塔……

15:00 – 15:30 乘缆车下山返回岘港，参观龙桥并畅游亚洲公园，直至晚上10点。

夜宿岘港

itinerary.title: 南会安VinWonders乐园（拼团） – 岘港城市游（含早餐）私人团
itinerary.html:
• 早餐后游览南会安VinWonders乐园。这是一个文化娱乐综合体，为各年龄段的游客提供丰富多样的景点和活动。以下是南会安VinWonders乐园的部分亮点：
  • 探索五大主题区：交汇港、民俗文化岛、河流野生动物园、冒险乐园和水上世界。每个区域都有独特的特色和景点，展现越南乃至世界的文化多样性与遗产。
  • 欣赏乐园定期举办的演出和活动，如水上音乐秀、3D光影秀、民间艺术表演和文化节庆。
  • 体验乐园提供的其他活动和服务，如餐饮、购物、水疗和酒店。这里有各式美食、纪念品和休闲选择，满足您的不同喜好和需求。
  • 南会安VinWonders乐园是与家人朋友共度欢乐难忘一天的好去处。您可以在线或在乐园入口购票。千万不要错过体验南会安VinWonders多彩世界的机会！
  • 随后游览山茶半岛、灵应寺、五行山、韩江、金桥(佛手桥)，晚上观看喷火表演（私人团）……

夜宿岘港

itinerary.title: 岘港 – 胡志明市（含早餐）
itinerary.html:
早餐后前往机场，飞往胡志明市。抵达胡志明市后，办理酒店入住。

  • 下午游览古芝地道（拼团）。这是一个全长200多公里、曲折蜿蜒的地下网络，象征着
  • 越南人民的意志与创造力。古芝距西贡约60公里，在1960年至1972年间曾是激烈的战场。

  • 游览古芝，您将了解游击队员如何挖掘地道、在地道中生活和战斗，体会坚强的意志如何对抗精良的武器。您将观看纪录片，参观自制武器、竹制陷阱等……还可随意钻进地道体验。我们还将了解当地人如何制作米纸和米酒。想知道开AK-47是什么感觉吗？来古芝地道就有机会一试。

itinerary.title: 湄公河三角洲（含早、午餐）拼团
itinerary.html:
上午

  • 沿着越南南部的省道驱车穿过稻田、菠萝种植园、果园和小村庄，是领略湄公河三角洲风情的难忘方式（车程约一个半小时）。

7:30 导游和巴士到酒店接您，驱车穿过乡村公路。

9:00 抵达美萩市，乘坐当地摩托艇沿龙岛、麟岛、凤岛和龟岛游览。途中可见渔港、Rach Mieu大桥、高脚屋和造船作坊。我们将在著名的麟岛停留，短途徒步参观果园。您还可以在养蜂场品尝热带水果、天然蜂蜜茶和米酒，并欣赏当地人表演的越南传统音乐。

  • 乘坐手划船缓缓穿行于宁静祥和、水椰丛生的运河。之后继续乘摩托艇前往槟知省，再换乘小型摩托艇沿着郁郁葱葱的绿色运河游览。午餐享用印度料理。

下午

前往当地餐厅享用越南午餐。午餐后可骑自行车游览，随后乘船返回美萩市，再乘巴士返回胡志明市。途中在盆景园停留参观体验，在村中漫步，参观鳄鱼养殖场或躺在吊床上休息。

itinerary.title: 胡志明市城市游 – 搭乘航班回国（含早餐）私人团
itinerary.html:
• 早餐后前往胡志明市参观独立宫（又称统一宫），它建于原诺罗敦宫的旧址上。独立宫是胡志明市家喻户晓的地标，由建筑师吴越树设计。

  • 继续欣赏法国殖民时期的精美建筑，如西贡圣母大教堂和历史悠久的中央邮局。随后参观著名的战争遗迹博物馆，馆内大量展出两次印度支那战争的相关展品。

之后前往机场，行程结束。

rows: 河内：First Eden hotel（豪华房） 下龙湾：Verdelotus（豪华阳台房） 胡志明市：Elios（高级大床房） 岘港：Nesta（高级海景房）

title.zh: 河内 – 下龙湾 – 沙坝 – 岘港 – 胡志明市

summary: You’ll enjoy a mix of SIC (join-in) tours and private services, comfortable hotels, and a special complimentary Vietnamese hair-wash experience or…
route: Hanoi Arrival – Ha Long Bay Overnight Cruise
Ha Long Bay – Hanoi – Half-Day City Tour
Hanoi – Ninh Binh
Sapa – Muong Hoa Mountain Railway – Fansipan
Cat Cat Village – Hanoi
Hanoi – Da Nang – Marble Mountain – Coconut Forest – Hoi An Night Market
Ba Na Hills & Golden Bridge
Da Nang – Ho Chi Minh City
Cu Chi Tunnel – Mekong Delta
Ho Chi Minh Half Day City Tour – Departure

itinerary.title: Hanoi Arrival – Ha Long Bay Overnight Cruise
itinerary.html:
Meals: Lunch, Dinner – SIC Transfer, Shared Cruise

  • Upon arrival at Noi Bai Airport (Hanoi), our representative will meet and assist you, then transfer you to the meeting point.

  • Board the SIC bus and depart straight to Ha Long Bay.

11:30 – 12:00

  • Arrive at Tuan Chau Harbor, check in at the waiting lounge.

12:00 – 12:10

  • Take a tender boat to the cruise.

  • Welcome drink, meet the captain and crew, and listen to safety briefing.

  • Check into your cabin.

13:00 – 13:15

  • Enjoy a Vietnamese seafood & vegetarian lunch while cruising through the magnificent Ha Long – Lan Ha Bay, admiring fascinating rock formations.

15:00

  • Relax on the sundeck or

  • Explore Ba Trai Dao – Tra Bau area and the natural lagoon of Lan Ha Bay by kayak.

17:30 – 18:00

  • Return to the cruise, join sunset party, take photos and relax.

19:00

  • Dinner at the restaurant on board.

  • After dinner: join squid fishing, relax on the sundeck, or enjoy a drink at the bar.

Overnight on the cruise.

itinerary.title: Ha Long Bay – Hanoi – Half-Day City Tour
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch – SIC Transfer & Cruise / PRIVATE City Tour

06:00 – 06:15

  • Join Tai Chi on the sundeck.

06:15 – 07:00

  • Breakfast while enjoying the morning view of the bay with tea or coffee.

07:00

  • Visit Dark & Light Cave:

    • Option 1: Take a bamboo boat to explore the karst and lagoon.

    • Option 2: Swim in the cool, clear blue water (if allowed by cruise & weather).

08:10

  • Return to your cabin, pack your luggage.

10:00

  • Check out of your cabin.

  • Enjoy an easy cruise back through the bay and have an early lunch at the restaurant.

11:00

  • Disembark, take speed boat back to Tuan Chau Port.

  • SIC bus back to Hanoi.

  • Check in at your Hanoi hotel.

Hanoi Half-Day City Tour (Private – ~4 hours)

You’ll visit:

  • Ho Chi Minh’s Mausoleum (outside)
    Grey granite monument with the inscription “CHỦ TỊCH HỒ CHÍ MINH”, surrounded by lawns, trees, and flowers from all over Vietnam – a powerful national symbol.

  • Tran Quoc Pagoda
    The oldest pagoda in Hanoi (nearly 1,500 years), on a small island in West Lake. A beautiful combination of solemn architecture, history, and tranquil lake scenery.

  • Train Street
    A narrow residential street with a railway running right through it. When the train passes, it’s incredibly close – an exciting and unique Hanoi experience.
    (Train schedule is not fixed by day. We will check and arrange as best as possible, but cannot guarantee the train passes exactly during your visit. You can return by yourself later if desired.)

  • Water Puppet Show
    A traditional Vietnamese art form performed on water. The show (45–60 minutes) combines wooden puppets, live music, and colorful lighting to recreate daily life and folk stories.

After the city tour, you’ll receive your complimentary Vietnamese hair-washing experience or body massage package.

Overnight in Hanoi.

itinerary.title: Hanoi – Ninh Binh (Hoa Lu – Trang An – Mua Cave) – Night Bus to Sapa
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch – SIC Tour

07:00

  • Pick-up from Hanoi Old Quarter / Opera House.

10:00 – Hoa Lu Ancient Citadel

  • Visit the former capital of Vietnam (10th–11th century).

  • Explore the temples of Dinh and Le emperors, restored in the 17th century on the original palace foundations.

  • The ruins and surrounding karst mountains create a mystical, historical atmosphere.

13:30 – Trang An Boat Trip

  • After a local lunch, depart for Trang An – a world-famous eco-tourism complex.

  • Take a sampan boat through:

    • Limestone mountains (250-million-year-old formations)

    • Flooded forests & river valleys

    • Multiple caves and grottoes

  • Enjoy tranquil scenery, cliffs, forests, and emerald waterways.

15:30 – Mua Cave (Hang Múa)

  • Climb nearly 500 steps to the summit.

  • At the top, see the iconic stone tower and enjoy a panoramic view of Tam Coc, mountains, and rice fields – one of the best viewpoints in Ninh Binh.

  • Finish the tour and drive back to Hanoi.

  • Drop-off in Old Quarter – free time for dinner and walking around on your own.

~21:00

  • Pick-up for Sapa by sleeper bus.

Overnight on the bus.

itinerary.title: Sapa – Muong Hoa Mountain Railway – Fansipan
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast – PRIVATE TOUR

~05:30

  • Early arrival in Sapa. Early check-in at pre-booked hotel & rest.

10:00 – Muong Hoa Mountain Railway & Fansipan

  • Take the Muong Hoa Mountain Railway, with a stylish classic–modern design and panoramic views of the Sapa valley.

  • Enjoy the feeling of the train winding along the mountainside, looking through large glass windows at the Northwest mountains.

Then transfer to Fansipan Cable Car Station:

  • 20-minute cable car ride through spectacular scenery to 2,800 m altitude.

  • Free time to:

    • Take photos

    • Visit pagodas and spiritual sites

    • Climb about 600 steps to the summit of Fansipan – “The Roof of Indochina” (3,143 m).

  • Spend about 1.5 hours for sightseeing and photos.

Overnight in Sapa.

itinerary.title: Cat Cat Village – Hanoi
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast – PRIVATE TOUR + SIC BUS

  • Breakfast at hotel.

Cat Cat Village Tour

  • Short walk to Cat Cat Village, home of the Black H’Mong.

  • Located in a deep valley at the foot of Fansipan Peak.

  • Visit local houses, see daily activities and traditional crafts.

  • Trek down to the waterfall and French-built hydraulic power station.

  • Photo stops at the bridge and waterfall.

  • Trek uphill back towards Sapa (approx. 2.5 km, about 2 hours).

  • After the tour, free time in Sapa until transfer.

  • Return to Hanoi by sleeper bus (SIC).

  • Upon arrival in Hanoi, you’ll be dropped at a hotel near the airport.

Overnight in / near Hanoi.

itinerary.title: Hanoi – Da Nang – Marble Mountain – Coconut Forest – Hoi An Night Market
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast, Dinner – SIC TOUR

  • Breakfast at hotel.

  • Driver transfers you to Noi Bai Airport for flight to Da Nang.

  • Upon arrival in Da Nang: pick-up and drop-off at your hotel to leave luggage and relax.

13:50 – 14:00 – Marble Mountains

  • Visit the Marble Mountains (Ngu Hanh Son) – five limestone hills named after the five elements: Metal, Water, Wood, Fire, and Earth.

  • Explore caves, pagodas, and viewpoints. This area has been a spiritual site for Cham people, Vietnamese emperors, and generals for centuries.

Coconut Forest (Bay Mau)

  • Transfer to the Coconut Forest, located along the Hoai, Thu Bon, and De Vong Rivers.

  • Take a basket boat ride through mangrove waterways lined with nipa palms.

  • Watch locals cast fishing nets and enjoy boat-spinning performances and fun “dancing” basket boats.

Hoi An Ancient Town & Night Market

  • Head to Hoi An Ancient Town – charming streets, old houses, temples, and colorful lanterns.

  • Walk through narrow alleys, take photos, shop local handicrafts.

  • Experience lantern releasing or small candle-lit boats on the river (optional).

  • Enjoy local dinner with famous Hoi An dishes.

Overnight in Da Nang.

itinerary.title: Ba Na Hills & Golden Bridge
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch – SIC TOUR

08:30

  • Depart along Nguyen Tat Thanh coastal road, see Thuan Phuoc Suspension Bridge, Thanh Beach, and Red Beach.

09:00

  • Arrive at Ba Na – Suoi Mo Cable Car Station.

  • Take cable car to De Bay Station, enjoy views of waterfalls, forests, and hills.

09:30 – Golden Bridge & Le Jardin d’Amour

  • Visit the famous Golden Bridge held by giant stone hands.

  • Explore Le Jardin area:

    • Tinh Tam Garden

    • Ancient French wine cellar & horse-binding area

    • Nearly 100-year-old pomelo tree

    • Ruins of French villas

  • Visit Linh Ung Ba Na Pagoda with a 27 m Shakyamuni Buddha statue, Loc Uyen Garden, and Quan Am Pavilion.

  • Take 2nd cable line up to the top of Ba Na (Nui Chua).

11:30

  • Buffet lunch at restaurant.

12:30 – 14:00

  • Conquer Nui Chua Peak (1,487 m) – the “roof” of Da Nang.

  • Enjoy panoramic views of Da Nang City and Da Nang Bay (sometimes under clouds).

  • Walk to ruins of old villas, outdoor opera house, and Debay Suspension Bridge.

  • Visit Fantasy Park – one of the biggest indoor amusement parks in the world, with:
    Love Wheel, Skiver Pilot, Fire Racing Track, Bumper Cars, Haunted House, Spider-Man games, Free-fall Tower, etc.

16:30

  • Take cable car down.

Overnight in Da Nang.

itinerary.title: Da Nang – Ho Chi Minh City
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast – PRIVATE CAR

  • Breakfast at hotel.

  • Driver transfers you to Da Nang Airport, fly to Ho Chi Minh City (Saigon).

  • Upon arrival, our representative will pick you up and drop you at your hotel.

  • Free time to rest and explore the city.

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City.

itinerary.title: Cu Chi Tunnel – Mekong Delta
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch – SIC TOUR

Morning – Cu Chi Tunnels

  • After breakfast, pick-up to Cu Chi Tunnels (~60 km from Saigon).

  • Explore over 200 km of underground tunnels – a symbol of Vietnamese resilience and ingenuity.

  • Watch a documentary, see self-made weapons, bamboo traps, hidden entrances.

  • Experience crawling inside the tunnels (optional).

  • See how locals make rice paper and rice wine.

  • Optional shooting range experience with AK-47 and other rifles (extra cost).

Afternoon – Mekong Delta (My Tho – Ben Tre)

  • Arrive in My Tho city.

  • Take a motorboat along the Mekong, passing Dragon, Unicorn, Phoenix, and Turtle Islands.

  • See fishing ports, Rach Mieu Bridge, stilt houses, and boat workshops.

  • Stop at Unicorn Island:

    • Walk to fruit gardens

    • Enjoy tropical fruits

    • Taste natural honey tea/wine at a bee farm

    • Listen to traditional Vietnamese music performed by locals

  • Take a rowing boat through small canals shaded by water coconut trees.

  • Continue by motorboat to Ben Tre Province, cruise through lush green canals before returning to the mainland.

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City.

itinerary.title: Ho Chi Minh Half Day City Tour – Departure
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast – SIC TOUR + PRIVATE AIRPORT TRANSFER

  • Breakfast at hotel.

  • Join a half-day city tour (SIC):

You’ll visit:

  • Independence Palace (Reunification Palace)
    Historic site and former presidential palace of South Vietnam.

  • Notre Dame Cathedral
    Built from 1877 to 1880, this red-brick cathedral is a symbol of Catholicism and French colonial architecture in Saigon.

  • Saigon Central Post Office
    Built from 1886–1891, designed by French architect Gustave Eiffel.
    Famous for its classical European architecture, arched windows, decorative details, and yellow façade.

  • After the tour, the SIC transfer drops you at the meeting point.

  • A private car will then take you to Tan Son Nhat Airport for your departure flight.

End of services.

included: All entrance fees as per itinerary
Trang An boat trip / Ha Long Bay kayaking (or as per cruise program)
Private ground transfers & SIC/shared tours as indicated
1–2 bottles of mineral water per person per day
Complimentary Vietnamese hair-wash or body massage in Hanoi
excluded: Bank transfer fee on your side
Personal expenses and any services not clearly mentioned in “Inclusion”

zh.summary: 行程结合SIC拼团游与私人服务，入住舒适酒店，并特别赠送越南洗头体验或…
route: 抵达河内 – 下龙湾游船过夜

itinerary.title: 抵达河内 – 下龙湾游船过夜（含午、晚餐）
itinerary.html:
餐食：午餐、晚餐 – 拼车接送，共享游船

  • 抵达内排机场（河内）后，我们的工作人员将接机并协助您，送您前往集合点。

  • 登上拼团巴士，直接前往下龙湾。

11:30 – 12:00

  • 抵达巡州岛码头，在候船厅办理登船手续。

12:00 – 12:10

  • 乘接驳船登上游船。

  • 享用迎宾饮品，与船长和船员见面，听取安全须知。

  • 入住船舱。

13:00 – 13:15

  • 一边巡游壮丽的下龙湾 – 兰夏湾，欣赏奇妙的岩石景观，一边享用越南海鲜及素食午餐。

15:00

  • 在日光甲板上休息，或

  • 划皮划艇探索兰夏湾的Ba Trai Dao – Tra Bau区域和天然潟湖。

17:30 – 18:00

  • 返回游船，参加日落派对，拍照留念、放松身心。

19:00

  • 在船上餐厅享用晚餐。

  • 晚餐后：参加夜钓鱿鱼，在日光甲板上休憩，或在酒吧小酌一杯。

夜宿游船。

itinerary.title: 下龙湾 – 河内 – 半日城市游（含早、午餐）
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐、午餐 – 拼车接送及游船 / 私人城市游

06:00 – 06:15

  • 在日光甲板上参加太极晨练。

06:15 – 07:00

  • 享用早餐，手捧一杯茶或咖啡欣赏海湾晨景。

07:00

  • 游览明暗洞：

    • 选择1：乘竹筏探索喀斯特地貌和潟湖。

    • 选择2：在清凉碧蓝的海水中畅游（视游船安排及天气而定）。

08:10

  • 返回船舱，整理行李。

10:00

  • 办理船舱退房。

  • 游船悠闲地驶回码头，在餐厅享用提前供应的午餐。

11:00

  • 下船，乘快艇返回巡州岛码头。

  • 乘拼团巴士返回河内。

  • 办理河内酒店入住。

河内半日城市游（私人团 – 约4小时）

您将参观：

  • 胡志明陵（外观）
    灰色花岗岩建筑，镌刻着“CHỦ TỊCH HỒ CHÍ MINH”（胡志明主席）字样，四周环绕着草坪、树木以及来自越南各地的花卉——是一个强有力的国家象征。

  • 镇国寺
    河内最古老的寺庙（近1,500年历史），坐落于西湖中的小岛上，庄严的建筑、悠久的历史与宁静的湖景完美交融。

  • 火车街
    一条铁轨从中穿过的狭窄民居街道。火车驶过时近在咫尺——是河内独一无二的刺激体验。
    （火车时刻每天不固定。我们将尽量查询并安排，但无法保证参观期间恰好有火车经过。如有需要，您可稍后自行前往。）

  • 水上木偶戏
    在水面上表演的越南传统艺术。演出时长45–60分钟，结合木偶、现场音乐和绚丽灯光，再现日常生活和民间故事。

城市游结束后，您将享受免费赠送的越南洗头体验或全身按摩套餐。

夜宿河内。

itinerary.title: 河内 – 宁平（华闾古都 – 长安 – 舞洞山） – 卧铺夜巴前往沙坝（含早、午餐）
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐、午餐 – 拼团游

07:00

  • 在河内老城区/歌剧院接您。

10:00 – 华闾古都

  • 参观越南古都（10–11世纪）。

  • 游览丁先皇和黎大行皇祠，两座祠庙于17世纪在原宫殿地基上重修。

  • 遗迹与周围的喀斯特群山共同营造出神秘而厚重的历史氛围。

13:30 – 长安乘船游

  • 享用当地午餐后，前往世界著名的生态旅游区长安。

  • 乘坐舢板穿越：

    • 石灰岩山峰（形成于2.5亿年前）

    • 水淹森林与河谷

    • 众多溶洞和岩洞

  • 尽享宁静的风光、悬崖、森林和碧绿的水道。

15:30 – 舞洞山（Hang Múa）

  • 攀登近500级台阶直抵山顶。

  • 在山顶观赏标志性的石塔，全景俯瞰三谷、群山和稻田——宁平最佳观景点之一。

  • 行程结束，乘车返回河内。

  • 在老城区下车——自由享用晚餐并四处逛逛。

约21:00

  • 接您乘卧铺巴士前往沙坝。

夜宿巴士。

itinerary.title: 沙坝 – 孟花山地铁路 – 番西邦峰（含早餐）
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐 – 私人团

约05:30

  • 清晨抵达沙坝，在预订的酒店提前入住并休息。

10:00 – 孟花山地铁路及番西邦峰

  • 乘坐孟花山地铁路，列车融合经典与现代的时尚设计，可全景饱览沙坝山谷。

  • 感受列车沿山蜿蜒而行，透过宽大的玻璃窗眺望西北群山。

随后前往番西邦缆车站：

  • 乘坐20分钟缆车，穿越壮丽风光抵达海拔2,800米处。

  • 自由活动：

    • 拍照留念

    • 参观寺庙和宗教圣地

    • 攀登约600级台阶登上“印度支那屋脊”番西邦峰顶（3,143米）。

  • 约1.5小时观光拍照。

夜宿沙坝。

itinerary.title: 猫猫村 – 河内（含早餐）
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐 – 私人团 + 拼团巴士

  • 在酒店享用早餐。

猫猫村之旅

  • 短途步行前往黑苗族聚居的猫猫村。

  • 村庄位于番西邦峰脚下的深谷之中。

  • 走访当地民居，了解村民的日常生活和传统手工艺。

  • 徒步下行至瀑布及法国人修建的水力发电站。

  • 在桥边和瀑布旁停留拍照。

  • 徒步上坡返回沙坝（约2.5公里，约2小时）。

  • 行程结束后，在沙坝自由活动直至接送。

  • 乘卧铺巴士（拼团）返回河内。

  • 抵达河内后，送您前往机场附近的酒店。

夜宿河内或河内附近。

itinerary.title: 河内 – 岘港 – 五行山 – 七亩椰林 – 会安夜市（含早、晚餐）
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐、晚餐 – 拼团游

  • 在酒店享用早餐。

  • 司机送您前往内排机场，搭乘航班飞往岘港。

  • 抵达岘港后：接机并送往酒店寄存行李、休息。

13:50 – 14:00 – 五行山

  • 游览五行山（Ngu Hanh Son）——以金、水、木、火、土五行命名的五座石灰岩山丘。

  • 探索溶洞、寺庙和观景点。数百年来，这里一直是占族人、越南历代帝王和将领的心灵圣地。

七亩椰林（Bay Mau）

  • 前往位于怀江、秋盆河和De Vong河沿岸的七亩椰林。

  • 乘坐簸箕船穿行于水椰丛生的红树林水道。

  • 观看当地渔民撒网捕鱼，欣赏簸箕船旋转表演和趣味“舞蹈”。

会安古镇及夜市

  • 前往会安古镇——迷人的街道、古老的房屋、寺庙和五彩缤纷的灯笼。

  • 漫步于狭窄小巷，拍照留念，选购当地手工艺品。

  • 体验在河上放河灯或乘坐烛光小船（自选）。

  • 享用当地晚餐，品尝会安著名美食。

夜宿岘港。

itinerary.title: 巴拿山及金桥(佛手桥)（含早、午餐）
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐、午餐 – 拼团游

08:30

  • 沿阮必成滨海公路出发，途经顺福大桥、清平海滩和红滩。

09:00

  • 抵达巴拿山Suoi Mo缆车站。

  • 乘缆车前往Debay站，欣赏瀑布、森林和山丘美景。

09:30 – 金桥(佛手桥)及爱情花园（Le Jardin d’Amour）

  • 游览由巨型石手托起的著名金桥(佛手桥)。

  • 探索Le Jardin花园区：

    • 静心花园

    • 古老的法式酒窖及拴马区

    • 近百年的柚子树

    • 法式别墅遗迹

  • 参观巴拿山灵应寺（内有27米高的释迦牟尼佛像）、鹿苑和观音阁。

  • 乘坐第二条缆车线路登上巴拿山顶（Chua山）。

11:30

  • 在餐厅享用自助午餐。

12:30 – 14:00

  • 征服岘港“屋脊”——Chua山顶（1,487米）。

  • 全景俯瞰岘港市和岘港湾（时而隐没于云海之中）。

  • 步行游览古别墅遗址、露天歌剧院和Debay吊桥。

  • 畅游世界最大的室内游乐园之一——Fantasy Park，项目包括：
    爱情摩天轮、Skiver飞行员、火焰赛道、碰碰车、鬼屋、蜘蛛侠游戏、自由落体塔等。

16:30

  • 乘缆车下山。

夜宿岘港。

itinerary.title: 岘港 – 胡志明市（含早餐）
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐 – 专车

  • 在酒店享用早餐。

  • 司机送您前往岘港机场，飞往胡志明市(西贡)。

  • 抵达后，我们的工作人员接机并送您前往酒店。

  • 自由休息，探索城市。

夜宿胡志明市。

itinerary.title: 古芝地道 – 湄公河三角洲（含早、午餐）
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐、午餐 – 拼团游

上午 – 古芝地道

  • 早餐后接您前往古芝地道（距西贡约60公里）。

  • 探索全长200多公里的地下地道网络——越南人民坚韧与智慧的象征。

  • 观看纪录片，参观自制武器、竹制陷阱和隐蔽入口。

  • 体验钻进地道匍匐前行（自选）。

  • 观看当地人制作米纸和米酒。

  • 可选体验AK-47等步枪射击（费用自理）。

下午 – 湄公河三角洲（美萩 – 槟知）

  • 抵达美萩市。

  • 乘摩托艇沿湄公河游览，途经龙岛、麟岛、凤岛和龟岛。

  • 沿途可见渔港、Rach Mieu大桥、高脚屋和造船作坊。

  • 在麟岛停留：

    • 步行参观果园

    • 品尝热带水果

    • 在养蜂场品尝天然蜂蜜茶/蜂蜜酒

    • 聆听当地人表演的越南传统音乐

  • 乘坐手划船穿行于水椰掩映的小运河。

  • 继续乘摩托艇前往槟知省，畅游绿意盎然的运河，然后返回陆地。

夜宿胡志明市。

itinerary.title: 胡志明市半日城市游 – 返程（含早餐）
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐 – 拼团游 + 私人机场送机

  • 在酒店享用早餐。

  • 参加半日城市游（拼团）：

您将参观：

  • 独立宫（统一宫）
    历史遗迹，前南越总统府。

  • 西贡圣母大教堂
    建于1877年至1880年，这座红砖教堂是西贡天主教和法国殖民建筑的象征。

  • 西贡中央邮局
    建于1886–1891年，由法国建筑师古斯塔夫·埃菲尔设计。
    以古典欧式建筑、拱形窗户、精美装饰细节和黄色外墙而闻名。

  • 游览结束后，拼团车辆将您送至集合点。

  • 随后专车送您前往新山一机场搭乘返程航班。

服务结束。

itinerary.title: Welcome to Hanoi – Half Day City Tour – Private Tour
itinerary.html:
Upon arrival at Noi Bai Airport, you will be welcomed by our representative and transferred to your hotel for check-in and rest.

In the afternoon, the tour guide will pick you up for a 4-hour Hanoi city tour. You will visit Ho Chi Minh’s Mausoleum, Tran Quoc Pagoda, Train Street, and enjoy a Water Puppet Show.

  • Ho Chi Minh’s Mausoleum (outside)
    The mausoleum is clad in grey granite, surrounded by rows of square granite columns. In the centre stands the inscription “CHỦ TỊCH HỒ CHÍ MINH”. The grounds are planted with trees and flowers brought from all regions of Vietnam. This is one of the most important cultural and historical symbols of the capital.

  • Tran Quoc Pagoda
    Located on a small island on the south-eastern shore of West Lake, Tran Quoc Pagoda is nearly 1,500 years old and considered the oldest pagoda in Thang Long – Hanoi. During the Ly and Tran dynasties, it was the Buddhist centre of the citadel. Its architecture harmoniously combines solemnity and antiquity with the elegant landscape of the lake.

  • Train Street
    This narrow 200-metre street is lined with residential houses right next to the railway. When the train passes, you can feel the excitement and thrill as it rumbles by just about one metre from where you sit. That unique experience makes Train Street a must-see spot in Hanoi.

  • Water Puppet Show
    An indispensable traditional art form in Vietnam. The stage is a pool of water; the puppets are the main “actors”, controlled by skilful artists behind the curtain. Each show lasts 45–60 minutes, combining puppetry, live music, sound effects, and colourful lighting to create lively, captivating performances.

After the tour, you will receive a complimentary Vietnamese hair-washing experience or body massage package.

Overnight in Hanoi.

itinerary.title: Ha Long Bay Day Cruise
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch – SIC Transfers & SIC Cruise

08:00 – 08:45 – Hotel Pick-up

English-speaking guide picks you up from hotels in the Hanoi Old Quarter. Pick-up time is approximate due to traffic; please be ready in the lobby.

11:45 – 12:00 – Boarding the Cruise

Arrive at Tuan Chau Marina by 22-seater limousine. Check in at our pier where the crew warmly welcomes you on board.

12:00 – 13:30 – Lunch on Board

The cruise departs Tuan Chau Harbor to discover the beauty of Ha Long Bay – a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Along the way, admire thousands of limestone islands such as Dog Rock, Duck Rock, and especially Thumb Rock, a limestone islet rising from the sea like a giant thumb.

Enjoy a buffet lunch with a wide variety of Vietnamese dishes and seafood.

13:30 – 14:30 – Explore Surprise (Sung Sot) Cave

Stop at Bo Hon Island. The guide leads you to Sung Sot (Surprise) Cave, the largest and most beautiful cave in Ha Long Bay.

After about 200 steps under the forest canopy, the cave entrance appears and a spectacular “underground paradise” opens in front of you. Explore the cave for about 45 minutes.

(Guests who prefer not to walk can remain on the cruise, relaxing on the sundeck or soaking in the jacuzzi.)

14:30 – 15:30 – Kayaking

The cruise heads to Luon Cave area. Here you can:

  • Enjoy kayaking for about 30 minutes, or

  • Sit on a rowboat paddled by local people to admire the peaceful scenery of Luon Cave.

15:30 – 16:30 – Titop Island

Stop at Titop Island. Climb partway up the mountain for a panoramic view of Ha Long Bay – a stunning 360° vista of limestone peaks and emerald waters.

17:00 – Sunset Party

Enjoy complimentary wine, Vietnamese tea, fresh fruit and small cakes while cruising back. Watch the sunset painting the sky with beautiful red, purple and yellow hues.

18:00 – Disembark – Limousine Back to Hanoi

Return to the harbor, board the limousine and travel back to Hanoi via the expressway (with a short break on the way).

20:30 – 21:00 – Drop-off at your hotel.

Overnight in Hanoi.

itinerary.title: Hanoi – Ninh Binh (Hoa Lu – Trang An – Mua Cave)
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch – SIC TOUR

07:00 – Pick-up from Hanoi Old Quarter / Opera House.

10:00 – Hoa Lu Ancient Citadel

Visit Hoa Lu, the ancient capital of Vietnam in the 10th–11th centuries. The remaining ruins lie amidst dramatic karst scenery, creating a mystical atmosphere. Nearby are the temples of the Dinh and Le emperors, restored in the 17th century on the original palace foundations.

13:30 – Trang An Scenic Landscape Complex

After a local lunch, depart for Trang An, a famous eco-tourism area:

  • 250-million-year-old limestone mountains

  • Flooded forests, rivers and caves

  • Archaeological and cultural relics

Take a sampan boat trip through tranquil waterways, limestone karsts and caves, fully immersed in peaceful nature.

15:30 – Mua Cave (Hang Múa)

Climb nearly 500 steps to the summit. At the top, a beautiful tower in traditional Vietnamese style awaits you alongside a breathtaking panorama of mountains and rice fields – one of the most iconic viewpoints in Ninh Binh.

After the tour, return to your Hanoi hotel.

Overnight in Hanoi.

itinerary.title: Hanoi – Da Nang – Dragon Bridge & Son Tra Night Market
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast – PRIVATE CAR

  • Breakfast at hotel, then transfer to Noi Bai Airport for your flight to Da Nang.

  • Upon arrival at Da Nang Airport, meet our representative and transfer to your hotel for check-in and rest (check-in time: 14:00–15:00).

In the evening, the driver will take you (no guide) to visit:

  • Dragon Bridge – famous for its dragon-shaped design and colourful lights at night.

  • Son Tra Night Market – a lively local market with food stalls, souvenirs, and entertainment.

Overnight in Da Nang.

itinerary.title: Marble Mountain – Coconut Forest – Hoi An Night Market
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast, Local Dinner – SIC TOUR

Morning: Breakfast and free time.

13:50 – 14:00 – Pick-up for Marble Mountains

Visit Ngu Hanh Son (Marble Mountains) – a group of five limestone hills named after the five elements: Metal, Water, Wood, Fire and Earth. Over the centuries, the peaks have been revered as a spiritual site by the Cham people, Vietnamese emperors and generals. Explore caves, pagodas and viewpoints overlooking Da Nang.

Bay Mau Coconut Forest

Continue to the Coconut Forest, lying along the banks of the Hoai, Thu Bon and De Vong rivers. Take a basket boat ride into the mangrove forest:

  • Enjoy fresh air along quiet waterway channels lined with nipa palms.

  • Watch locals casting fishing nets – like a live folk performance.

  • See exciting basket-boat spinning shows and fun “boat racing” on the water.

Hoi An Ancient Town & Night Market
Head to Hoi An Ancient Town, a charming trading port preserved from the 15th–19th century:

  • Wander lantern-lit streets, old houses and narrow alleys.

  • Take photos and shop for local handicrafts.

  • Experience lantern releasing or small candle-lit boats on the river.

  • Enjoy a local dinner with delicious Hoi An specialities.

Overnight in Da Nang.

itinerary.title: Ba Na Hills & Golden Bridge
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch – SIC TOUR

08:30 – Depart to Ba Na Hills along the Nguyen Tat Thanh coastal road. See Thuan Phuoc Suspension Bridge, Thanh Beach and Red Beach (where the French first landed in Da Nang).

09:00 – Arrive at Ba Na – Suoi Mo Cable Car Station. Take the cable car to DeBay Station, passing Mo Stream waterfalls, primeval forest and red-leaf trees.

09:30 – Visit:

  • Golden Bridge – the world-famous pedestrian bridge supported by giant stone hands.

  • Le Jardin d’Amour area with:

    • Tinh Tam Garden

    • Old French horse-stable area

    • Nearly 100-year-old pomelo tree

    • Ruins of French villas

  • Linh Ung Ba Na Pagoda with a 27-metre Shakyamuni Buddha statue, Loc Uyen Garden and Quan Am Pavilion.

Continue to Gare DeBay to take the second cable car to the summit of Ba Na.

11:30 – Lunch at restaurant.

12:30 – 14:00

  • Conquer Nui Chua Peak (1,487 m) – the “roof” of Da Nang.

  • Enjoy panoramic views of Da Nang City and Da Nang Bay, often floating in a sea of white clouds.

  • Walk along forest trails to see ruins of ancient villas, the outdoor opera house and Debay Suspension Bridge.

Then visit Fantasy Park, one of the world’s largest indoor amusement parks, with games such as: Love Wheel, Skiver Pilot, Fire Racing Track, Bumper Cars, Haunted House, Mortar games, Spider-Man, Free-Fall Tower, etc.

16:30 – Take the cable car down.

Overnight in Da Nang.

itinerary.title: Da Nang – Phu Quoc
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast – PRIVATE CAR

  • Breakfast at hotel.

  • Driver transfers you to Da Nang Airport for your flight to Phu Quoc Island.

  • Upon arrival, our representative will pick you up and transfer you to your pre-booked hotel for check-in and relaxation (check-in time: 14:00–15:00).

Overnight in Phu Quoc.

itinerary.title: Phu Quoc – Thom Island & 4 Islands by Speed Boat
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch (Local Buffet) – SIC TOUR

Cable Car + Aquatopia Water Park & Three Islands by Speed Boat

09:00 – Guide picks you up and transfers to the harbour.

Board the speed boat to explore islands in southern Phu Quoc:

  • Gam Ghi Island – Snorkel among coral reefs and relax on the beach.

  • Xuong (Mong Tay) Island – More colourful corals and clear waters for snorkelling.

  • May Rut Island – White-sand lagoon, chill-out spots and photo corners.

Optional: Sea Walker (extra cost)
Walk on the seabed with a special helmet, surrounded by fish and vibrant corals.

Arrive at Thom Island:

  • Enjoy Aquatopia Water Park with more than 20 modern water games from world-class manufacturers.

Return via Hon Thom Cable Car (around 25 minutes):

  • Admire panoramic views of islands and the Sun Kiss Bridge at sunset (weather permitting).

~17:00 – Back to hotel.

Overnight in Phu Quoc.

itinerary.title: Full Day Vinwonders & Vinpearl Safari
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch – PRIVATE TOUR

After breakfast, transfer to discover:

Vinpearl Safari Phu Quoc

  • Vietnam’s largest wildlife conservation park and the only open semi-wild safari in the country (about 380 hectares).

  • Take a bus tour inside the safari to see animals roaming freely in natural-style habitats: giraffes, zebras, rhinos, lions, tigers and many rare species such as Arabian oryx, cranes, white-necked swans, etc.

  • Enjoy various animal shows (time-dependent).

Note: Safari closes at 16:00 daily. Bus inside the safari park is not included in the ticket price and is paid on spot.

VinWonders Phu Quoc (Afternoon)

Explore Vietnam’s largest theme park (approx. 50 hectares) with 6 themed zones and 12 sub-themes:

  • Thrilling rides & roller coasters

  • Water park slides

  • Indoor games

  • Street performances & musical fountain shows

  • 5D cinema and many other attractions

Overnight in Phu Quoc.

itinerary.title: Phu Quoc – Departure
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast – PRIVATE CAR

  • Breakfast at hotel.

  • Free at leisure until check-out.

  • Driver transfers you to Phu Quoc Airport for your flight home.

End of services.

Trang An boat trip & Ha Long Bay kayaking (or as per cruise program)

1–2 bottles of mineral water per person per day

itinerary.title: 欢迎来到河内 – 半日城市游 – 私人团
itinerary.html:
抵达内排机场后，我们的工作人员将热情迎接，并送您前往酒店办理入住、休息。

下午，导游接您开始4小时河内城市游。您将参观胡志明陵、镇国寺、火车街，并观看水上木偶戏。

  • 胡志明陵（外观）
    陵墓外墙以灰色花岗岩砌成，四周环绕着一排排方形花岗岩柱，正中镌刻着“CHỦ TỊCH HỒ CHÍ MINH”（胡志明主席）字样。陵园内种植着来自越南各地的树木和花卉。这里是首都最重要的文化与历史象征之一。

  • 镇国寺
    镇国寺坐落于西湖东南岸的一座小岛上，已有近1,500年历史，被誉为升龙–河内最古老的寺庙。李朝和陈朝时期，这里是京城的佛教中心。寺庙建筑庄严古朴，与秀美的湖光山色和谐交融。

  • 火车街
    这条长约200米的狭窄街道两旁民居紧挨着铁轨。火车经过时，距离您的座位仅约一米，轰鸣而过的刺激感令人心跳加速。正是这种独特体验，让火车街成为河内必打卡之地。

  • 水上木偶戏
    越南不可或缺的传统艺术形式。舞台是一池清水，木偶是主要“演员”，由幕后技艺娴熟的艺人操控。每场演出45–60分钟，融合木偶表演、现场音乐、音效和绚丽灯光，生动有趣、引人入胜。

行程结束后，您将享受免费赠送的越南洗头体验或全身按摩套餐。

夜宿河内。

itinerary.title: 下龙湾一日游船（含早、午餐）
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐、午餐 – 拼车接送及拼团游船

08:00 – 08:45 – 酒店接客

英文导游到河内老城区的酒店接您。因交通原因，接送时间为大致时间，请提前在大堂等候。

11:45 – 12:00 – 登船

乘坐22座豪华商务车抵达巡州岛游艇码头，在码头办理登船手续，船员热情欢迎您登船。

12:00 – 13:30 – 船上午餐

游船从巡州岛码头出发，探索联合国教科文组织世界遗产——下龙湾之美。沿途欣赏数千座石灰岩岛屿，如狗石、鸭石，尤其是如巨大拇指般从海中拔地而起的拇指石。

享用自助午餐，品尝丰富多样的越南菜肴和海鲜。

13:30 – 14:30 – 探索惊讶洞

停靠Bo Hon岛，导游带您参观下龙湾最大、最美的溶洞——惊讶洞。

在林荫下攀登约200级台阶后，洞口豁然出现，壮观的“地下天堂”展现在眼前。游览溶洞约45分钟。

（不想步行的游客可留在船上，在日光甲板上休息或享受按摩浴缸。）

14:30 – 15:30 – 皮划艇

游船驶向Luon洞区域。在这里您可以：

  • 体验约30分钟的皮划艇，或

  • 乘坐当地人划的小木船，欣赏Luon洞的宁静风光。

15:30 – 16:30 – 天堂岛(Titop岛)

停靠天堂岛(Titop岛)。登上半山腰，全景俯瞰下龙湾——石灰岩群峰与碧绿海水构成令人惊叹的360°美景。

17:00 – 日落派对

返航途中享用免费葡萄酒、越南茶、新鲜水果和小点心，观赏夕阳将天空染成红、紫、金黄的绚丽色彩。

18:00 – 下船 – 乘豪华商务车返回河内

返回码头，登上豪华商务车，经高速公路返回河内（途中短暂休息）。

20:30 – 21:00 – 送回酒店。

夜宿河内。

itinerary.title: 河内 – 宁平（华闾古都 – 长安 – 舞洞山）（含早、午餐）
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐、午餐 – 拼团游

07:00 – 在河内老城区/歌剧院接您。

10:00 – 华闾古都

参观10–11世纪的越南古都华闾古都。现存遗迹坐落于壮观的喀斯特山水之间，营造出神秘的氛围。附近有丁先皇祠和黎大行皇祠，均于17世纪在原宫殿地基上重修。

13:30 – 长安名胜群

享用当地午餐后，前往著名生态旅游区长安：

  • 形成于2.5亿年前的石灰岩山峰

  • 水淹森林、河流与溶洞

  • 考古及文化遗迹

乘坐舢板穿行于宁静的水道、石灰岩峰林和溶洞之间，完全沉浸在静谧的大自然中。

15:30 – 舞洞山（Hang Múa）

攀登近500级台阶直抵山顶。山顶有一座越南传统风格的精美石塔，群山与稻田的壮丽全景尽收眼底——这是宁平最具代表性的观景点之一。

行程结束后，返回河内酒店。

夜宿河内。

itinerary.title: 河内 – 岘港 – 龙桥及山茶夜市（含早餐）
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐 – 专车

  • 在酒店享用早餐，然后前往内排机场，搭乘航班飞往岘港。

  • 抵达岘港机场后，与我们的工作人员会合，前往酒店办理入住并休息（入住时间：14:00–15:00）。

晚上，司机带您（不含导游）游览：

  • 龙桥——以龙形设计和夜间五彩灯光而闻名。

  • 山茶夜市——热闹的当地夜市，有美食摊位、纪念品和娱乐活动。

夜宿岘港。

itinerary.title: 五行山 – 七亩椰林 – 会安夜市（含早、晚餐）
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐、当地风味晚餐 – 拼团游

上午：享用早餐，自由活动。

13:50 – 14:00 – 接您前往五行山

游览五行山（Ngu Hanh Son）——以金、水、木、火、土五行命名的五座石灰岩山丘。数百年来，这些山峰一直被占族人、越南历代帝王和将领奉为心灵圣地。探索溶洞、寺庙以及俯瞰岘港的观景点。

七亩椰林

继续前往位于怀江、秋盆河和De Vong河沿岸的七亩椰林。乘坐簸箕船深入红树林：

  • 沿着水椰丛生的幽静水道，呼吸清新空气。

  • 观看当地渔民撒网捕鱼——宛如一场生动的民俗表演。

  • 欣赏精彩的簸箕船旋转表演和水上趣味“赛船”。

会安古镇及夜市
前往会安古镇，这座迷人的贸易港口完好保存了15–19世纪的风貌：

  • 漫步于灯笼映照的街道、古老房屋和狭窄小巷。

  • 拍照留念，选购当地手工艺品。

  • 体验在河上放河灯或乘坐烛光小船。

  • 享用当地风味晚餐，品尝美味的会安特色菜。

夜宿岘港。

itinerary.title: 巴拿山及金桥(佛手桥)（含早、午餐）
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐、午餐 – 拼团游

08:30 – 沿阮必成滨海公路前往巴拿山。沿途可见顺福大桥、清平海滩和红滩（法国人最初在岘港登陆的地方）。

09:00 – 抵达巴拿山Suoi Mo缆车站，乘缆车前往Debay站，途经Mo溪瀑布、原始森林和红叶树。

09:30 – 游览：

  • 金桥(佛手桥)——由巨型石手托起、闻名世界的步行桥。

  • 爱情花园（Le Jardin d’Amour）区域，包括：

    • 静心花园

    • 古老的法式马厩区

    • 近百年的柚子树

    • 法式别墅遗迹

  • 巴拿山灵应寺（内有27米高的释迦牟尼佛像）、鹿苑和观音阁。

继续前往Debay站，乘坐第二条缆车登上巴拿山顶。

11:30 – 在餐厅享用午餐。

12:30 – 14:00

  • 征服岘港“屋脊”——Chua山顶（1,487米）。

  • 全景俯瞰岘港市和岘港湾，常常漂浮在茫茫白云之海中。

  • 沿林间小径漫步，参观古别墅遗址、露天歌剧院和Debay吊桥。

随后畅游世界最大的室内游乐园之一——Fantasy Park，游乐项目包括：爱情摩天轮、Skiver飞行员、火焰赛道、碰碰车、鬼屋、迫击炮游戏、蜘蛛侠、自由落体塔等。

16:30 – 乘缆车下山。

夜宿岘港。

itinerary.title: 岘港 – 富国岛（含早餐）
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐 – 专车

  • 在酒店享用早餐。

  • 司机送您前往岘港机场，搭乘航班飞往富国岛。

  • 抵达后，我们的工作人员接机并送您前往预订的酒店办理入住、休息（入住时间：14:00–15:00）。

夜宿富国岛。

itinerary.title: 富国岛 – 香岛及快艇四岛游（含早、午餐）
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐、午餐（当地自助餐） – 拼团游

缆车 + Aquatopia水上乐园及快艇三岛游

09:00 – 导游接您前往码头。

登上快艇，探索富国岛南部诸岛：

  • Gam Ghi岛——在珊瑚礁间浮潜，在海滩上放松。

  • Xuong（Mong Tay）岛——更多绚丽的珊瑚和清澈的海水，适合浮潜。

  • May Rut岛——白沙潟湖、休闲去处和拍照打卡点。

可选：海底漫步（费用自理）
戴上特制头盔漫步海底，与鱼群和缤纷的珊瑚相伴。

抵达香岛：

  • 畅玩Aquatopia水上乐园，拥有20多项来自世界一流制造商的现代水上游乐设施。

乘坐香岛缆车返回（约25分钟）：

  • 日落时分全景欣赏海岛风光和日落之吻桥（Sun Kiss Bridge）（视天气而定）。

约17:00 – 返回酒店。

夜宿富国岛。

itinerary.title: VinWonders及Vinpearl野生动物园全天游（含早、午餐）
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐、午餐 – 私人团

早餐后出发探索：

富国岛Vinpearl野生动物园

  • 越南最大的野生动物保护园，也是全国唯一的开放式半野生动物园（占地约380公顷）。

  • 乘坐园内观光巴士，观赏在仿自然栖息地中自由漫步的动物：长颈鹿、斑马、犀牛、狮子、老虎，以及阿拉伯大羚羊、鹤、黑颈天鹅等众多珍稀物种。

  • 欣赏各种动物表演（视场次时间而定）。

注意：野生动物园每天16:00关闭。园内巴士费用不含在门票中，需现场支付。

富国岛VinWonders乐园（下午）

探索越南最大的主题乐园（占地约50公顷），拥有6大主题区和12个子主题：

  • 惊险游乐设施及过山车

  • 水上乐园滑道

  • 室内游戏

  • 街头表演及音乐喷泉秀

  • 5D影院及众多其他景点

夜宿富国岛。

itinerary.title: 富国岛 – 返程（含早餐）
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐 – 专车

  • 在酒店享用早餐。

  • 退房前自由活动。

  • 司机送您前往富国岛机场，搭乘航班回国。

服务结束。

itinerary.title: Welcome to Ha Noi- Ha Long Bay- Sung Sot Cave-Titop Island ( B,l,d)
itinerary.html:
Upon arrival at Ha Noi Airport, your private guide and driver are waiting to meet you go to Ha Noi, early checkin hotel, have breakfast and go to Ha Long bay by bus

8h00: Tour guide of Cozy Bay Cruise will pick you up at your hotel in Ha Noi Old Quarter.

8h45: We complete the pick-up point then go to Halong Bay by Expressway

10h15: Have a short break on half way for 20 minutes to relax.

12h00: Arrive to Tuan Chau Harbor.

12h30: Welcome to Cozy Bay Cruise and Enjoy welcome to drink and get a brief introduction about cruise and safety guidelines. Check- in your room with Air-Conditioning.

13h00: Enjoy a special lunch with Vietnamese traditional dishes, while cruising in the magnificent Halong Bay, admiring the fascinating rock formations in the bay.

Afternoon Itinerary:

15h00: Visiting Sung Sot Cave (Surprising cave).

16h00: Our cruise will take you to the Titop Island. It is noted for having a viewpoint at its peak which affords splendid views all around Halong Bay or you can enjoy your swimming on romance sandy beach.

17h30: Come back to Cozy Bay Cruise then take a shower, Relax on sundeck, sunset watching in comfortable lounge chairs while drinking a cocktail or reading a book in the most magical moment.

18h00: Enjoy welcome Sunset Party and Cooking Class. How to make fresh noodle roll, you can enjoy product which you make it.

Evening Relaxing:

19h00: Enjoy your Barbecue Dinner when sitting by overlooking sea view window in the night romantic bay

20h30: After having dinner, our customers will be served the natural herbal foot bath, to help reduce foot pain and toxin excretion.

21h00: Playing some sports games like: Squid Fishing, Singing karaoke, or Relax on sundeck

Overnight on boat : Clean air – conditioning room.

itinerary.title: Halong Bay- Pearl Farm – Kayaking – Hanoi (B/ L)
itinerary.html:
6h00: Wake up in the early morning to see sunrise on sundeck.

7h00: Morning view of bay with a cup of tea of coffee. Have Buffet Breakfast !

7h45: Start visiting Halong Bay Pearl farm. The pearls in Halong are the most renowned in Vietnam. The process of farming and retrieving pearls take years.

8h30: Do kayaking to explore Halong Bay in your own.

9h30: Check-out and enjoy a fantastic cruise on the bay.

10h45: Enjoy the lunch while Cruising back to Tuan Chau Harbour.

12h00: Cozy Bay Cruise is landing Halong Bay harbor, tourist say goodbye to sailors and finish the cruise. After that, get on the Bus to return Hanoi by Expressway.

14h15: Stop on half way for short break.

15h30: Arrive at the hotel in Ha Noi Old Quarter. Trip ends !

Overnight in Ha Noi

itinerary.title: City Ha Noi ( Meal B)
itinerary.html:
After breakfast, join tour go to city Ha Noi

08.45: Arrive at Tran Quoc Pagoda located on Golden Fish IsLand in West Lake. It is the oldest pagoda in Ha Noi built in the 6th century.

09.30: Visit Ho Chi Minh complex, you have a chance to see the embalmed body of Ho Chi Minh then walk around the garden to see 2 houses where he lived & worked from 1954 to 1969. Then visit One Pillar Pagoda where worships the Godess of Mercy – It is the most unique padoga in the world

  • Should dress modestly by covering from shoulders to knees when visiting Ho Chi Minh mausoleum, temples, pagodas…
  • Ho Chi Minh’s Mausoleum is closed on Mondays and Fridays.
  • Ho Chi Minh’s Mausoleum is closed at least 2 months (15thJune -15thAugust) for the annual maintaining but still can take picture Mausoleum and visit around that area

11.15: Visit Vietnam Ethnology Museum to learn about the culture of 54 ethnic groups living in the whole country of Vietnam. Special Note : we will visit Women Museum instead of Ethnology Museum closed on Mondays

12.45: Have lunch at our restaurant. You have an opportunity to enjoy Vietnamese cuisine with 8 delicious dishes.

14.00-14.15 : Continue to visit Temple of Literature – the first university of Vietnam, established in the 11 century

15.15: Leave for Hoa Lo Prison Museum which originally used by the French colonists in Indochina for political prisoners, and later by North Vietnam for U.S. prisoners of war during the Vietnam War. During this later period, it was known to American POWs as the “Hanoi Hilton

17.15: puppet show

Overnight at Ha Noi

itinerary.title: Ha Noi-Da Nang, Vietnam (Meal B)
itinerary.html:
Have breakfast,go to Noi Bai aiport, fly to Da Nang

Afternoon join tour visit coconut fores, Hoi An night market, Lautern Boat at Hoi An

Overnight in Da Nang.

itinerary.title: Welcome to Bana Hills (B) Join Tour
itinerary.html:
Have breakfast and go to Ba Na hills

8h30: Departure to Ba Na Hills along the Nguyen Tat Thanh tourist route, the most beautiful sea route in Central Vietnam. See Thuan Phuoc suspension bridge (the longest suspension bridge in Vietnam), Thanh Beach, and Red Beach (where the French colonialists first landed in Da Nang).

9:00: Arrive at Ba Na – Suoi Mo cable car station. Board the cable car to DeBay station. See Mo Stream with white foaming waterfalls, primeval forests, and red-leaved trees.

9h30: Visit the Golden Bridge, visit Le Jardin Area with French relics such as Tinh Tam Garden, a French horse-binding area, a nearly 100-year-old pomelo tree, and traces of ancient villas. Visit Linh Ung Ba Na Pagoda to admire the 27m-high statue of Shakyamuni Buddha, visit Loc Uyen Garden, Quan Am Cac. Continue to Gare Deand bay take the 2nd cable line to the top of Ba Na.

12h00 – 14h00: Conquering the top of Nui Chua – the roof of the city, taking pictures at the 1,487m high landmark. Enjoy the panoramic view of Da Nang City and Da Nang Bay when hidden, sometimes under a sea of white clouds. Leaving the top of Chua mountain, follow the trail to visit the ancient villa ruins in the forest, the ruins of the outdoor Opera house, and the Debay Suspension Bridge…

The tour guide takes the delegation to visit: The world’s third largest indoor amusement park called FANTASY PARK (Love wheel, SKIVER pilot, Fire race track, Tramcar crash, Haunted house, Mortar). Windmill, Spider-Man, Free-falling Tower…

15:00-15:30 Get off the cable car back to Da Nang.

Overnight in Da Nang

itinerary.title: City Da Nang ( B)
itinerary.html:
• Have breakfast, and visit the Marble Mountain, a group of five limestone hills that represent the five elements of nature. You can climb up the Thuy Son (Water Mountain), the largest and most beautiful one, and explore its caves,

  • pagodas, and viewpoints.
  • Explore Son Tra Peninsula, natural reserve with lush forests, diverse wildlife, and beautiful beaches. You can visit the Linh Ung Pagoda and the Lady Buddha Statue and the Lady Buddha Statue, which are both impressive landmarks on the peninsula. The pagoda is one of the largest in Vietnam, while the statue is the tallest of its kind in the country
  • In the evening, you an admire the Dragon Bridge, which is a unique structure that resembles a dragon crossing the Han River. The bridge is illuminated with colorful lights at night, and on weekends, it breathes fire and water from its mouth. You can also stroll along Bach Dang Street, which is a lively riverside promenade with many cafes, bars, and restaurants

Overnight in Da Nang

itinerary.title: Da Nang- Flight Ho Chi Minh ( B)
itinerary.html:
After breakfast and go to airport for flight Ho Chi Minh.

  • Checkin hotel, and afternoon visit Cu Chi tunnel . Cu Chi tunnel is an underground zigzag network of over 200 Km, is a symbol of the
  • will and the creativity of the Vietnamese. Located about 60 Km from Saigon, Cu Chi was a fierce battlefield during 1960- 1972.
  • Visiting Cu Chi, you will see how guerrillas drug, lived and fought the tunnel, you will learn how the strength of will is against sophisticated weapons. You will watch the documentary films and see self-made weapons, bamboo traps,…And crawl in the tunnel as you like. We will also know how the locals make rice – paper and rice – wine. Ever wonder what it feels like to fire Ak- 47. Visit Cuchi Tunnel you have a chance to find out.
  • Comeback Ho Chi Minh city

Overnight at Ho Chi Minh City

itinerary.title: Mekong Delta ( B) join tour
itinerary.html:
Morning

  • An unforgettable way of seeing the Mekong Delta is to drive along the provincial roads in the Southern region of Vietnam through paddy rice- fields, pineapple plantation, orchard, and small hamlets. (one and a half hour driving).

7:30The tour guide and bus pick up you from the hotel then drive past rural area roads.

9:00 AM arrive in My tho city, the local motor boat will take you to go along Dragon Island, Unicorn Island, Phoenix Island, and Turtle Island. On the way, you can see the fishing port, Rach Mieu bridge, stilt house, and boat building workshop. We will stop at the famous Unicorn Island. Then you take a short trek to see the fruit gardens. You can also enjoy tropical fruits, natural honey tea, and wine at a bee farms and Vietnamese traditional music shows by the locals.

  • A rowing boat carries you slowly through the canals which cover a peaceful air and full of water- coconuts tree. After that, you continue your motor boat trip to Ben Tre province. Then transfer to a small motorboat and travel along the lush, green canals. Have lunch with India food

Afternoon

  • Moving to a local restaurant for Vietnamese lunch. After lunch You can ride the bikeBoat will take you back My Tho city. Then the bus will drive you back to Ho chi Minh city. On the way we stop at BONSAI garden to visit and have more experience. around the village and visit crocodile farm or take a rest on hammock.

itinerary.title: City Tour Ho Chi Minh( B) Join Tour
itinerary.html:
• Afterbreakfast and visit Independence Palace, also known as the Reunification palace, which was built on the sight of the former Norodom palace. The Independence palace is a widely known landmark of Ho Chi Minh City and was designed by the architect Ngo Viet Thu.

  • Continue seeing the beautiful structures from the French. Colonial times such as the Notre Dame Cathedral, and the historic Central Post Office. Followed by the remarkable site of the War Remnants Museum the museum has a vast display of both the Indochina wars.

Then head to the airport. End of the trip

itinerary.title: 欢迎来到河内 – 下龙湾 – 惊讶洞 – 天堂岛(Titop岛)（含早、午、晚餐）
itinerary.html:
抵达河内机场后，您的专属导游和司机将在机场迎接您前往河内，提前办理酒店入住，享用早餐后乘巴士前往下龙湾

8h00：Cozy Bay Cruise的导游将到您位于河内老城区的酒店接您。

8h45：完成所有接客点后，经高速公路前往下龙湾

10h15：途中短暂休息20分钟。

12h00：抵达巡州岛码头。

12h30：登上Cozy Bay Cruise，享用迎宾饮品，并听取游船及安全须知简介。入住带空调的客舱。

13h00：游船巡游壮丽的下龙湾，一边欣赏海湾中迷人的奇石景观，一边享用越南传统菜肴特色午餐。

下午行程：

15h00：参观惊讶洞。

16h00：游船带您前往天堂岛(Titop岛)。岛顶观景台可将下龙湾全景尽收眼底，您也可以在浪漫的沙滩上畅游。

17h30：返回Cozy Bay Cruise，淋浴后在日光甲板上放松，坐在舒适的躺椅上观赏日落，品一杯鸡尾酒或读一本书，享受最梦幻的时刻。

18h00：参加日落欢迎派对及烹饪课，学习制作越南鲜春卷，并可品尝亲手制作的成果。

晚间休闲：

19h00：坐在海景窗边享用烧烤晚餐，感受浪漫的海湾夜色

20h30：晚餐后，为客人提供天然草药足浴，帮助缓解足部疲劳、排出毒素。

21h00：参加各种娱乐活动，如：钓鱿鱼、唱卡拉OK，或在日光甲板上放松

夜宿游船：干净的空调客舱。

itinerary.title: 下龙湾 – 珍珠养殖场 – 皮划艇 – 河内（含早、午餐）
itinerary.html:
6h00：清晨早起，在日光甲板上观赏日出。

7h00：品一杯茶或咖啡，欣赏海湾晨景。享用自助早餐！

7h45：参观下龙湾珍珠养殖场。下龙湾珍珠是越南最负盛名的珍珠，养殖和采收珍珠需要历时数年。

8h30：自行划皮划艇探索下龙湾。

9h30：办理退房，继续享受美妙的海湾巡游。

10h45：游船返回巡州岛码头途中享用午餐。

12h00：Cozy Bay Cruise停靠下龙湾码头，游客与船员道别，结束游船之旅。随后乘巴士经高速公路返回河内。

14h15：途中短暂休息。

15h30：抵达河内老城区的酒店。行程结束！

夜宿河内

itinerary.title: 河内市区游（含早餐）
itinerary.html:
早餐后，参加河内市区拼团游

08.45：抵达位于西湖金鱼岛上的镇国寺。这是河内最古老的寺庙，始建于6世纪。

09.30：参观胡志明纪念区，您有机会瞻仰胡志明主席的遗容，随后漫步花园，参观他在1954年至1969年间生活和工作过的两座故居。之后参观供奉观音菩萨的独柱寺——世界上独一无二的寺庙

  • 参观胡志明陵、寺庙、佛塔等场所时，请着装得体，遮盖肩膀至膝盖……
  • 胡志明陵逢周一和周五闭馆。
  • 胡志明陵每年至少闭馆2个月（6月15日至8月15日）进行年度维护，但仍可在外拍照并参观周边区域

11.15：参观越南民族学博物馆，了解生活在越南全国的54个民族的文化。特别说明：民族学博物馆逢周一闭馆，届时将改为参观越南妇女博物馆

12.45：在我们的餐厅享用午餐，品尝8道美味的越南菜肴。

14.00-14.15：继续参观文庙——越南第一所大学，建于11世纪

15.15：前往火炉监狱博物馆。这里最初是法国殖民者在印度支那关押政治犯的监狱，后来在越南战争期间被北越用来关押美国战俘。在那一时期，美国战俘称之为“河内希尔顿”

17.15：观看水上木偶戏

夜宿河内

itinerary.title: 河内 – 岘港（含早餐）
itinerary.html:
早餐后，前往内排机场，飞往岘港

下午参加拼团游，游览七亩椰林、会安夜市，乘坐会安灯笼船

夜宿岘港。

itinerary.title: 欢迎来到巴拿山（含早餐）拼团游
itinerary.html:
享用早餐后前往巴拿山

8h30：沿着越南中部最美的滨海公路——阮必成旅游路线前往巴拿山。沿途可欣赏顺福悬索桥（越南最长的悬索桥）、清滩及红滩（法国殖民者最早在岘港登陆的地方）。

9:00：抵达巴拿 – 梦溪缆车站，乘缆车前往DeBay站。沿途可欣赏白浪翻涌的梦溪瀑布、原始森林和红叶树。

9h30：参观金桥(佛手桥)，游览Le Jardin花园区，欣赏法式遗迹，如静心花园、法国拴马区、近百年的柚子树以及古别墅遗址。参观巴拿山灵应寺，瞻仰高27米的释迦牟尼佛像，游览鹿苑花园、观音阁。继续前往Gare Debay站，乘坐第二条缆车线登上巴拿山顶。

12h00 – 14h00：征服被誉为“城市屋脊”的主峰（Nui Chua），在海拔1,487米的地标处拍照留念。俯瞰岘港市和岘港湾全景，时而隐没于白色云海之下。离开主峰后，沿步道参观林中古别墅遗址、露天歌剧院遗址以及Debay吊桥……

导游带领团队游览世界第三大室内游乐园——FANTASY PARK（爱情摩天轮、SKIVER飞行员、火焰赛道、碰碰电车、鬼屋、迫击炮），以及风车、蜘蛛侠、自由落体塔……

15:00-15:30 乘缆车下山，返回岘港。

夜宿岘港

itinerary.title: 岘港市区游（含早餐）
itinerary.html:
• 享用早餐后，参观五行山——由五座石灰岩山组成，象征自然界的五行。您可以登上其中最大、最美的水山，探索山中的洞穴、

  • 寺庙和观景点。
  • 探索山茶半岛——一个拥有茂密森林、丰富野生动物和美丽海滩的自然保护区。您可以参观灵应寺和观音像，二者都是半岛上令人叹为观止的地标。灵应寺是越南最大的寺庙之一，而观音像则是越南同类佛像中最高的
  • 傍晚，您可以欣赏龙桥——一座造型独特、宛如巨龙横跨韩江的大桥。夜晚桥身亮起五彩灯光，周末时龙口还会喷火和喷水。您还可以漫步白藤街，这是一条热闹的滨江长廊，遍布咖啡馆、酒吧和餐厅

夜宿岘港

itinerary.title: 岘港 – 飞往胡志明市（含早餐）
itinerary.html:
早餐后前往机场，飞往胡志明市。

  • 办理酒店入住，下午参观古芝地道。古芝地道是一个全长200多公里、曲折蜿蜒的地下网络，是越南人民
  • 意志与创造力的象征。古芝距西贡约60公里，在1960年至1972年间曾是激烈的战场。
  • 参观古芝地道，您将了解游击队员如何挖掘地道、在地道中生活和战斗，体会坚强的意志如何对抗先进的武器。您将观看纪录片，参观自制武器、竹制陷阱等，还可以随意钻进地道体验。我们还将了解当地人如何制作米纸和米酒。是否想过开AK-47步枪是什么感觉？参观古芝地道，您将有机会一试。
  • 返回胡志明市

夜宿胡志明市

itinerary.title: 湄公河三角洲（含早餐）拼团游
itinerary.html:
上午

  • 沿着越南南部的省道驱车穿过稻田、菠萝种植园、果园和小村落，是游览湄公河三角洲令人难忘的方式（车程约一个半小时）。

7:30 导游和巴士到酒店接您，随后驱车穿过乡村道路。

9:00 AM 抵达美萩市，乘坐当地机动船游览龙岛、麟岛、凤岛和龟岛。沿途可看到渔港、拉缪桥、高脚屋和造船作坊。我们将在著名的麟岛停留，随后短途步行参观果园。您还可以在养蜂场品尝热带水果、天然蜂蜜茶和果酒，欣赏当地人表演的越南传统音乐。

  • 乘坐手划小船缓缓穿行于宁静的水道之间，两岸水椰林立。之后继续乘机动船前往槟知省，再换乘小型机动船穿行于郁郁葱葱的水道中。午餐享用印度菜

下午

  • 前往当地餐厅享用越南午餐。午餐后可以骑自行车，随后乘船返回美萩市，再乘巴士返回胡志明市。途中在盆景园停留参观体验，还可在村中漫步、参观鳄鱼养殖场或在吊床上休息。

itinerary.title: 胡志明市市区游（含早餐）拼团游
itinerary.html:
• 早餐后参观独立宫，又称统一宫，建于原诺罗敦宫旧址之上。统一宫是胡志明市著名的地标，由建筑师吴越书设计。

  • 继续欣赏法国殖民时期留下的精美建筑，如西贡圣母大教堂和历史悠久的中央邮局。随后参观著名的战争遗迹博物馆，馆内大量展示了两次印度支那战争的史料。

随后前往机场。行程结束

title.en: Ha Long – Ninh Binh – Sapa 8 Days 7 Nights Tour From Hanoi
title.zh: 河内出发：下龙湾 – 宁平 – 沙坝 8天7晚之旅

summary: Coming to Ha Long, tourists can experience kayaking to admire the beautiful scenery of the bay, continue the journey to Ninh Binh, tourists can visit the sacred pagoda, famous landscapes, come to Sapa to enjoy cloud hunting, see the fresh flowers, experience the culture of the highlands of ethnic minorities in the…
route: Xin Chao! Welcome to Hanoi & City Tour
Ha Noi - Ha Long Bay – Shared Tour
Ha Long Bay - Ha Noi
Ha Noi – Ninh Binh- Ha Noi – Private Tour
Ha Noi –Sapa – Cat Cat Village- Shared Sleeping Bus
Sapa- Lao Chai- Ta Van Villages
Sapa –Ha Noi City
Ha Noi City Airport Tranfer

itinerary.title: Xin Chao! Welcome to Hanoi & City Tour
itinerary.html:
Upon arrival at Noi Bai Airport, our car and tour guide will pick you up and take you directly to your hotel in the center of Hanoi. (Check-in time is from 2:00 pm. If the room is available, check-in time may be earlier).

13:30 the guide and driver pick up you to visit city tour.

  • The car takes guests to visit Tran Quoc Pagoda located on the east side of West Lake (Tay Ho district), one of the ancient pagodas with a historical development process of 1500 years. Guests can admire the peaceful landscape.
  • You will visit the Ho Chi Minh Relic Site (Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum and Stilt House), you will have the opportunity to learn about Uncle Ho’s simple life. In addition, visit the Presidential Palace, One Pillar Pagoda to admire one of the Four Symbols of Hanoi.
  • Continue to Hoan Kiem Lake in the center of Hanoi with Turtle Tower, Ngoc Son Temple (viewed from outside for photo taking). In addition, you can explore traditional Vietnamese architecture and French colonial architecture through the buildings around the lake. You can spend time walking around Hanoi Old Quarter to see the daily activities of Hanoi people.

Overnight in Ha Noi.

itinerary.title: Ha Noi - Ha Long Bay – Shared Tour ( B, L,d )
itinerary.html:
Morning

  • After breakfast, your tour guide will pick you up and depart for a tour of Ha Long Bay, passing through the rich fields of the Red River Delta to the legendary Ha Long Bay, where you will board a traditional Vietnamese Sailboat, where you will spend the evening. The limestone mountains…
  • Arriving in Ha Long, you will board the boat, be welcomed with fruits, and receive safety instructions on the cruise, and depart to visit the bay.

Afternoon

  • After lunch on board, you will sunbathe on the deck and enjoy the tranquility of the bay.
  • Visit the Grotte des Surprises Cave and let yourself drift through the beautiful limestone formations containing thousands of stalactites and stalagmites.
  • The boat takes you through the islands, taking in the views of deserted bays, white sand beaches and floating villages.
  • Enjoy onboard activities and take in the stunning views of the Bay or indulge in a spa treatment on board or swim in the crystal clear waters.
  • At the end of the day, you will sail to the overnight anchorage where you will have the opportunity to attend a chef’s cooking demonstration or enjoy a mesmerizing sunset on deck before a sumptuous dinner.
  • In the evening you can watch a movie or join the crew in squid fishing before returning to your room to rest.

Overnight on board in Halong Bay

itinerary.title: Ha Long Bay - Ha Noi ( B, L )
itinerary.html:
Morning

  • Tai Chi is a great way to start your day, following local customs. Take a cooking class on the Junk with professional chefs, then enjoy a scenic kayak ride.
  • Back to the Junk boat. Check out of the cabin and then enjoy a full brunch buffet as you cruise back to port. Disembark around midday for your return to Hanoi.

Overnight in Ha Noi

itinerary.title: Ha Noi – Ninh Binh- Ha Noi – Private Tour ( B, L)
itinerary.html:
Morning

  • The car takes guests to Ninh Binh, a wild landscape, with mountain views and underground streams or mysterious caves.
  • Arriving in Ninh Binh, you will visit Trang An eco-tourism area (the third Unesco world heritage on your list) to visit caves conquering high peaks and quiet streams. Take a sampan boat to explore the caves, arches and spectacular grottoes of Trang An, including Sang Cave, Toi Cave, Ba Giot Cave and Sinh Cave.

Afternoon

  • After lunch, visit Hoa Lu, the former capital of Vietnam dating back to the 11th century with stunning scenery.
  • Immerse yourself in history at the two remaining temples of King Dinh and King Le. Renovated in the 17th century, the temples are believed to have been built on the original foundations of older palaces from the 11th and 12th centuries.
  • You will cycle to see the majestic mountains along the small roads. Then you will reach Hang Mua Mountain, where you can walk or enjoy the view of the Ngo Dong River below cutting through the towering mountains.
  • At the end of the afternoon. You go back the hotel in Ha Noi.

Overnight in Ha Noi

itinerary.title: Ha Noi –Sapa – Cat Cat Village- Shared Sleeping Bus ( B, L )
itinerary.html:
Coming to Sapa, you can walk to see the colorful flowers or visit villages to experience the unique culture.

6.30 AM: The guide and driver pick up you from the hotel and depart to Sapa.

  • The car takes you to Lao Cai on the highway, on the way the car stops for you to enjoy the scenery for about 20 minutes, then departs for Lao Cai, you can enjoy the fresh natural scenery from the valley or the golden terraced fields.

12:30: Arrive in Sapa. Enjoy the lunch with local Vietnamese dishes.check in hotel.

14.30: You will walk to Cat Cat village, home to the Black H’mong people and located near the foot of a deep valley at the foot of Fansipan peak. The local guide will show you the daily activities of the local people, walk down the valley to the waterfall where the French built the Hydroelectric Plant, a short time to take pictures with the bridge and the waterfall then you will walk up the hill back to Sapa with beautiful natural scenery in the late afternoon. The walking distance is about 3.0 km and lasts for 2 hours.

17.00: Walking back to Sapa Town. Have dinner and go around to see night activities.

Overnight in Sapa

itinerary.title: Sapa- Lao Chai- Ta Van Villages ( B, L )
itinerary.html:
7.00 – 7.45: Have breakfast at hotel and prepare light pack for trekking

8.00: A short drive to Y Linh Ho then trek through the rice terraces and along Muong Hoa Stream to the Black Hmong village of Lao Chai and Ta Van to see the spectacular landscape of Hoang Lien Son Mountain and learn about culture and custom of Black Mong and Dzay people. Trekking distance is about 9 kms and it lasts for 3.5 hours

11.30: Return to Sapa town for lunch and rest until 2pm, take the cable car to the top of the mountain to explore the roof of Indochina – Fansipan peak. Return to town.

Overnight in Sapa.

itinerary.title: Sapa –Ha Noi City ( B, L )
itinerary.html:
You will have breakfast. Then walk up to visit Dragon Head Park to see the whole view of the town and the valley. You will also have the opportunity to admire the beautiful landscape and many kinds of flowers.

11: 30 you check out the room. Go to restaurant for lunch. Then get on the sleeping bus go back Ha Noi .

Overnight in Hue city.

itinerary.title: Ha Noi City Airport Tranfer ( B )
itinerary.html: Breakfast, relax until get on the bus to go to the airport fof flight home.

zh.summary: 来到下龙湾，游客可以体验划皮划艇，欣赏海湾美景；继续前往宁平，参观神圣的寺庙和著名景点；来到沙坝追云赏花，体验高原少数民族的独特文化……
route: Xin Chao！欢迎来到河内 & 市区游
河内 – 下龙湾 – 拼团游
下龙湾 – 河内
河内 – 宁平 – 河内 – 私人游
河内 – 沙坝 – 猫猫村 – 拼车卧铺巴士
沙坝 – 老寨 – 达湾村
沙坝 – 河内
河内机场送机

itinerary.title: Xin Chao！欢迎来到河内 & 市区游
itinerary.html:
抵达内排机场后，我们的车辆和导游将接您直接前往河内市中心的酒店。（入住时间为下午2:00起，如有空房可提前入住。）

13:30 导游和司机接您开始市区游览。

  • 乘车前往位于西湖东岸（西湖郡）的镇国寺，这是一座拥有1500年历史的古寺。您可以在此欣赏宁静的景色。
  • 参观胡志明遗迹区（胡志明陵和高脚屋），了解胡伯伯简朴的一生。此外还将参观主席府，以及河内四大象征之一的独柱寺。
  • 继续前往河内市中心的还剑湖，欣赏龟塔和玉山祠（在外部拍照）。您还可以通过湖畔的建筑探索越南传统建筑与法国殖民时期建筑。您可以在河内老城区漫步，感受河内人的日常生活。

夜宿河内。

itinerary.title: 河内 – 下龙湾 – 拼团游（含早、午、晚餐）
itinerary.html:
上午

  • 早餐后，导游接您出发游览下龙湾。途经红河三角洲富饶的田野，前往传说中的下龙湾，登上越南传统帆船，并在船上过夜。石灰岩群山……
  • 抵达下龙湾后登船，享用迎宾水果，听取游船安全须知，随后启航游览海湾。

下午

  • 在船上享用午餐后，您可以在甲板上晒日光浴，享受海湾的宁静。
  • 参观惊讶洞，徜徉于美丽的石灰岩景观之中，洞内有成千上万的钟乳石和石笋。
  • 游船穿行于岛屿之间，沿途可欣赏幽静的海湾、白沙滩和水上村落。
  • 参加船上活动，欣赏海湾的壮丽景色，或享受船上水疗服务，或在清澈的海水中畅游。
  • 傍晚，游船驶往过夜锚地，您可以观看厨师烹饪示范，或在甲板上欣赏迷人的日落，随后享用丰盛的晚餐。
  • 晚上您可以观看电影，或与船员一起钓鱿鱼，之后返回客舱休息。

夜宿下龙湾游船

itinerary.title: 下龙湾 – 河内（含早、午餐）
itinerary.html:
上午

  • 入乡随俗，以太极拳开启美好的一天。在帆船上跟随专业厨师上一堂烹饪课，然后划皮划艇欣赏美景。
  • 返回帆船，退房后在游船返港途中享用丰盛的自助早午餐。中午前后下船，返回河内。

夜宿河内

itinerary.title: 河内 – 宁平 – 河内 – 私人游（含早、午餐）
itinerary.html:
上午

  • 乘车前往宁平，这里风光原始，群山环绕，有地下溪流和神秘的洞穴。
  • 抵达宁平后，参观长安生态旅游区（您行程中的第三处联合国教科文组织世界遗产），探访洞穴，饱览高耸的山峰和宁静的溪流。乘坐舢板船探索长安的洞穴、石拱和壮观的岩洞，包括光洞、暗洞、Ba Giot洞和Sinh洞。

下午

  • 午餐后，参观华闾古都——越南11世纪时的古都，风景秀丽迷人。
  • 参观仅存的丁王祠和黎王祠，沉浸于历史之中。两座祠庙于17世纪重修，据信建在11至12世纪古宫殿的原址之上。
  • 沿着乡间小路骑行，欣赏雄伟的群山。随后抵达舞洞山，您可以徒步登山，俯瞰蜿蜒穿过巍峨群山的吴同河。
  • 傍晚时分返回河内的酒店。

夜宿河内

itinerary.title: 河内 – 沙坝 – 猫猫村 – 拼车卧铺巴士（含早、午餐）
itinerary.html:
来到沙坝，您可以漫步观赏五彩缤纷的花朵，或走访村寨体验独特的民族文化。

6.30 AM：导游和司机到酒店接您，出发前往沙坝。

  • 车辆沿高速公路前往老街，途中停车约20分钟供您欣赏风景，随后继续前往老街，沿途可欣赏山谷中清新的自然风光或金黄的梯田。

12:30：抵达沙坝。享用越南地方菜午餐，办理酒店入住。

14.30：步行前往猫猫村。这里是黑苗族的聚居地，位于番西邦峰脚下的深谷附近。当地导游将带您了解村民的日常生活，沿山谷而下前往法国人修建水电站的瀑布，在桥边和瀑布前短暂拍照，然后步行上山返回沙坝，沿途欣赏傍晚美丽的自然风光。步行距离约3.0公里，历时约2小时。

17.00：步行返回沙坝镇。享用晚餐，并四处逛逛，感受夜间活动。

夜宿沙坝

itinerary.title: 沙坝 – 老寨 – 达湾村（含早、午餐）
itinerary.html:
7.00 – 7.45：在酒店享用早餐，准备轻便行装开始徒步

8.00：短途车程前往Y Linh Ho，然后徒步穿过梯田，沿着孟花溪前往黑苗族村寨老寨和达湾，欣赏黄连山的壮丽景色，了解黑苗族和瑶族（Dzay）的文化与习俗。徒步距离约9公里，历时约3.5小时

11.30：返回沙坝镇享用午餐并休息至下午2点，之后乘缆车登顶，探索“印度支那屋脊”——番西邦峰。返回镇上。

夜宿沙坝。

itinerary.title: 沙坝 – 河内（含早、午餐）
itinerary.html:
享用早餐后，步行登上龙头公园（咸龙山），俯瞰小镇和山谷全景。您还将有机会欣赏美丽的风景和各种花卉。

11: 30 办理退房，前往餐厅享用午餐。随后乘卧铺巴士返回河内。

夜宿河内。

itinerary.title: 河内机场送机（含早餐）
itinerary.html: 享用早餐，休息放松，之后乘车前往机场搭乘回程航班。

title.en: Da Nang – Phu Quoc Tour 8 Days 7 Nights
title.zh: 岘港 – 富国岛 8天7晚之旅

summary: Discover the beauty of Da Nang Phu Quoc 8 days 7 nights, visitors will visit the scenic areas of Ba Na, Ngu Hanh Son, Cu Lao Cham... or go to the pearl island to visit historical sites such as Phu Quoc Prison, and experience life with fishermen on the island such as night squid fishing, or how to grow pepper, make…
route: Welcome to Ha Noi- Hanoi City Tour
HA NOI – Ha Long Bay
Back to Hanoi
Ha Noi-Da Nang, Vietnam
Welcome to Bana Hills
DA NANG- Phu Quoc
4-island of Phu Quoc
Goodbye!

itinerary.title: Welcome to Ha Noi- Hanoi City Tour( B)
itinerary.html:
Upon arrival at Noi Bai Airport, the company’s private car and tour guide will pick you up, take you to the hotel in Hanoi, rest for about 2 hours (3* hotel/3* hotel near the airport), have breakfast, then visit Hanoi:

  • Visit Ho Chi Minh relic site (Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum and Stilt House) – Where the great leader lived and worked until the last years of his life. You will learn about Uncle Ho’s simple life, visit the Presidential Palace, One Pillar Pagoda to admire one of the four symbols of Hanoi.
    Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum
    Lotte Observation Deck
    Hoan Kiem Lake
  • You will visit the Imperial Citadel of Thang Long, a complex of relics associated with the history of Thang Long – Dong Kinh and Hanoi city from the pre-Thang Long period (An Nam domination in the 7th century) through the Dinh – Tien Le period, developed under the Ly, Tran, Le dynasties and Hanoi citadel under the Nguyen dynasty, a massive architectural work, built by kings through many historical periods, now becoming one of the most important relics in the system of Vietnamese relics…

overnight in Hanoi

itinerary.title: HA NOI – Ha Long Bay ( Meal B,L,D)
itinerary.html:
Have breakfast, then head to Ha Long Bay ( english driver only, no guide on the car)

  • Arriving in Ha Long, you will board a sailing boat for a tour, and will be welcomed with fruit and given an introduction to the tour itinerary and safety instructions on the boat.

Afternoon

  • Enjoy lunch on board, sunbathe on the deck and enjoy the tranquillity of the bay. Visit the Grotto “Grotte des Surprises”, a hidden gem of Mother Nature, see limestone formations with stunning natural stalactites and stalagmites.
  • You will sail through the islands, admire the scenery of the bay, and the famous landmarks or small villages nestled in the peaceful landscape.
  • You will participate in activities on board and admire the scenery of the Bay, enjoy the spa services on board or swim in the clear blue water.
  • At the end of the day, you will sail to the overnight anchorage to watch the sunset and the beauty of the Bay at night, and attend the cooking demonstration of the onboard chef.
  • In the evening, you can watch a movie or join the crew in squid fishing before returning to your room.

Note: If time permits, we strongly recommend staying an extra night on board to have more time to relax and enjoy the beautiful scenery. You will be sailing deeper into the Bay, where it is more beautiful and less crowded.

Overnight on Cruise in Ha Long Bay

itinerary.title: Back to Hanoi( B, L)
itinerary.html:
Morning

  • Join Tai Chi exercises and join local experts on the Junk deck for a morning class about Halong Bay, hop on a kayak and paddle around the lagoon, admiring the stunning views
  • Return to the Junk. Check out of your cabin and then enjoy a late breakfast buffet before you sail back to port. Disembark around noon and board the bus back to Hanoi.

Overnight in Ha Noi

itinerary.title: Ha Noi-Da Nang, Vietnam (B)
itinerary.html:
Have breakfast, go to Noi Bai airport, fly to Da Nang.

  • In the afternoon visit Coconut forest, then head to Hoi An Ancient Town

Overnight in Da Nang

itinerary.title: Welcome to Bana Hills (B)
itinerary.html:
7:30 – 8:30: Car and tour guide pick up you at the hotel go to Ba Na hills

8h30:The car will take you to Ba Na Hills along the coastal route. Visit Thuan Phuoc suspension bridge (the longest suspension bridge in Vietnam), Bai Thanh, Bai Do (where the first French colonists landed in Da Nang).

9:00: Arriving at Ba Na – Suoi Mo cable car station, you take the cable car to DeBay station. Admire Suoi Mo with white foam in the middle of the cool green primeval forest.

9h30: You will visit the Golden Bridge, Le Jardin area with French relics such as Tinh Tam Garden, French horse riding area, nearly 100-year-old grapefruit tree, ancient villa relic, Linh Ung Ba Na Pagoda, admire the 27m high Buddha statue, visit Loc Uyen Garden, Quan Am Cac.

Continue to Gare Deand bay take the 2nd cable line to the top of Ba Na.

12h00 – 14h00: You will conquer the top of Chua Mountain at an altitude of 1,487m, from above you can see the whole view of Da Nang city. Leaving the top of Chua Mountain, follow the trail to visit the ancient villa in the forest, the outdoor Opera House, Debay Suspension Bridge…

  • The tour guide takes the delegation to visit: The world’s third largest indoor amusement park called FANTASY PARK (Love wheel, SKIVER pilot, Fire race track, Tramcar crash, Haunted house, Mortar). Windmill, Spider-Man, Free-falling Tower…

15:00-15:30 Get off the cable car back to Da Nang.

Overnight in Da Nang

itinerary.title: DA NANG- Phu Quoc ( Meal B)
itinerary.html:
Go to the airport for a flight to Phu Quoc

  • In the afternoon, you, along with our guide and driver, will go to Phu Quoc prison.
  • The car will take you to Sunset Sanato Beach Club, to see the unique scenery, clean beach, white sand. Sunset Sanato has many miniature models such as “elephants” walking on the sea, jellyfish flying on the shore, “human head” entrance,… The unique beauty of Phu Quoc.
  • In the evening, you can admire the beauty of the Grand World Phu Quoc Musical Fountain. You can enjoy the show “Quintessence of Vietnam” (cost not included).

Overnight in Phu Quoc.

itinerary.title: 4-island of Phu Quoc ( private cano)
itinerary.html:
You will go sightseeing in Phu Quoc and visit 4 islands in one day by speedboat.

09:00 The guide pick you up at the hotel lobby for an island tour

  • Arrived at the harbor – board our boat
  • First stop for Fishing near “Pineapple Island”
  • Visit the famous “Finger Nail Island” to relax and swim
  • Enjoy “Dam Ngang island is Gam Ghi island“ snorkeling at the coral reef
  • Discover “May Rut Island” and enjoy lunch on the island
  • You can also take a ride on Hon Thom cable car – the world’s longest sea-crossing cable car line.

Overnight in Phu Quoc

itinerary.title: Goodbye!
itinerary.html: Have breakfast and go to Phu Quoc International Airport for a flight home.

zh.summary: 探索岘港与富国岛8天7晚之美：游客将游览巴拿山、五行山、占婆岛等名胜，或前往“珍珠岛”富国岛参观富国监狱等历史遗迹，体验岛上渔民的生活，如夜钓鱿鱼，了解胡椒种植、制作……
route: 欢迎来到河内 – 河内市区游
河内 – 下龙湾
返回河内
河内 – 岘港
欢迎来到巴拿山
岘港 – 富国岛
