itinerary.title: 欢迎来到河内 – 河内市区游（含早餐）
itinerary.html:
抵达内排机场后，公司专车和导游将接您前往河内的酒店，休息约2小时（3星酒店/机场附近3星酒店），享用早餐后游览河内：

  • 参观胡志明遗迹区（胡志明陵和高脚屋）——伟大领袖生前生活和工作直至晚年的地方。您将了解胡伯伯简朴的一生，参观主席府，以及河内四大象征之一的独柱寺。
    胡志明陵
    乐天观景台
    还剑湖
  • 参观升龙皇城——一处与升龙、东京及河内城历史紧密相连的遗迹群，历经前升龙时期（7世纪安南都护府时期）、丁朝和前黎朝，在李朝、陈朝、黎朝时期不断发展，直至阮朝时期的河内城。这座宏伟的建筑群由历代君王历经多个历史时期修建而成，如今已成为越南遗迹体系中最重要的遗迹之一……

夜宿河内

itinerary.title: 河内 – 下龙湾（含早、午、晚餐）
itinerary.html:
享用早餐后前往下龙湾（仅配英文司机，车上无导游）

  • 抵达下龙湾后登上帆船游览，享用迎宾水果，并听取行程介绍及船上安全须知。

下午

  • 在船上享用午餐，在甲板上晒日光浴，享受海湾的宁静。参观惊讶洞——大自然隐藏的瑰宝，欣赏石灰岩洞中令人惊叹的天然钟乳石和石笋。
  • 游船穿行于岛屿之间，您可欣赏海湾风光、著名地标以及隐匿于宁静山水间的小渔村。
  • 参加船上活动，欣赏海湾美景，享受船上水疗服务，或在碧蓝清澈的海水中畅游。
  • 傍晚，游船驶往过夜锚地，您可欣赏日落和海湾夜景，并观看船上厨师的烹饪示范。
  • 晚上您可以观看电影，或与船员一起钓鱿鱼，之后返回客舱休息。

注：如时间允许，我们强烈建议在船上多住一晚，以便有更多时间放松身心、欣赏美景。游船将驶入海湾更深处，那里风景更美，游客更少。

夜宿下龙湾游船

itinerary.title: 返回河内（含早、午餐）
itinerary.html:
上午

  • 参加太极晨练，并在帆船甲板上跟随当地专家上一堂有关下龙湾的晨间课程，然后乘皮划艇环游潟湖，欣赏壮丽美景
  • 返回帆船，退房后在返港途中享用自助早午餐。中午前后下船，乘巴士返回河内。

夜宿河内

itinerary.title: 河内 – 岘港（含早餐）
itinerary.html:
享用早餐后前往内排机场，飞往岘港。

  • 下午游览七亩椰林，随后前往会安古镇

夜宿岘港

itinerary.title: 欢迎来到巴拿山（含早餐）
itinerary.html:
7:30 – 8:30：车辆和导游到酒店接您前往巴拿山

8h30：车辆沿滨海公路前往巴拿山。途经顺福悬索桥（越南最长的悬索桥）、清滩、红滩（法国殖民者最早在岘港登陆的地方）。

9:00：抵达巴拿 – 梦溪缆车站，乘缆车前往DeBay站。欣赏清凉翠绿的原始森林中白浪翻涌的梦溪。

9h30：参观金桥(佛手桥)、Le Jardin花园区的法式遗迹，如静心花园、法国骑马区、近百年的柚子树、古别墅遗址，以及巴拿山灵应寺，瞻仰高27米的佛像，游览鹿苑花园、观音阁。

继续前往Gare Debay站，乘坐第二条缆车线登上巴拿山顶。

12h00 – 14h00：征服海拔1,487米的主峰（Chua山），从山顶俯瞰岘港市全景。离开主峰后，沿步道参观林中古别墅、露天歌剧院、Debay吊桥……

  • 导游带领团队游览世界第三大室内游乐园——FANTASY PARK（爱情摩天轮、SKIVER飞行员、火焰赛道、碰碰电车、鬼屋、迫击炮）。风车、蜘蛛侠、自由落体塔……

15:00-15:30 乘缆车下山，返回岘港。

夜宿岘港

itinerary.title: 岘港 – 富国岛（含早餐）
itinerary.html:
前往机场，飞往富国岛

  • 下午，在导游和司机的陪同下参观富国监狱。
  • 乘车前往Sunset Sanato Beach Club，欣赏独特的景观、洁净的海滩和白沙。Sunset Sanato有许多微缩造型，如在海上行走的“大象”、在岸边飞翔的水母、“人头”入口等……尽显富国岛的独特之美。
  • 晚上，您可以欣赏富国岛大世界音乐喷泉的美景，还可以观看“越南精粹”演出（费用不含）。

夜宿富国岛。

itinerary.title: 富国岛四岛游（私人快艇）
itinerary.html:
您将在富国岛观光，乘快艇一日畅游4座岛屿。

09:00 导游在酒店大堂接您开始海岛游

  • 抵达码头，登船出发
  • 第一站：在“菠萝岛”附近钓鱼
  • 游览著名的“指甲岛”，放松身心、畅游大海
  • 前往“Dam Ngang岛（又称Gam Ghi岛）”，在珊瑚礁浮潜
  • 探索“May Rut岛”，并在岛上享用午餐
  • 您还可以乘坐香岛缆车——世界上最长的跨海缆车线路。

夜宿富国岛

itinerary.title: 再见！
itinerary.html: 享用早餐后前往富国国际机场，搭乘回程航班。

title.en: Nha Trang – Da Lat – Mui Ne – Mekong Delta – Ho Chi Minh
title.zh: 芽庄 – 大叻 – 美奈 – 湄公河三角洲 – 胡志明市

summary: Travelers will experience the vibrant seaside city of Nha Trang, the cool climate and flower filled hills of Da Lat, the golden sand dunes of Mui Ne, and the cultural richness of the Mekong Delta before concluding in Ho Chi Minh…
route: Arrival in Nha Trang – City Tour
Nha Trang – Da Lat
Da Lat Full Day Sightseeing
Da Lat – Mui Ne | Sunset Tour
Mui Ne – Mekong Delta – Ho Chi Minh City
Ho Chi Minh City – Free Time / Optional Exploration
Ho Chi Minh City – Departure

itinerary.title: Arrival in Nha Trang – City Tour
itinerary.html:
Meals: Lunch, Dinner | Overnight: Nha Trang

Upon arrival at Cam Ranh International Airport, you will be warmly welcomed by Vietlook Travel’s English-speaking guide and transferred by private car to Nha Trang city.

Enjoy lunch at a local restaurant, offering an introduction to the fresh and flavorful coastal cuisine of Nha Trang.

In the afternoon, begin a gentle city exploration:

  • Local Coffee Experience: Relax at a local café and enjoy authentic Vietnamese coffee, a key part of daily life in Vietnam.

  • Nha Trang Cathedral (Stone Church): A French Gothic-style church located on a small hill, reflecting the city’s colonial heritage.

  • Po Nagar Cham Towers: An ancient Cham temple complex built before 781 A.D., representing the spiritual and architectural legacy of the Cham civilization.

  • Dam Market: The largest local market in Nha Trang, ideal for purchasing local specialties and souvenirs.

At 18:30, enjoy dinner at a local restaurant.

Free time in the evening.

Overnight in Nha Trang.

itinerary.title: Nha Trang – Da Lat
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner | Overnight: Da Lat

After breakfast, depart at 08:30 for Da Lat, traveling through scenic mountain roads and highland landscapes.

En route and upon arrival, visit:

  • Cau Dat Tea Plantation: A vast tea farm surrounded by rolling hills, famous for its fresh air and green scenery.

  • Linh Phuoc Pagoda: One of Da Lat’s most impressive Buddhist temples, entirely decorated with intricate mosaic artwork.

  • Da Lat Railway Station: Built in 1932 by French architects Moncet and Reveron, this is the oldest railway station in Vietnam.

  • Stairway to Heaven (Nấc Thang Lên Thiên Đường): A popular viewpoint and photo spot overlooking Da Lat’s countryside.

Lunch at a local restaurant.

In the afternoon:

  • Visit Xuan Huong Lake, Da Lat Square, enjoy coffee at Doha Coffee, and free time at Big C Supermarket.

  • Check in at your hotel in Da Lat.

Dinner at 18:00.

Optional visit to Da Lat Night Market.

Overnight in Da Lat.

itinerary.title: Da Lat Full Day Sightseeing
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner | Overnight: Da Lat

Breakfast at the hotel.

At 08:30, begin a full day of sightseeing:

  • Datanla Waterfall: A lively natural attraction with multiple small waterfalls, surrounded by pine forest (optional adventure activities available).

  • Tuyen Lam Lake: A peaceful lake set among pine-covered hills, offering beautiful scenery and fresh air.

  • Happy Hills: A scenic lakeside area ideal for photography and relaxation.

  • Hydrangea Flower Farm: Expansive hillside flower fields showcasing Da Lat’s most iconic blooms.

Lunch at a local restaurant.

In the afternoon:

  • Van Thanh Flower Village: One of Da Lat’s largest flower-growing villages, famous for roses and vegetables.

  • Hoa Son Dien Trang: A popular eco-tourism site known for its forest setting and unique photo spots.

  • Mê Linh Coffee Farm: Enjoy coffee while overlooking coffee plantations and countryside views.

Dinner at a local restaurant.

Overnight in Da Lat.

itinerary.title: Da Lat – Mui Ne | Sunset Tour
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner | Overnight: Mui Ne

Breakfast at the hotel.

Check out at 08:30 and transfer to Mui Ne by private car.

Arrive around 12:00, enjoy lunch at a local restaurant, then check in and relax.

At 15:00, join the Mui Ne sunset tour:

  • Fairy Stream: A shallow stream surrounded by colorful sand formations in shades of red, white, orange, and pink.

  • Mui Ne Fishing Village: Observe daily coastal life, fishing boats, and local fishermen at work.

  • Red Sand Dunes: Gentle slopes offering beautiful sunset views and excellent photo opportunities.

At 18:00, enjoy a BBQ seafood dinner at a local restaurant.

Return to hotel.

Overnight in Mui Ne.

itinerary.title: Mui Ne – Mekong Delta – Ho Chi Minh City
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner | Overnight: Ho Chi Minh City

After breakfast, depart at 07:30 for the Mekong Delta.

Arrive in My Tho and enjoy lunch at a local restaurant.

In the afternoon:

  • Board a motorboat to Phoenix Island (Con Phung).

  • Take a horse cart ride to a cultural performance area to enjoy Đờn Ca Tài Tử, a traditional Southern Vietnamese folk music recognized by UNESCO, along with seasonal tropical fruits.

  • Cruise on a traditional hand-rowing boat through narrow canals shaded by coconut trees.

  • Visit a bee-keeping farm to taste honey tea.

  • Stop at a coconut candy workshop to learn about local handicrafts.

At 17:00, return to Ho Chi Minh City by private car.

Dinner at a local restaurant.

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City.

itinerary.title: Ho Chi Minh City – Free Time / Optional Exploration
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast

Breakfast at the hotel.

Free day at leisure for shopping, walking around the city, or optional tours.

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City.

itinerary.title: Ho Chi Minh City – Departure
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast

Breakfast at the hotel.

Private transfer to the airport for your departure.

zh.summary: 游客将领略活力四射的海滨城市芽庄、气候凉爽且花开满山的大叻、美奈的金色沙丘，以及文化底蕴深厚的湄公河三角洲，最后在胡志明市结束旅程……

itinerary.title: 抵达芽庄 – 市区游
itinerary.html:
餐食：午餐、晚餐 | 住宿：芽庄

抵达金兰国际机场后，Vietlook Travel的英文导游将热情迎接您，并乘专车送您前往芽庄市区。

在当地餐厅享用午餐，初尝芽庄新鲜美味的海滨风味。

下午开始轻松的市区游览：

  • 品味当地咖啡：在当地咖啡馆小憩，品尝正宗越南咖啡——越南人日常生活中不可或缺的一部分。

  • 芽庄大教堂（石头教堂）：一座坐落在小山丘上的法式哥特风格教堂，见证了这座城市的殖民历史。

  • 婆那加占婆塔：始建于公元781年之前的古老占婆寺庙建筑群，体现了占婆文明的精神与建筑遗产。

  • 芽庄坝市场：芽庄最大的本地市场，是选购地方特产和纪念品的理想之地。

18:30在当地餐厅享用晚餐。

晚间自由活动。

夜宿芽庄。

itinerary.title: 芽庄 – 大叻
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐、午餐、晚餐 | 住宿：大叻

早餐后，08:30出发前往大叻，沿途穿越风景秀丽的山路和高原风光。

途中及抵达后参观：

  • Cau Dat茶园：被连绵起伏的山丘环绕的广阔茶园，以清新的空气和满目翠绿闻名。

  • 灵福寺：大叻最令人惊叹的佛教寺庙之一，整座寺庙以精美繁复的马赛克艺术装饰。

  • 大叻火车站：由法国建筑师Moncet和Reveron于1932年设计建造，是越南最古老的火车站。

  • 天堂之梯（Nấc Thang Lên Thiên Đường）：热门观景点和拍照打卡地，可俯瞰大叻乡村风光。

在当地餐厅享用午餐。

下午：

  • 游览春香湖、大叻广场，在Doha Coffee品尝咖啡，并在Big C超市自由活动。

  • 办理大叻酒店入住。

18:00享用晚餐。

可自选前往大叻夜市。

夜宿大叻。

itinerary.title: 大叻全天观光
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐、午餐、晚餐 | 住宿：大叻

在酒店享用早餐。

08:30开始全天观光：

  • 达坦拉瀑布：由多个小瀑布组成的热门自然景点，四周松林环绕（可自选探险活动）。

  • 宣林湖：坐落于松林覆盖的山丘之间的宁静湖泊，风景优美，空气清新。

  • Happy Hills：风景秀丽的湖畔景区，适合拍照和休闲放松。

  • 绣球花农场：山坡上广阔的花田，展示大叻最具代表性的花卉。

在当地餐厅享用午餐。

下午：

  • 万城花村：大叻最大的花卉种植村之一，以玫瑰和蔬菜闻名。

  • Hoa Son Dien Trang：热门生态旅游景区，以森林环境和独特的拍照点著称。

  • Mê Linh咖啡农场：一边品尝咖啡，一边俯瞰咖啡种植园和田园风光。

在当地餐厅享用晚餐。

夜宿大叻。

itinerary.title: 大叻 – 美奈 | 日落之旅
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐、午餐、晚餐 | 住宿：美奈

在酒店享用早餐。

08:30退房，乘专车前往美奈。

约12:00抵达，在当地餐厅享用午餐，随后办理入住并休息。

15:00参加美奈日落之旅：

  • 仙女溪：一条浅浅的小溪，两旁环绕着红、白、橙、粉等多种色彩的砂岩景观。

  • 美奈渔村：观察海滨日常生活，欣赏渔船和正在劳作的当地渔民。

  • 红沙丘：平缓的沙坡，可欣赏美丽的日落，是绝佳的拍照胜地。

18:00在当地餐厅享用海鲜烧烤晚餐。

返回酒店。

夜宿美奈。

itinerary.title: 美奈 – 湄公河三角洲 – 胡志明市
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐、午餐、晚餐 | 住宿：胡志明市

早餐后，07:30出发前往湄公河三角洲。

抵达美萩，在当地餐厅享用午餐。

下午：

  • 乘机动船前往凤岛（Con Phung）。

  • 乘坐马车前往文化表演区，欣赏被联合国教科文组织列入非物质文化遗产的越南南部传统民间音乐——才子弹唱（Đờn Ca Tài Tử），并品尝时令热带水果。

  • 乘坐传统手划船，穿行于椰林掩映的狭窄水道之间。

  • 参观养蜂场，品尝蜂蜜茶。

  • 参观椰子糖作坊，了解当地手工艺。

17:00乘专车返回胡志明市。

在当地餐厅享用晚餐。

夜宿胡志明市。

在酒店享用早餐。

全天自由活动，可购物、在城市中漫步或参加自选行程。

title.en: Nha Trang – Da Lat – Mui Ne – Ho Chi Minh City
title.zh: 芽庄 – 大叻 – 美奈 – 胡志明市

summary: Nha Trang – Da Lat – Mui Ne – Ho Chi Minh City itinerary is one of our signature programs, carefully designed to showcase Vietnam’s diverse landscapes,…
route: Arrival in Nha Trang – City Tour
Nha Trang – Da Lat
Da Lat Full Day Sightseeing
Da Lat – Mui Ne | Sunset Tour
Mui Ne – Ho Chi Minh City | City Tour
Ho Chi Minh City – Departure

itinerary.title: Arrival in Nha Trang – City Tour
itinerary.html:
Meals: Lunch, Dinner | Overnight: Nha Trang

Upon arrival at Cam Ranh International Airport, you will be warmly welcomed by Vietlook Travel’s English-speaking guide and transferred by private vehicle to Nha Trang city. After enjoying lunch at a local restaurant, the journey begins with an introduction to the city’s cultural and historical highlights.

  • Po Nagar Cham Towers: An ancient Cham religious complex dating back to before 781 A.D., showcasing unique architecture and spiritual significance.

  • Long Son Pagoda: A peaceful Buddhist site famous for its giant white Buddha statue and panoramic views over Nha Trang.

  • Nha Trang Cathedral: A French Gothic-style church built during the colonial period, representing the city’s architectural heritage.

After the tour, check in to your hotel and relax.
Dinner will be served at a local restaurant in the evening.
You may explore Nha Trang Night Market on your own before resting overnight.

itinerary.title: Nha Trang – Da Lat (Scenic Drive)
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner | Overnight: Da Lat

After breakfast, depart for Da Lat City by private car. The journey offers scenic views of mountains, forests, and rural landscapes.

Upon arrival in Da Lat, enjoy lunch before starting an afternoon city tour:

  • Van Thanh Flower Village: The largest flower-growing area in Da Lat, well known for its rose cultivation.

  • Crazy House: A uniquely designed architectural attraction, reflecting artistic creativity and fantasy.

  • Domaine de Marie Church: A peaceful hilltop church featuring French colonial architecture and beautiful surroundings.

  • Da Lat Railway Station: The oldest railway station in Vietnam, built in 1932, notable for its distinctive design.

Visit Da Lat Square and enjoy free time for coffee or shopping before checking in at the hotel.

Dinner at a local restaurant.

Optional visit to Da Lat Night Market.

Overnight in Da Lat.

itinerary.title: Da Lat Full Day Sightseeing
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner | Overnight: Da Lat

After breakfast, begin a full day exploring Da Lat’s natural beauty and spiritual landmarks:

  • Linh Phuoc Pagoda: A remarkable Buddhist temple decorated entirely with colorful mosaic materials.

  • Hydrangea Flower Farm: Vast flower fields thriving in Da Lat’s cool climate.

  • Stairway to Heaven: A popular viewpoint offering scenic photos of the surrounding landscape.

Lunch at a local restaurant.

In the afternoon:

  • Datanla Waterfall: A beautiful natural site surrounded by pine forest.

  • Robin Hill Cable Car: A scenic ride overlooking Da Lat’s highland scenery.

  • Truc Lam Zen Monastery: A tranquil monastery located near Tuyen Lam Lake.

  • Happy Hills: A peaceful lakeside area ideal for photography.

Dinner at a local restaurant.

Free evening at leisure.

Overnight in Da Lat.

itinerary.title: Da Lat – Mui Ne | Sunset Tour
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner | Overnight: Mui Ne

After breakfast, check out and travel from the Central Highlands to the coastal town of Mui Ne.

Upon arrival, enjoy lunch and check in at the hotel.
In the afternoon, join a sunset tour:

  • Fairy Stream: A gentle walk through shallow water surrounded by colorful sand formations.

  • Mui Ne Fishing Village: Observe the daily life of local fishermen along the coast.

  • Red Sand Dunes: A perfect spot to admire the sunset over the dunes.

Dinner with BBQ seafood at a local restaurant.

Overnight in Mui Ne.

itinerary.title: Mui Ne – Ho Chi Minh City | City Tour
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch | Overnight: Ho Chi Minh City

After breakfast, check out and visit:

  • White Sand Dunes: A spectacular desert-like landscape. Optional jeep or quad bike ride available at extra cost.

Transfer to Ho Chi Minh City.
Lunch at a local restaurant, followed by a city tour:

  • Notre Dame Cathedral

  • Central Post Office

  • Tan Dinh (Pink) Church

Check in at the hotel.

Free time for shopping, walking tours, or relaxation.

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City.

itinerary.title: Ho Chi Minh City – Departure
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast

Breakfast at the hotel.

Private transfer to the airport approximately 2.5 hours before departure.

itinerary.title: 抵达芽庄 – 市区游
itinerary.html:
餐食：午餐、晚餐 | 住宿：芽庄

抵达金兰国际机场后，Vietlook Travel的英文导游将热情迎接您，并乘专车送您前往芽庄市区。在当地餐厅享用午餐后，旅程正式开始，带您领略这座城市的文化与历史亮点。

  • 婆那加占婆塔：始建于公元781年之前的古老占婆宗教建筑群，建筑独特，具有重要的精神意义。

  • 龙山寺：一处宁静的佛教圣地，以巨大的白色佛像和俯瞰芽庄全景的视野而闻名。

  • 芽庄大教堂：建于殖民时期的法式哥特风格教堂，代表着这座城市的建筑遗产。

游览结束后，办理酒店入住并休息。
晚上在当地餐厅享用晚餐。
休息前您可自行逛逛芽庄夜市。

itinerary.title: 芽庄 – 大叻（沿途风光之旅）
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐、午餐、晚餐 | 住宿：大叻

早餐后，乘专车前往大叻市。沿途可欣赏山峦、森林和田园风光。

抵达大叻后享用午餐，下午开始市区游览：

  • 万城花村：大叻最大的花卉种植区，以玫瑰种植闻名。

  • 疯狂屋（Crazy House）：设计独特的建筑景点，充满艺术创意与奇幻色彩。

  • Domaine de Marie教堂：一座宁静的山顶教堂，具有法国殖民时期建筑风格，周边环境优美。

  • 大叻火车站：越南最古老的火车站，建于1932年，设计独具特色。

游览大叻广场，自由活动喝咖啡或购物，随后办理酒店入住。

在当地餐厅享用晚餐。

可自选前往大叻夜市。

夜宿大叻。

itinerary.title: 大叻全天观光
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐、午餐、晚餐 | 住宿：大叻

早餐后，开始全天游览，探索大叻的自然美景与宗教地标：

  • 灵福寺：一座令人惊叹的佛教寺庙，整座寺庙以五彩缤纷的马赛克材料装饰。

  • 绣球花农场：在大叻凉爽气候中盛放的广阔花田。

  • 天堂之梯：热门观景点，可拍摄周边美景。

在当地餐厅享用午餐。

下午：

  • 达坦拉瀑布：被松林环绕的美丽自然景点。

  • 罗宾山缆车：乘缆车俯瞰大叻高原风光。

  • 竹林禅院：位于宣林湖附近的一座宁静禅院。

  • Happy Hills：宁静的湖畔景区，适合拍照。

在当地餐厅享用晚餐。

晚间自由活动。

夜宿大叻。

itinerary.title: 大叻 – 美奈 | 日落之旅
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐、午餐、晚餐 | 住宿：美奈

早餐后退房，从西原地区前往海滨小镇美奈。

抵达后享用午餐并办理酒店入住。
下午参加日落之旅：

  • 仙女溪：沿着浅浅的溪水轻松漫步，两旁环绕着色彩斑斓的砂岩景观。

  • 美奈渔村：观察海边当地渔民的日常生活。

  • 红沙丘：欣赏沙丘日落的绝佳地点。

在当地餐厅享用海鲜烧烤晚餐。

夜宿美奈。

itinerary.title: 美奈 – 胡志明市 | 市区游
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐、午餐 | 住宿：胡志明市

早餐后退房，参观：

  • 白沙丘：宛如沙漠般的壮观景色。可自费选择吉普车或沙滩摩托体验。

前往胡志明市。
在当地餐厅享用午餐，随后进行市区游览：

  • 西贡圣母大教堂

  • 中央邮局

  • 新定教堂（粉红教堂）

办理酒店入住。

自由活动，可购物、步行游览或休息放松。

title.en: Hanoi – Ha Long – Ninh Binh – Sapa
title.zh: 河内 – 下龙湾 – 宁平 – 沙坝

summary: This tour 6 day, 5-night Hanoi – Ha Long – Ninh Binh – Sapa package is designed for travelers who want to experience the very best of Northern Vietnam in…
route: Welcome to Hanoi – Half Day City Tour
Hanoi – Ninh Binh – Hoa Lu – Trang An – Mua Cave
Ha Long Bay Day Cruise
Sapa – Fansipan Peak – Ta Van Village
Cat Cat Village – Hanoi
Departure from Hanoi

itinerary.title: Welcome to Hanoi – Half Day City Tour
itinerary.html:
Upon arrival at Noi Bai Airport, our representative will welcome you and transfer you to the hotel for check-in and relaxation.

In the afternoon, your guide will pick you up for a 4 hour Hanoi city tour, including:

  • Ho Chi Minh’s Mausoleum (outside)
    The mausoleum is clad in grey granite, supported by rows of square columns, with the words “CHỦ TỊCH HỒ CHÍ MINH” prominently displayed. The surrounding grounds are planted with trees and flowers from across Vietnam, making this one of the capital’s most meaningful historical and cultural symbols.

  • Tran Quoc Pagoda
    Located on a small island on West Lake’s southeastern shore, this 1,500-year-old pagoda is considered the oldest in Thang Long – Hanoi and was once the Buddhist center during the Ly and Tran dynasties. Its architecture harmoniously blends solemnity, antiquity, and natural lakeside beauty.

  • Train Street
    A unique 200-meter-long street tightly flanked by residential houses. When the train passes, you will experience the thrilling feeling of being just about one meter away, making it one of Hanoi’s most iconic photo and experience spots.

  • Water Puppet Show
    A traditional Vietnamese art form performed entirely on water. Each show lasts 45–60 minutes, with wooden puppets as the “actors”, accompanied by live music, sound effects, and lighting, creating a lively and captivating performance.

After the tour, you will enjoy a complimentary Vietnamese hair washing experience or body massage package.

itinerary.title: Hanoi – Ninh Binh – Hoa Lu – Trang An – Mua Cave
itinerary.html:
07:00 – Pick-up from your hotel in the Old Quarter or the Hanoi Opera House and depart for Ninh Binh.

10:00 – Hoa Lu Ancient Citadel

Visit the former capital of Vietnam in the 11th century. The ancient ruins, partly reclaimed by nature, create a mystical atmosphere. Explore the temples of Kings Dinh and Le, restored in the 17th century but believed to be on the original foundations of the royal palaces from the 11th–12th centuries.

After local lunch (around 13:30) – Depart for Trang An, a UNESCO-recognized eco-tourism complex:

  • Explore a 250-million-year-old limestone system with flooded forests, towering karst peaks, and cultural relics.

  • Enjoy a peaceful boat trip through caves and along emerald rivers, passing spectacular limestone cliffs and lush landscapes.

15:30 – Mua Cave

Climb nearly 500 stone steps to the summit. At the top, a tower in traditional Vietnamese style crowns the mountain. From here, take in the panoramic view of rice fields, winding rivers, and karst mountains – one of the most beautiful viewpoints in Ninh Binh.

Return to Hanoi.

itinerary.title: Ha Long Bay Day Cruise
itinerary.html:
08:00–08:45 – Hotel Pick-up

Your English-speaking guide will collect you from various hotels around Hanoi Old Quarter (timing approximate due to traffic).

11:45–12:00 – Boarding the Cruise

Arrive at Tuan Chau Marina, board the cruise from our private pier where the crew will warmly welcome you.

12:00–13:30 – Lunch on Board

Cruise out into the heart of Ha Long Bay, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Sail past iconic limestone islands such as Dog Rock, Duck Rock, and Thumb Rock, a tall islet shaped like a giant thumb.

Enjoy a buffet lunch with a variety of seafood and Vietnamese dishes.

13:30–14:30 – Explore Sung Sot (Surprise) Cave

Stop at Bo Hon Island and walk up around 200 steps under the forest canopy to the entrance of Sung Sot Cave, the largest and most beautiful cave in Ha Long Bay. Spend about 45 minutes exploring its impressive chambers.

(Guests who prefer not to walk can stay on board and relax on the sundeck or in the jacuzzi.)

14:30–15:30 – Kayaking / Rowboat

Head to Luon Cave. Here you can:

  • Go kayaking for about 30 minutes, or

  • Sit on a rowboat paddled by locals to admire the limestone cliffs and peaceful water.

15:30–16:30 – Titop Island

Stop at Titop Island, where you can climb halfway up for a panoramic view of Ha Long Bay. This viewpoint offers one of the most stunning vistas of the bay.

17:00 – Sunset Party

Enjoy complimentary wine, Vietnamese tea, fresh fruit, and small cakes while cruising back. Watch the sky change colors as the sun sets over the bay.

18:00 – Disembark and return to Hanoi by limousine bus.

You will be dropped off in the Old Quarter to have dinner or explore by yourself.

Around 21:00, a sleeper bus will pick you up to depart for Sapa.

Overnight on the sleeping bus.

itinerary.title: Sapa – Fansipan Peak – Ta Van Village
itinerary.html:
05:30 – Arrive in Sapa, early check-in at your pre-booked hotel and rest.

10:00–10:30 – Your guide will pick you up to visit Fansipan:

  • Transfer to the Cable Car Station and take a 20-minute cable car ride, enjoying breathtaking views of the Hoang Lien Son mountain range.

  • Reach an altitude of about 2,800 meters, where you can:

    • Explore the pagoda complex and spiritual sites.

    • Climb around 600 steps to the summit of Fansipan – “The Roof of Indochina”.

    • Spend about 1.5 hours for photos and sightseeing.

After that, visit Ta Van Village, about 12 km from Sapa town:

  • This is home to the Black H’Mong and Red Dao ethnic minorities, each with distinct languages, houses, and customs.

  • The village lies in Muong Hoa Valley, the largest valley in Sapa along the Hoang Lien Son range.

  • While Sapa town is lively and busy, Ta Van offers a peaceful, rural atmosphere with:

    • Vast terraced rice fields covering hillsides

    • The sound of flowing streams and singing birds

itinerary.title: Cat Cat Village – Hanoi
itinerary.html:
Morning: Breakfast at the hotel, then your guide will take you to Cat Cat Village:

  • Take a short walk to Cat Cat, a village of the Black H’Mong people located in a deep valley at the foot of Fansipan Peak.

  • Observe daily life, traditional handicrafts, and local culture.

  • Trek down to the waterfall and old French Hydraulic Power Station, stop for photos at the bridge and waterfall.

  • Trek back uphill to Sapa with beautiful scenery along the way (trekking distance approx. 2.5 km, about 2 hours).

After the tour, you will return to Hanoi by sleeper bus.

Upon arrival in Hanoi, check in to the hotel and enjoy free time.

zh.summary: 这条河内 – 下龙湾 – 宁平 – 沙坝6天5晚套餐专为希望在有限时间内体验越南北部精华的旅行者而设计……
route: 欢迎来到河内 – 半日市区游
河内 – 宁平 – 华闾古都 – 长安 – 舞洞山
下龙湾一日游船
沙坝 – 番西邦峰 – 达湾村
猫猫村 – 河内
河内离境
highlights: 出行时段：9月1日 – 次年3月31日

itinerary.title: 欢迎来到河内 – 半日市区游
itinerary.html:
抵达内排机场后，我们的工作人员将迎接您并送您前往酒店办理入住，休息放松。

下午，导游将接您开始4小时河内市区游，包括：

  • 胡志明陵（外观）
    陵墓外墙以灰色花岗岩砌成，由一排排方柱支撑，正面醒目地镌刻着“CHỦ TỊCH HỒ CHÍ MINH”（胡志明主席）字样。陵墓四周种植着来自越南各地的树木和花卉，是首都最具意义的历史文化象征之一。

  • 镇国寺
    镇国寺坐落于西湖东南岸的一座小岛上，已有1500年历史，被视为升龙 – 河内最古老的寺庙，曾是李朝和陈朝时期的佛教中心。其建筑将庄严、古朴与湖畔的自然美景和谐融为一体。

  • 火车街
    一条长约200米的独特街道，两侧民居紧密相邻。火车驶过时，您将体验与列车仅约一米之遥的惊险刺激，这里是河内最具标志性的拍照和体验地之一。

  • 水上木偶戏
    一种完全在水上表演的越南传统艺术。每场演出持续45–60分钟，以木偶为“演员”，配以现场音乐、音效和灯光，表演生动有趣、引人入胜。

游览结束后，您将免费享受一次越式洗头体验或全身按摩套餐。

itinerary.title: 河内 – 宁平 – 华闾古都 – 长安 – 舞洞山
itinerary.html:
07:00 – 从您位于老城区的酒店或河内大剧院接您，出发前往宁平。

10:00 – 华闾古都

参观越南11世纪时的古都。部分已被大自然重新覆盖的古老遗址营造出一种神秘的氛围。探访丁王祠和黎王祠，两座祠庙于17世纪重修，据信建在11至12世纪王宫的原址之上。

享用当地午餐后（约13:30） – 前往联合国教科文组织认定的生态旅游区长安：

  • 探索拥有2.5亿年历史的石灰岩地貌，这里有水淹森林、高耸的喀斯特山峰和文化遗迹。

  • 享受宁静的乘船游览，穿过洞穴、沿着碧绿的河流前行，途经壮观的石灰岩峭壁和郁郁葱葱的风景。

15:30 – 舞洞山

攀登近500级石阶登顶。山顶矗立着一座越南传统风格的塔亭。在这里可将稻田、蜿蜒的河流和喀斯特群山的全景尽收眼底——这是宁平最美的观景点之一。

返回河内。

itinerary.title: 下龙湾一日游船
itinerary.html:
08:00–08:45 – 酒店接送

您的英文导游将到河内老城区各酒店接您（因交通状况，时间仅供参考）。

11:45–12:00 – 登船

抵达巡州岛码头，从我们的专属码头登船，船员将热情欢迎您。

12:00–13:30 – 船上午餐

游船驶入联合国教科文组织世界遗产下龙湾的腹地，途经标志性的石灰岩岛屿，如狗石、鸭石和拇指石——一座形似巨大拇指的高耸小岛。

享用自助午餐，品尝各式海鲜和越南菜肴。

13:30–14:30 – 探索惊讶洞

在Bo Hon岛停靠，在林荫下攀登约200级台阶到达惊讶洞洞口。惊讶洞是下龙湾最大、最美的溶洞。花约45分钟探索洞内令人震撼的洞厅。

（不想步行的游客可留在船上，在日光甲板或按摩浴缸中休闲放松。）

14:30–15:30 – 皮划艇 / 手划船

前往Luon洞，在这里您可以：

  • 划皮划艇约30分钟，或

  • 乘坐当地人划的手划船，欣赏石灰岩峭壁和宁静的水面。

15:30–16:30 – 天堂岛(Titop岛)

在天堂岛(Titop岛)停靠，您可以爬到半山腰俯瞰下龙湾全景。这一观景点可欣赏到海湾最令人惊叹的美景之一。

17:00 – 日落派对

返航途中免费享用葡萄酒、越南茶、新鲜水果和小点心。观赏夕阳西下时海湾上空变幻的色彩。

18:00 – 下船，乘豪华商务车返回河内。

您将在老城区下车，自行享用晚餐或自由探索。

约21:00，卧铺巴士接您出发前往沙坝。

夜宿卧铺巴士。

itinerary.title: 沙坝 – 番西邦峰 – 达湾村
itinerary.html:
05:30 – 抵达沙坝，在预订的酒店提前入住并休息。

10:00–10:30 – 导游接您游览番西邦峰：

  • 前往缆车站，乘坐20分钟缆车，欣赏黄连山山脉的壮丽景色。

  • 抵达海拔约2,800米处，您可以：

    • 探访寺庙建筑群及宗教圣地。

    • 攀登约600级台阶，登上番西邦峰顶——“印度支那屋脊”。

    • 花约1.5小时拍照观光。

随后参观距沙坝镇约12公里的达湾村：

  • 这里是黑苗族和红瑶族少数民族的家园，各民族有着不同的语言、房屋和习俗。

  • 村庄位于孟花谷，这是沙坝境内沿黄连山山脉最大的山谷。

  • 与热闹繁忙的沙坝镇不同，达湾村拥有宁静的田园氛围：

    • 漫山遍野的广阔梯田

    • 潺潺溪流与婉转鸟鸣

itinerary.title: 猫猫村 – 河内
itinerary.html:
上午：在酒店享用早餐，随后导游带您前往猫猫村：

  • 短途步行前往猫猫村，这是黑苗族人的村寨，位于番西邦峰脚下的深谷之中。

  • 观察当地人的日常生活、传统手工艺和地方文化。

  • 徒步下行至瀑布和法国人修建的旧水电站，在桥边和瀑布前停留拍照。

  • 徒步上坡返回沙坝，沿途风景优美（徒步距离约2.5公里，约2小时）。

游览结束后，乘卧铺巴士返回河内。

抵达河内后，办理酒店入住，自由活动。

itinerary.title: 河内离境
itinerary.html: 早餐后自由活动，直至专车接您前往机场搭乘后续航班。

title.en: Ha Giang – Cao Bang – Ban Gioc Waterfall – Ba Be Lake
title.zh: 河江 – 高平 – 板约瀑布 – 三海湖

summary: Ha Giang – Cao Bang – Ban Gioc – Ba Be Lake Easy Rider tour is perfect for travelers who want to go deeper into Vietnam’s wild and mountainous…
route: Ha Giang City – Bac Sum Slope – Quan Ba Heaven Gate – Twin Mountains – Yen Minh – Tham Ma Slope – H’Mong King Palace – Dong Van
Dong Van – Volunteer Youth Monument – Ma Pi Leng Pass – Nho Que River Viewpoint – Meo Vac – Bao Lac
Bao Lac – Me Pia Slope – Phia Thap Village
Phia Thap – Nguom Ngao Cave – Ban Gioc Waterfall – Cao Bang City
Cao Bang – Ba Be Lake – Pac Ngoi Village
Ba Be – Boat Trip on Ba Be Lake – Hanoi

itinerary.title: Ha Giang City – Bac Sum Slope – Quan Ba Heaven Gate – Twin Mountains – Yen Minh – Tham Ma Slope – H’Mong King Palace – Dong Van
itinerary.html:
Meals: Lunch, Dinner

After breakfast at the homestay, your Easy Rider team will brief you on safety and the route, then the adventure begins.

  • Ride out of Ha Giang into the mountains – the scenery changes quickly from town to towering limestone peaks.

  • Stop at Bac Sum Slope for panoramic views and a short drink break.

  • Continue through Dong Van Karst Plateau Geopark – a UNESCO-recognized area full of rice terraces, rock formations and hidden valleys.

  • Visit Quan Ba Heaven Gate and the famous Twin Mountains (Fairy Bosom Hills) – a classic Ha Giang viewpoint.

  • Lunch at a local restaurant in Yen Minh Town.

  • In the afternoon, continue to Tham Ma Slope, a winding mountain road with impressive views.

  • Visit the historic H’Mong King Palace (Vuong family residence), an important cultural and architectural site.

  • Arrive in Dong Van Town, check into homestay, have dinner and free time to explore the Old Quarter (if time allows).
    Overnight in Dong Van.

itinerary.title: Dong Van – Volunteer Youth Monument – Ma Pi Leng Pass – Nho Que River Viewpoint – Meo Vac – Bao Lac
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

One of the most spectacular days of the trip.

  • After breakfast, ride from Dong Van towards Mã Pí Lèng Pass on the Happiness Road between Dong Van and Meo Vac.

  • Stop at the Volunteer Youth Monument and multiple viewpoints along the pass.

  • Ride the Sky Path to admire the full view of deep canyons and the turquoise Nho Quế River below. This is one of the most iconic sceneries in all of Vietnam.

  • Take time for photo stops and to soak in the mountainous landscape.

  • Continue through Meo Vac Town, then ride further into Cao Bang province along remote mountain trails.

  • Reach Bao Lac Town, home to many ethnic groups (including Tay, Nung, H’Mong, etc.).

  • Check in to a Tay family homestay, enjoy a home-cooked dinner and “happy water” (local rice wine).
    Overnight in Bao Lac.

itinerary.title: Bao Lac – Me Pia Slope – Phia Thap Village
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

Today you ride approximately 130 km through some of the best scenery in Northeast Vietnam.

  • Depart Bao Lac towards Phia Thap Village.

  • Ride through vast forests, limestone mountains, valleys and small local villages.

  • Stop at Mẻ Pia Slope (Ma Pia) – a spectacular zig-zag mountain pass with dramatic views perfect for photos.

  • Enjoy the cool, fresh air of Cao Bang province, with scenic stops along the way.

  • Lunch en route at a local restaurant.

  • Afternoon ride to Phia Thap Village, known for its charming geo-cultural landscape and traditional life.

  • Check in at a local homestay, relax, and enjoy dinner with the host family.
    Overnight in Phia Thap.

itinerary.title: Phia Thap – Nguom Ngao Cave – Ban Gioc Waterfall – Cao Bang City
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

Nature day with cave and waterfall highlights.

  • Leave Phia Thap and head to Nguom Ngao Cave – one of Northern Vietnam’s most beautiful caves, featuring impressive stalactites and stalagmites.

  • Stop at viewpoints along the way to appreciate Northeast Vietnam’s hidden charm.

  • Continue riding to Ban Gioc Waterfall on the Vietnam–China border – the largest and one of the most stunning waterfalls in Vietnam.

  • Enjoy the sight of emerald water cascading over terraced rock formations surrounded by forested cliffs.

  • Optional: short bamboo raft ride to get closer to the falls (if available, at extra cost).

  • In the afternoon, ride back towards Cao Bang City.

  • Check in to accommodation in Cao Bang, dinner and free time.
    Overnight in Cao Bang.

itinerary.title: Cao Bang – Ba Be Lake – Pac Ngoi Village
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

  • After breakfast, depart Cao Bang for Ba Be National Park – famous for its combination of mountains, rivers, caves and one of Vietnam’s largest natural freshwater lakes.

  • Ride through mountain passes and rural villages on the way to Ba Be.

  • Arrive in Ba Be Lake area, set among high limestone ranges. The lake never runs dry, even in the dry season.

  • If time permits, you may take a short boat trip on Ba Be Lake or walk around the village.

  • Continue to Pac Ngoi Village, a peaceful Tay ethnic village beside the lake.

  • Check in at a traditional stilt house homestay, dinner and relax in the quiet countryside.
    Overnight in Ba Be.

itinerary.title: Ba Be – Boat Trip on Ba Be Lake – Hanoi
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch

  • After breakfast, enjoy trekking in Ba Be National Park – visit hidden villages, traditional Tay houses and explore the surrounding nature.

  • Later, take a boat trip on Ba Be Lake (if not done the previous day) to experience the calm water, limestone cliffs and lush forest.

  • Lunch at a local restaurant in Ba Be.

  • Tour ends in the early afternoon.

13:00 – Departure to Hanoi

  • Board a limousine bus from Ba Be at around 13:00.

  • Evening arrival back in Hanoi.
    End of tour.

included: Transportation Hanoi ↔ Ha Giang ↔ Ba Be ↔ Hanoi: Sleeper bus luxury private cabin (pick-up in Hanoi Old Quarter 19:30–20:00) Limousine bus (pick-up around Hanoi Old Quarter 15:00–15:30 for some routes / return from Ba Be at 13:00)
Sleeper bus luxury private cabin (pick-up in Hanoi Old Quarter 19:30–20:00)

All entry fees to indicated sites (caves, waterfalls, viewpoints…)
Protective gear: helmet, raincoat, basic protective equipment
Drinking water during the riding days (1 bottle/day)
excluded: Border entry permit for restricted areas (if required)

zh.summary: 河江 – 高平 – 板约瀑布 – 三海湖摩托车司机带骑之旅，非常适合希望深入探索越南原始山区的旅行者……
route: 河江市 – 北苏坡 – 管坝天门 – 双乳山 – 安明 – 三马坡 – 苗王宫 – 同文
同文 – 青年志愿者纪念碑 – 马皮冷山口 – 侬桂河观景点 – 苗旺 – 保乐
保乐 – 梅皮亚坡 – Phia Thap村
Phia Thap – 银鹅洞 – 板约瀑布 – 高平市
高平 – 三海湖 – Pac Ngoi村
三海 – 三海湖乘船游 – 河内
highlights: 河内 → 河江（卧铺巴士）

itinerary.title: 河江市 – 北苏坡 – 管坝天门 – 双乳山 – 安明 – 三马坡 – 苗王宫 – 同文
itinerary.html:
餐食：午餐、晚餐

在民宿享用早餐后，摩托车司机带骑团队将为您讲解安全须知和路线，随后开启冒险之旅。

  • 骑行驶出河江进入山区——景色迅速从城镇转换为高耸的石灰岩山峰。

  • 在北苏坡停留，饱览全景并短暂休息饮水。

  • 继续穿越同文喀斯特高原地质公园——联合国教科文组织认定的地质公园，遍布梯田、奇石和隐秘的山谷。

  • 游览管坝天门和著名的双乳山（仙女山）——河江的经典观景点。

  • 在安明镇的当地餐厅享用午餐。

  • 下午继续前往三马坡，这是一条蜿蜒的山路，景色令人震撼。

  • 参观历史悠久的苗王宫（王氏家族宅邸），这是一处重要的文化和建筑遗址。

  • 抵达同文镇，入住民宿，享用晚餐，并自由探索同文古街（如时间允许）。
    夜宿同文。

itinerary.title: 同文 – 青年志愿者纪念碑 – 马皮冷山口 – 侬桂河观景点 – 苗旺 – 保乐
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐、午餐、晚餐

本次旅程中最壮观的一天。

  • 早餐后，沿着连接同文与苗旺的“幸福之路”，从同文骑行前往马皮冷山口。

  • 在青年志愿者纪念碑及山口沿途多个观景点停留。

  • 骑行天空之路，俯瞰幽深的峡谷和谷底碧绿的侬桂河全景。这是全越南最具标志性的景色之一。

  • 停车拍照，尽情感受壮美的山区风光。

  • 继续穿过苗旺镇，然后沿着偏远的山间小路深入高平省。

  • 抵达保乐镇，这里聚居着岱依族、侬族、苗族等多个民族。

  • 入住岱依族家庭民宿，享用家常晚餐并品尝“快乐水”（当地米酒）。
    夜宿保乐。

itinerary.title: 保乐 – 梅皮亚坡 – Phia Thap村
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐、午餐、晚餐

今天您将骑行约130公里，穿越越南东北部最美的风景。

  • 从保乐出发前往Phia Thap村。

  • 骑行穿过广袤的森林、石灰岩山峰、山谷和当地小村落。

  • 在梅皮亚坡（Mẻ Pia / Ma Pia）停留——这是一段壮观的之字形山路，景色雄伟，是拍照的绝佳之地。

  • 享受高平省凉爽清新的空气，沿途在风景优美处停留。

  • 途中在当地餐厅享用午餐。

  • 下午骑行前往Phia Thap村，这里以迷人的地质文化景观和传统生活方式而闻名。

  • 入住当地民宿，休息放松，与接待家庭共进晚餐。
    夜宿Phia Thap。

itinerary.title: Phia Thap – 银鹅洞 – 板约瀑布 – 高平市
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐、午餐、晚餐

以溶洞和瀑布为亮点的自然之旅。

  • 离开Phia Thap，前往银鹅洞——越南北部最美的溶洞之一，洞内钟乳石和石笋蔚为壮观。

  • 沿途在观景点停留，欣赏越南东北部隐秘的魅力。

  • 继续骑行前往位于越中边境的板约瀑布——越南最大、也是最壮观的瀑布之一。

  • 欣赏碧绿的瀑布从层层叠叠的岩石上倾泻而下，四周峭壁林木葱茏。

  • 自选项目：乘坐竹筏近距离观赏瀑布（如开放，需额外付费）。

  • 下午骑行返回高平市。

  • 入住高平的住宿，享用晚餐并自由活动。
    夜宿高平。

itinerary.title: 高平 – 三海湖 – Pac Ngoi村
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐、午餐、晚餐

  • 早餐后，从高平出发前往三海国家公园——以山川、河流、溶洞交相辉映而闻名，拥有越南最大的天然淡水湖之一。

  • 骑行穿过山口和乡村，前往三海。

  • 抵达三海湖景区，湖泊坐落在高耸的石灰岩山脉之间，即使在旱季也从不干涸。

  • 如时间允许，您可以在三海湖上短途乘船游览，或在村中漫步。

  • 继续前往Pac Ngoi村——湖畔一座宁静的岱依族村寨。

  • 入住传统高脚屋民宿，享用晚餐，在宁静的乡村中放松身心。
    夜宿三海。

itinerary.title: 三海 – 三海湖乘船游 – 河内
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐、午餐

  • 早餐后，在三海国家公园徒步——探访隐秘的村落、传统岱依族房屋，探索周边的自然风光。

  • 随后乘船游览三海湖（如前一天未游览），感受平静的湖水、石灰岩峭壁和茂密的森林。

  • 在三海的当地餐厅享用午餐。

  • 行程于午后结束。

13:00 – 出发前往河内

  • 约13:00从三海乘坐豪华商务车出发。

  • 傍晚抵达河内。
    行程结束。

itinerary.title: Welcome to Hanoi – Half Day City Tour
itinerary.html:
Upon arrival at Noi Bai Airport, our representative will meet and transfer you to your hotel for check-in and rest.

In the afternoon, your guide will pick you up for a 4-hour Hanoi city tour:

  • Ho Chi Minh’s Mausoleum (outside) – admire the solemn grey-granite building and the large parade square planted with trees and flowers from all regions of Vietnam.

  • Tran Quoc Pagoda – the oldest pagoda in Hanoi, located on a small island on West Lake. Discover its 1,500-year history as a Buddhist center of the ancient Thang Long citadel and enjoy the tranquil lakeside setting.

  • Train Street – feel the unique atmosphere of this narrow residential street where the train passes just meters from the houses.

  • Water Puppet Show – enjoy a traditional Vietnamese art form performed on water with live music, sound effects and colorful lighting (45–60 minutes).

After the tour, you will receive a complimentary Vietnamese hair washing experience or body massage package.

itinerary.title: Hanoi – Ha Long Bay Overnight Cruise
itinerary.html:
Breakfast at the hotel.

  • The guide picks you up at the hotel lobby and you transfer by SIC bus to Ha Long Bay.

  • 11:30 – 12:00: Arrive at Tuan Chau Harbor, check in at the waiting lounge.

  • 12:00 – 12:10: Board the tender to your cruise, enjoy a welcome drink, meet the captain and crew, and receive a safety and itinerary briefing. Check in to your cabin.

  • 13:00 – 13:15: Enjoy a Vietnamese seafood & vegetarian lunch while cruising among the magnificent limestone karsts of Lan Ha – Ha Long Bay.

  • 15:00: Relax on the sundeck or explore the Ba Trai Dao / Tra Bau area and natural lagoon of Lan Ha Bay with kayaking.

  • 17:30 – 18:00: Return to the cruise for a sunset party – take photos and relax.

  • 19:00: Dinner on board. After dinner, you can try squid fishing, relax on the sundeck or enjoy a drink at the bar.

Overnight on the cruise.

itinerary.title: Ha Long Bay – Hanoi
itinerary.html:
• 06:00 – 06:15: Join a Tai Chi session on the sundeck.

  • 06:15 – 07:00: Light breakfast with tea/coffee while enjoying the morning scenery.

  • 07:00: Visit Dark & Light Cave by bamboo boat to explore the tranquil lagoon and limestone formations, or swim in the clear water (depending on weather and tide).

  • 08:10: Return to your cabin, relax and pack your luggage.

  • 10:00: Check out of the cabin. Enjoy an early lunch while the cruise heads back to the harbor.

  • 11:00: Take a high-speed canoe back to Tuan Chau Port and return to Hanoi by SIC bus.

Check in to your hotel and enjoy free time.

itinerary.title: Bat Trang – Chuong Conical Hat Village – Quang Phu Cau Incense Village
itinerary.html: 08:00: Your guide and driver pick you up from the Old Quarter or Hanoi Opera House.

itinerary.title: Ninh Binh – Hoa Lu – Trang An – Mua Cave
itinerary.html:
• 07:00: Pick-up from the Old Quarter or Hanoi Opera House and depart for Ninh Binh.

  • 10:00: Visit Hoa Lu Ancient Citadel, Vietnam’s capital in the 11th century. Explore the atmospheric ruins surrounded by dramatic karst scenery and visit the temples of Kings Dinh and Le, rebuilt in the 17th century on the original palace foundations.

  • After local lunch (around 13:30), continue to Trang An – a UNESCO-listed eco-tourism complex famous for its limestone mountains, flooded forests and cave systems.

    • Take a boat trip through caves and along tranquil rivers, surrounded by towering cliffs and lush greenery.

  • 15:30: Visit Mua Cave. Climb nearly 500 stone steps to the summit and the tower with traditional Vietnamese design. From the top, enjoy a panoramic view of Tam Coc, rice fields and karst mountains – one of the most spectacular viewpoints in Ninh Binh.

Return to Hanoi and drop off at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Departure from Hanoi
itinerary.html: Breakfast at the hotel. Free time until your driver picks you up for the airport transfer for your flight home.

highlights: 出行时段：9月1日 – 次年3月31日

itinerary.title: 欢迎来到河内 – 半日市区游
itinerary.html:
抵达内排机场后，我们的工作人员将迎接您并送您前往酒店办理入住、休息。

下午，导游将接您开始4小时河内市区游：

  • 胡志明陵（外观）——欣赏庄严的灰色花岗岩建筑，以及种满越南各地树木花卉的宽阔广场。

  • 镇国寺——河内最古老的寺庙，坐落于西湖的一座小岛上。了解它作为古升龙城佛教中心的1500年历史，享受宁静的湖畔风光。

  • 火车街——感受这条狭窄居民街的独特氛围，火车从距房屋仅数米处呼啸而过。

  • 水上木偶戏——欣赏在水上表演的越南传统艺术，配以现场音乐、音效和绚丽灯光（45–60分钟）。

游览结束后，您将免费享受一次越式洗头体验或全身按摩套餐。

itinerary.title: 河内 – 下龙湾游船过夜
itinerary.html:
在酒店享用早餐。

  • 导游在酒店大堂接您，乘拼车巴士（SIC）前往下龙湾。

  • 11:30 – 12:00：抵达巡州岛码头，在候船厅办理登船手续。

  • 12:00 – 12:10：乘接驳船登上游船，享用迎宾饮品，与船长和船员见面，听取安全及行程介绍。入住客舱。

  • 13:00 – 13:15：游船穿行于兰夏湾 – 下龙湾壮丽的石灰岩喀斯特山峰之间，享用越南海鲜及素食午餐。

  • 15:00：在日光甲板上放松，或划皮划艇探索兰夏湾的Ba Trai Dao / Tra Bau区域及天然潟湖。

  • 17:30 – 18:00：返回游船参加日落派对——拍照留念、休闲放松。

  • 19:00：在船上享用晚餐。晚餐后，您可以尝试钓鱿鱼，在日光甲板上放松，或在酒吧小酌一杯。

夜宿游船。

itinerary.title: 下龙湾 – 河内
itinerary.html:
• 06:00 – 06:15：在日光甲板上参加太极晨练。

  • 06:15 – 07:00：享用简单早餐和茶/咖啡，欣赏清晨美景。

  • 07:00：乘竹筏游览明暗洞，探索宁静的潟湖和石灰岩景观，或在清澈的海水中游泳（视天气和潮汐而定）。

  • 08:10：返回客舱，休息并整理行李。

  • 10:00：退房。游船返港途中享用早午餐。

  • 11:00：乘高速快艇返回巡州岛码头，再乘拼车巴士（SIC）返回河内。

办理酒店入住，自由活动。

itinerary.title: 钵场 – 钟村斗笠村 – 广富求制香村
itinerary.html: 08:00：导游和司机在老城区或河内大剧院接您。

itinerary.title: 宁平 – 华闾古都 – 长安 – 舞洞山
itinerary.html:
• 07:00：在老城区或河内大剧院接您，出发前往宁平。

  • 10:00：参观华闾古都——越南11世纪时的都城。探索被壮丽喀斯特风光环绕、充满历史氛围的遗址，参观丁王祠和黎王祠，两座祠庙于17世纪在原宫殿地基上重建。

  • 享用当地午餐后（约13:30），继续前往长安——列入联合国教科文组织名录的生态旅游区，以石灰岩山峰、水淹森林和洞穴系统而闻名。

    • 乘船游览，穿过洞穴，沿宁静的河流前行，四周峭壁高耸、绿意盎然。

  • 15:30：游览舞洞山。攀登近500级石阶登上山顶及越南传统风格的塔亭。在山顶可将三谷、稻田和喀斯特群山的全景尽收眼底——宁平最壮观的观景点之一。

返回河内，送回酒店。

itinerary.title: 河内离境
itinerary.html: 在酒店享用早餐。自由活动，直至司机接您送机，搭乘回程航班。

summary: This five day four night tour at Vietlook Travel combines southern Vietnam’s natural landscapes, cultural heritage, and historical landmarks. Travelers…
route: Mui Ne Sunset Tour

itinerary.title: Mui Ne Sunset Tour
itinerary.html:
Lunch included

Overnight in Mui Ne

Morning

Pick up at the airport and transfer to Mui Ne.

Noon

Lunch at a local restaurant. Check in at the hotel and relax.

Afternoon

At 03:15 PM, depart from the hotel for sightseeing.

Visit Fairy Stream, a spectacular natural site with vibrant orange-red stream water and unique sand formations.

Observe the daily life of fishermen at the Mui Ne Fishing Village. Boats return from the sea, women sort the catch, and the atmosphere reflects traditional coastal life.

Visit the Red Sand Dunes, which offer excellent photography opportunities with their striking red sand and gentle slopes.

Evening

At 06:00 PM, enjoy a fresh barbecue seafood dinner at a local restaurant. Free time in the evening.

Overnight in Mui Ne.

itinerary.title: Mui Ne Sunrise Tour – Ho Chi Minh City
itinerary.html:
Breakfast and lunch included

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City

Early Morning

At 05:30 AM, the tour guide and driver will pick you up for the sunrise tour at White Sand Dunes. Optional activities include quad bike rides, ostrich riding, and sand sliding (at personal expense).

Return to the hotel for breakfast and free time for swimming or relaxing at the resort.

Midday

Check out at 12:00 PM and have lunch before departing for Ho Chi Minh City.

Late Afternoon

Check in at the hotel in Ho Chi Minh City at 05:00 PM. Free time to explore Ben Thanh Night Market.

itinerary.title: Mekong Delta Tour
itinerary.html:
Breakfast and lunch included

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City

Morning

At 08:15 AM, depart from Ho Chi Minh City for My Tho city by private car.

Board a motorboat at the pier and cruise along the Mekong River. Observe floating houses and local fish farming activities.

Continue to Thoi Son Islet (Unicorn Island) and take a horse cart to a performance site to enjoy traditional Vietnamese music, “Đàn Ca Tài Tử,” recognized by UNESCO as Intangible Cultural Heritage. Seasonal tropical fruits will also be served.

Take a small hand-rowing boat along a creek lined with coconut trees to experience the Mekong Delta lifestyle. Visit a local bee farm and enjoy honey tea.

Noon

Lunch at a local restaurant. Visit a coconut candy workshop and sample freshly made candies.

Afternoon

Return to Ho Chi Minh City by private car. Free evening.

itinerary.title: Cu Chi Tunnels – Ho Chi Minh City City Tour
itinerary.html:
Breakfast and lunch included

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City

Morning

At 08:30 AM, depart for the Cu Chi Tunnels, approximately 60 kilometers from Ho Chi Minh City. Explore the extensive tunnel network used during the Vietnam War and learn about the history of the region. Optional shooting experience with rifles is available.

Noon

Lunch at a local restaurant.

Afternoon

Return to Ho Chi Minh City and enjoy a city tour: visit Ho Chi Minh City Hall, Nguyen Hue Walking Street, and Coffee Apartment for local coffee.

Visit the Pink Church, famous for its unique architecture and striking pink color.

Continue to Saigon Central Post Office, one of Asia’s grandest post offices. Learn about Vietnam’s cultural history and try sending mail the traditional way.

Evening

Free time to explore Ben Thanh Night Market near the hotel.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.html:
Breakfast included

Depending on your flight schedule, pick up at the hotel and transfer to the airport. The tour ends.

included: Private car pickup and drop off
Four nights accommodation in three-star hotels

zh.summary: Vietlook Travel推出的这条五天四晚线路，融合了越南南部的自然风光、文化遗产与历史名胜。旅客……
route: 美奈日落之旅
美奈日出之旅 – 胡志明市
湄公河三角洲之旅

itinerary.title: 美奈日落之旅
itinerary.html:
含午餐

夜宿美奈

上午

机场接机，前往美奈。

中午

在当地餐厅享用午餐。入住酒店休息。

下午

15:15从酒店出发观光。

游览仙女溪，这里溪水呈鲜艳的橙红色，沙土地貌独特，景色壮观。

前往美奈渔村，观察渔民的日常生活：渔船从海上归来，妇女们分拣渔获，处处洋溢着传统海滨生活的气息。

游览红沙丘，鲜艳的红沙与平缓的沙坡是绝佳的摄影胜地。

晚上

18:00在当地餐厅享用新鲜烧烤海鲜晚餐。晚间自由活动。

夜宿美奈。

itinerary.title: 美奈日出之旅 – 胡志明市
itinerary.html:
含早餐和午餐

夜宿胡志明市(西贡)

清晨

05:30导游和司机接您前往白沙丘观赏日出。可自费体验沙滩越野四轮摩托车、骑鸵鸟和滑沙等项目。

返回酒店享用早餐，之后自由活动，可在度假村游泳或休息。

中午

12:00退房，午餐后启程前往胡志明市。

傍晚

17:00入住胡志明市酒店。自由活动，可逛逛滨城夜市。

itinerary.title: 湄公河三角洲之旅
itinerary.html:
含早餐和午餐

夜宿胡志明市(西贡)

上午

08:15乘专车从胡志明市出发前往美萩市。

在码头登上摩托艇，畅游湄公河，观赏水上人家和当地的养鱼场。

继续前往泰山岛（麟岛），乘马车前往表演场地，欣赏被联合国教科文组织列为非物质文化遗产的越南传统音乐“才子弹唱”，并品尝当季热带水果。

乘坐手划小船穿行于椰林夹岸的小河道，体验湄公河三角洲的水乡生活。参观当地养蜂场，品尝蜂蜜茶。

中午

在当地餐厅享用午餐。参观椰子糖作坊，品尝新鲜出炉的椰子糖。

下午

乘专车返回胡志明市。晚间自由活动。

itinerary.title: 古芝地道 – 胡志明市市区游
itinerary.html:
含早餐和午餐

夜宿胡志明市(西贡)

上午

08:30出发前往距胡志明市约60公里的古芝地道。探索越战时期使用的庞大地道网络，了解当地历史。可自费体验步枪射击。

中午

在当地餐厅享用午餐。

下午

返回胡志明市进行市区游览：参观胡志明市人民委员会大楼、阮惠步行街，并到咖啡公寓品尝越南本地咖啡。

参观以独特建筑和醒目粉色外观闻名的粉红教堂。

继续前往亚洲最宏伟的邮局之一——西贡中央邮局，了解越南文化历史，并体验以传统方式寄送信件。

晚上

自由活动，可逛逛酒店附近的滨城夜市。

itinerary.title: 送机离境
itinerary.html:
含早餐

根据您的航班时间，从酒店接您前往机场。行程结束。

title.en: Ho Chi Minh City – Mui Ne – Vung Tau Tour
title.zh: 胡志明市 – 美奈 – 头顿之旅

summary: This five day, four night tour ( HCM - Mui Ne - Vung Tau Tour) offers a well balanced journey through southern Vietnam, combining vibrant city life,…
route: Ho Chi Minh City Tour
Ho Chi Minh City – Mui Ne Sunset Tour
Mui Ne Sunrise Tour – Ho Chi Minh City
Vung Tau Full Day Tour
Ho Chi Minh City Departure

itinerary.title: Ho Chi Minh City Tour
itinerary.html:
Lunch included

Morning

Your tour guide will pick you up at the airport and transfer you to the city center of Ho Chi Minh City.

Noon

Enjoy lunch at a local restaurant with Vietnamese beef noodle soup, known as pho.

Afternoon

Visit the Ho Chi Minh City People’s Committee building and walk along Nguyen Hue Walking Street. Stop at the Coffee Apartment to enjoy traditional Vietnamese coffee.

Continue to visit the Pink Church, one of the most famous architectural landmarks in the city, built in the mid nineteenth century in a European architectural style with its distinctive pink exterior.

Visit the Saigon Central Post Office, an outstanding example of European neoclassical architecture combined with Asian decorative elements.

View Notre Dame Cathedral, built in classical French architectural style and recognized for its cultural, historical, and religious significance.

Evening

Free time to explore Ben Thanh Night Market near the hotel.

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City.

itinerary.title: Ho Chi Minh City – Mui Ne Sunset Tour
itinerary.html:
Breakfast, lunch, and dinner included

Overnight in Mui Ne

Morning

Pick up at the hotel and depart for Mui Ne. The journey takes approximately four hours.

Noon

Have lunch at a local restaurant. Check in to the hotel and relax.

Afternoon

At 03:15 PM, depart from the hotel for sightseeing.

Visit Suoi Tien, a popular photo location known for its colorful sand formations in red, white, orange, and pink.

Visit the fishing village to observe the daily life of local fishermen, including boats returning from the sea and families sorting the catch.

Visit the Red Sand Dunes, where the gentle slopes and vibrant red sand create excellent photo opportunities, especially near sunset.

Evening

At 06:00 PM, enjoy a fresh barbecue seafood dinner at a local restaurant.

Free time in the evening.

Overnight in Mui Ne.

itinerary.title: Mui Ne Sunrise Tour – Ho Chi Minh City
itinerary.html:
Breakfast and lunch included

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City

Early Morning

At 05:30 AM, the tour guide and driver will pick you up for the sunrise tour.

Visit the White Sand Dunes to watch the sunrise. Optional activities such as quad bike riding, ostrich riding, and sand sliding are available at personal expense.

Return to the hotel for breakfast and free time to swim or relax at the resort.

Midday

At 12:00 PM, check out and have lunch before departing for Ho Chi Minh City.

Late Afternoon

At 05:00 PM, check in at the hotel in Ho Chi Minh City. Free time to explore Ben Thanh Night Market.

itinerary.title: Vung Tau Full Day Tour
itinerary.html:
Breakfast and lunch included

Morning

At 07:30 AM, depart from the hotel for Vung Tau City.

At 10:00 AM, arrive in Vung Tau and enjoy free time at Thuy Van Beach, also known as Back Beach, one of the most beautiful beaches in Vietnam with a coastline of nearly ten kilometers.

Noon

Have an authentic Vietnamese lunch at a local restaurant.

Afternoon

Visit the Jesus Christ Statue by walking up eight hundred and forty seven steps to reach the thirty two meter tall statue.

Adventurous visitors may climb inside the statue’s arms to enjoy panoramic views of Vung Tau City.

Visit Thang Tam Temple, also known as the Whale Temple, which reflects the coastal belief in the whale as a protector deity.

Continue to Bach Dinh, a colonial era mansion built in the early twentieth century as a retreat for the French Governor of Indochina.

Visit Cape Nghinh Phong, a scenic cliff area offering wide views of the city and the East Sea.

Evening

At 05:00 PM, return to Ho Chi Minh City.

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City.

itinerary.title: Ho Chi Minh City Departure
itinerary.html:
Breakfast included

After breakfast, pick up at the hotel and transfer to the airport.

included: Private car pickup and drop off
Three local lunches and one dinner
Four nights accommodation in three star hotels

zh.summary: 这条五天四晚的线路（胡志明市 – 美奈 – 头顿）带您均衡体验越南南部风情，将充满活力的都市生活……
route: 胡志明市市区游
胡志明市 – 美奈日落之旅
美奈日出之旅 – 胡志明市
头顿一日游
胡志明市送机离境

itinerary.title: 胡志明市市区游
itinerary.html:
含午餐

上午

导游机场接机，送您前往胡志明市市中心。

中午

在当地餐厅享用午餐，品尝越南牛肉河粉（Pho）。

下午

参观胡志明市人民委员会大楼，漫步阮惠步行街。在咖啡公寓小憩，品尝传统越南咖啡。

继续参观市内最著名的建筑地标之一——粉红教堂，教堂建于19世纪中叶，采用欧式建筑风格，粉色外观独具特色。

参观西贡中央邮局，这是欧洲新古典主义建筑与亚洲装饰元素相融合的杰出典范。

观赏西贡圣母大教堂，教堂采用法国古典建筑风格，具有重要的文化、历史和宗教意义。

晚上

自由活动，可逛逛酒店附近的滨城夜市。

夜宿胡志明市。

itinerary.title: 胡志明市 – 美奈日落之旅
itinerary.html:
含早、午、晚餐

夜宿美奈

上午

酒店接您出发前往美奈，车程约四小时。

中午

在当地餐厅享用午餐。入住酒店休息。

下午

15:15从酒店出发观光。

游览仙女溪，这里有红、白、橙、粉多彩的沙土地貌，是热门的拍照胜地。

参观渔村，观察当地渔民的日常生活，看渔船从海上归来、渔家分拣渔获。

游览红沙丘，平缓的沙坡与鲜艳的红沙构成绝佳的拍摄场景，日落时分尤为迷人。

晚上

18:00在当地餐厅享用新鲜烧烤海鲜晚餐。

晚间自由活动。

夜宿美奈。

itinerary.title: 美奈日出之旅 – 胡志明市
itinerary.html:
含早餐和午餐

夜宿胡志明市

清晨

05:30导游和司机接您开始日出之旅。

前往白沙丘观赏日出。可自费体验沙滩越野四轮摩托车、骑鸵鸟和滑沙等项目。

返回酒店享用早餐，之后自由活动，可在度假村游泳或休息。

中午

12:00退房，午餐后启程前往胡志明市。

傍晚

17:00入住胡志明市酒店。自由活动，可逛逛滨城夜市。

itinerary.title: 头顿一日游
itinerary.html:
含早餐和午餐

上午

07:30从酒店出发前往头顿市。

10:00抵达头顿，在瑞云海滩（又称后滩）自由活动。这里是越南最美的海滩之一，海岸线长近十公里。

中午

在当地餐厅享用地道的越南午餐。

下午

参观耶稣像：攀登847级台阶，抵达高32米的耶稣巨像。

喜欢冒险的游客还可以登上雕像手臂内部，俯瞰头顿全城风光。

参观八月庙（又称鲸鱼庙），这里体现了沿海居民将鲸鱼奉为守护神的信仰。

继续前往白宫（Bach Dinh），这座法属时期的宅邸建于20世纪初，曾是法属印度支那总督的度假行宫。

游览迎风角，这片风景秀丽的海崖可远眺城市和东海全景。

晚上

17:00返回胡志明市。

夜宿胡志明市。

itinerary.title: 胡志明市送机离境
itinerary.html:
含早餐

早餐后，从酒店接您前往机场。

included: 三顿当地午餐和一顿晚餐

title.en: Ha Giang – Cao Bang Easy Rider – 5 Days
title.zh: 河江 – 高平摩托车司机带骑之旅 – 5天

summary: This 5 day Ha Giang – Cao Bang Easy Rider tour is perfect for travelers seeking a deeper journey into Northern Vietnam. The route combines the world–famous…
route: Ha Giang City – Bac Sum Pass – Quan Ba Heaven Gate – Twin Mountains – Yen Minh – Tham Ma Slope – H’Mong King Palace – Dong Van
Dong Van – Volunteer Youth Monument – Ma Pi Leng Pass – Sky Path – Nho Que River Viewpoint – Meo Vac – Bao Lac
Bao Lac – Me Pia Slope – Phia Thap Village
Phia Thap – Nguom Ngao Cave – Ban Gioc Waterfall – Ban Gioc
Ban Gioc – God’s Eye Mountain – Cao Bang City → Hanoi

itinerary.title: Ha Giang City – Bac Sum Pass – Quan Ba Heaven Gate – Twin Mountains – Yen Minh – Tham Ma Slope – H’Mong King Palace – Dong Van
itinerary.html:
Meals: Lunch, Dinner

08:30 – Tour starts from our homestay in Ha Giang City.
Safety briefing with your Easy Riders before departure.

Highlights of the day:

  • Ride into the mountains with dramatic scenery changes

  • Stop at Bac Sum Pass for panoramic views

  • Visit Quan Ba Heaven Gate and admire the spectacular landscape

  • See the famous Twin Mountains (Fairy Bosom Hills)

  • Enjoy lunch in Yen Minh Town

In the afternoon, continue to:

  • Tham Ma Slope – an iconic winding mountain road and popular photo spot

  • H’Mong King Palace (Vuong Family Residence) – former royal residence of the H’Mong family

Arrive in Dong Van Town in the late afternoon.
Dinner and overnight in a local homestay.

itinerary.title: Dong Van – Volunteer Youth Monument – Ma Pi Leng Pass – Sky Path – Nho Que River Viewpoint – Meo Vac – Bao Lac
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

After breakfast, prepare for the most spectacular part of the Ha Giang Loop:

  • Ride along Ma Pi Leng Pass – known as the “King of Vietnam’s mountain passes”

  • Follow the Sky Path, overlooking the deep canyon and emerald Nho Que River

  • Stop at multiple viewpoints for unforgettable photos

Continue riding through rural villages:

  • Lung Ho

  • Mau Due

  • Meo Vac (lunch stop)

From Meo Vac, ride into the mountainous trail area of Cao Bang province and arrive at Bao Lac Town.
Dinner and overnight with a Tay ethnic family at a local homestay.

itinerary.title: Bao Lac – Me Pia Slope – Phia Thap Village
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

Today’s 130 km ride takes you through some of the most breathtaking landscapes in Northeast Vietnam:

  • Remote mountains and limestone formations

  • Peaceful ethnic minority villages

  • Misty passes and hidden valleys

Main stop:

  • Me Pia Slope – a dramatic zig–zag mountain pass with spectacular viewpoints

In the afternoon, continue to Phia Thap Village, known for its traditional craft culture and beautiful surroundings.
Check in at a local homestay. Dinner and overnight with the host family.

itinerary.title: Phia Thap – Nguom Ngao Cave – Ban Gioc Waterfall – Ban Gioc
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

A full day of natural wonders and scenic landscapes:

  • Visit Nguom Ngao Cave, one of the most impressive caves in Northern Vietnam

  • Make scenic photo stops along forested roads and mountain viewpoints

  • Ride through terraced rice fields and rolling mountain passes

Continue to:

  • Ban Gioc Waterfall – Vietnam’s most magnificent waterfall, located on the Vietnam–China border

    • Take a bamboo raft ride to approach the falls closer

    • Admire the towering cliffs, emerald water, and lush green surroundings

Overnight in the Ban Gioc area at a local homestay.

itinerary.title: Ban Gioc – God’s Eye Mountain – Cao Bang City → Hanoi
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch

After breakfast:

  • Depart Ban Gioc and ride to Thung Mountain, home to the iconic God’s Eye Mountain (Nui Thung)

  • Enjoy final scenic stops and viewpoints on the way back to Cao Bang City

Lunch at a local restaurant in Cao Bang.

12:30 – Board the limousine bus back to Hanoi.
End of tour upon arrival in Hanoi.

included: Transfer Hanoi ↔ Ha Giang ↔ Cao Bang ↔ Hanoi Luxury private–cabin sleeper bus Limousine bus
Free overnight at homestay in Ha Giang City (traditional house)
Accommodation: Private rooms in homestays during the tour
All entrance fees as per itinerary
Drinking water during the tour (1 bottle per person per day)
excluded: Personal drinks (coffee, beer, soft drinks, etc.)

zh.summary: 这条5天河江 – 高平摩托车司机带骑线路，非常适合希望深度探索越南北部的旅客。路线结合了举世闻名的……
route: 河江市 – 北山山口 – 管坝天门 – 双乳山 – 安明 – 坦马坡 – 苗王宫 – 同文
同文 – 青年志愿者纪念碑 – 马皮冷山口 – 天空之路 – 侬桂河观景台 – 苗旺 – 保乐
保乐 – 美皮亚坡 – Phia Thap村
Phia Thap – 古岩洞（Nguom Ngao） – 板约瀑布 – 板约
板约 – 神眼山 – 高平市 → 河内

itinerary.title: 河江市 – 北山山口 – 管坝天门 – 双乳山 – 安明 – 坦马坡 – 苗王宫 – 同文
itinerary.html:
餐食：午餐、晚餐

08:30 – 从我们位于河江市的民宿出发。
出发前由摩托车司机进行安全讲解。

当日亮点：

  • 驶入群山之中，沿途风景变化壮观

  • 在北山山口停留，饱览全景

  • 游览管坝天门，欣赏壮丽景色

  • 观赏著名的双乳山（仙女山）

  • 在安明镇享用午餐

下午继续前往：

  • 坦马坡 – 标志性的蜿蜒山路，热门拍照点

  • 苗王宫（王氏府邸） – 昔日赫蒙族王族的府邸

傍晚抵达同文镇。
晚餐并入住当地民宿。

itinerary.title: 同文 – 青年志愿者纪念碑 – 马皮冷山口 – 天空之路 – 侬桂河观景台 – 苗旺 – 保乐
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐、午餐、晚餐

早餐后，准备迎接河江环线最壮观的路段：

  • 骑行马皮冷山口 – 被誉为“越南山口之王”

  • 沿天空之路前行，俯瞰深邃峡谷与碧绿的侬桂河

  • 在多个观景台停留，拍下难忘的照片

继续骑行穿越乡村：

  • Lung Ho

  • Mau Due

  • 苗旺（午餐）

从苗旺出发，驶入高平省的山间小路，抵达保乐镇。
晚餐并入住当地岱依族家庭民宿。

itinerary.title: 保乐 – 美皮亚坡 – Phia Thap村
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐、午餐、晚餐

今天130公里的骑行将带您穿越越南东北部最令人惊叹的风景：

  • 偏远的群山与石灰岩地貌

  • 宁静的少数民族村落

  • 云雾缭绕的山口和隐秘的山谷

主要停留点：

  • 美皮亚坡 – 壮观的之字形山路，拥有绝美观景点

下午继续前往以传统手工艺文化和优美环境著称的Phia Thap村。
入住当地民宿，与房东一家共进晚餐并留宿。

itinerary.title: Phia Thap – 古岩洞（Nguom Ngao） – 板约瀑布 – 板约
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐、午餐、晚餐

全天饱览自然奇观与秀美风光：

  • 游览越南北部最令人震撼的溶洞之一——古岩洞（Nguom Ngao）

  • 沿林间公路和山间观景点停车拍照

  • 骑行穿越梯田和起伏的山口

继续前往：

  • 板约瀑布 – 越南最壮丽的瀑布，位于越中边境

    • 乘竹筏近距离靠近瀑布

    • 欣赏高耸的崖壁、碧绿的河水和葱郁的四周景致

夜宿板约地区当地民宿。

itinerary.title: 板约 – 神眼山 – 高平市 → 河内
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐、午餐

早餐后：

  • 离开板约，骑行前往桶山，这里有标志性的神眼山（Nui Thung）

  • 返回高平市途中，在最后几处风景点和观景台停留

在高平当地餐厅享用午餐。

12:30 – 乘豪华商务车返回河内。
抵达河内后行程结束。

included: 河内 ↔ 河江 ↔ 高平 ↔ 河内交通：豪华独立包厢卧铺巴士、豪华商务车
豪华独立包厢卧铺巴士
免费入住河江市民宿一晚（传统房屋）
住宿：行程中民宿独立房间
全程餐食：早餐 – 午餐 – 晚餐
经验丰富的摩托车司机带骑
行程所列所有景点门票
防护装备：头盔、护具、雨衣
行程中饮用水（每人每天1瓶）
excluded: 导游及摩托车司机小费
个人饮品（咖啡、啤酒、软饮等）

title.en: Tour Hanoi – Ha Long – Ninh Binh – Hoa Lu – Trang An – Hang Mua 4N3D
title.zh: 河内 – 下龙湾 – 宁平 – 华闾古都 – 长安 – 舞洞山 4天3晚之旅

summary: During the 4-day, 3-night Ha Long tour, visitors will experience a 5-star cruise to admire the beauty of the bay, visit the beauty of Hoa Lu, freely check-in at Hang Mua to save beautiful photos and enjoy delicious dishes that will bring visitors the most enjoyable…
route: Welcome to Ha Noi- Ha Long Bay- Lan Ha Bay
Lan Ha Bay- Tuan Chau
Hanoi – Ninh Binh- Hoa Lu- Trang An – Mua Cave
Ha Noi Flight Home

itinerary.title: Welcome to Ha Noi- Ha Long Bay- Lan Ha Bay ( Meal B,l,d) Join Tour
itinerary.html:
08:30 : The car will pick you up at your hotel in Hanoi’s Old Quarter and depart to visit Ha Long Bay on the highway to admire the beautiful scenery.

11:30 am – 12:00 Arrive at Tuan Chau harbor, check in at the waiting room.

12:00 am – 12:30 pm You board the cruise and enjoy a welcome drink, listen to the cruise introduction and safety instructions. The group checks in.

13:00 pm – 13:15 pm Enjoy a seafood and vegetarian lunch while cruising on Ha Long – Lan Ha Bay, admiring the beauty of the fascinating islands rising from the emerald waters.

15:00 pm Relax on the sundeck or explore the Tra Bau area and lagoon the natural beauty of Lan Ha Bay and go kayaking or swimming here.

17:30 pm – 18:00 pm Return to the cruise and join the Cooking Class on the cruise. Take pictures and relax with “Happy Hour”: Drink promotion.

19:00 pm Enjoy dinner with local dishes prepared and served by the staff on board, watching the beautiful night scene on Lan Ha Bay.

21:00 pm After the dinner, you can join the squid fishing program and relax on the sundeck, enjoy the atmosphere on Bay at night.

itinerary.title: Lan Ha Bay- Tuan Chau ( B,l)
itinerary.html:
06:00 am You will participate in morning activities with Taichi exercises on the sundeck, watching the sunrise from the ship.

06:15 am – 07:00 am The cruise takes you through the karst tower, you can admire the scenery and enjoy tea, coffee and a light breakfast on board.

07:00 am Visiting Dark and Bright Cave, you can freely kayak or row a bamboo boat to explore the underwater caves, lagoons or experience swimming in the bay.

09:30 amBack in the cabin, please relax and carefully check all luggage before leaving the cabin.

10:00 am Check out, then enjoy lunch at the restaurant while the cruise returns to the port.

11:00 am Get on the Tender to go back Tuan Chau habor

11:30 am – 12:00 am The driver is waiting for yo to transfer back to Ha Noi.( for booking in advance)

15:00 pm – 15:30pm Car takes you back to Hanoi (book in advance).

itinerary.title: Hanoi – Ninh Binh- Hoa Lu- Trang An – Mua Cave ( B) Join Tour
itinerary.html:
Morning: You have breakfast, 8:00 guide and driver pick you up to go to Ninh Binh.

10:00 The first stop when arriving in Ninh Binh is Hoa Lu Ancient Capital, which was recognized by UNESCO as the first and only dual cultural heritage in Southeast Asia in 2014. Hoa Lu is home to many relics and imprints from many eras.

12:00 : Enjoy a buffet lunch at a nice local restaurant with great local cuisine.

13:30 : You will visit Trang An eco-tourism area, admire the outstanding natural beauty of the majestic limestone mountains, from the rice fields. Deep inside are high mountain ranges, mysterious valleys, many freshwater ponds and dense forests. You will board a traditional sampan boat and gently row down the beautiful river through many caves. For example: Lam Cave, Vang Cave, Dai Cave, Thanh Truot Cave, … and Cao Son Temple, Suoi Tien Temple, Vu Lam Temple …

15:30: Visiting Mua Cave, you can conquer Ngoa Long Mountain to admire the majestic rice valley and beautiful natural scenery.

17:15 : You get on the the bus to go back to Ha Noi.

19:30 : Drop you off at your hotel. Overnight in Ha Noi.

itinerary.title: Ha Noi Flight Home ( Meal B)
itinerary.html: After breakfast , you check out and go to airport to take flight to next destination.

zh.summary: 在这条4天3晚的下龙湾线路中，游客将乘坐五星级游轮欣赏海湾美景，游览华闾古都的秀丽风光，在舞洞山尽情打卡留下美照，并品尝美味佳肴，为游客带来最愉悦的……
route: 欢迎来到河内 – 下龙湾 – 兰夏湾
兰夏湾 – 巡州岛
河内 – 宁平 – 华闾古都 – 长安 – 舞洞山
河内送机返程

itinerary.title: 欢迎来到河内 – 下龙湾 – 兰夏湾（含早、午、晚餐）拼团
itinerary.html:
08:30：车辆到河内老城区酒店接您，经高速公路前往下龙湾，沿途欣赏美丽风光。

11:30 – 12:00 抵达巡州岛码头，在候船室办理登记。

12:00 – 12:30 登上游轮，享用欢迎饮品，听取游轮介绍及安全须知，办理入住。

13:00 – 13:15 游轮巡游下龙湾 – 兰夏湾，您可享用海鲜及素食午餐，欣赏碧波之上拔地而起的迷人岛屿。

15:00 在日光甲板上休憩，或前往Tra Bau区域和泻湖探索兰夏湾的自然美景，在此划皮划艇或游泳。

17:30 – 18:00 返回游轮，参加船上的烹饪课。拍照留念，享受“欢乐时光”饮品优惠。

19:00 享用船员精心准备的当地风味晚餐，欣赏兰夏湾美丽的夜景。

21:00 晚餐后可参加钓鱿鱼活动，或在日光甲板上放松，感受海湾夜晚的氛围。

itinerary.title: 兰夏湾 – 巡州岛（含早、午餐）
itinerary.html:
06:00 在日光甲板上参加太极晨练，从船上观赏日出。

06:15 – 07:00 游轮穿行于喀斯特石峰之间，您可欣赏美景，并在船上享用茶、咖啡和简易早餐。

07:00 游览明暗洞，可自由划皮划艇或乘竹筏探索水上溶洞、泻湖，或在海湾中畅游。

09:30 返回船舱休息，离舱前请仔细检查所有行李。

10:00 办理退房，游轮返港途中在餐厅享用午餐。

11:00 换乘接驳船返回巡州岛码头。

11:30 – 12:00 司机在此等候，送您返回河内（需提前预订）。

15:00 – 15:30 车辆送您抵达河内（需提前预订）。

itinerary.title: 河内 – 宁平 – 华闾古都 – 长安 – 舞洞山（含早餐）拼团
itinerary.html:
上午：享用早餐，8:00导游和司机接您前往宁平。

10:00 抵达宁平后的第一站是华闾古都。2014年，长安名胜群被联合国教科文组织列为东南亚首个、也是唯一一处文化与自然双重遗产，华闾古都即为其中一部分。这里保存着众多跨越不同时代的遗迹与印记。

12:00：在一家环境舒适的当地餐厅享用自助午餐，品尝地道美食。

13:30：游览长安生态旅游区，欣赏雄伟石灰岩山峰从稻田间拔地而起的绝美自然风光。深处有高耸的山脉、神秘的山谷、众多淡水湖塘和茂密森林。您将乘坐传统舢板小船，沿秀美河流缓缓穿过多个溶洞，如Lam洞、Vang洞、Dai洞、Thanh Truot洞……以及高山庙、仙溪庙、雾林庙等。

15:30：游览舞洞山，攀登卧龙山，俯瞰壮丽的稻田山谷和秀美的自然风光。

17:15：乘车返回河内。

19:30：送您回酒店。夜宿河内。

itinerary.title: Hanoi – Sapa by Bus – Short Trek to Cat Cat Village
itinerary.html:
Meals included: Lunch, Dinner

06:00 – 06:30 – Welcome at the bus station, board the sleeper bus and depart for Sapa.

07:30 – 11:45 – Travel along the highway to Lao Cai City with a comfort break on the way.

11:45 – 13:00 – Continue on the mountain road approaching Sapa Town, passing scenic valleys and terraced fields.

13:00 – 13:30 – Arrive in Sapa Town, where you will see colorful traditional costumes of the H’Mong, Dzao, and Tay ethnic people.

  • Welcome drink and itinerary briefing

  • Lunch with local Vietnamese dishes

  • Hotel check-in

14:30 – Take a short walk to the gate of Cat Cat Village, home of the Black H’Mong ethnic group at the bottom of a deep valley at the foot of Fansipan Peak.

Your local guide will show you the daily lifestyle of the villagers. Trek down to the valley to visit the waterfall and the French-built Hydroelectric Power Station. Enjoy some time for photos at the bridge and waterfall, then trek uphill back towards Sapa with beautiful late-afternoon scenery. The driver will pick you up and transfer you back to Sapa Town.

17:00 – Return to Sapa Town. Have dinner and stay overnight at the hotel, with free time to enjoy night activities.

itinerary.title: Sapa – Fansipan Peak – Moana View
itinerary.html:
Meals included: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

08:00 – After breakfast at the hotel, the driver and tour guide will take you to the Cable Car Station. Spend about 20 minutes on the cable car, taking in the spectacular views.

09:00 – At an altitude of 2,800 meters, enjoy time to sightsee and take photos. Visit the pagoda and spiritual sites, then trek approximately 600 steps to reach the peak of Fansipan – “The Roof of Indochina.”
You will spend about 1.5 hours hiking and taking photos.

11:30 – Return to the Cable Car Station and travel back to Sapa Town.

12:00 – Lunch at a local restaurant or at the hotel.

Afternoon – Visit Moana View

Start a short, easy walk to Moana View, located about 700 meters from Sapa Church. This is one of the latest check-in spots designed for travelers who enjoy creative photography and new experiences.

You can take photos at:

  • Bali Gate

  • Infinity Lake

  • Moana Girl Statue

  • Golden Hand

  • Thrilling Swing

  • Lonely Tree

  • Panoramic Café overlooking Fansipan Peak and Muong Hoa Valley

You are encouraged to prepare attractive outfits, hats, and accessories for your best photos.

17:00 – Return to Sapa Town. Have dinner and stay overnight at the hotel.

itinerary.title: 河内 – 乘巴士前往沙坝 – 短途徒步猫猫村
itinerary.html:
含餐：午餐、晚餐

06:00 – 06:30 – 在巴士站迎接，登上卧铺巴士前往沙坝。

07:30 – 11:45 – 沿高速公路前往老街市，途中停车休息。

11:45 – 13:00 – 沿山路继续驶向沙坝镇，沿途经过秀美的山谷和梯田。

13:00 – 13:30 – 抵达沙坝镇，在这里可以看到赫蒙族、瑶族和岱依族色彩缤纷的传统服饰。

  • 欢迎饮品及行程介绍

  • 越南当地特色午餐

  • 办理酒店入住

14:30 – 短途步行至猫猫村村口。猫猫村是黑赫蒙族的聚居地，坐落在番西邦峰脚下的深谷底部。

当地导游将带您了解村民的日常生活。徒步下到谷底，参观瀑布和法国人修建的水电站。在桥边和瀑布旁拍照留念，然后伴着傍晚的美景徒步上坡返回沙坝方向。司机将接您返回沙坝镇。

17:00 – 返回沙坝镇。在酒店享用晚餐并过夜，自由活动，可尽情享受夜间活动。

itinerary.title: 沙坝 – 番西邦峰 – Moana观景点
itinerary.html:
含餐：早餐、午餐、晚餐

08:00 – 在酒店享用早餐后，司机和导游送您前往缆车站。乘坐约20分钟缆车，沿途饱览壮丽景色。

09:00 – 在海拔2,800米处观光拍照。参观寺庙及宗教圣地，然后攀登约600级台阶，登上“印度支那屋脊”——番西邦峰顶。
徒步和拍照时间约1.5小时。

11:30 – 返回缆车站，乘缆车回到沙坝镇。

12:00 – 在当地餐厅或酒店享用午餐。

下午 – 游览Moana观景点

轻松步行前往距沙坝教堂约700米的Moana观景点。这是专为喜爱创意摄影和新奇体验的游客打造的最新网红打卡地之一。

您可以在以下地点拍照：

  • 巴厘岛之门

  • 无边湖

  • Moana女孩雕像

  • 金手

  • 惊险秋千

  • 孤独树

  • 可俯瞰番西邦峰和孟花山谷的全景咖啡馆

建议您准备漂亮的服装、帽子和配饰，拍出最美照片。

17:00 – 返回沙坝镇。在酒店享用晚餐并过夜。

itinerary.title: 沙坝 – 乘巴士返回河内
itinerary.html:
含餐：早餐、午餐

上午在酒店享用早餐，之后自由活动，自行探索沙坝。

12:00 – 退房，享用午餐，休息至出发时间。

13:00 – 14:00 – 乘巴士返回河内，途中停车休息。

20:00 – 20:30 – 抵达河内巴士站，行程结束。

title.en: Cao Bang 3 Days 2 Nights
title.zh: 高平3天2晚

summary: This 3 day, 2 night journey takes you deep into the majestic landscapes and historical sites of Cao Bang in the Northeast of Vietnam. Visit…
route: Hanoi – Cao Bang – Pac Bo
Cao Bang – Ban Gioc Waterfall – Nguom Ngao Cave – Nui Mat Than – Cao Bang
Cao Bang – Ba Be Lake – Hanoi

itinerary.title: Hanoi – Cao Bang – Pac Bo
itinerary.html:
• Morning pick-up in Hanoi and drive to Cao Bang.

  • Lunch at a local restaurant.

  • Afternoon visit to Pac Bo Historical Site – including Lenin Stream and Karl Marx Mountain, where President Ho Chi Minh lived and worked in the early days of the revolution.

  • Return to Cao Bang City for dinner.

  • Overnight at hotel in Cao Bang.

itinerary.title: Cao Bang – Ban Gioc Waterfall – Nguom Ngao Cave – Nui Mat Than – Cao Bang
itinerary.html:
• Breakfast at hotel.

  • Depart for Ban Gioc Waterfall, one of the most spectacular waterfalls in Vietnam. Free time for sightseeing and photos. (Optional bamboo boat ride to get closer to the falls – at your own expense.)

  • Visit Nguom Ngao Cave, famous for its impressive stalactites and stalagmites.

  • Stop at Nui Mat Than (God’s Eye Mountain / Nui Thung) for photo opportunities of this unique mountain with a natural “eye” in the rock. (Motorbike taxi to the viewpoint available at your own expense.)

  • Return to Cao Bang City for dinner and overnight at hotel.

itinerary.title: Cao Bang – Ba Be Lake – Hanoi
itinerary.html:
• Breakfast at hotel, then depart for Ba Be National Park.

  • Enjoy a boat trip on Ba Be Lake, surrounded by limestone mountains, forests, and peaceful villages.

  • Lunch at a local restaurant or homestay area (depending on timing).

  • Afternoon drive back to Hanoi.

  • Evening arrival in Hanoi. End of tour.

zh.summary: 这趟3天2晚的旅程将带您深入越南东北部高平的壮丽山水与历史遗迹。游览……
route: 河内 – 高平 – 北坡
高平 – 板约瀑布 – 古岩洞（Nguom Ngao） – 神眼山 – 高平
高平 – 三海湖 – 河内

itinerary.title: 河内 – 高平 – 北坡
itinerary.html:
• 上午在河内接您，驱车前往高平。

  • 在当地餐厅享用午餐。

  • 下午参观北坡历史遗址——包括列宁溪和马克思山，胡志明主席在革命初期曾在此生活和工作。

  • 返回高平市享用晚餐。

  • 夜宿高平酒店。

itinerary.title: 高平 – 板约瀑布 – 古岩洞（Nguom Ngao） – 神眼山 – 高平
itinerary.html:
• 在酒店享用早餐。

  • 前往越南最壮观的瀑布之一——板约瀑布。自由观光拍照。（可自费乘竹筏近距离靠近瀑布。）

  • 游览以壮观的钟乳石和石笋闻名的古岩洞（Nguom Ngao）。

  • 在神眼山（Nui Mat Than / 桶山）停留拍照，这座独特的山峰岩石上有一个天然的“眼睛”。（可自费乘摩托车前往观景点。）

  • 返回高平市享用晚餐，夜宿酒店。

itinerary.title: 高平 – 三海湖 – 河内
itinerary.html:
• 在酒店享用早餐后，前往三海国家公园。

  • 乘船游览三海湖，湖泊四周环绕着石灰岩山峰、森林和宁静的村庄。

  • 在当地餐厅或民宿区享用午餐（视时间而定）。

  • 下午驱车返回河内。

  • 傍晚抵达河内，行程结束。

杜嘉村 – 杜嘉瀑布 – 杜昂上山谷 – 泰安公路 – 北迷 – 河江市 → 河内

title.en: Ha Giang Jeep Tour – 3 Days
title.zh: 河江吉普车之旅 – 3天

summary: Ha Giang Jeep Tour is ideal for travelers who want to discover the full beauty of the Ha Giang Loop in comfort and safety. Instead of riding a motorbike,…
route: Ha Giang City – Bac Sum Pass – Quan Ba Heaven Gate – Twin Mountains – Yen Minh – Tham Ma Slope – H’Mong King Palace – Dong Van
Dong Van – Volunteer Youth Monument – Ma Pi Leng Pass – Sky Path – Nho Que River Viewpoint – Meo Vac – Du Gia Village
Du Gia Village – Du Gia Waterfall – Duong Thuong Valley – Thai An Road – Bac Me – Ha Giang City → Hanoi

itinerary.title: Ha Giang City – Bac Sum Pass – Quan Ba Heaven Gate – Twin Mountains – Yen Minh – Tham Ma Slope – H’Mong King Palace – Dong Van
itinerary.html:
Meals: Lunch, Dinner

08:30 – The tour starts from our homestay in Ha Giang City. Your English–speaking guide and jeep driver will give you a short safety and route briefing before departure.

As you leave Ha Giang, the scenery quickly transforms into towering mountains and deep valleys. Along the way you will:

  • Stop at Bac Sum Pass to enjoy panoramic views and a drink break

  • Continue to Quan Ba Heaven Gate and admire the spectacular landscape

  • See the iconic Twin Mountains (Fairy Bosom Hills)

  • Enjoy lunch at a local restaurant in Yen Minh Town

In the afternoon, the jeep continues deeper into the Dong Van Karst Plateau Geopark:

  • Drive over Tham Ma Slope, a famous winding mountain road with great photo spots

  • Visit the historic H’Mong King Palace (Vuong Family Residence), former home of the H’Mong royal family

Arrive in Dong Van Town in the late afternoon.
Check in at the homestay, have dinner, and enjoy free time to explore Dong Van Old Quarter in the evening.

itinerary.title: Dong Van – Volunteer Youth Monument – Ma Pi Leng Pass – Sky Path – Nho Que River Viewpoint – Meo Vac – Du Gia Village
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

After breakfast, depart Dong Van and follow one of the most stunning mountain roads in all of Vietnam:

  • Drive along the legendary Ma Pi Leng Pass, known for its craggy cliffs and breathtaking views

  • Stop at the Volunteer Youth Monument and several viewpoints along the pass

  • Take the Sky Path road to admire the full panorama of the valley and the emerald Nho Que River far below

  • Enjoy many opportunities for photos of dramatic rock formations and deep gorges

Continue by jeep through remote mountain areas and villages:

  • Pass Lung Ho, Mau Due, and Meo Vac, where you will stop for lunch and rest

From Meo Vac, keep driving through a mountain–trail road to Du Gia Village, a peaceful valley surrounded by rice terraces and home to several ethnic minority groups.

  • Check in at a local Tay minority homestay

  • Enjoy a homemade dinner and “happy water” with the host family

Overnight in Du Gia Village.

itinerary.title: Du Gia Village – Du Gia Waterfall – Duong Thuong Valley – Thai An Road – Bac Me – Ha Giang City → Hanoi
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch

After breakfast at the homestay:

  • Visit the hidden Du Gia Waterfall, where you can relax and enjoy the peaceful nature

  • Say goodbye to your host family and continue the jeep journey

On the way back to Ha Giang, you will still enjoy impressive landscapes:

  • Drive through Duong Thuong Valley with its beautiful mountain scenery

  • Follow Thai An Road, a scenic route with great viewpoints

  • Pass through the Bac Me area before returning to Ha Giang City in the afternoon

From Ha Giang, you will board the limousine bus at 16:00 back to Hanoi.
The tour ends upon your arrival in Hanoi.

included: Round–trip transportation Hanoi ↔ Ha Giang: Luxury private–cabin sleeper bus (pick–up 19:30–20:00 in Hanoi Old Quarter) Limousine bus (pick–up 15:00–15:30 in Hanoi Old Quarter)

zh.summary: 河江吉普车之旅非常适合希望舒适、安全地领略河江环线全部美景的旅客。无需自己骑摩托车……
route: 河江市 – 北山山口 – 管坝天门 – 双乳山 – 安明 – 坦马坡 – 苗王宫 – 同文
同文 – 青年志愿者纪念碑 – 马皮冷山口 – 天空之路 – 侬桂河观景台 – 苗旺 – 杜嘉村
杜嘉村 – 杜嘉瀑布 – 杜昂上山谷 – 泰安公路 – 北迷 – 河江市 → 河内

itinerary.title: 河江市 – 北山山口 – 管坝天门 – 双乳山 – 安明 – 坦马坡 – 苗王宫 – 同文
itinerary.html:
餐食：午餐、晚餐

08:30 – 从我们位于河江市的民宿出发。出发前，英文导游和吉普车司机将为您做简短的安全和路线讲解。

离开河江后，眼前的景色很快变为巍峨的群山和深邃的山谷。沿途您将：

  • 在北山山口停留，饱览全景并稍作休息、享用饮品

  • 继续前往管坝天门，欣赏壮丽景色

  • 观赏标志性的双乳山（仙女山）

  • 在安明镇当地餐厅享用午餐

下午，吉普车继续深入同文喀斯特高原地质公园：

  • 驶过坦马坡，这条著名的蜿蜒山路有绝佳的拍照点

  • 参观历史悠久的苗王宫（王氏府邸），这里曾是赫蒙族王族的府邸

傍晚抵达同文镇。
入住民宿，享用晚餐，晚间可自由探索同文老街。

itinerary.title: 同文 – 青年志愿者纪念碑 – 马皮冷山口 – 天空之路 – 侬桂河观景台 – 苗旺 – 杜嘉村
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐、午餐、晚餐

早餐后离开同文，驶上全越南最震撼的山路之一：

  • 驱车行驶在传奇的马皮冷山口，这里以嶙峋峭壁和令人屏息的美景闻名

  • 在青年志愿者纪念碑及山口沿线多个观景台停留

  • 沿天空之路欣赏山谷全景，俯瞰谷底碧绿的侬桂河

  • 尽情拍摄壮观的岩石地貌和幽深峡谷

乘吉普车继续穿越偏远山区和村落：

  • 途经Lung Ho、Mau Due和苗旺，在苗旺停留午餐并休息

从苗旺出发，沿山间小路前往杜嘉村，这座宁静的山谷被梯田环绕，是多个少数民族的家园。

  • 入住当地岱依族民宿

  • 与房东一家享用家常晚餐和“快乐水”（自酿米酒）

夜宿杜嘉村。

itinerary.title: 杜嘉村 – 杜嘉瀑布 – 杜昂上山谷 – 泰安公路 – 北迷 – 河江市 → 河内
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐、午餐

在民宿享用早餐后：

  • 探访隐秘的杜嘉瀑布，在此放松身心，享受宁静的大自然

  • 告别房东一家，继续吉普车之旅

返回河江途中，您依然能欣赏到令人赞叹的风景：

  • 驶过风景秀丽的杜昂上山谷

  • 沿泰安公路前行，这条景观路线上有许多绝佳观景点

  • 途经北迷地区，下午返回河江市

从河江乘坐16:00的豪华商务车返回河内。
抵达河内后行程结束。

title.en: Mekong Delta 3 Days 2 Nights ( My Tho – Ben Tre – Can Tho – Ca Mau)
title.zh: 湄公河三角洲3天2晚（美萩 – 槟知 – 芹苴 – 金瓯）

summary: Experience the Mekong Delta with Vietlook Travel immerse yourself in rivers, culture, and Southern Vietnamese cuisine on this 3 day journey from My Tho to…
route: Saigon – My Tho – Ben Tre – Can Tho
Can Tho – Cai Rang Floating Market – Ca Mau

itinerary.title: Saigon – My Tho – Ben Tre – Can Tho
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast – Lunch – Dinner

Morning: Pick-up at centrally located hotels near Ben Thanh Market (6:50 – 7:20 AM). Depart for My Tho and Ben Tre.

  • Mekong Restop: Enjoy typical Southern Vietnamese breakfast (Hu Tieu My Tho, Com Tam), restrooms available, and optional snacks.

  • Vinh Trang Pagoda: 19th-century architectural relic combining European and Asian styles.

  • My Tho River Cruise: Boat trip along Tien River, visit four islets (Long, Lan, Qui, Phung), floating fish rafts, and Rach Mieu Bridge.

  • Thoi Son Island (Lan Island): Walk through village roads, local houses, fruit gardens; visit honey bee farm, enjoy honey lemon tea.

  • Cultural Experience: Southern folk music (Don Ca Tai Tu Xu Dua), fruit tasting, rowing through canals, visit coconut candy workshop.

Noon: Lunch at a local restaurant. Optional activities: fishing for crocodiles, walking on the monkey bridge, resting in hammocks, cycling along village roads.

Afternoon (2:30 PM): Return to My Tho by boat, then depart for Can Tho (2–3 hours drive). Check-in at city center hotel.

Evening (6:30 PM): Dinner on a luxury yacht at Ninh Kieu Wharf with Western cuisine and Southern folk music.

9:30 PM: Yacht docks. Free time to explore Can Tho city nightlife. Return to hotel.

itinerary.title: Can Tho – Cai Rang Floating Market – Ca Mau
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast – Lunch – Dinner

Morning: Breakfast at hotel. Visit:

  • Cai Rang Floating Market: One of the largest floating markets in the Mekong Delta. See local trade and Hu Tieu craft village.

  • Soc Trang: SomRong Temple – largest reclining Buddha temple in Vietnam with Khmer architecture.

  • Bac Lieu: Tac Say Church – Gia Rai Bac Lieu, grave of Father Truong Buu Diep.

Noon: Depart for Ca Mau. Lunch at Anh Nguyet Restaurant.

Afternoon: Explore Ca Mau Cape:

  • Mangrove forest, National Coordinate Landmark – GPS 0001, panoramic view of Ca Mau Cape

  • Visit the museum, Au Co’s mother statue, flagpole, and take souvenir photos

  • Return to hotel to rest

Evening (6:00 PM): Dinner and free time to explore Ca Mau city nightlife.

itinerary.title: Ca Mau – Bac Lieu – Sai Gon
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast – Lunch

Morning: Breakfast at hotel and check-out. Depart for Bac Lieu:

  • Cong Tu Bac Lieu House: Built in 1919 by a French engineer with imported materials.

  • Nam Hai Buddha: Pray for good luck for yourself and family.

  • Soc Trang: Visit Quang Tran Pia Cake Factory (since 1950).

Noon: Lunch in Hau Giang with Southern specialties (Hotpot, garden chicken, Linh fish, fried cod fish).

Afternoon: Return journey to Ho Chi Minh City. Rest stop at Cai Be station.

Evening (7:00 PM): Arrive in Ho Chi Minh City. End of tour.

included: Pick-up and drop-off at centrally located hotels near Ben Thanh Market
2-night hotel stay in city center or equivalent (2–3 people per room)
Sightseeing tickets, boat trips, rowing boat, bicycle
excluded: Personal expenses or items not included in tour inclusions

zh.summary: 跟随Vietlook Travel畅游湄公河三角洲，沉浸于河流风光、民俗文化与越南南部美食之中，开启这趟从美萩到……的3天旅程
route: 西贡 – 美萩 – 槟知 – 芹苴
芹苴 – 丐冷水上市场 – 金瓯
金瓯 – 薄寮 – 西贡

itinerary.title: 西贡 – 美萩 – 槟知 – 芹苴
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐 – 午餐 – 晚餐

上午：在滨城市场附近的市中心酒店接您（6:50 – 7:20）。出发前往美萩和槟知。

  • Mekong Restop休息站：享用典型的越南南部早餐（美萩粿条、碎米饭），设有洗手间，可自选小吃。

  • 永长寺：建于19世纪的建筑遗迹，融合了欧亚两种风格。

  • 美萩游船：乘船游览前江，途经龙、麟、龟、凤四座小岛、水上养鱼排和沥庙大桥。

  • 泰山岛（麟岛）：漫步乡间小路，参观当地民居和果园；参观养蜂场，品尝蜂蜜柠檬茶。

  • 文化体验：欣赏南部民间音乐（才子弹唱），品尝水果，划船穿行于河道，参观椰子糖作坊。

中午：在当地餐厅享用午餐。可选活动：钓鳄鱼、走猴桥、躺吊床休憩、沿乡间小路骑自行车。

下午（14:30）：乘船返回美萩，随后前往芹苴（车程2–3小时）。入住市中心酒店。

晚上（18:30）：在宁桥码头的豪华游艇上享用西式晚餐，欣赏南部民间音乐。

21:30：游艇靠岸。自由活动，探索芹苴夜生活。返回酒店。

itinerary.title: 芹苴 – 丐冷水上市场 – 金瓯
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐 – 午餐 – 晚餐

上午：在酒店享用早餐。游览：

  • 丐冷水上市场：湄公河三角洲最大的水上市场之一。观看当地水上交易，参观粿条手工作坊村。

  • 朔庄：索姆隆寺（SomRong）——越南最大的卧佛寺，具有高棉建筑风格。

  • 薄寮：塔赛教堂（Tac Say）——位于薄寮嘉莱，张宝蝶神父之墓所在地。

中午：前往金瓯。在Anh Nguyet餐厅享用午餐。

下午：探索金瓯角：

  • 红树林、国家坐标原点地标GPS 0001，俯瞰金瓯角全景

  • 参观博物馆、瓯姬母亲像、旗杆，拍照留念

  • 返回酒店休息

晚上（18:00）：享用晚餐，自由活动，探索金瓯夜生活。

itinerary.title: 金瓯 – 薄寮 – 西贡
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐 – 午餐

上午：在酒店享用早餐并退房。前往薄寮：

  • 薄寮公子府：1919年由一位法国工程师使用进口材料建造。

  • 南海观音：为自己和家人祈福。

  • 朔庄：参观广珍饼厂（Quang Tran，创立于1950年）。

中午：在后江享用南部特色午餐（火锅、走地鸡、鲮鱼、炸鳕鱼）。

下午：返回胡志明市，在丐皮服务站休息。

晚上（19:00）：抵达胡志明市，行程结束。

included: 滨城市场附近市中心酒店接送
餐食：3顿早餐、3顿午餐、2顿晚餐
市中心或同等酒店住宿2晚（2–3人一间）
观光门票、游船、手划船、自行车
