title.en: Mekong Delta 3 Days 2 Nights
title.zh: 湄公河三角洲3天2晚

summary: Vietlook Travel 3 day tour takes you on an immersive journey through the Mekong Delta, exploring rivers, floating markets, traditional villages,…
route: Saigon – My Tho – Ben Tre – Chau Doc
Chau Doc – Tra Su Melaleuca Forest – Can Tho
Can Tho Floating Market – My Khanh Ecotourism Village – Sai Gon

itinerary.title: Saigon – My Tho – Ben Tre – Chau Doc
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast – Lunch – Dinner

Morning (6:30 – 6:50 AM): Pick-up at centrally located hotels near Ben Thanh Market. Depart for My Tho and Ben Tre.

  • Mekong Restop: Enjoy typical southern Vietnamese breakfast (Hu Tieu My Tho, Com Tam), restrooms available, and optional snacks.

  • Vinh Trang Pagoda: 19th-century architectural and artistic relic combining European and Asian styles.

  • My Tho River Cruise: Boat trip to Tien River and four islets (Long, Lan, Qui, Phung). Learn about local fish farming and see Rach Mieu Bridge.

  • Thoi Son Island (Lan Island): Village walk, local houses, fruit gardens, honey bee farm, honey lemon tea.

  • Cultural Experience: Don Ca Tai Tu southern folk music, fresh fruit tasting, rowing through canals, visit coconut candy workshop.

Noon: Lunch at a local restaurant. Optional activities include fishing for crocodiles, walking the monkey bridge, resting in hammocks, or cycling along village roads.

Afternoon (2:30 PM): Return to My Tho by boat and depart for Chau Doc (2–3 hours drive). Check-in at a city center hotel.

Evening (6:00 PM): Dinner at Sunrise Restaurant. Free time to explore Chau Doc nightlife.

itinerary.title: Chau Doc – Tra Su Melaleuca Forest – Can Tho
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast – Lunch – Dinner

Morning: Breakfast at the hotel. Visit:

  • Ba Chua Su Pagoda (Sam Mountain)

  • Thoai Ngoc Hau Tomb

  • Tay An Co Tu Pagoda

Journey along Vinh Te canal through That Son range, Cam Mountain, Mount Ket, and Khmer pagodas. Continue to Tra Su Melaleuca Forest: walk 500m to the wharf, then motorboat 10 minutes through the flooded forest.

Noon: Lunch at forest area in stilt houses. Depart for Long Xuyen for additional lunch before heading to Can Tho.

Afternoon: Arrive in Can Tho, check-in at hotel.

Evening (6:30 PM): Dinner on a luxury yacht at Ninh Kieu Wharf with western cuisine and southern folk music.

9:00 PM: Yacht docks. Free time to explore Can Tho city at night. Return to hotel.

itinerary.title: Can Tho Floating Market – My Khanh Ecotourism Village – Sai Gon
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast – Lunch

Morning: Breakfast at hotel. Visit:

  • Cai Rang Floating Market: One of the largest floating markets in the Mekong Delta. See local trade and Hu Tieu craft village.

  • My Khanh Ecotourism Village: Fruit gardens, flower garden, 100-year-old ancient house.

  • Truc Lam Phuong Nam Zen Monastery: Cultural architecture of Ly-Tran dynasties.

Noon: Lunch at My Khanh tourist village. Free time to relax.

Afternoon: Visit Purple House Coffee – Can Tho Film Studio (self-paid ticket). Explore the unique purple-themed location. Return to Ho Chi Minh City.

5:30 PM: Drop-off at Ben Thanh Market or Pham Ngu Lao Street. Tour guide bids farewell.

zh.summary: Vietlook Travel的这条3天线路带您沉浸式畅游湄公河三角洲，探索河流、水上市场、传统村落……
route: 西贡 – 美萩 – 槟知 – 朱笃
朱笃 – 茶素白千层林 – 芹苴
芹苴水上市场 – 美庆生态旅游村 – 西贡

itinerary.title: 西贡 – 美萩 – 槟知 – 朱笃
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐 – 午餐 – 晚餐

上午（6:30 – 6:50）：在滨城市场附近的市中心酒店接您。出发前往美萩和槟知。

  • Mekong Restop休息站：享用典型的越南南部早餐（美萩粿条、碎米饭），设有洗手间，可自选小吃。

  • 永长寺：建于19世纪的建筑艺术遗迹，融合了欧亚两种风格。

  • 美萩游船：乘船游览前江及龙、麟、龟、凤四座小岛，了解当地养鱼业，观赏沥庙大桥。

  • 泰山岛（麟岛）：漫步乡村，参观当地民居、果园和养蜂场，品尝蜂蜜柠檬茶。

  • 文化体验：欣赏才子弹唱南部民间音乐，品尝新鲜水果，划船穿行于河道，参观椰子糖作坊。

中午：在当地餐厅享用午餐。可选活动包括钓鳄鱼、走猴桥、躺吊床休憩或沿乡间小路骑自行车。

下午（14:30）：乘船返回美萩，前往朱笃（车程2–3小时）。入住市中心酒店。

晚上（18:00）：在Sunrise餐厅享用晚餐。自由活动，探索朱笃夜生活。

itinerary.title: 朱笃 – 茶素白千层林 – 芹苴
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐 – 午餐 – 晚餐

上午：在酒店享用早餐。游览：

  • 主处圣母庙（三山）

  • 瑞玉侯陵

  • 西安古寺

沿永济运河前行，途经七山山脉、禁山、Ket山和高棉寺庙。继续前往茶素白千层林：步行500米至码头，再乘摩托艇10分钟穿行于水上森林。

中午：在林区高脚屋享用午餐。前往龙川加餐，然后前往芹苴。

下午：抵达芹苴，入住酒店。

晚上（18:30）：在宁桥码头的豪华游艇上享用西式晚餐，欣赏南部民间音乐。

21:00：游艇靠岸。自由活动，探索芹苴夜景。返回酒店。

itinerary.title: 芹苴水上市场 – 美庆生态旅游村 – 西贡
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐 – 午餐

上午：在酒店享用早餐。游览：

  • 丐冷水上市场：湄公河三角洲最大的水上市场之一。观看当地水上交易，参观粿条手工作坊村。

  • 美庆生态旅游村：果园、花园和百年古宅。

  • 南方竹林禅院：具有李朝、陈朝文化风格的建筑。

中午：在美庆旅游村享用午餐，自由休息。

下午：参观紫色房子咖啡 – 芹苴电影城（门票自理），探索这处独特的紫色主题景点。返回胡志明市。

17:30：在滨城市场或范五老街下车。导游与您道别。

title.en: Sapa Tour 3 Days 2 Nights (shared tour)
title.zh: 沙坝3天2晚之旅（拼团）

summary: On the 3-day, 2-night Sapa tour, visitors will visit Cat Cat and Ta Van villages to experience the culture of ethnic minorities, or immerse themselves in the clear blue waterfalls like Bac waterfall... especially the terraced fields winding around the mountainside, along with the beauty of blooming…
route: Hanoi – Sapa by bus with a short trek to Cat Cat village
Sapa discovery with long trek Y Linh Ho - Lao Chai - Ta Van village
Sapa - Tram Ton - Thac Bac - Bus to Ha Noi

itinerary.title: Hanoi – Sapa by bus with a short trek to Cat Cat village (L, D)
itinerary.html:
6:00 – 6:30: The car will pick you up at your hotel in the old quarter or bus station, board the sleeper bus and depart for Sapa.

7:30 – 11:45: The car takes you along the highway to Lao Cai city.

11:45 – 13.00 : On the way, you can admire the mountain scenery, the valleys filled with flowers or the golden terraced fields.

13:00: Arriving in Sapa town, you can rent colorful traditional costumes of the H’mong, Dao, Tay people.

Enjoy lunch with local specialties, and check in.

14:30: You will take a short walk to Cat Cat village, home to the Black H’mong people, located near the foot of a deep valley at the foot of Fansipan peak. Your tour guide will introduce you to the activities and daily life of the people here. Then you will walk down to the foot of the valley to visit. waterfall where the French built a Hydraulic Power Station, short time for photo with bridge and the waterfall then you will trekking up hill to get back to Sapa with very beautiful scenery in the late afternoon. Driver pick up back to Sapa.

  • Trekking distance is about 2.5 kms and it lasts for 2 hours

16:30: Come back to Sapa Town. We prepare a good dinner for you at 18.00. Overnight at the hotel

itinerary.title: Sapa discovery with long trek Y Linh Ho - Lao Chai - Ta Van village (B, L, D)
itinerary.html:
7:00 – 7:45: Have breakfast at hotel and prepare light pack for the long trek of 5 kms

8:00: A short drive to Y Linh Ho then trek through the rice terraces and along Muong Hoa Stream to the Black Hmong village of Lao Chai to see the spectacular landscape of Hoang Lien Son Mountain then trek to Ta Van village – home of Dzay ethnic people. Trekking distance is about 9 kms and it lasts for 4 hours

11:30: Bus picks you up form Ta Van Bridge to Sapa.

12:00 Have lunch and enjoy free time in the afternoon do discover Sapa town by yourself. Have dinner and overnight in the hotel.

itinerary.title: Sapa - Tram Ton - Thac Bac - Bus to Ha Noi (B, L)
itinerary.html:
6:00-8:00. Breakfast and meet your tour guide

8:00. Start your day with a 12 km road trip up to Tram Ton and Cong Troi (Heaven Gate) where you edit pictures of the most beautiful mountain-pass scenery of Northern Vietnam, then visit Thac Bac water-fall (Silver Water-fall) and Salmon farm-fishing

12:00 – 13:00: Have a shower at hotel, have lunch, time at leisure on your own.

13:30: Meet all group members at hotel to get ready for Hanoi.

14:00: Get on bus to go back to Hanoi with two comfort breaks.

20:30 – 21:00: We say goodbye to you at bus stop. Trip ends.

zh.summary: 在这条3天2晚的沙坝线路中，游客将走访猫猫村和达湾村，体验少数民族文化，或沉醉于银瀑布等清澈的瀑布美景……尤其是盘绕山腰的层层梯田，以及盛开的……
route: 河内 – 乘巴士前往沙坝，短途徒步猫猫村
沙坝探索，长途徒步依林河村 – 老寨 – 达湾村
沙坝 – 天门山口 – 银瀑布 – 乘巴士返回河内

itinerary.title: 河内 – 乘巴士前往沙坝，短途徒步猫猫村（含午、晚餐）
itinerary.html:
6:00 – 6:30：车辆到老城区酒店或巴士站接您，登上卧铺巴士前往沙坝。

7:30 – 11:45：沿高速公路前往老街市。

11:45 – 13:00：途中可欣赏山景、开满鲜花的山谷或金黄的梯田。

13:00：抵达沙坝镇，可租借赫蒙族、瑶族、岱依族色彩缤纷的传统服饰。

享用当地特色午餐，办理入住。

14:30：短途步行前往猫猫村。猫猫村是黑赫蒙族的聚居地，坐落在番西邦峰脚下的深谷附近。导游将为您介绍村民的生产活动和日常生活。随后步行下到谷底，参观法国人修建水电站的瀑布，在桥边和瀑布旁稍作停留拍照，然后伴着傍晚的美景徒步上坡返回沙坝。司机接您返回沙坝。

  • 徒步距离约2.5公里，用时约2小时

16:30：返回沙坝镇。18:00为您准备丰盛的晚餐。夜宿酒店。

itinerary.title: 沙坝探索，长途徒步依林河村 – 老寨 – 达湾村（含早、午、晚餐）
itinerary.html:
7:00 – 7:45：在酒店享用早餐，为长途徒步准备轻便背包

8:00：短途车程前往依林河村，随后徒步穿越梯田，沿孟花溪前往黑赫蒙族的老寨村，欣赏黄连山的壮丽风光，再徒步前往岱依族（Dzay）聚居的达湾村。徒步距离约9公里，用时约4小时

11:30：巴士在达湾桥接您返回沙坝。

12:00 享用午餐，下午自由活动，自行探索沙坝镇。晚餐并夜宿酒店。

itinerary.title: 沙坝 – 天门山口 – 银瀑布 – 乘巴士返回河内（含早、午餐）
itinerary.html:
6:00-8:00 享用早餐，与导游会合

8:00 开始12公里的公路之旅，前往天门山口（Tram Ton）和天门（Cong Troi），拍摄越南北部最美的山口风光，随后游览银瀑布（Thac Bac）和三文鱼养殖场

title.en: Discovery Phong Nha – Hang Tien Cave 2 Day Tour
title.zh: 探索峰牙 – 仙洞（Hang Tien）2日游

summary: The Hang Tien Cave 2 Day Tour is an ultimate jungle and cave adventure in Phong Nha – Ke Bang National Park. Combining trekking, caving, and outdoor…
route: Phong Nha – Tan Hoa – Hang Ruc
Hang Tien 1 – Hang Tien 2 – Tan Hoa – Phong Nha

itinerary.title: Phong Nha – Tan Hoa – Hang Ruc
itinerary.html:
07:30 – 08:00 – Pick up from your hotel in Phong Nha. Drive to Oxalis’s Tan Hoa office, passing through scenic jungle and fields. Receive safety instructions, collect gear, and sign the Release Form.

10:30 – Begin trekking into the jungle. First section includes a 1-hour uphill trek, followed by a downhill path along the river.

13:00 – 13:30 – Stop for lunch in the jungle.

14:00 – Cross the river and continue to Hang Ruc, a picturesque stream cave with short swims and flowstone cascades.

16:00 – Trek upriver to the campsite next to a natural jungle pool. Swim, take photos, and relax. Porters prepare a BBQ dinner for the night.

itinerary.title: Hang Tien 1 – Hang Tien 2 – Tan Hoa – Phong Nha
itinerary.html:
08:00 – Breakfast at the campsite.

09:00 – Explore Hang Tien 1, a large chamber featuring stunning formations and Gour pools. Climb ladders to reach the cave exit around 11:00.

11:30 – Trek into Hang Tien 2, exploring 300 meters of subterranean formations before exiting and enjoying a picnic lunch.

13:00 – 16:00 – Return trek to the road, with cold drinks waiting.

16:00 – 18:30 – Shower, change, and transfer back to Phong Nha. Tour ends at your hotel around 18:30.

childPolicy: Only travelers aged 16 years and above can join this tour

zh.summary: 仙洞（Hang Tien）2日游是峰牙-格邦国家公园内终极的丛林与洞穴探险之旅。融合徒步、探洞与户外……
route: 峰牙 – 新化 – Ruc洞
仙洞1号 – 仙洞2号 – 新化 – 峰牙

itinerary.title: 峰牙 – 新化 – Ruc洞
itinerary.html:
07:30 – 08:00 – 从峰牙酒店接您，驱车前往Oxalis新化办事处，沿途穿过秀美的丛林和田野。接受安全指导，领取装备，并签署免责声明。

10:30 – 开始徒步进入丛林。第一段为1小时上坡徒步，随后沿河下坡前行。

13:00 – 13:30 – 在丛林中停下享用午餐。

14:00 – 渡河后继续前往Ruc洞，这是一处风景如画的溪流洞穴，需短距离游泳，还有层层流石瀑布。

16:00 – 逆河徒步至天然丛林水潭旁的营地。游泳、拍照、放松身心。挑夫为您准备烧烤晚餐。

itinerary.title: 仙洞1号 – 仙洞2号 – 新化 – 峰牙
itinerary.html:
08:00 – 在营地享用早餐。

09:00 – 探索仙洞1号，巨大的洞厅中有令人惊叹的岩石景观和边石池。攀爬梯子，约11:00抵达洞口。

11:30 – 徒步进入仙洞2号，探索300米的地下奇观，出洞后享用野餐午餐。

13:00 – 16:00 – 徒步返回公路，冷饮已在等候。

16:00 – 18:30 – 淋浴、更衣，送返峰牙。约18:30抵达酒店，行程结束。

zh.childPolicy: 仅限16岁及以上旅客参加本团。

title.en: Hang En Cave Adventure Camp – 2 Days / 1 Night
title.zh: 燕子洞（Hang En）探险露营 – 2天1晚

summary: The Hang En Cave Adventure is one of Vietnam’s most spectacular cave experiences. Hang En is considered the world’s third-largest cave and is a…
route: Phong Nha – Ban Doong Village – Hang En
Hang En – Hang Lanh – Phong Nha

itinerary.title: Phong Nha – Ban Doong Village – Hang En
itinerary.html:
07:30 – 08:00 – Pick up from your hotel in Phong Nha and transfer to Oxalis Headquarters. Gear up, receive a safety briefing, and sign the release form.

10:00 – Start trekking into the jungle via a steep hill and rivers. Hike through primary forest to reach Ban Doong Village, an ethnic minority village, for tea and cultural experience.

12:30 – 13:00 – Picnic lunch near the river.

Continue trekking through rivers and jungle valleys toward Hang En Cave.

15:00 – Arrive at Hang En. Camp is set up on the cave’s beach by the porter team. Explore the cave, walk to the viewpoint above camp to see 300-million-year-old fossils, relax or swim in the natural pool, and enjoy a grilled dinner with rice wine under the sounds of swifts overhead.

itinerary.title: Hang En – Hang Lanh – Phong Nha
itinerary.html:
08:00 – Breakfast and pack belongings.

09:00 – Depart Hang En and trek 1 km along the riverside to Hang Lanh (“Cold Cave”).

10:00 – 12:00 – Explore Hang Lanh, a 4 km-long wet cave with cold rivers, magnificent formations, and rare fossils.

12:00 – 13:00 – Lunch with the group.

13:00 – 14:00 – Trek through the river valley and jungle paths back toward the trailhead.

14:00 – 16:00 – Final uphill trek to the pickup point.

16:30 – 17:30 – Return to your hotel in Phong Nha.

childPolicy: Only guests aged 16 years and above can join this tour

zh.summary: 燕子洞（Hang En）探险是越南最壮观的洞穴体验之一。燕子洞被认为是世界第三大洞穴，也是……
route: 峰牙 – 邦栋村 – 燕子洞
燕子洞 – 冷洞 – 峰牙

itinerary.title: 峰牙 – 邦栋村 – 燕子洞
itinerary.html:
07:30 – 08:00 – 从峰牙酒店接您，前往Oxalis总部。领取装备，听取安全讲解，并签署免责声明。

10:00 – 开始徒步进入丛林，翻越陡峭山坡、蹚过河流。穿越原始森林抵达少数民族村落邦栋村，品茶并体验当地文化。

12:30 – 13:00 – 在河边享用野餐午餐。

继续徒步穿越河流和丛林山谷，前往燕子洞。

15:00 – 抵达燕子洞。挑夫团队在洞内沙滩上搭建营地。探索洞穴，步行至营地上方的观景点观赏3亿年前的化石，在天然水潭中放松或游泳，伴着头顶雨燕的鸣叫，享用烧烤晚餐和米酒。

itinerary.title: 燕子洞 – 冷洞 – 峰牙
itinerary.html:
08:00 – 享用早餐，收拾行装。

09:00 – 离开燕子洞，沿河岸徒步1公里前往冷洞（Hang Lanh）。

10:00 – 12:00 – 探索冷洞，这是一个长达4公里的湿洞，洞内有冰冷的暗河、壮观的岩石景观和珍稀化石。

12:00 – 13:00 – 与团队共进午餐。

13:00 – 14:00 – 穿越河谷和丛林小径，徒步返回登山口方向。

14:00 – 16:00 – 最后一段上坡徒步至接驳点。

16:30 – 17:30 – 返回峰牙酒店。

zh.childPolicy: 仅限16岁及以上游客参加本团。

title.en: Ha Giang Jeep Tour – 2 Days
title.zh: 河江吉普车之旅 – 2天

summary: Ha Giang Jeep Tour is perfect for travelers who want to experience the legendary Ha Giang Loop in comfort and safety. Instead of riding a motorbike, you…
route: Ha Giang City – Bac Sum Slope – Quan Ba Heaven Gate – Twin Mountains – Yen Minh – Tham Ma Slope – H’Mong King Palace – Dong Van Town
Dong Van Town – Volunteer Youth Monument – Ma Pi Leng Pass – Nho Que River Viewpoint – Meo Vac – Ha Giang City → Hanoi

itinerary.title: Ha Giang City – Bac Sum Slope – Quan Ba Heaven Gate – Twin Mountains – Yen Minh – Tham Ma Slope – H’Mong King Palace – Dong Van Town
itinerary.html:
Meals: Lunch, Dinner

08:30 – The tour begins at our homestay in Ha Giang City. Your guide and driver will give you a short safety briefing before you hop into the jeep and start the journey.

You will notice a dramatic change in scenery as you leave the city and drive into the mountains. Along the way, you will:

  • Stop at Bac Sum Slope to enjoy panoramic views and a refreshment break

  • Continue to Quan Ba Heaven Gate and admire the sweeping mountain landscape

  • See the famous Twin Mountains (Fairy Bosom Hills)

  • Enjoy lunch at a local restaurant in Yen Minh Town

In the afternoon, the jeep takes you further along the Ha Giang Loop to:

  • Tham Ma Slope – a stunning zigzag mountain road and classic photo stop

  • H’Mong King Palace (Vuong Family Residence) – the former home of the H’Mong royal family, rich in history and traditional architecture

Arrive in Dong Van Town, check in at the homestay, have dinner, and enjoy free time to explore the old quarter in the evening.

itinerary.title: Dong Van Town – Volunteer Youth Monument – Ma Pi Leng Pass – Nho Que River Viewpoint – Meo Vac – Ha Giang City → Hanoi
itinerary.html:
Meals: Breakfast, Lunch

After breakfast at the homestay, you will start one of the most beautiful driving sections in Vietnam:

  • Drive along the legendary Ma Pi Leng Pass, known as the “Heaven Pass” of Ha Giang

  • Stop at viewpoints to admire the dramatic cliffs and turquoise Nho Que River flowing far below

  • Visit the Volunteer Youth Monument, a historical site along the pass

From Ma Pi Leng, continue by jeep towards Meo Vac, passing through impressive karst formations, terraced fields, and remote villages. You will:

  • Discover stunning mountain scenery and rural life

  • See various hill tribes, such as the H’Mong, in their colorful traditional clothing

  • Have lunch at a local restaurant on the way

In the afternoon, the route leads you back to Ha Giang City, passing equally beautiful landscapes as the first day.

The tour ends in Ha Giang around 17:00.
You will then have free time for dinner on your own before boarding the night sleeper bus back to Hanoi at 21:00.

included: Transportation Hanoi ↔ Ha Giang ↔ Hanoi: Luxury private–cabin sleeper bus (pick–up in Hanoi Old Quarter from 19:30 to 20:00) Limousine bus option (pick–up in Hanoi Old Quarter from 15:00 to 15:30)

zh.summary: 河江吉普车之旅非常适合希望舒适、安全地体验传奇河江环线的旅客。无需自己骑摩托车，您……
route: 河江市 – 北山坡 – 管坝天门 – 双乳山 – 安明 – 坦马坡 – 苗王宫 – 同文镇

itinerary.title: 河江市 – 北山坡 – 管坝天门 – 双乳山 – 安明 – 坦马坡 – 苗王宫 – 同文镇
itinerary.html:
餐食：午餐、晚餐

08:30 – 行程从我们位于河江市的民宿开始。导游和司机将为您做简短的安全讲解，随后登上吉普车开启旅程。

离开市区驶入群山，您会发现景色发生了戏剧性的变化。沿途您将：

  • 在北山坡停留，饱览全景并稍作休息

  • 继续前往管坝天门，欣赏辽阔的山地风光

  • 观赏著名的双乳山（仙女山）

  • 在安明镇当地餐厅享用午餐

下午，吉普车沿河江环线继续前往：

  • 坦马坡 – 令人惊叹的之字形山路，经典拍照点

  • 苗王宫（王氏府邸） – 昔日赫蒙族王族的府邸，历史底蕴深厚，传统建筑独具特色

抵达同文镇，入住民宿，享用晚餐，晚间可自由探索老街。

itinerary.title: 同文镇 – 青年志愿者纪念碑 – 马皮冷山口 – 侬桂河观景台 – 苗旺 – 河江市 → 河内
itinerary.html:
餐食：早餐、午餐

在民宿享用早餐后，开启越南最美的驾车路段之一：

  • 驱车行驶在传奇的马皮冷山口，它被誉为河江的“天堂山口”

  • 在观景台停留，欣赏壮观的悬崖和谷底奔流的碧绿侬桂河

  • 参观山口沿线的历史遗址青年志愿者纪念碑

从马皮冷出发，乘吉普车继续前往苗旺，途经壮观的喀斯特地貌、梯田和偏远村落。您将：

  • 领略令人惊叹的山地风光和乡村生活

  • 见到身着色彩鲜艳传统服饰的赫蒙族等山地民族

  • 途中在当地餐厅享用午餐

下午沿路返回河江市，沿途风景与第一天同样秀美。

约17:00在河江结束行程。
随后自由活动，晚餐自理，21:00乘夜班卧铺巴士返回河内。

title.en: Mekong Delta 2 Days 1 Night
title.zh: 湄公河三角洲2天1晚

summary: Mekong Delta 2 days 1 night tour offers an immersive experience into the unique lifestyle of the Mekong Delta. Escape the busy city of Ho Chi Minh and…
route: Saigon to Can Tho Via My Tho and Ben Tre
Can Tho Floating Market and My Khanh Ecotourism Village

itinerary.title: Saigon to Can Tho Via My Tho and Ben Tre
itinerary.html:
Morning (7:30 – 8:30 AM): Pick-up from centrally located hotels near Ben Thanh Market. Depart for My Tho and Ben Tre in the Mekong Delta.

  • Mekong Restop: Short stop for snacks and restroom.

  • Vinh Trang Pagoda: Built in the 19th century, this pagoda combines European and Asian architectural styles and is ranked third among southern pagodas in terms of artistic and cultural value.

  • My Tho River Cruise: Board a boat on the Tien River, admire the four islets of Long, Lan, Qui, and Phung, and learn about local fish farming. See Rach Mieu Bridge.

  • Thoi Son Island (Lan Island): Walk along village roads, visit local houses and fruit gardens, take photos, visit the honey bee farm, and enjoy honey lemon tea.

  • Experience Don Ca Tai Tu southern folk music, sample fresh fruit, row through narrow canals flanked by coconut trees, and visit a coconut candy workshop to see traditional candy-making.

Noon: Lunch at a local restaurant. After lunch, optional activities include fishing for crocodiles, walking across the monkey bridge, resting in hammocks, or cycling along village roads.

Afternoon (2:30 PM): Return to My Tho by boat and depart for Can Tho (approximately 2–3 hours drive). Check in at a centrally located hotel near Ninh Kieu Wharf.

Evening (6:30 PM): Dinner on a luxury yacht at Ninh Kieu Wharf with Western cuisine and southern folk music.

9:30 PM: Yacht docks, free time to explore Can Tho city at night, then return to the hotel.

itinerary.title: Can Tho Floating Market and My Khanh Ecotourism Village
itinerary.html:
Morning (7:30 AM): Breakfast at the hotel. Depart to Ninh Kieu Wharf for a boat cruise along the Can Tho River.

  • Cai Rang Floating Market: One of the largest floating markets in the Mekong Delta. Learn about local trade and see traditional river life.

  • My Khanh Ecotourism Village: Visit fruit gardens, My Khanh flower garden, and a 100-year-old ancient house.

  • Truc Lam Phuong Nam Zen Monastery: Discover a monastery built in the cultural style of the Ly and Tran dynasties.

Noon: Lunch at My Khanh tourist village. Free time to relax.

Afternoon: Visit Purple House Coffee – Can Tho Film Studio (self-paid ticket). Explore the unique all-purple style of this popular attraction. Depart back to Ho Chi Minh City.

5:30 PM: Arrival in Ho Chi Minh City. Drop-off at Ben Thanh Market or Pham Ngu Lao Street. Tour guide bids farewell.

included: Pick-up and drop-off at centrally located hotels near Ben Thanh Market

zh.summary: 湄公河三角洲2天1晚之旅带您沉浸式体验湄公河三角洲独特的生活方式。逃离繁忙的胡志明市，……
route: 西贡经美萩、槟知前往芹苴
芹苴水上市场与美庆生态旅游村

itinerary.title: 西贡经美萩、槟知前往芹苴
itinerary.html:
上午（7:30 – 8:30）：在滨城市场附近的市中心酒店接您。出发前往湄公河三角洲的美萩和槟知。

  • Mekong Restop休息站：短暂停留，享用小吃、使用洗手间。

  • 永长寺：建于19世纪，融合欧亚建筑风格，其艺术与文化价值在南部寺庙中位列第三。

  • 美萩游船：在前江登船，欣赏龙、麟、龟、凤四座小岛，了解当地养鱼业，观赏沥庙大桥。

  • 泰山岛（麟岛）：漫步乡间小路，参观当地民居和果园，拍照留念，参观养蜂场，品尝蜂蜜柠檬茶。

  • 欣赏才子弹唱南部民间音乐，品尝新鲜水果，划船穿行于椰林夹岸的狭窄河道，参观椰子糖作坊，了解传统制糖工艺。

中午：在当地餐厅享用午餐。午餐后可选活动包括钓鳄鱼、走猴桥、躺吊床休憩或沿乡间小路骑自行车。

下午（14:30）：乘船返回美萩，前往芹苴（车程约2–3小时）。入住宁桥码头附近的市中心酒店。

晚上（18:30）：在宁桥码头的豪华游艇上享用西式晚餐，欣赏南部民间音乐。

21:30：游艇靠岸，自由活动，探索芹苴夜景，随后返回酒店。

itinerary.title: 芹苴水上市场与美庆生态旅游村
itinerary.html:
上午（7:30）：在酒店享用早餐。前往宁桥码头，乘船游览芹苴河。

  • 丐冷水上市场：湄公河三角洲最大的水上市场之一。了解当地水上交易，感受传统的河上生活。

  • 美庆生态旅游村：参观果园、美庆花园和百年古宅。

  • 南方竹林禅院：探访这座以李朝、陈朝文化风格建造的禅院。

中午：在美庆旅游村享用午餐，自由休息。

下午：参观紫色房子咖啡 – 芹苴电影城（门票自理），探索这处热门景点独特的全紫色风格。启程返回胡志明市。

17:30：抵达胡志明市，在滨城市场或范五老街下车。导游与您道别。

title.en: Hanoi City Tour Full Day: History And Culture

summary: Join Vietlook Travel on a one-day Hanoi City Tour to explore iconic landmarks, ancient pagodas, and historic sites. Immerse yourself in the city’s…

itinerary.title: Hanoi City Tour Full Day ( Please dress modestly, covering shoulders and knees).
itinerary.html:
8:00 – 8:30: Pick-up at your hotel and start exploring Hanoi City.

08:45: Arrive at Tran Quoc Pagoda, located on Golden Fish Island in West Lake. It is the oldest pagoda in Hanoi, dating back to the 6th century.

09:30: Visit Ho Chi Minh complex, you have a chance to see the embalmed body of Ho Chi Minh then walk around the garden to see 2 houses where he lived and worked from 1954 to 1969. Then visit One Pillar Pagoda where worships the Godess of Mercy – It is the most unique padoga in the world

  • Should dress modestly by covering from shoulders to knees when visiting Ho Chi Minh mausoleum, temples, pagodas…
  • Ho Chi Minh’s Mausoleum is closed on Mondays and Fridays.
  • Ho Chi Minh’s Mausoleum is closed at least 2 months (15 June -15 August) for the annual maintaining but still can take picture Mausoleum and visit around that area

11:15: Visit the Vietnam Museum of Ethnology to learn about the cultures of the 54 ethnic groups in Vietnam.

12:45: Enjoy lunch at our restaurant with a selection of 8 delicious Vietnamese dishes.

14:00 – 14:15: Continue to visit the Temple of Literature, the first university of Vietnam, established in the 11th century.

15:15: Depart for the Hoa Lo Prison Museum, originally used by the French colonialists to imprison political prisoners, and later used by North Vietnam for U.S. prisoners of war during the Vietnam War. It was known as the “Hanoi Hilton” by American POWs.

16:15 – 16:30: Tour concludes. Return to your hotel.

zh.summary: 跟随Vietlook Travel开启河内一日城市游，探访标志性地标、古老寺庙与历史遗迹，沉浸于这座城市的…
route: 河内全天城市游

itinerary.title: 河内全天城市游（请着装得体，遮盖肩膀和膝盖）
itinerary.html:
8:00 – 8:30: 酒店接您，开启河内城市探索之旅。

08:45: 抵达位于西湖金鱼岛上的镇国寺。镇国寺始建于6世纪，是河内最古老的寺庙。

09:30: 参观胡志明陵园区，您有机会瞻仰胡志明的遗容，随后漫步园中，参观他在1954年至1969年间生活和工作过的两座故居。之后参观供奉观音菩萨的独柱寺——世界上独一无二的寺庙。

  • 参观胡志明陵、寺庙、佛寺等场所时，请着装得体，衣着需遮盖肩膀至膝盖。
  • 胡志明陵逢周一和周五闭馆。
  • 胡志明陵每年至少闭馆2个月（6月15日至8月15日）进行年度维护，但游客仍可在陵外拍照并在周边游览。

11:15: 参观越南民族学博物馆，了解越南54个民族的文化。

12:45: 在我们的餐厅享用午餐，品尝8道精选越南美食。

14:00 – 14:15: 继续参观文庙——越南第一所大学，建于11世纪。

15:15: 前往火炉监狱博物馆。这里最初被法国殖民者用来关押政治犯，后来在越南战争期间被北越用于关押美军战俘，被美国战俘称为“河内希尔顿”。

16:15 – 16:30: 行程结束，返回酒店。

title.en: Ha Noi City Tour 01 Day Trip

summary: The 1-day Hanoi tour will take visitors to Tran Quoc Pagoda located on the eastern island of West Lake, visit Uncle Ho's Mausoleum, Vietnam Museum of Ethnology, Temple of Literature, or meaningful historical sites such as Hoa Lo…
route: Itinerary of Hanoi City Tour full day

itinerary.title: Itinerary of Hanoi City Tour full day
itinerary.html:
08h00-08h30: Tour guide and driver pick you up at your hotel in Hanoi Old Quarter or Hanoi Opera House. Morning Then depart for the trip::

  • Tran Quoc Pagoda is located on an island east of West Lake (Tay Ho district), considered the oldest pagoda in Thang Long – Hanoi, built about 1500 years ago. Since a millennium ago, this place has become the Buddhist center of Thang Long.
  • Visit the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum Complex (Mausoleum and Stilt House) – Where the great leader lived and worked until the last years of his life. Here, you will have the opportunity to learn about Uncle Ho’s simple life. On the way to the garden, you will stop by the One Pillar Pagoda to admire one of the Four Great Symbols of Hanoi.

Note:for departures on Mondays and Fridays, the Mausoleum Management Board will be maintaining the Mausoleum, you cannot enter the Mausoleum.

  • Vietnam Museum of Ethnology: This is the newest but perhaps the largest and certainly the most interesting museum in Hanoi and Vietnam. You have the opportunity to learn about the culture and customs of 54 ethnic groups in Vietnam, especially those in the Central Highlands of Vietnam.

On Mondays, the Vietnam Museum of Ethnology is closed, replaced by the Vietnamese Women’s Museum.

Noon: Return to the Old Quarter for lunch at a restaurant. After lunch, you will be able to see the 36 streets from the bus and listen to the tour guide tell stories about the streets of the ancient urban market.

Afternoon: Continue to visit:

  • The temple of literature (The first university in Vietnam): recognized by UNESCO as a documentary heritage and listed in the “Global Memory” list.
  • Hoa Lo prison: Built in 1899. The French mainly detained political prisoners here, then Vietnamese used it to detain American pilots who were shot down and captured as prisoners of war.

16h00: End of the tour of Hanoi city, the car will take you back to the hotel or depending on the needs of the tourists, the car can take you to a place near Hoan Kiem Lake. Here, you can visit the lake, walk along Hanoi’s Old Quarter or rent a tricycle to explore the Old Quarter or buy tickets to watch a water puppet show.

zh.summary: 河内一日游将带领游客参观位于西湖东侧小岛上的镇国寺，瞻仰胡伯伯陵（胡志明陵），游览越南民族学博物馆、文庙，或火炉监狱等意义非凡的历史遗址…
route: 河内全天城市游行程

itinerary.title: 河内全天城市游行程
itinerary.html:
08h00-08h30: 导游和司机前往您位于河内老城区或河内大剧院附近的酒店接您。上午出发，开启行程：

  • 镇国寺位于西湖（西湖郡）东侧的小岛上，被誉为升龙 – 河内最古老的寺庙，建于约1500年前。千百年来，这里一直是升龙的佛教中心。
  • 参观胡志明陵园区（陵墓及高脚屋）——伟大领袖生活和工作直至晚年的地方。在这里，您将有机会了解胡伯伯简朴的生活。在前往花园的途中，您将驻足独柱寺，欣赏河内四大象征之一。

注意：周一和周五出发的团队，因陵墓管理委员会对陵墓进行维护，无法进入陵内参观。

  • 越南民族学博物馆：这是河内乃至越南最新、或许也是规模最大、无疑最有趣的博物馆。您将有机会了解越南54个民族的文化与习俗，尤其是越南西原地区的民族。

越南民族学博物馆逢周一闭馆，届时将改为参观越南妇女博物馆。

中午：返回老城区，在餐厅享用午餐。午餐后，您可在车上游览三十六行街，聆听导游讲述这座古老城市集市街道的故事。

下午：继续参观：

  • 文庙（越南第一所大学）：被联合国教科文组织认定为文献遗产，列入“世界记忆”名录。
  • 火炉监狱：建于1899年。法国人主要在此关押政治犯，后来越南人用它关押被击落俘获的美国飞行员战俘。

16h00：河内城市游结束，专车送您返回酒店，或根据游客需求，将您送至还剑湖附近。在这里，您可以游览还剑湖、漫步河内老城区，或租乘人力三轮车探索老城区，亦可购票观看水上木偶戏。

title.zh: 拜订寺 – 长安 – 舞洞山一日游

summary: Ninh Binh 1 day tour will take visitors to visit the beauty of Hang Mua, or take a boat to admire the beautiful scenery of ripe rice fields surrounded by undulating limestone mountains, watch the lotus lake with fragrant scent, enjoy a cup of fragrant lotus tea will bring visitors the most enjoyable…
route: Ha Noi - Bai Dinh - Trang An - Mua Cave

itinerary.title: Ha Noi - Bai Dinh - Trang An - Mua Cave
itinerary.html:
07:30 – 08:00 – Your guide will pick you up at your hotel/accommodation and begin your 110km journey by modern bus through lush countryside. Stops along the way.

10:00 – Come to Bai Dinh pagoda complex located at the foot of Dinh mountain, surrounded by majestic limestone mountains, a peaceful scene.

The pagoda complex has the most massive and magnificent architecture of the Vietnamese tradition, built so elaborately that it takes you a whole day to explore it all. So you will visit some of the highlights that belong to the country: 500 stone statues of “La Han” (Arhat), 2 giant bronze bells, one weighing 27 tons, the other weighing 36 tons. Visit the statue of Avalokitesvara with a thousand hands and a thousand eyes, Visit the statue of Gautama Buddha.

12:00 – Enjoy a buffet lunch at the restaurant with local dishes.

13:30 – Coming to Trang An Cave, you will admire the outstanding natural beauty of the majestic limestone massif of 20 km2 rising above the rice fields. Deep in the high mountain ranges are mysterious valleys, many freshwater ponds and primeval forests.

Embark on a traditional sampan gently roweddown the exquisite river through numerous caves: Lam Cave, Vang Cave, Dai Cave, Thanh Truot Cave,…and Cao Sơn Temple, Suoi Tien Temple, Vu Lam Temple…

15:30 – You will visit Hang Mua and conquer Ngoa Long mountain peak to admire the majestic rice valley with beautiful natural scenery.

16:30 – Return to our bus and then come back to Ha noi

18:30 – Drop you off at your hotel/stay. Trip ends.

zh.summary: 宁平一日游将带您领略舞洞山之美，或乘船欣赏起伏的石灰岩群山环抱中金黄稻田的秀丽风光，观赏荷香四溢的荷花湖，品一杯清香的莲花茶，带给游客最愉悦的…
route: 河内 – 拜订寺 – 长安 – 舞洞山

itinerary.title: 河内 – 拜订寺 – 长安 – 舞洞山
itinerary.html:
07:30 – 08:00 – 导游在您的酒店/住处接您，乘坐现代化巴士穿越郁郁葱葱的乡村，开启110公里的旅程，途中设有停靠休息。

10:00 – 抵达位于订山脚下的拜订寺建筑群，四周环绕着雄伟的石灰岩山峰，景色宁静祥和。

拜订寺建筑群拥有越南传统中最宏伟壮观的建筑，建造精美，全部游览需耗时一整天。因此您将参观其中最具代表性的亮点：500尊石雕罗汉像、2口巨型铜钟（一口重27吨，另一口重36吨）、千手千眼观音像以及释迦牟尼佛像。

12:00 – 在餐厅享用当地特色自助午餐。

13:30 – 来到长安，欣赏面积达20平方公里、矗立于稻田之上的雄伟石灰岩山体的非凡自然美景。高耸的山脉深处隐藏着神秘的山谷、众多淡水池塘和原始森林。

乘坐传统舢板，沿着秀美的河流缓缓划行，穿过众多洞穴：Lam洞、Vang洞、Dai洞、Thanh Truot洞……以及高山庙、仙溪庙、武林庙……

15:30 – 游览舞洞山，登顶卧龙山，俯瞰壮丽的稻田山谷与秀美的自然风光。

16:30 – 返回巴士，启程回河内。

18:30 – 送您返回酒店/住处，行程结束。

itinerary.title: Arrival in Hanoi
itinerary.html:
Upon arrival at Noi Bai Airport – Hanoi, the car and tour guide will hold up a welcome sign with your name on it and take you straight to your hotel in the Old Quarter.

  • After checking in, you will have time to relax and adapt to the pace of life in Hanoi. The tour guide will introduce you to your tour schedule, then go enjoy the cuisine at KOTO restaurant in Hanoi.

Overnight in Hanoi
Meals: (_/_/D)

itinerary.title: Hanoi – Full day City Tour & Local food discovery
itinerary.html:
The tour guide and car will take you to visit the city’s attractions, enjoy Hanoi’s dishes at the food stalls.

Morning: Start your tour at the Ho Chi Minh Memorial Site, the ‘Great Father’ of the country, you will visit the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, where the embalmed body of President Ho Chi Minh is kept and his Stilt House to observe how he lived and what his life was like, visit the miniature One Pillar Pagoda from the 11th century, a Buddhist temple of historical and cultural significance.

  • From the Ho Chi Minh Memorial Site, you will take a leisurely walk through the small alleys towards Huu Tiep Lake. Visit the grounds of a 400-year-old temple, then stroll through the traditional local market streets to see the B52 crash site at the lake. This US bomber was shot down during the 1972 bombing of Hanoi, a poignant reminder of Vietnam’s recent history.
  • Drive to the outskirts of Hanoi to visit the Museum of Ethnology, which displays artifacts from Vietnam’s 54 ethnic groups.

Lunch: Pho, at a delicious noodle shop.

Afternoon: Visit the Temple of Literature, which is both a university and a Confucian temple. Next is Hoa Lo (also known as the Hanoi Hilton), a prison used by the French colonialists in Vietnam to hold political prisoners, and later by North Vietnam to hold American prisoners of war.

  • Hop on a cyclo (three-wheeled bicycle) to visit French-style villages, past French-style villas, the Vietnam History Museum, the heritage Metropole Legend Hotel and the Opera House, etc.
  • Enjoy egg coffee at Pho Co Café with a stunning view of Hoan Kiem Lake, Ngoc Son Temple and the surrounding areas.
  • End the day with a walking tour of Hanoi’s Old Quarter (as opposed to the French Quarter) to explore the street food in Hanoi. Your guide will introduce you to the different ingredients and herbs of each dish, Try delicious dishes such as Nom Du Du (green papaya salad), Banh Mi Pho Te (a sandwich that reflects Vietnam’s culinary heritage) and Hanoi’s famous Bun Cha (grilled pork and noodles).

Overnight in Hanoi

Meals: (B/L/D)

itinerary.title: Hanoi – Authentic Local Cooking Class
itinerary.html:
Morning: Private guide and driver out of the city to Ngoc Thuy Market – a vibrant local market. Here, you will have a cooking lesson with a professional chef, you will learn how to prepare local dishes.

  • Then you will visit Ly Thuong Kiet Hero Temple, a local pagoda and a local herb garden, where your private chef will give a short talk about Hanoi cuisine, vegetables, herbs & spices as well as how to prepare & use them.
  • Continue to the cooking school, where you will go into the kitchen and start cooking 4 main dishes of a traditional meal. The practical lesson includes learning cooking, cutting techniques and how to use Vietnamese vegetable peelers & knives. You will be carefully guided step by step by the professional chef to create your own Masterpiece.

Afternoon: After the cooking lesson, you will enjoy with the chef the dishes you have just prepared. Say goodbye to the chef and return to the hotel, you are free to visit the sights, or explore Hanoi Old Quarter and try many famous dishes on the lake such as: Pho Cuon (fresh spring rolls) and Nom (mixed salad).

Overnight in Hanoi

Meals: (B/L/D)

itinerary.title: Hanoi – Halong Bay
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast, check out, your guide will pick you up and take you on a sightseeing tour through the Red River Delta to the legendary Ha Long Bay, where you will experience a traditional Vietnamese Sailing Boat, where you will spend the evening.

  • Upon arrival, you will board the boat to begin your journey around the thousands of islets and limestone caves of the bay.

Afternoon: After lunch on board, you will spend time sunbathing on the deck and enjoying the peaceful tranquility of the bay.

  • Visit the Cave of Surprises “Grotte des Surprises”, a hidden gem of Mother Nature. The boat gently drifts through the beautiful limestone formations containing thousands of stalactites and stalagmites.
  • Cruising through the islands, you will encounter deserted bays, white sand beaches and floating villages, enjoying activities on board and around the beautiful scenery of the Bay.
  • At the end of the day, you will sail to the overnight anchorage area. During this time – the magical “blue hour” – Halong Bay reveals its true magnificence. You have the opportunity to attend a cooking demonstration by the chef or watch the breathtaking sunset on the deck before dinner. Then you are free to explore, watch a movie or join the crew in squid fishing before retiring to your room to rest.

Note: If time permits, you can spend the night on the boat to enjoy the scenery and go deeper into the bay.

Overnight on the boat in Halong Bay

Meals: (B/L/D)

itinerary.title: Halong Bay – Hanoi
itinerary.html:
Morning: Wake up early to practice gentle Tai Chi to start your day as a local custom. Join a morning class with a ‘Local Expert’ on the Junk’s deck in a beautiful natural setting. Enjoy the morning seascape, experience kayaking and rowing through Bright and Dark Caves, admiring the sparkling rock walls.

  • Return to the Junk to check out then enjoy a full breakfast buffet as you return to the port.

Afternoon: Upon returning to the mainland, your guide and driver will take you back to Hanoi.

Overnight in Hanoi

Meals: (B/L/_)

itinerary.title: Hanoi – Mai Chau
itinerary.html:
Morning: Car and tour guide pick you up to visit through green rice fields and majestic mountains to Mai Chau, surrounded by rows of cool green trees.

  • Arrive in Mai Chau around noon and you check in at the charming Mai Chau Ecolodge. Located in the Mai Chau valley surrounded by mountains and rice fields, Mai Chau ecolodge is a peaceful oasis.

Afternoon: Tour guide will take you on foot (or bike if you want) to Pom Coong and Lac villages. With stilt houses and peaceful scenery, Lac and Pom Coong villages are ancient and peaceful Thai ethnic villages where you experience the life of the people here.

  • Visit Mo Luong cave and Chieu cave with many stalactites and stalagmites thousands of years old, beautiful works of art by mother nature. Filled with shapes, sizes and colors, the caves will make you feel like you are lost in the ancient world of primitive creations.
  • Visit the Thai Ethnology Museum. More than 1,000 artifacts are displayed, closely related to the daily life of the Thai people. You will see hunting tools, ceremonial costumes, bowls, plates, ancient coins, musical instruments, hundreds of years old books… exuding Thai culture.

Evening: Enjoy the atmosphere of Mai Chau, and enjoy local dishes, while sipping a glass of spicy rice wine.

  • After dinner, you will return to Mai Chau Lodge to watch a traditional dance performance by the White Thai people.

Overnight in Mai Chau

Meals: (B/L/D)

itinerary.title: Mai Chau - Cycling the countryside
itinerary.html:
Morning: Your local guide takes you on a bike ride through the local valleys. Your first 6 miles will wind through the villages of Chieng Chau and Van Mai, passing through the villages of the ethnic minorities, and learning about their culture.

  • Continue another 6 miles to the Thai village of Cun Pheo on a mix of single-track and rugged jeep trails. The scenery is stunning as you ride through villages and lush rice paddies, lined with palm trees used by the highlanders for roofing, passing hot springs, cycling over suspension bridges and following the contours of beautiful terraced rice fields.
  • Around noon, you will arrive at Ban Buoc, a picturesque village of the White Thai minority, and stroll around this peaceful village. Finally, you will visit a local family where you will be treated to a delicious home-cooked lunch.

Afternoon: Say goodbye to your host family, pick up your bikes and cycle back along the scenic route to Mai Chau, where you will spend your second night at the beautiful Mai Chau Ecolodge.

Overnight in Mai Chau

Meals: (B/L/_)

itinerary.title: Mai Chau – Ninh Binh
itinerary.html:
Morning: From Mai Chau, you will cross the mountainous forest roads and arrive at the ancient capital of Ninh Binh. Only three hours from Mai Chau, Ninh Binh with its majestic limestone mountains

  • Arrive in Ninh Binh around noon and enjoy lunch at a local restaurant.

Afternoon: Take a traditional bamboo boat tour of the mountainous landscape to Van Long Nature Reserve, where many scenes in the movie Kong: Skull Island took place. Gliding through the poetic landscapes and rolling hills, you will capture beautiful scenes.

  • Visit Hoa Lu, the ancient capital of Vietnam dating back to the 11th century, with breathtaking scenery creating a mystical atmosphere that is sure to stimulate your imagination. Once there, immerse yourself in history at the two remaining temples of King Dinh and King Le. Renovated in the 17th century, it is believed that the temples were built on the original foundations of the old palaces from the 11th and 12th centuries.
  • Experience cycling through the towering limestone mountains above you as you travel along the small roads and stunning views. At Hang Mua Mountain, take a scenic walk along the Ngo Dong River below cutting through the towering mountains.
  • Transfer to Tam Coc Garden Resort for an overnight stay, surrounded by stunning rice fields and limestone formations, Tam Coc Resort is an oasis that will take you away from the hustle and bustle of city life amidst the most stunning landscapes.

Overnight in Ninh Binh

Meals: (B/L/_)

itinerary.title: Ninh Binh – Nam Dinh
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast, the car will take you from Ninh Binh 3 hours to Xuan Thuy National Park Nam Dinh, 150 km southwest of Hanoi in the coastal region of the Red River Delta. On the way, you will visit the ancient Co Le Pagoda dating back to the 10th century.

  • Visit Vi Khe Village, you will admire the rows of green trees such as phoenix, dragon, horse, unicorn … or the symbol of the Temple of Literature.
  • Arrive at Xuan Thuy National Park, formerly known as the Regional Nature Reserve and later became the first Ramsar site in Vietnam, to preserve wetlands. Xuan Thuy National Park is located in the Red River Biosphere Reserve recognized by UNESCO. This is a coastal wetland with rich biodiversity, home to about 220 species of birds, 110 species of aquatic plants and 500 other species of aquatic organisms.
  • At around noon, you will arrive at Xuan Giao Commune near the National Park. Here, you will board a boat to explore the wetlands. Then go to the Clam House, you will enjoy a delicious seafood lunch. Rest and relax in the Clam House before getting on the bus back to the mainland.

Afternoon: You will start a relaxing tour around Giao Xuan Commune and through the villages. Walk along the inter-village road to see the lives of local people and watch them harvest the season or visit the old houses, Catholic churches and the Agricultural Museum. If it is sunny, you can visit the salt fields to see the locals making salt. You can try making salt.

  • Go to the bird station (applicable for winter from November to March) to see many species of birds flying from East Asia to Australia such as: Black-faced Spoonbill, Spoonbill, Spotted Green-billed Swallow, Saunders Gull and Asian Yellow-billed Swallow…

Evening: You will arrive at the house of the people in Xuan Giao Commune, and you will enjoy dinner and stay overnight here.

Overnight in Xuan Giao Nam Dinh

Meals: (B/L/D)

itinerary.title: Nam Dinh – Day train to Dong Hoi – Phong Nha
itinerary.html:
Morning: Take a relaxing bike ride (or car) around the commune, watch the beautiful sunrise over the sea and then visit the local Fish Market, where you can watch fishermen bring in their overnight catch. Hundreds of people from surrounding villages flock to this wholesale market to buy the best of the day.

  • On the way, you will stop to visit a local fish sauce family, where you can see the traditional method of making this delicious sauce.

After breakfast, check out and drive to Nam Dinh station to catch the train to Dong Hoi Quang Binh. The train journey lasts 8 hours and you will have a nice and comfortable air-conditioned four-berth soft sleeper compartment.

Evening: Arrive in Dong Hoi, your guide and driver will pick you up at the boat exit and take you to Chay Lap Resort and Farm, where you will spend the night, the resort is located among limestone mountains, away from the tourist trails, Chay Lap is a true gem of Phong Nha & Ke Bang National Park.

Overnight in Phong Nha National Park

Meals: (B/_/_)

itinerary.title: Discover Phong Nha Cave and Paradise Cave
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast, you will be taken to explore Phong Nha Cave, the longest limestone cave in the world, which was once used as a hospital and ammunition depot during the Vietnam War. You will enter the cave by boat along the Son River and once inside, you will be amazed by the fine sand beaches, spectacular milky white stalagmites and stalactites of the cave.

  • Visit the historic Tam Co Cave with its fascinating war history.

Afternoon: After lunch at a local restaurant, you will visit Thien Duong Cave. Discovered in 2005 by scientists from the British Cave Research Association, Thien Duong Cave is a magical complex of skyscraper-high stalagmites and stalactites suspended like the pipes of a giant church organ, with the majesty of a church, with wooden steps and walkways leading across the uneven floor.

  • Return to the Farmstay in the late afternoon, you are free to explore the scenery, or you have the option to cycle around the local villages.

Overnight in Phong Nha National Park

Meals: (B/L/_)

itinerary.title: Phong Nha – Dong Hoi – Day train to Hue
itinerary.html:
Morning: You will be served at the Farmstay and check out at noon.

Afternoon: Your guide and driver will pick you up at the Farmstay and take you to Dong Hoi Train Station to catch the daytime train (soft seat with air conditioning) to Hue, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and the former capital of the Vietnamese Empire from 1802 to 1945.

Evening: Your guide and driver will pick you up at the train station and take you to the hotel to check in. You are free to relax. Your guide will recommend a good restaurant near the hotel for your dinner.

Overnight in Hue

Meals: (B/_/_)

itinerary.title: Hue – Full day City tour
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast, you will explore the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Hue with your guide and driver, where you will see some of Hue’s important historical sights and landmarks:
Take a cyclo (rickshaw) through the ‘Old Quarter’ to Tinh Tam Lake, where the Emperors used to relax.

  • From the lake, head to the ancient and atmospheric walled Citadel, home to the former Royal Palace and the Forbidden City.
  • The Hue Museum of Royal Antiquities houses a stunning collection of royal antiques.
  • The impressive tomb of Emperor Tu Duc and Vietnam’s only Roman Colosseum.
  • Visit the local Buddhist temple, where you will be treated to a delicious vegetarian lunch cooked and served by nuns. Learn about Buddhism or just get to know your friendly hosts.

Afternoon: Take a dragon boat ride on the poetic Perfume River, and you will stop to visit the iconic Thien Mu Pagoda – Hue’s most famous religious site. Explore the pagoda’s landscaped gardens, seven-story octagonal tower and watch monks chanting sutras.

  • Visit Truc Chi Garden, a bamboo paper handicraft workshop. You will have the opportunity to meet practitioners and have a hands-on experience to learn how to use bamboo pulp carving techniques to create works of art.
    Return to the hotel in the late afternoon, where you are free to relax for the rest of the day.

Overnight in Hue
Meals: (B/L/_)

itinerary.title: Hue – Da Nang – Hoi An
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast, drive from Hue to Da Nang and Hoi An for four hours along the coast, enjoying one of the most scenic drives through the Hai Van Pass (Sea Cloudy Pass). From the top of the pass, you can enjoy the view.

  • Upon arrival in Da Nang, you will visit the Marble Mountains, the Cham Museum and the long My Khe Beach.
  • Continue driving to Hoi An around noon. Check in at your boutique resort, just a short distance from the old town.

Afternoon: You are free to relax. Enjoy the resort’s facilities or stroll around the Old Town, admiring the colorful lanterns and bougainvillea vines that surround the poetic landscape.

Overnight in Hoi An

Meals: (B/_/_)

itinerary.title: Hoi An – Walking & Food Tour
itinerary.html:
Morning: After enjoying a late breakfast at the hotel.

Afternoon: Your guide will pick you up and take you to Hoi An Ancient Town, where you will walk to visit places such as: Ong Pagoda, Tan Ky Ancient House, Phuc Kien Assembly Hall and Japanese Covered Bridge.

  • Precious Heritage Museum, where the Precious Heritage Collection of Réhahn is permanently displayed.
  • Visit Reaching Out Tea House, a small oasis of welcome peace in the bustling Old Town, owned and operated by deaf and mute people. Here, you will be treated to delicious cakes and wonderful oriental tea.
  • Visit a lantern artisan’s house, where you can observe the lantern-making techniques of the craftsmen before practicing each stage of making lanterns under the guidance of the craftsmen: from bending the lantern into the frame, cutting the fabric, gluing, to finishing the lantern. Before the end of the tour, you will have a lantern made by your own hands.
  • Discover Hoi An street food. Together with your guide, you will weave through the small alleys, enjoying dishes with the locals at the stalls. At 4pm every day, Hoi An streets are filled with countless street food carts, stalls and street vendors, you will enjoy some of Hoi An’s specialties prepared by the locals, introduce you to the faces behind the broth and teach you how the locals handle those spice trays!

Overnight in Hoi An

Meals: (B/_/D)

itinerary.title: Hoi An – My Son Holly Land
itinerary.html:
Morning: After an early breakfast, your guide and driver will pick you up and take you to My Son Sanctuary, about an hour inland from Hoi An. The remains of the Cham culture. In 1999, UNESCO recognized My Son as a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

  • You will take a two-hour walking tour around this historic complex. Learn about the construction techniques, traditional materials used, such as: Wood, brick and stone. You will also find many bomb craters left here by American bombs from the war in the 1960s and 1970s.
  • After exploring the ruins, you will watch a traditional Apsara Dance next to the historic temples. The girls will perform the dance to the sound of pans and drums, wearing colorful traditional costumes and conical hats.
  • Return to the hotel in Hoi An. Stop on the way to visit a rice paper workshop to test your cooking skills and learn how to make a delicious local snack. Afterwards, enjoy your creations with a cup of Vietnamese coffee and a friendly chat with your host about the rural lifestyle here.

Afternoon: You are free to explore, explore the local market and try street food (try Lao Cau and White Rose Dumplings), sew something for 24 hours, join a hands-on cooking class.

  • The beautiful An Bang Beach is only 5 km from the Old Town. You can cycle there for swimming and relaxing.

Overnight in Hoi An

Meals: (B/_/_)

itinerary.title: Hoi An – Day at leisure
itinerary.html:
A completely free day for you in paradise, you Visit the Old Town again and enjoy everything Hoi An has to offer, from restaurants to cafes and bakeries. You can join a Yoga or Qigong Tai Chi class at Nomad Yoga Hoi An. Besides classes, you can socialize with other like-minded people.

Overnight in Hoi An

Meals: (B/_/_)

itinerary.title: Hoi An – Da Nang – Flight to Buon Ma Thuot
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast, the car will take you to Da Nang Airport to catch a flight to Buon Ma Thuot in the Central Highlands, Vietnam.

  • Upon arrival, the tour guide and driver will pick you up and take you straight to the hotel in the city center to check in.

Afternoon: Explore Buon Ma Thuot, the coffee capital of Vietnam, visit Trung Nguyen coffee village, a beautiful garden with fountains, architects… Here, you can learn about Vietnamese coffee culture, coffee trees, coffee processing industry.

  • Visit the Museum of Ethnology. The exhibitions here will give you an insight into the life and culture of ethnic minorities in the Central Highlands, Vietnam.
  • Visit Kien Cuong Civet Coffee Garden. You will meet the owner Kien Cuong “coffee king”, who will tell you how he grows and processes the famous civet coffee (the most expensive coffee in the world).
  • Visit AkoDhong village, home to the Ede ethnic minority who live in long stilt houses, stop at the village chief’s house (Ama H’Rin’s house) and learn about the Ede and their matriarchy.

Return to Buon Ma Thuot in the late afternoon and spend the rest of the day at leisure.

Overnight in Buon Ma Thuot

Meals: (B/_/_)

itinerary.title: Buon Ma Thuot – Elephant experience full day
itinerary.html:
After an early breakfast, your guide and driver will pick you up from your hotel and take you to Yok Don National Park to join the Elephant Conservation Project team.

  • Upon arrival, after a briefing, you will meet the elephant keepers and enjoy a full day of exploring the forest in search of three elephants that are currently roaming freely in the national park. Your guide will tell you about each elephant’s personality, their background and why they live in Yok Don National Park.
  • Your guide will share with you the flora and fauna that inhabit this forest and show you plants that are used in traditional medicine by some local ethnic minorities.
  • You may come across signs of rare wild elephants in the park, such as footprints, feeding signs or their droppings.
  • Enjoy a picnic lunch in the middle of the park.

Afternoon: You will continue hiking until you reach the elephants’ home deep in the forest. You will have the opportunity to meet the elephants and participate in bathing them (30 minutes) and feeding them bananas and sugar cane. Because it is a conservation area, you are not allowed to ride the elephants.

  • End of a wonderful day and return to Buon Ma Thuot.

Overnight in Buon Ma Thuot

Meals: (B/L/_)

itinerary.title: Buon Ma Thuot – Lak Lake – Da Lat
itinerary.html:
After breakfast and check out your private guide and driver will take visit the famous waterfalls of D’ray Nur and Dray Sap. Fed by the Srepock River, a major tributary of the Mekong River that flows from the Central Highlands into northeastern Cambodia, Dray Nur and Dray Sap waterfalls are definitely the must-sees.

  • Upon arrival, take a short walk through some lush forest and around the base of the waterfall. If you’re really feeling adventurous you can walk under a small portion of the waterfall and rinse off.
  • Depart Buon Ba Thuat you will be driven to Lak Lake. Vast, tranquil and fringed by rolling hills, Lak Lake is the Central Highland’s largest natural freshwater lake. Take a boat trip on the lake and visit a local village, home to the Mnong people, a tribe that relies on the lake for their livelihood and they can be seen fishing in traditional dugout canoes.
  • After the boat trip, pay a visit to Bao Dai Villa where the last King of Vietnam used to live. Perched on top of a hill, the building was one of the emperor’s many, many holiday homes in the Central Highlands, a region he frequented to indulge in one of his favourite pastimes, hunting.
  • Continue your road journey south passing through spectacular mountain scenery, to the former French colonial hill station of Dalat. The high altitude, cool climate and natural beauty are what first drew the French colonialists here in the first half of the 20th century. It flourished as an alpine/lakeside summer holiday town, garnering it yet a nickname, “Le Petit Paris” or little Paris.

Arrive Da Lat in the late afternoon and check into your resort. The remainder of the day will be at your leisure.

Overnight in Da Lat
Meals: (B/_/_)

itinerary.title: Da Lat – Full day City tour
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast, the car and tour guide will take you to visit Da Lat, visit Bao Dai located on a hill.

  • Visit Truc Lam Zen Monastery (the largest Zen school in Vietnam today) surrounded by pine forests. You can take the cable car down 300 meters to visit Tuyen Lam Lake which looks like a paradise.
  • Visit Hang Nga Crazy House (also known as Hang Nga Guesthouse), in contrast to the French colonial villas of Da Lat, the pioneering guesthouse is a maze of spiral staircases, sculpted bedrooms, wavy surfaces, swirls of bright colors, narrow bridges and hidden nooks.

Afternoon: After lunch at a local restaurant, you visit Xuan Huong Lake and Lam Ty Ni Pagoda, where the Buddhist folk monk Vien Thuc created abstract paintings and wrote poetry.

  • Visit the XQ embroidery workshop and art gallery, where you can learn about the history of Vietnamese art and enjoy many handmade embroidery masterpieces.
  • Visit the famous central market with fresh flowers, vegetables and rare fruits. Walk through the small alleys and join the locals to taste one of the many street foods such as: Grilled pork, grilled vegetables and especially Dalat pizza, a round rice paper, covered with egg coating and grilled over charcoal.

Overnight in Dalat

Meals: (B/L/D)

itinerary.title: Da Lat – Nha Trang
itinerary.html:
After breakfast, drive from Da Lat to Nha Trang along the scenic Ngoan Muc Pass, passing through tea plantations, forests and ethnic villages.

  • Arrive in Nha Trang, check in at your chosen resort and enjoy the rest of the day at your leisure.
  • Nha Trang is best known for its long stretch of golden sand beaches lined with palm trees, with an average temperature of 26 degrees Celsius.
  • In the evening, you are free to explore Nha Trang, with many great outdoor bars and restaurants.

Overnight in Nha Trang

Meals: (B/_/_)

itinerary.title: Nha Trang – Discover the Bay with Emperor Cruise
itinerary.html:
Morning: You arrive at Nha Trang Port and board the Emperor Cruise.

  • Upon arrival, you will be warmly welcomed by the captain and crew, followed by a brief introduction to Nha Trang Bay, local people, cuisine, culture, safety precautions and the Emperor Cruise.
  • Start cruising to see the breathtaking scenery of Nha Trang Bay. Enjoy a welcome drink while the guitarist will take you into the world of deep classical music.
  • In the late morning, you will arrive at Mini Beach, where you can swim, kayak, snorkel. In addition, you can relax under the large trees, admire the beautiful bay and the sails of the Emperor Cruise.
  • Besides, there are many other activities on the sea that you can join such as: Scuba diving, Jet skiing, Parasailing and Banana boat…
  • Enjoy a hearty lunch on board with local beer, soft drinks, fine wine or fine spirits as the boat anchors near Hon Tre Island with its tranquil lagoon.

Afternoon: After lunch, you can go fishing, relax or visit a fish farm to explore the beautiful landscape by basket boat.

  • Cruise back to Nha Trang Port via Vung Ngan floating village and Vinpearl Island, before catching a glimpse of Bao Dai Villa as you return to the mainland.
  • Return to your resort where you spend the rest of the day at your leisure.

Overnight in Nha Trang

Meals: (B/L/_)

itinerary.title: Nha Trang – Day at leisure
itinerary.html:
The whole day is free at your leisure. Enjoy the comforts of the resort, indulge in spa treatments or just relax on the white sand beach.

Overnight in Nha Trang
Meals: (B/_/_)

itinerary.title: Nha Trang – Day at leisure
itinerary.html:
Enjoy another day at leisure in Nha Trang.

Overnight in Nha Trang
Meals: (B/_/_)

itinerary.title: Nha Trang – Flight to Can Tho – Bassac Cruise
itinerary.html:
Morning: You will be picked up at Nha Trang airport for a short flight to Can Tho, located in the heart of the Mekong Delta.

  • Upon arrival at Can Tho airport, you will be picked up and transferred to Ninh Kieu wharf, where you will board the Bassac Boat, a beautifully crafted wooden boat that has the style and elegance of the traditional rice barges typical of the Mekong Delta, where you will spend the evening.
  • Enjoy a drink, listen to an introduction to the boat and crew, and begin your cruise down the Hau River.

Lunch: You will enjoy lunch on the upper deck of the boat.

Afternoon: You will disembark and walk around the local villages and learn about the lifestyle of the villagers, such as how they grow rice, fruit and vegetables. You will stop to visit and experience the life of the people along the river.

  • Return to the boat, relax on the deck and watch the sunset. Enjoy dinner on board as the boat cruises along the Mang Thit River towards its anchorage for the night.

Overnight on the Bassac Boat

Meals: (B/L/D)

itinerary.title: Cai Be – Ho Chi Minh City
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast on the boat, travel to Cai Be.

  • Bassac crosses the Co Chien River and drifts into Cho Lach Canal, amidst the bustling traffic, markets and churches, giving you a unique experience of seeing the diverse life on the shore as well as on the water.
  • Arriving near Cai Be, check out and transfer to a rowing boat to visit a small canal if the tide permits.
  • Meet a local boat, which will take you to the shore to visit the local handicraft industry of Cai Be.
  • The tour will end in Cai Be town, your guide and car will take you straight to Ho Chi Minh City.

Afternoon: Arrive and check in to your hotel in the city center. The rest of the afternoon and evening is free to visit the Night Market and enjoy delicious local dishes.

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City

Meals: (B/_/_)

itinerary.title: HCM City – Sightseeing tour full day
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast, the tour guide and car will pick you up at the hotel to start the first tour to the Reunification Palace. Then, go to the War Remnants Museum, you will learn about the historical site, with many documents of the war, you can also see the collection of bombs, tanks, planes and helicopters displayed in the outdoor area.

  • Visit Paris Square, a small square located in the center of Ho Chi MinhCity in District 1, located between Saigon Notre Dame Cathedral and Nguyen Du Street. Visit the Central Post Office and Notre Dame Cathedral and the absolute beauty of the church …

Lunch: Enjoy a delicious lunch with Banh Xeo, Bo La Lot and Nem Cuon.

Afternoon: After lunch, you will visit the Fito Museum. Then, you will go to an old apartment where the last US helicopter left Vietnam in 1975, signaling the end of the War. You will pass by the former US Embassy and Villa 60 Vo Van Tan, which was the residence of General William Westmoreland, commander of all US forces in Vietnam.

  • Visit the famous Jade Emperor Pagoda built by the first Chinese community in Ho Chi Minh City over 100 years ago. The pagoda is also known as Turtle Pagoda and is one of the five most important pagodas in the city.
  • Visit the top of Bitexco Tower, the tallest building in Vietnam to watch the sunset and get the best panoramic view of the city.

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City

Meals: (B/L/_)

itinerary.title: HCM City – Cao Dai Temple & Cu Chi tunnels
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast, your guide and driver will pick you up and take you to Cu Chi, a small community northwest of Ho Chi Minh City, famous for its network of deep tunnels that served as a hideout and an effective infiltration source for the Viet Cong during the final years of the Vietnam War.

  • Upon arrival, you will watch old documentary footage, tour the secret Viet Cong tunnel network that stretched for “hundreds of miles”, total length, with living quarters, storage rooms, makeshift hospitals and kitchens… Although initially very narrow, some sections have been opened to tourists and you have the opportunity to explore some parts of the system.
  • Try some of the wartime staples, with cassava served with sour tea.
  • Leaving Cu Chi, you will go to Cao Dai Temple in Tay Ninh Province, explore the sacred temple and learn more about the Cao Dai religion, you will attend the noon mass, admire the monks in traditional costumes and listen to the enchanting hymns.

Afternoon: After lunch at a local restaurant, you will return to the hotel in Ho Chi Minh City. Free to relax the rest of the day.

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City

Meals: (B/L/_)

itinerary.title: HCM City – Departure
itinerary.html:
Pick up from your hotel after breakfast and transfer to Ho Chi Minh International Airport where you can catch your flight home or continue your adventure, we will help you plan.

Meals: (B/_/_)

zh.summary: 用30天29晚探寻越南之美，沿着S形的国土深入了解越南的文化、风光与人民：游览首都河内，乘游船畅游下龙湾，骑行探访乡村，一边欣赏美景一边品一杯香茶，或在诗意的风景中享用美味佳肴，让您的旅程比以往更加诗情画意……

itinerary.title: 抵达河内
itinerary.html:
抵达河内内排机场后，司机和导游将手举写有您姓名的接机牌迎候，随后直接送您前往老城区的酒店。

  • 办理入住后，您可以稍作休息，适应河内的生活节奏。导游将向您介绍行程安排，随后前往河内的KOTO餐厅享用美食。

夜宿河内
餐食：（含晚餐）

itinerary.title: 河内 – 全天市区游及地道美食探索
itinerary.html:
导游和专车将带您游览城市景点，并在美食摊品尝河内特色菜肴。

上午：从胡志明纪念区开始行程。胡志明被誉为越南的“国父”，您将参观安放胡志明主席遗体的胡志明陵，以及他的高脚屋，了解他生前的生活起居；随后参观建于11世纪、小巧精致的独柱寺，这是一座具有重要历史和文化意义的佛教寺庙。

  • 从胡志明纪念区出发，您将漫步穿过小巷前往友谊湖（Huu Tiep），参观一座有400年历史的古庙，再沿着传统的本地市场街道前行，观看湖中的B52轰炸机残骸。这架美国轰炸机在1972年轰炸河内期间被击落，令人深刻地追忆越南的近代历史。
  • 驱车前往河内郊区参观民族学博物馆，馆内展示了越南54个民族的文物。

午餐：在一家美味的粉店品尝越南河粉（Pho）。

下午：参观文庙，这里既是越南最早的大学，也是一座孔庙。接着前往火炉监狱（又称“河内希尔顿”），这里曾是法国殖民者关押政治犯的监狱，后来又被北越用来关押美国战俘。

  • 乘坐人力三轮车游览法式街区，途经法式别墅、越南历史博物馆、历史悠久的Metropole Legend Hotel以及河内大剧院等。
  • 在Pho Co Café品尝鸡蛋咖啡，俯瞰还剑湖、玉山祠及周边的迷人景色。
  • 以步行游览河内老城区（与法国区相对）结束这一天，探寻河内街头美食。导游将为您介绍每道菜所用的食材与香草，带您品尝青木瓜沙拉（Nom Du Du）、Banh Mi Pho Te（体现越南饮食传统的法棍三明治）以及河内著名的烤肉米线（Bun Cha）等美味。

夜宿河内

餐食：（含早、午、晚餐）

itinerary.title: 河内 – 正宗本地烹饪课
itinerary.html:
上午：私人导游和司机带您出城，前往热闹的本地市场——玉瑞市场（Ngoc Thuy）。在这里，您将跟随专业厨师上一堂烹饪课，学习制作地道的越南菜肴。

  • 随后参观李常杰英雄祠、一座本地寺庙和一处本地香草园，您的私人厨师将简要讲解河内美食、蔬菜、香草与香料，以及它们的处理和使用方法。
  • 继续前往烹饪学校，走进厨房，开始烹制一顿传统家常饭的4道主菜。实践课程包括烹饪方法、刀工技巧以及越南削皮刀和厨刀的使用。专业厨师将一步步细心指导，帮助您完成属于自己的“杰作”。

下午：烹饪课结束后，与厨师一同享用您亲手制作的菜肴。告别厨师后返回酒店，您可自由游览景点，或探索河内老城区，在湖边品尝众多著名小吃，如河粉卷（Pho Cuon）和越式凉拌（Nom）。

夜宿河内

餐食：（含早、午、晚餐）

itinerary.title: 河内 – 下龙湾
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐后办理退房，导游将接您出发，途经红河三角洲，前往充满传奇色彩的下龙湾，体验越南传统帆船，并在船上过夜。

  • 抵达后登船，开始在海湾成千上万座小岛和石灰岩溶洞之间巡游。

下午：在船上享用午餐后，您可以在甲板上晒日光浴，尽享海湾的宁静祥和。

  • 参观惊讶洞（“Grotte des Surprises”），这是大自然隐藏的瑰宝。游船缓缓驶过美丽的石灰岩地貌，洞内有成千上万的钟乳石和石笋。
  • 穿行于群岛之间，您将看到幽静的海湾、白色沙滩和水上渔村，在美丽的海湾风光中享受船上及周边的各项活动。
  • 傍晚时分，游船驶向过夜停泊区。此时正值神奇的“蓝调时刻”，下龙湾展现出它真正的壮美。晚餐前，您可以观看厨师的烹饪示范，或在甲板上欣赏令人屏息的日落。之后可自由活动、观看电影，或与船员一起钓鱿鱼，然后回房休息。

注意：如时间允许，您可以在船上多住一晚，尽情欣赏美景，深入海湾更深处。

夜宿下龙湾游船

餐食：（含早、午、晚餐）

itinerary.title: 下龙湾 – 河内
itinerary.html:
上午：清晨早起，像当地人一样练习舒缓的太极拳，开启美好的一天。在风景优美的帆船甲板上，跟随“本地达人”参加晨练课程。欣赏清晨海景，体验皮划艇和划船穿越明洞与暗洞，欣赏晶莹闪烁的岩壁。

  • 返回帆船办理退房，在返回码头途中享用丰盛的自助早餐。

下午：返回陆地后，导游和司机将送您返回河内。

夜宿河内

餐食：（含早、午餐）

itinerary.title: 河内 – 梅州
itinerary.html:
上午：专车和导游接您出发，途经绿油油的稻田和雄伟的群山，前往绿树成荫的梅州。

  • 中午前后抵达梅州，入住迷人的Mai Chau Ecolodge。该生态度假村坐落在群山与稻田环绕的梅州山谷中，宛如一片宁静的世外桃源。

下午：导游将带您步行（如您愿意也可骑自行车）前往Pom Coong村和Lac村。这两座古老宁静的泰族村寨保留着高脚屋和恬静的田园风光，您可以在这里体验当地人的生活。

  • 参观Mo Luong洞和Chieu洞，洞内有许多历经数千年的钟乳石和石笋，堪称大自然的艺术杰作。洞中形态各异、大小不一、色彩缤纷，让您仿佛置身于远古的原始世界。
  • 参观泰族民族学博物馆，馆内展出1,000多件与泰族日常生活息息相关的文物，包括狩猎工具、礼仪服饰、碗盘、古钱币、乐器、数百年历史的古籍……处处散发着泰族文化的气息。

晚上：感受梅州的氛围，品尝当地菜肴，小酌一杯辛辣的米酒。

  • 晚餐后返回Mai Chau Lodge，观看白泰族的传统舞蹈表演。

夜宿梅州

餐食：（含早、午、晚餐）

itinerary.title: 梅州 – 骑行乡村
itinerary.html:
上午：当地导游带您骑自行车穿越当地山谷。最初的6英里蜿蜒穿过Chieng Chau村和Van Mai村，途经少数民族村寨，了解他们的文化。

  • 继续骑行6英里，沿着单车小径和崎岖的吉普车道前往泰族村寨Cun Pheo。沿途风景美不胜收：穿过村庄和郁郁葱葱的稻田，两旁是山民用来盖屋顶的棕榈树，途经温泉，骑过吊桥，沿着美丽的梯田轮廓前行。
  • 中午前后抵达白泰族风景如画的村寨Ban Buoc，在宁静的村中漫步。最后拜访一户当地人家，享用美味的家常午餐。

下午：告别寄宿家庭，骑上自行车沿着风景优美的路线返回梅州，第二晚入住美丽的Mai Chau Ecolodge。

夜宿梅州

餐食：（含早、午餐）

itinerary.title: 梅州 – 宁平
itinerary.html:
上午：从梅州出发，穿越山林公路，抵达古都宁平。距梅州仅三小时车程的宁平拥有雄伟的石灰岩山峦。

  • 中午前后抵达宁平，在当地餐厅享用午餐。

下午：乘坐传统竹船游览山水风光，前往云龙自然保护区，电影《金刚：骷髅岛》的许多场景都在这里拍摄。小船在诗意的山水与起伏的丘陵间穿行，您可以尽情拍下美丽的画面。

  • 参观华闾古都，这是越南11世纪的古都，令人惊叹的景色营造出神秘的氛围，定能激发您的想象。在这里，您将参观仅存的丁先皇祠和黎大行皇祠，沉浸在历史之中。两座祠庙于17世纪重修，据信建在11至12世纪旧宫殿的原址之上。
  • 沿着乡间小路骑行，头顶是高耸的石灰岩山峰，沿途风光令人惊叹。在舞洞山，沿着山下穿越群山的Ngo Dong河进行一段风景优美的漫步。
  • 前往Tam Coc Garden Resort入住。Tam Coc Resort被美丽的稻田和石灰岩地貌环绕，宛如一片绿洲，让您在绝美的风景中远离城市的喧嚣。

夜宿宁平

餐食：（含早、午餐）

itinerary.title: 宁平 – 南定
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐后，专车载您从宁平出发，约3小时车程前往南定省春水国家公园，该公园位于河内西南150公里处的红河三角洲沿海地区。途中参观始建于10世纪的古利寺（Co Le）。

  • 参观Vi Khe村，欣赏一排排修剪成凤、龙、马、麒麟……或文庙标志等造型的绿植盆景。
  • 抵达春水国家公园。这里前身为地区自然保护区，后成为越南第一个拉姆萨尔湿地保护地。春水国家公园位于联合国教科文组织认定的红河生物圈保护区内，是一片生物多样性丰富的沿海湿地，栖息着约220种鸟类、110种水生植物和500种其他水生生物。
  • 中午前后抵达国家公园附近的Xuan Giao乡。在这里乘船探索湿地，然后前往蚌屋（Clam House）享用美味的海鲜午餐，在蚌屋中休息放松后再乘车返回陆地。

下午：开始在Giao Xuan乡及周边村庄轻松游览。沿着村间小路漫步，观察当地人的生活，看他们收割庄稼，或参观古宅、天主教堂和农业博物馆。如果天气晴朗，还可以参观盐田，观看当地人制盐，并亲手尝试晒盐。

  • 前往观鸟站（适用于每年11月至次年3月的冬季），观赏许多从东亚飞往澳大利亚的候鸟，如黑脸琵鹭、琵鹭、小青脚鹬、黑嘴鸥和亚洲黄嘴燕鸥等……

晚上：抵达Xuan Giao乡的当地人家中，享用晚餐并在此过夜。

夜宿南定省Xuan Giao

餐食：（含早、午、晚餐）

itinerary.title: 南定 – 乘日间火车前往洞海 – 峰牙
itinerary.html:
上午：轻松地骑自行车（或乘车）环游乡村，欣赏海上美丽的日出，然后参观当地鱼市，观看渔民运回整夜的渔获。周边村庄的数百人涌向这个批发市场，争购当天最好的海鲜。

  • 途中拜访一户制作鱼露的本地人家，了解这种美味调料的传统制作方法。

早餐后，办理退房，驱车前往南定火车站，乘火车前往广平省洞海。火车行程约8小时，您将乘坐舒适的空调四人软卧包厢。

晚上：抵达洞海后，导游和司机将在出站口接您，送您前往Chay Lap Resort and Farm入住。度假村坐落在石灰岩群山之间，远离热门旅游路线，是峰牙-格邦国家公园中的一颗真正的明珠。

夜宿峰牙国家公园

餐食：（含早餐）

itinerary.title: 探索峰牙洞与天堂洞
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐后探索峰牙洞。这是世界上最长的石灰岩溶洞之一，越战期间曾被用作医院和弹药库。您将乘船沿着Son河进入洞内，细腻的沙滩和壮观的乳白色石笋、钟乳石定会令您叹为观止。

  • 参观具有传奇战争历史的Tam Co洞。

下午：在当地餐厅享用午餐后，参观天堂洞。天堂洞于2005年由英国洞穴研究协会的科学家发现，洞内高耸入云的石笋和钟乳石悬垂如巨型教堂管风琴的风管，宛如一座神奇的地下宫殿，气势如教堂般恢宏，木质台阶和栈道横跨起伏不平的洞底。

  • 傍晚返回农庄民宿，您可自由欣赏风景，也可选择骑行游览周边村庄。

夜宿峰牙国家公园

餐食：（含早、午餐）

itinerary.title: 峰牙 – 洞海 – 乘日间火车前往顺化
itinerary.html:
上午：在农庄民宿享用早餐，中午办理退房。

下午：导游和司机到农庄民宿接您，送您前往洞海火车站，乘坐日间火车（空调软座）前往顺化。顺化是联合国教科文组织世界遗产地，也是1802年至1945年越南王朝的旧都。

晚上：导游和司机在火车站接您，送您前往酒店办理入住，随后自由休息。导游会为您推荐酒店附近的优质餐厅享用晚餐。

夜宿顺化

餐食：（含早餐）

itinerary.title: 顺化 – 全天市区游
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐后，在导游和司机的陪同下探索联合国教科文组织世界遗产地顺化，参观顺化重要的历史古迹和地标：
乘坐人力三轮车穿过“老城区”，前往昔日帝王休憩的静心湖。

  • 从湖边前往古老而富有氛围的顺化皇城，这里曾是皇宫和紫禁城所在地。
  • 顺化宫廷文物博物馆收藏着精美绝伦的皇家古董。
  • 参观气势恢宏的嗣德皇陵，以及越南唯一的古罗马式斗兽场。
  • 参观当地佛教寺院，品尝由尼师亲手烹制的美味素斋午餐。您可以了解佛教文化，或与热情的主人交流。

下午：乘龙舟游览诗意的香江，途中参观标志性的天姥寺——顺化最著名的宗教圣地。游览寺内园林、七层八角塔，观看僧侣诵经。

  • 参观Truc Chi Garden竹纸手工艺作坊。您将有机会与手艺人见面，亲身体验如何运用竹浆雕刻技艺创作艺术作品。
    傍晚返回酒店，当天余下时间自由休息。

夜宿顺化
餐食：（含早、午餐）

itinerary.title: 顺化 – 岘港 – 会安
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐后，沿海岸线从顺化驱车约四小时前往岘港和会安，途经越南最美的公路之一——海云关（又称“海云岭”），从山口顶端可饱览壮丽风光。

  • 抵达岘港后，参观五行山、占婆雕刻博物馆以及绵长的美溪海滩。
  • 中午前后继续驱车前往会安，入住距古镇不远的精品度假村。

下午：自由休息。您可以享受度假村的设施，或在古镇漫步，欣赏五彩缤纷的灯笼和点缀在诗意风景中的三角梅。

夜宿会安

餐食：（含早餐）

itinerary.title: 会安 – 徒步及美食之旅
itinerary.html:
上午：在酒店悠闲地享用一顿较晚的早餐。

下午：导游接您前往会安古镇，步行参观关公庙、进记古宅、福建会馆和日本廊桥等景点。

  • 参观珍贵遗产博物馆，这里常设展出摄影师Réhahn的“珍贵遗产”系列作品。
  • 参观Reaching Out Tea House，这是热闹古镇中一片宁静的小绿洲，由聋哑人士经营管理。在这里，您将品尝美味的糕点和上好的东方茶。
  • 拜访一位灯笼手艺人的家，观看匠人制作灯笼的技艺，然后在他们的指导下亲手完成制作灯笼的每道工序：从弯制灯笼骨架、裁剪布料、上胶到最后完工。行程结束前，您将拥有一盏亲手制作的灯笼。
  • 探索会安街头美食。跟随导游穿梭于小巷之间，在小摊上与当地人一起品尝美食。每天下午4点，会安街头便摆满了无数的小吃车、小摊和流动小贩。您将品尝当地人制作的会安特色美食，结识熬制高汤的摊主，并学习当地人如何使用那些调料盘！

夜宿会安

餐食：（含早、晚餐）

itinerary.title: 会安 – 美山圣地
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐后，导游和司机接您前往距会安约一小时车程的内陆地区——美山圣地。这里是占婆文化的遗迹，1999年被联合国教科文组织列为世界文化遗产。

  • 您将在这座历史建筑群中进行约两小时的徒步游览，了解其建筑技术以及所用的木材、砖块和石材等传统材料。您还会看到许多20世纪六七十年代战争期间美军轰炸留下的弹坑。
  • 探索遗址后，在古老的寺塔旁观看传统的阿普萨拉舞（Apsara）。少女们身着色彩艳丽的传统服装、头戴斗笠，伴随着锣鼓声翩翩起舞。
  • 返回会安酒店，途中参观一家米纸作坊，一展厨艺，学习制作美味的当地小吃。之后伴着一杯越南咖啡品尝自己的作品，与主人亲切交谈，了解当地的乡村生活。

下午：自由活动，可逛逛当地市场、品尝街头小吃（不妨试试高楼面Cao Lau和白玫瑰饺子），在24小时内定制一件衣服，或参加一堂实践烹饪课。

  • 美丽的安邦海滩距古镇仅5公里，您可以骑自行车前往游泳和休闲。

夜宿会安

餐食：（含早餐）

itinerary.title: 会安 – 全天自由活动
itinerary.html:
在这片天堂中度过完全自由的一天。您可以再次游览古镇，尽享会安的一切美好，从餐厅到咖啡馆再到面包店。您也可以在Nomad Yoga Hoi An参加瑜伽或气功太极课程，除了上课，还可以结识志趣相投的朋友。

夜宿会安

餐食：（含早餐）

itinerary.title: 会安 – 岘港 – 飞往邦美蜀
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐后，专车送您前往岘港机场，搭乘航班飞往越南中部高原的邦美蜀。

  • 抵达后，导游和司机接机，直接送您前往市中心的酒店办理入住。

下午：探索越南的咖啡之都邦美蜀，参观中原咖啡村（Trung Nguyen），这里有美丽的花园、喷泉和建筑……您可以在此了解越南咖啡文化、咖啡树以及咖啡加工产业。

  • 参观民族学博物馆，这里的展览将带您深入了解越南中部高原少数民族的生活与文化。
  • 参观Kien Cuong麝香猫咖啡园。您将见到园主、人称“咖啡大王”的Kien Cuong，他会为您讲述如何种植和加工著名的麝香猫咖啡（世界上最昂贵的咖啡）。
  • 参观AkoDhong村，这里是居住在长高脚屋中的埃地族（Ede）的家园。拜访村长家（Ama H'Rin之家），了解埃地族及其母系社会。

傍晚返回邦美蜀，当天余下时间自由活动。

夜宿邦美蜀

餐食：（含早餐）

itinerary.title: 邦美蜀 – 全天大象体验
itinerary.html:
早餐后，导游和司机到酒店接您，前往约顿国家公园（Yok Don），加入大象保护项目团队。

  • 抵达并听取简介后，您将与大象饲养员见面，用一整天时间深入森林，寻找目前在国家公园内自由漫步的三头大象。导游会为您介绍每头大象的性格、来历以及它们为何生活在约顿国家公园。
  • 导游将为您介绍栖息在这片森林中的动植物，并向您展示一些当地少数民族用于传统医药的植物。
  • 在公园内，您可能会发现珍稀野象的踪迹，如脚印、觅食痕迹或粪便。
  • 在公园中享用野餐午餐。

下午：继续徒步，直至抵达森林深处的大象栖息地。您将有机会与大象近距离接触，参与为大象洗澡（30分钟），并喂它们香蕉和甘蔗。由于这里是保护区，不允许骑大象。

  • 结束精彩的一天，返回邦美蜀。

夜宿邦美蜀

餐食：（含早、午餐）

itinerary.title: 邦美蜀 – 叻湖 – 大叻
itinerary.html:
早餐并退房后，私人导游和司机带您游览著名的D'ray Nur瀑布和Dray Sap瀑布。这两座瀑布由湄公河的主要支流——发源于中部高原、流入柬埔寨东北部的Srepok河——汇聚而成，绝对是不容错过的景点。

  • 抵达后，穿过一片郁郁葱葱的森林，在瀑布底部短暂漫步。如果您喜欢冒险，还可以走到一小段瀑布下面冲个凉。
  • 离开邦美蜀，驱车前往叻湖。叻湖辽阔宁静，四周丘陵起伏，是中部高原最大的天然淡水湖。乘船游湖并参观当地村庄，这里是嘛侬族（Mnong）的家园，他们依湖为生，常可见到他们驾着传统的独木舟捕鱼。
  • 游船结束后，参观越南末代皇帝曾经居住的保大行宫。这座建筑坐落在山顶，是保大皇帝在中部高原众多度假别墅之一，他常来这里享受自己最喜爱的消遣之一——狩猎。
  • 继续驱车南下，途经壮观的山地风光，前往昔日的法国殖民山城大叻。高海拔、凉爽的气候和自然美景，在20世纪上半叶首先吸引了法国殖民者来到这里。大叻作为高山湖畔避暑胜地蓬勃发展，并因此得名“小巴黎”（Le Petit Paris）。

傍晚抵达大叻，入住度假村，当天余下时间自由活动。

夜宿大叻
餐食：（含早餐）

itinerary.title: 大叻 – 全天市区游
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐后，专车和导游带您游览大叻，参观坐落在山丘上的保大行宫。

  • 参观松林环抱的竹林禅院（越南目前最大的禅宗寺院）。您可以乘坐缆车下行300米，前往宛如仙境的泉林湖。
  • 参观疯狂屋（又称Hang Nga Guesthouse）。与大叻的法国殖民时期别墅截然不同，这座独树一帜的旅馆是一座由螺旋楼梯、雕塑般的卧室、波浪形墙面、绚丽的色彩漩涡、狭窄的小桥和隐秘角落构成的迷宫。

下午：在当地餐厅享用午餐后，游览春香湖和林寺尼寺（Lam Ty Ni），佛门民间僧人Vien Thuc曾在此创作抽象画并赋诗。

  • 参观XQ刺绣工坊和艺术馆，了解越南艺术的历史，欣赏众多手工刺绣杰作。
  • 参观著名的中心市场，这里有鲜花、蔬菜和珍稀水果。穿行于小巷之间，与当地人一起品尝各色街头小吃，如烤猪肉、烤蔬菜，尤其是大叻披萨——在圆形米纸上铺上蛋液，放在炭火上烤制而成。

夜宿大叻

餐食：（含早、午、晚餐）

itinerary.title: 大叻 – 芽庄
itinerary.html:
早餐后，从大叻沿着风景秀丽的Ngoan Muc山口驱车前往芽庄，途经茶园、森林和少数民族村寨。

  • 抵达芽庄，入住您所选的度假村，当天余下时间自由活动。
  • 芽庄以绵长的金色沙滩和成排的棕榈树而闻名，年平均气温为26摄氏度。
  • 晚上，您可以自由探索芽庄，这里有许多很棒的露天酒吧和餐厅。

夜宿芽庄

餐食：（含早餐）

itinerary.title: 芽庄 – 乘Emperor Cruise探索海湾
itinerary.html:
上午：抵达芽庄港，登上Emperor Cruise。

  • 登船后，船长和船员将热情迎接您，随后简要介绍芽庄湾、当地人民、美食、文化、安全须知以及Emperor Cruise。
  • 游船启航，欣赏芽庄湾令人屏息的美景。一边享用欢迎饮品，一边聆听吉他手带您进入深邃的古典音乐世界。
  • 上午晚些时候抵达迷你海滩（Mini Beach），您可以游泳、划皮划艇、浮潜，也可以在大树下休憩，欣赏美丽的海湾和Emperor Cruise的风帆。
  • 此外，您还可以参加许多其他海上活动，如水肺潜水、水上摩托、拖伞和香蕉船……
  • 游船停泊在竹岛（Hon Tre）宁静的泻湖附近，您可在船上享用丰盛的午餐，搭配当地啤酒、软饮、优质葡萄酒或烈酒。

下午：午餐后，您可以钓鱼、休息，或参观养鱼场，乘簸箕船探索美丽的风景。

  • 游船途经Vung Ngan水上渔村和珍珠岛乐园(Vinpearl)返回芽庄港，返回陆地时还可远眺保大别墅。
  • 返回度假村，当天余下时间自由活动。

夜宿芽庄

餐食：（含早、午餐）

itinerary.title: 芽庄 – 全天自由活动
itinerary.html:
全天自由活动。尽享度假村的舒适设施，享受水疗护理，或在白色沙滩上放松身心。

夜宿芽庄
餐食：（含早餐）

itinerary.title: 芽庄 – 全天自由活动
itinerary.html:
在芽庄再享受一天自由时光。

夜宿芽庄
餐食：（含早餐）

itinerary.title: 芽庄 – 飞往芹苴 – Bassac游船
itinerary.html:
上午：专车接您前往芽庄机场，搭乘短途航班飞往位于湄公河三角洲中心的芹苴。

  • 抵达芹苴机场后，专车接您前往宁桥码头（Ninh Kieu），登上Bassac游船。这是一艘精工打造的木船，具有湄公河三角洲典型传统运米船的风格与优雅，您将在船上度过这一晚。
  • 享用饮品，听取游船和船员介绍，随后开始沿后江（Hau River）顺流而下。

午餐：在游船上层甲板享用午餐。

下午：上岸漫步当地村庄，了解村民的生活方式，如他们如何种植水稻、水果和蔬菜。途中将停留参观，体验河畔人家的生活。

  • 返回游船，在甲板上休息并欣赏日落。游船沿Mang Thit河驶向过夜停泊地，您可在船上享用晚餐。

夜宿Bassac游船

餐食：（含早、午、晚餐）

itinerary.title: 丐背 – 胡志明市
itinerary.html:
上午：在船上享用早餐后，前往丐背（Cai Be）。

  • Bassac游船横渡Co Chien河，驶入Cho Lach运河，穿行于繁忙的船流、市场和教堂之间，让您以独特的视角观赏岸上和水上多姿多彩的生活。
  • 抵达丐背附近后办理退房，如潮水允许，换乘手划船游览一条小运河。
  • 换乘当地小船上岸，参观丐背的本地手工艺作坊。
  • 行程在丐背镇结束，导游和专车将直接送您前往胡志明市。

下午：抵达后入住市中心酒店。下午和晚上自由活动，可逛逛夜市，品尝美味的当地菜肴。

夜宿胡志明市

餐食：（含早餐）

itinerary.title: 胡志明市 – 全天观光游
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐后，导游和专车到酒店接您，首站参观统一宫。随后前往战争遗迹博物馆，通过大量战争文献了解这段历史，您还可以在室外展区看到展出的炸弹、坦克、飞机和直升机。

  • 参观巴黎广场，这是位于胡志明市第一郡中心的一个小广场，位于西贡圣母大教堂和阮攸街之间。参观中央邮局和西贡圣母大教堂，欣赏教堂的绝美建筑……

午餐：享用美味午餐，品尝越式煎饼（Banh Xeo）、香叶烤牛肉（Bo La Lot）和越式春卷（Nem Cuon）。

下午：午餐后参观FITO传统医药博物馆。随后前往一座旧公寓楼，1975年最后一架美国直升机正是从这里撤离越南，标志着战争的结束。您将途经前美国大使馆和武文新街60号别墅，这里曾是驻越美军总司令威廉·威斯特摩兰将军的官邸。

  • 参观著名的玉皇殿，由胡志明市第一批华人社区于100多年前修建。该庙又称龟庙，是市内最重要的五座寺庙之一。
  • 登上越南最高建筑之一的Bitexco金融塔顶层，欣赏日落，饱览城市全景。

夜宿胡志明市

餐食：（含早、午餐）

itinerary.title: 胡志明市 – 高台教圣殿及古芝地道
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐后，导游和司机接您前往古芝。这是位于胡志明市西北部的一个小社区，以其纵深的地道网络而闻名，越战后期这里曾是越共的藏身之所和有效的渗透据点。

  • 抵达后观看历史纪录片，参观总长“数百英里”的越共秘密地道网络，其中设有生活区、储藏室、简易医院和厨房……地道原本非常狭窄，部分路段已拓宽向游客开放，您将有机会探索其中的一部分。
  • 品尝战时主食——木薯配酸茶。
  • 离开古芝，前往西宁省的高台教圣殿，探索这座神圣的庙宇，深入了解高台教。您将参加正午弥撒，欣赏身着传统服饰的教士，聆听动人的圣歌。

下午：在当地餐厅享用午餐后，返回胡志明市酒店，当天余下时间自由休息。

夜宿胡志明市

餐食：（含早、午餐）

itinerary.title: 胡志明市 – 送机离境
itinerary.html:
早餐后从酒店出发，送您前往胡志明市国际机场，搭乘航班回国或继续您的旅程，我们将协助您规划后续行程。

餐食：（含早餐）

title.en: Vietnam Tour 22 Days 21 Nights
title.zh: 越南22天21晚深度游

summary: Vietnam tour 22 days 21 nights su visitors will visit the beauty and historical sites in HCM, go to the Central Highlands to visit Buon Ma Thuot, Pleiku, Kontum., experience elephant riding, visit the communal houses with gong festival, continue the journey to Da Nang to see the poetic beach and learn about the daily life with coastal…
