HCM City – Vung Liem
Vung Liem – HCM City – Flight to Dalat
Dalat – Trekking and Kayaking
Dalat – Lake Lake – Buon Triet Lake
Buon Triet Lake – Nam Ka
Nam Ka – Buon Ma Thuot
Buon Ma Thuot – Elephant experience full day
Buon Ma Thuot – Pleiku – Kontum
Kontum – Hoi An
Hoi An – Cooking Class and Kayaking
Hoi An – Day at leisure
Hoi An – Da Nang – Flight to Hanoi
Hanoi – Experience Off the Beaten Path by Russian Minsk Motorcycle
Hanoi – Da Bac – Sung Village
Sung Village – Da Bia Village
Da Bia Village – Thung Nai – Ninh Binh
Ninh Binh – Cat Ba Island – Lan Ha Bay
Lan Ha Bay – Further Discovery
Lan Ha Bay – Cat Ba Island – Hanoi
Hanoi – Departure

itinerary.title: Arrival in Ho Chi Minh City
itinerary.html:
Hello! Welcome to Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.

  • Upon arrival in Vietnam, your tour guide and driver will be waiting for you at the arrival lounge, holding a welcome sign with your name on it and taking you straight to your hotel in the city center.
  • After checking in, you can relax and enjoy the view of Ho Chi Minh City, your tour guide will introduce you to Bloom restaurant for dinner.

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City

Meals: (_/_/D)

itinerary.title: HCM City – Morning Tour
itinerary.html:
Get up early (avoid the crowds) and take a cyclo tour of Ho Chi Minh City with a guide and take you off the tourist trail.

  • Hop on a cyclo and tour through the quiet streets. Stop to see the Notre Dame Cathedral and the Central Post Office (designed by Gustave Eiffel).
  • Tao Dan local park, a green space to relax and enjoy nature. Get off the cyclo and enjoy a coffee and take in the view.
  • From the park, you will come to the memorial site dedicated to Buddhist monk Thich Quang Duc. During the trip, your guide will take you to one of the best places in the city to eat Pho (Vietnamese Pho).
  • Swap the cyclo for a private car and travel along Nguyen Dinh Chieu Street to visit the traditional market, visit a secret weapons bunker used to hide the arsenal of the Saigon Commandos. Among them were about 2 tons of weapons, prepared for the Tet Offensive (January 1968).
  • End the tour with a walk around the Ho Thi Ky Flower Market, the city’s hidden gem. Then, return to the hotel to relax.

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City

Meals: (B/_/_)

itinerary.title: HCM City – Vung Liem (Mekong Delta)
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast, your guide and driver will take you to the Mekong Delta. Upon arrival, you will check into the bungalows at Co Co Riverside Lodge. Nestled on the banks of the Mekong River, surrounded by coconut forests and rice fields….

Afternoon: After lunch, you will take a leisurely bike ride on the quiet village roads passing coconut farms, green rice fields and small villages. Along the way, you will stop to visit a dragon fruit plantation and taste the fruit right in the garden.

  • Return to the lodge to watch the picturesque sunset of Asia. After a shower and rest, you will walk with the locals using traditional torches made from dried coconut leaves to the neighbor’s house, where you will enjoy a traditional music performance.
  • Return to the lodge and join the cooking class with the chef. Afterwards, enjoy what you have cooked together. Free to explore.

Overnight at Co Co Riverside Lodge in Vung Liem

Meals: (B/L/D)

itinerary.title: Vung Liem – HCM City – Flight to Dalat
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast, you will visit a local school and a nearby market. Then, take a boat trip through small canals to visit a local industrial area specializing in coconut processing. After the coconuts are dehusked, the coir is separated from the shell to make rope, which is then used to weave mats.

  • Take a local ferry to visit a Cao Dai temple, visit the local religion.
  • Return to the Lodge. If time permits, try weaving with nipa palm leaves. Leaves are the main building material in the Mekong Delta and are used to build walls and roofs with the locals.

Afternoon: Check out and return to Ho Chi Minh City. Then, transfer to the airport to catch a flight to Da Lat, where the climate is mild and cool, Da Lat is known as the “City of Eternal Spring” due to the mist that covers the nearby valleys all year round.

  • Upon arrival, your guide and driver will pick you up and take you to the hotel to check in.

Overnight in Da Lat

Meals: (B/_/_)

itinerary.title: Dalat – Trekking and Kayaking
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast, your guide will take you on a three-hour trek starting from Bao Dai Waterfall through a small village to the green pine forest, enjoying the cool breeze and admiring the hundreds of years old trees.

  • You will go to Samson Mountain to take beautiful photos, this is the most beautiful place to take photos in Da Lat. From the top of the mountain, you can admire the beautiful view of Da Lat from above.
  • After about 3 hours of exploring, you will arrive at Thien Duong Lake, where you will enjoy a picnic lunch prepared by your guide.

Afternoon: After lunch, you will kayak and paddle around the small islands on the lake. Enjoy the beautiful scenery of the green pine forest surrounding the lake.

  • After about 2 hours of exploring, you will arrive on the other side of the lake, where the driver is waiting for you and takes you back to the hotel.
  • Arrive at the hotel around 15:00, where you will spend the rest of the afternoon and evening relaxing, strolling through the streets, or enjoying a cup of coffee while admiring the dreamy scenery of Da Lat, you can taste many street foods such as: Grilled pork, grilled vegetables and especially Da Lat pizza, a round rice paper, covered with egg coating and grilled over charcoal.

Overnight in Da Lat

Meals: (B/L/_)

itinerary.title: Dalat – Lake Lake – Buon Triet Lake
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast, your guide and driver will take you on a four-hour drive from Da Lat to Lak Lake, passing villages, rice fields…

  • Upon arrival, you will take a dugout canoe across Lak Lake to M’Lieng village, meet the M’nong people, a tribe that depends on the lake for their livelihood and can see them fishing with traditional dugout canoes. You can walk around the village to learn more about daily life in the Central Highlands.

Afternoon: Leaving Lak Lake, you will go to Buon Triet Lake, upon arrival, you will row a boat and pass Buon Triet Lake.

  • Arrive at Jatu Village, home to the M’nong ethnic minority, visit small villages such as: M’nong Gar, M’nong Nong, M’nong Bih…. a small village with 14 households and about 60 people living together. They live by growing rice, raising cattle and gathering from the forest.
  • You stay overnight at the stilt house, which is also the village chief.

Overnight in Ja Tu village

Meals: (B/L/_)

itinerary.title: Buon Triet Lake – Nam Ka
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast, you will go hiking (about 14km) through the evergreen forest, including climbing and descending into the forest and crossing a stream, with birdsong.

Afternoon: After enjoying a picnic lunch on the way, you will continue hiking towards Nam Ka Lake, where you can board a boat and row for 4km.

  • In the late afternoon, you will arrive at the rural village of Rai in Nam Ka, home to the Ede ethnic minority with 15 households and about 75 residents in the village. The people here also mainly live on rice cultivation, raising cattle, pigs and other poultry.
  • You will stay overnight in Rai village as chief Ay Sel. This is a traditional Ede-style longhouse with a staircase decorated with a crescent moon symbolizing fidelity and a pair of breasts symbolizing prosperity and matriarchy.

Evening: Enjoy dinner hosted by a local family. Take time to learn about their lifestyle and customs.

Overnight in Rai Village

Meals: (B/L/D)

itinerary.title: Nam Ka – Buon Ma Thuot
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast and check out, say goodbye to your host family and walk three kilometers through the rural villages. Then, your driver will pick you up and take you to Buon Ma Thuot City, the coffee capital of Vietnam.

  • On the way, you will stop to visit two of the most impressive waterfalls in the Central Highlands: Dray Sap and Dray Nu.

Afternoon: Arrive and check in to your hotel in the city center. After a short break, you will sit outside to explore the city.

  • Visit Trung Nguyen Coffee Village, a beautiful garden with fountains, interesting architecture. Here, you can learn about Vietnamese coffee culture, coffee trees, coffee processing industry.
  • Visit the Museum of Ethnology. The exhibitions here will give you an insight into the life and culture of the people in the Central Highlands of Vietnam.
  • Kien Cuong weasel coffee garden. You will meet the owner, Mr. Kien Cuong, the “coffee king”, who will tell you how he grows and processes the famous civet coffee (the most expensive coffee in the world).

End of the tour and return to the hotel, you are free to relax.

Overnight in Buon Ma Thuot

Meals: (B/_/_)

itinerary.title: Buon Ma Thuot – Elephant experience full day
itinerary.html:
After an early breakfast, your guide and private driver will pick you up from your hotel and take you to Yok Don National Park to join the Elephant Conservation Project team.

  • After an introduction, you will meet the elephant caretakers and explore the forest in search of three elephants that are currently roaming freely in the national park. Your guide will tell you about each elephant’s personality, their background, and why they live in Yok Don National Park.
  • Throughout the trip, your guide will share their knowledge of the national park, pointing out the many species of plants and wildlife that live in this forest.
  • You may come across signs of the rare wild elephant community in the park, such as footprints, feeding signs, or their droppings.
  • Enjoy a picnic lunch in the middle of the park.

Afternoon: You will continue hiking until you reach the elephants’ home deep in the forest. You will have the opportunity to meet the elephants and participate in bathing them (30 minutes) and feeding them bananas and sugar cane. As the center focuses on conservation, they no longer allow elephant riding.

  • End your wonderful day and return to Buon Ma Thuot.

Overnight in Buon Ma Thuot

Meals: (B/L/_)

itinerary.title: Buon Ma Thuot – Pleiku – Kontum
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast, your guide and driver will take you to Kontum via Pleiku. Stop to visit Phun village, a small village of the Gia Rai ethnic group, most famous for its cemeteries decorated with wooden statues, and stop at coffee, rubber and pepper plantations along the way.

Afternoon: After a 5-hour drive, you will arrive in Kontum. Visit the town including: Museum, wooden church, orphanage and Kon K’Lor suspension bridge. Then, you will take a leisurely walk through the tea plantations and the villages of Kon Ko Lor Lor I and Kon Ko Lor II.

  • Boat on a wooden boat on the Dakbla River and travel to Kon Ko Tu village, home to the Bahnar ethnic minority, experiencing the culture here with the curved roofs shaped like high axes is quite a magnificent sight.

Evening: Enjoy dinner organized by the family and stay overnight at a local homestay, clean and comfortable.

Overnight in Kon Ko Tu village

Meals: (B/L/D)

itinerary.title: Kontum – Hoi An
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast and check out, your guide and driver will take you to Hoi An for a seven-hour drive. Stop along the way to visit the Dakto Tan Canh Victory Monument and former war sites such as Charlie Hill & Phoenix Airport, also known as Dak To Base Camp and Dak To II Airport, now just a bare patch of asphalt where farmers dry cassava.

  • Continue driving on the road. Stop to visit Dak Che Waterfall and the Rong House of the Gie-Trieng ethnic group.

Lunch: Have lunch at a local restaurant in Kham Duc town

Afternoon: Arrive in Hoi An and check in at the beautiful Hoi An Eco-lodge. Hoi An Eco-lodge is a peaceful oasis.

Overnight in Hoi An

Meals: (B/_/_)

itinerary.title: Hoi An – Cooking Class and Kayaking
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast, your tour guide will take you to the local market. Here, the chef will guide you around the market, explain about local products, explain about the market culture, you buy ingredients to learn cooking with the chef, and enjoy the finished product right away.

  • Then, walk to the pier to board the Chic Boat, which runs by engine down the Thu Bon River. Enjoy the beautiful scenery along the river.
  • The boat will stop to put the kayak down the river and paddle leisurely (about 45 minutes). Explore and experience some hidden corners and natural beauty of Hoi An.
  • Get back on the boat. Enjoy drinks, then start the cooking class on the boat. The chef will guide you how to prepare and cook each dish before you do it yourself.
  • Under the guidance of the chef, discover the flavors blending with “Tâm Hự”, enjoy the excitement as you enjoy a piece of fatty, salty fried fish spring roll and feel the rich flavor of ginger braised chicken, helping you discover the secrets of Vietnamese cuisine.
  • Lunch will be served more with steamed rice, vegetable soup and a dessert.

Afternoon: you will spend time relaxing and enjoying everything the river has to offer on the journey back to Hoi An. Get off at the pier and return to your Ecolodge, free to relax at your own leisure.

Overnight in Hoi An

Meals: (B/L/_)

itinerary.title: Hoi An – Day at leisure
itinerary.html:
The whole day is your free time. You can go to the Old Town to explore or you can cycle to the beach to swim and relax. Otherwise, enjoy the comfort of the Ecolodge.

Overnight in Hoi An

Meals: (B/_/_)

itinerary.title: Hoi An – Da Nang – Flight to Hanoi
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast, the driver will pick you up and take you to Da Nangairport for the flight to Hanoi.

  • The tour guide and driver will pick you up at Noi Bai airport, Hanoi and take you to the hotel in Hanoi Old Quarter to check in. After that, you are free to relax.

Afternoon: Enjoy your free time to stroll through the narrow streets of the Old Quarter.

Evening: The tour guide will take you to the Lotus Theatre, where you will experience the Water Puppet Show, a unique traditional art performance of Vietnam. Admire the dexterity of the colorful puppets and the dexterity of real artists as they control the puppets behind a “water stage”.

Overnight in Hanoi

Meals: (B/_/_)

itinerary.title: Hanoi – Experience Off the Beaten Path by Russian Minsk Motorcycle
itinerary.html:
You will experience Hanoi on the Minsk Russian motorbike trail that will take you to the Hanoi life museum, you will explore different neighborhoods of Hanoi, and visit the main, hidden gem local market of Hanoi, you enjoy delicious street food.

Note: If you do not like motorbikes, there is an alternative option for your family to take an open-air wartime Jeep.

Morning: After breakfast, the car and tour guide will pick you up at the hotel lobby at the scheduled time to go sightseeing by 1952 Russian-made 150cc motorbikes out of the city. While driving, you will be introduced to some beautiful scenery.

  • Visit the Black Market through small alleys. Meet and interact with friendly locals. Stop at a food court at the back of the market and try some street food.
  • You will arrive at a local house, where you will be introduced and hear stories about Hanoi.
  • Heading to the railway tracks, your guide will time it so that you can see a Reunification Express train passing by, and you can take in the view and capture the best moments.
  • Back in the City, you will be taken through the French colonial architecture of the area known as the French Quarter. You will pass by French-style villas, the Vietnam History Museum, the heritage Metropole Legend Hotel and the Opera House…
  • To Hanoi’s Old Quarter, explore the maze of small alleys and narrow streets. You will be amazed by the city’s mix of things. Stop at eateries and food stalls to enjoy the best of Hanoi including local delicacies and specialties.
  • Head out of the city towards Long Bien Bridge, a magnificent structure built by the French over a hundred years ago across the Red River.
  • From the bridge, you will arrive at Bai Giua, commonly known as Banana Island, a 24ha strip of land in the middle of the Red River, surrounded by rows of banana trees, clear water where you can enjoy the fresh air. Then you will return to the City. The last stop will be a hidden Coffee Shop to enjoy a cup of egg coffee and admire the scenery.
  • Around noon, your tour guide will take you back to the hotel. The tour ends.

Afternoon: Spend the rest of the day at leisure. Relax or stroll through the hidden alleys in the Old Quarter.

Overnight in Hanoi

Meals: (B/L/_)

itinerary.title: Hanoi – Da Bac – Sung Village
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast, your tour guide and driver will pick you up and take you to Da Bac Commune, Hoa Binh Province, 100km from Hanoi, where ethnic minorities live mainly. You will visit and experience life with the local people.

  • After a three-hour drive through the picturesque countryside, you will arrive at Sung Village, home to the Tien Dao ethnic group. There are about 75 households and about 350 residents in the village and they make a living by farming.
  • Check in at a local house. The house is beautifully designed with carved and painted beams inside the house and bedrooms. Clean sheets and fresh towels are standard, and the mattress and pillows are very comfortable. Each bed has a mosquito net and curtains that you can pull back for more privacy.

Afternoon: After enjoying lunch cooked and served by the host, you will take a leisurely walk around the village, enjoying Shan Tuyet tea. You can also visit a local handicraft workshop, watch the villagers weave and traditional dyeing techniques.

  • Take a short walk (about 2 km) to Sung Cave to visit a 100-year-old tea plantation, the path is a bit difficult so be careful.
  • Return to the homestay to relax, rest, soak in a hot and comfortable shower and enjoy local cuisine.

Evening: Enjoy dinner with the host family and experience the highland culture.

Overnight in Sung Village

Meals: (B/L/D)

itinerary.title: Sung Village – Da Bia Village
itinerary.html:
After an early breakfast, you will start a five-hour trek (about 12 km). You will walk through lush corn and rice fields, pass by lakes and spectacular rocky mountains, you can stop to take pictures along the way of the stunning views of the mountains, valleys, and turquoise lakes.

  • Arrive at Da Bia Village, home to the Muong ethnic group. Here, you will enjoy a delicious lunch served by a Muong family that you will stay with.

Afternoon: You will be free to relax. You can also enjoy swimming or kayaking in Da Reservoir.

Evening: Enjoy dinner with your host family and spend the evening relaxing.

Overnight in Da Bia Village

Meals: (B/L/D)

itinerary.title: Da Bia Village – Thung Nai – Ninh Binh
itinerary.html:
Morning: After an early breakfast, you will leave Da Bia village and return to Da Lake, where you will board a private boat for your journey (approximately 1-1.5 hours) to Thung Nai port. From here, you will be picked up and driven through the lush countryside to Son Ha village in Ninh Binh province.

  • Upon arrival, you will embark on a rural cycling tour, amidst lush green fields and through narrow lanes, watching the locals at work.

Afternoon: After lunch, you will take a relaxing rowing boat ride along a small canal to visit Thien Ha cave, enjoying the natural scenery along the way. This is a newly discovered eco-tourism spot and is considered by visitors to be the most beautiful cave in Ninh Binh, offering countless photo opportunities.

  • You will be rowed for another 2.5 hours on a pristine waterway towards Thung Nang “Anh Duong Valley”, a pristine area surrounded by steep limestone cliffs and stunning rice fields, promising to bring you an unforgettable experience.
  • Arriving at Thung Nang, you will be picked up by a waiting driver and taken to Hoa Lu, the site of the ancient capital of Vietnam dating back to the 11th century. Eroded over millennia, the crumbling ruins have been almost absorbed by the spectacular landscape creating a mystical atmosphere that is sure to stimulate your imagination.
  • Upon arrival, visit the historical site at the two remaining temples of the Dinh and Le kings. Restored in the 17th century.
  • Leaving the temple, you will reach Hang Mua Mountain, where you can take a scenic walk with breathtaking views of the Ngo Dong River below, cutting through the towering mountains.
  • End of tour and transfer to your hotel in Ninh Binh to check in. The rest is free for you to relax.

Overnight in Ninh Binh

Meals: (B/L/_)

itinerary.title: Ninh Binh – Cat Ba Island – Lan Ha Bay
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast, your tour guide and driver will pick you up from your hotel and take you to Hai Phong city, then take a ferry to Cai Ba Island.

  • Around noon, you will board a wooden boat and start your journey to Lan Ha Bay. Located to the south and east of Cat Ba Island, Lan Ha’s approximately 300 karst islands and limestone outcrops are as beautiful as Ha Long Bay. What makes Lan Ha special is that the karst blocks are located close together, making it the most ideal place for kayaking and swimming.
  • Around noon, the boat will be dropped into the middle of the bay for lunch. Enjoy delicious Vietnamese cuisine with a stunning panoramic view.

Afternoon: Continue your journey to Ba Trai Dao beach through floating fish farms. Then, the boat will stop for you to kayak leisurely into the bay on the limestone mountains before swimming and sunbathing on the beach.

  • Return to the Junk boat and you will be guided by the chef to cook. Learn about local ingredients and how to prepare classic Vietnamese dishes.

Evening: As the sun sets, you will arrive at an anchorage. Take a swim from the boat if you wish.

  • After dinner, enjoy some more drinks on the top deck or have some fun squid fishing with the crew before retiring to your cabin.

Overnight on board in Lan Ha Bay

Meals: (B/L/D)

itinerary.title: Lan Ha Bay – Further Discovery
itinerary.html:
Morning: Wake up early to watch the sunrise and have breakfast. Then, the boat will weigh anchor and head to Dua Beach and Vung Kiem Lam area. You can kayak and paddle around the lake to enjoy the tranquility of this beautiful place.

Afternoon: You will continue to Viet Hai Village. When you arrive at Viet Hai Wharf, you will have a close-up view of the pristine nature, you can cycle to enjoy the peaceful scenery of the coastal village.

  • Explore the village school and organic gardens, meet the locals. If you want to be more active, you can hike to the top of Hai Quan Mountain to enjoy the stunning view of the park and part of Ha Long Bay.
  • End the tour and return to the boat then sail to a hidden spot in Lan Ha for your second night.
  • Enjoy dinner. Then, experience squid fishing before resting in your cozy cabin.

Overnight on board in Lan Ha Bay

Meals: (B/L/D)

itinerary.title: Lan Ha Bay – Cat Ba Island – Hanoi
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast, start your day with a cruise around the steep cliffs of Lan Ha Bay to Monkey Island, where the beautiful sandy beach is ideal for a stroll.

  • Return to the boat to check out. Then enjoy a set lunch as you sail back to shore.

Afternoon: Get off the boat at the pier, your private driver will take you back to Hanoi.

  • After checking into your hotel, spend the rest of the day relaxing. Stroll around town or visit Hoan Kiem Lake & Ngoc Son Temple, a short walk from your hotel. They are beautifully lit up at night.

Overnight in Hanoi

Meals: (B/L/_)

itinerary.title: Hanoi – Departure
itinerary.html:
Pick up from your hotel after breakfast and transfer to Hanoi International Airport where you can catch your flight home or continue your adventure, we will help you plan.

Meals: (B/_/_)

included: Private English-speaking guide, accommodation, private tours and transfer, domestic flights, A/C vehicles, some main meals, all entrance fees, tax, and service charge.

zh.summary: 越南22天21晚之旅将带您游览胡志明市的美景与历史古迹，深入中部高原探访邦美蜀、波来古、昆嵩，体验大象之旅，参观举办锣钲节的高脚公共长屋，继续前往岘港欣赏诗意的海滩，了解沿海居民的日常生活……

itinerary.title: 抵达胡志明市
itinerary.html:
您好！欢迎来到越南胡志明市。

  • 抵达越南后，导游和司机将在到达大厅手举写有您姓名的接机牌迎候，直接送您前往市中心的酒店。
  • 办理入住后，您可以休息放松，欣赏胡志明市的风景。导游将带您前往Bloom餐厅享用晚餐。

夜宿胡志明市

餐食：（含晚餐）

itinerary.title: 胡志明市 – 上午游
itinerary.html:
清早出发（避开人潮），在导游陪同下乘坐人力三轮车游览胡志明市，远离热门旅游路线。

  • 坐上人力三轮车，穿行于宁静的街道。途中参观西贡圣母大教堂和中央邮局（由古斯塔夫·埃菲尔设计）。
  • 前往本地公园——陶坛公园（Tao Dan），这里是放松身心、亲近自然的绿色空间。下车喝杯咖啡，欣赏周边景色。
  • 从公园出发，前往纪念佛教僧人释广德的纪念地。途中，导游将带您前往城中最好的河粉店之一品尝越南河粉（Pho）。
  • 换乘专车，沿阮廷炤街（Nguyen Dinh Chieu）前往传统市场，并参观西贡特工队用来藏匿武器的秘密地下武器库，这里曾储存约2吨武器，为1968年1月的春节攻势做准备。
  • 最后漫步城中的隐藏瑰宝——何氏己花市（Ho Thi Ky），随后返回酒店休息。

夜宿胡志明市

餐食：（含早餐）

itinerary.title: 胡志明市 – 永廉（湄公河三角洲）
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐后，导游和司机将带您前往湄公河三角洲。抵达后入住Co Co Riverside Lodge的小木屋。该旅舍坐落在湄公河畔，四周环绕着椰林和稻田……

下午：午餐后，沿着宁静的乡村小路悠闲骑行，途经椰子园、绿色稻田和小村庄。途中参观火龙果种植园，在果园里现摘现尝。

  • 返回旅舍，欣赏如画的亚洲日落。洗澡休息后，与当地人一起手持用干椰叶制成的传统火把，步行前往邻居家中欣赏传统音乐表演。
  • 返回旅舍，与厨师一起参加烹饪课，随后共同享用亲手烹制的菜肴。之后自由活动。

夜宿永廉Co Co Riverside Lodge

餐食：（含早、午、晚餐）

itinerary.title: 永廉 – 胡志明市 – 飞往大叻
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐后参观当地一所学校和附近的市场。随后乘船穿过小运河，参观一处专门从事椰子加工的本地工坊区。椰子去壳后，椰棕从壳上剥离，搓成绳子，再用来编织草席。

  • 乘坐本地渡船参观一座高台教寺庙，了解当地的宗教。
  • 返回旅舍。如时间允许，可尝试用水椰叶编织。水椰叶是湄公河三角洲的主要建筑材料，当地人用它来搭建墙壁和屋顶。

下午：办理退房，返回胡志明市，随后前往机场搭乘航班飞往大叻。大叻气候温和凉爽，附近山谷常年云雾缭绕，因此被誉为“永恒之春城”。

  • 抵达后，导游和司机接机并送您前往酒店办理入住。

夜宿大叻

餐食：（含早餐）

itinerary.title: 大叻 – 徒步及皮划艇
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐后，导游将带您进行三小时徒步，从保大瀑布出发，穿过一座小村庄，走进苍翠的松林，享受清凉的微风，欣赏数百年树龄的古树。

  • 前往参孙山（Samson）拍摄美照，这里是大叻最美的拍照地点。从山顶可俯瞰大叻的美丽全景。
  • 探索约3小时后，抵达天堂湖，享用导游准备的野餐午餐。

下午：午餐后，划皮划艇环绕湖中小岛，欣赏湖畔苍翠松林的美丽风光。

  • 探索约2小时后抵达湖对岸，司机已在此等候，送您返回酒店。
  • 约15:00抵达酒店，下午和晚上可以自由休息、漫步街头，或一边品咖啡一边欣赏大叻梦幻般的景色。您还可以品尝众多街头小吃，如烤猪肉、烤蔬菜，尤其是大叻披萨——在圆形米纸上铺上蛋液，放在炭火上烤制而成。

夜宿大叻

餐食：（含早、午餐）

itinerary.title: 大叻 – 叻湖 – 布特湖
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐后，导游和司机带您驱车约四小时从大叻前往叻湖，途经村庄、稻田……

  • 抵达后，乘独木舟横渡叻湖前往M'Lieng村，拜访嘛侬族（M'nong）。他们依湖为生，常可见到他们驾着传统独木舟捕鱼。您可以在村中漫步，深入了解中部高原的日常生活。

下午：离开叻湖，前往布特湖（Buon Triet），抵达后划船游览布特湖。

  • 抵达嘛侬族聚居的Jatu村，参观M'nong Gar、M'nong Nong、M'nong Bih……等小村落。这是一个仅有14户、约60人共同生活的小村庄，村民以种稻、养牛和林间采集为生。
  • 您将在村长家的高脚屋中过夜。

夜宿Ja Tu村

餐食：（含早、午餐）

itinerary.title: 布特湖 – 南卡
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐后，穿越常绿森林徒步（约14公里），一路上山下山、涉过溪流，耳畔鸟鸣婉转。

下午：途中享用野餐午餐后，继续徒步前往南卡湖（Nam Ka），在这里登船划行4公里。

  • 傍晚抵达南卡的乡村Rai村，这里是埃地族（Ede）的家园，全村15户，约75位居民。村民主要以种植水稻、饲养牛、猪及其他家禽为生。
  • 您将在Rai村村长Ay Sel家中过夜。这是一座传统的埃地族长屋，楼梯上装饰着象征忠贞的新月和象征富足与母系社会的一对乳房图案。

晚上：享用当地人家准备的晚餐，花些时间了解他们的生活方式和风俗习惯。

夜宿Rai村

餐食：（含早、午、晚餐）

itinerary.title: 南卡 – 邦美蜀
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐并退房后，告别寄宿家庭，步行三公里穿过乡村。随后司机接您前往越南的咖啡之都——邦美蜀市。

  • 途中参观中部高原最壮观的两座瀑布：Dray Sap瀑布和Dray Nu瀑布。

下午：抵达后入住市中心酒店。稍作休息后，外出探索城市。

  • 参观中原咖啡村（Trung Nguyen），这里有美丽的花园、喷泉和别具一格的建筑。您可以在此了解越南咖啡文化、咖啡树以及咖啡加工产业。
  • 参观民族学博物馆，这里的展览将带您深入了解越南中部高原人民的生活与文化。
  • Kien Cuong麝香猫咖啡园。您将见到园主、人称“咖啡大王”的Kien Cuong先生，他会为您讲述如何种植和加工著名的麝香猫咖啡（世界上最昂贵的咖啡）。

行程结束后返回酒店，自由休息。

夜宿邦美蜀

餐食：（含早餐）

itinerary.title: 邦美蜀 – 全天大象体验
itinerary.html:
早餐后，导游和专车司机到酒店接您，前往约顿国家公园（Yok Don），加入大象保护项目团队。

  • 听取介绍后，您将与大象饲养员见面，深入森林寻找目前在国家公园内自由漫步的三头大象。导游会为您介绍每头大象的性格、来历以及它们为何生活在约顿国家公园。
  • 整个行程中，导游将分享有关国家公园的知识，为您指认栖息在这片森林中的众多动植物。
  • 在公园内，您可能会发现珍稀野象群的踪迹，如脚印、觅食痕迹或粪便。
  • 在公园中享用野餐午餐。

下午：继续徒步，直至抵达森林深处的大象栖息地。您将有机会与大象近距离接触，参与为大象洗澡（30分钟），并喂它们香蕉和甘蔗。由于中心专注于动物保护，已不再提供骑大象项目。

  • 结束精彩的一天，返回邦美蜀。

夜宿邦美蜀

餐食：（含早、午餐）

itinerary.title: 邦美蜀 – 波来古 – 昆嵩
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐后，导游和司机带您经波来古前往昆嵩。途中参观Phun村，这是嘉莱族（Gia Rai）的一个小村落，以装饰木雕的墓地而最为著名；沿途还将在咖啡、橡胶和胡椒种植园稍作停留。

下午：约5小时车程后抵达昆嵩，游览市镇景点：博物馆、木教堂、孤儿院以及Kon K'Lor吊桥。随后悠闲漫步于茶园以及Kon Ko Lor I村和Kon Ko Lor II村之间。

  • 乘木船游览Dakbla河，前往巴拿族（Bahnar）聚居的Kon Ko Tu村，体验当地文化。形似高耸斧刃的弯曲屋顶蔚为壮观。

晚上：享用当地家庭准备的晚餐，入住干净舒适的本地民宿。

夜宿Kon Ko Tu村

餐食：（含早、午、晚餐）

itinerary.title: 昆嵩 – 会安
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐并退房后，导游和司机带您驱车约七小时前往会安。途中参观达多新景（Tan Canh）胜利纪念碑以及昔日战场遗址，如查理山（Charlie Hill）和凤凰机场——又称达多基地营和达多二号机场，如今只剩一片光秃秃的柏油地，农民在上面晾晒木薯。

  • 继续驱车前行，途中参观Dak Che瀑布和杰-德楞族（Gie-Trieng）的Rong公共长屋。

午餐：在Kham Duc镇的当地餐厅享用午餐

下午：抵达会安，入住美丽的Hoi An Eco-lodge。Hoi An Eco-lodge是一片宁静的世外桃源。

夜宿会安

餐食：（含早餐）

itinerary.title: 会安 – 烹饪课及皮划艇
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐后，导游带您前往本地市场。厨师将带您逛市场，介绍当地物产和市场文化，您将采购食材，跟随厨师学习烹饪，并当场享用成品。

  • 随后步行至码头，登上Chic Boat，沿秋盆河（Thu Bon）顺流而下，欣赏沿岸美景。
  • 游船停下，放下皮划艇，您可悠闲划行（约45分钟），探索和体验会安一些隐秘的角落与自然美景。
  • 返回船上享用饮品，随后开始船上烹饪课。厨师会先示范每道菜的准备和烹饪方法，然后由您亲自动手。
  • 在厨师的指导下，用“心意”探寻交融的风味：咬一口咸香酥脆的炸鱼春卷，感受姜焖鸡浓郁的味道，揭开越南美食的秘密。
  • 午餐还将配有米饭、蔬菜汤和一道甜点。

下午：在返回会安的航程中，放松身心，尽享河上风光。在码头下船后返回生态旅舍，自由休息。

夜宿会安

餐食：（含早、午餐）

itinerary.title: 会安 – 全天自由活动
itinerary.html:
全天自由活动。您可以前往古镇探索，也可以骑车去海滩游泳休闲，或者在生态旅舍里尽享舒适时光。

夜宿会安

餐食：（含早餐）

itinerary.title: 会安 – 岘港 – 飞往河内
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐后，司机接您前往岘港机场，搭乘航班飞往河内。

  • 导游和司机将在河内内排机场接机，送您前往河内老城区的酒店办理入住，之后自由休息。

下午：自由漫步于老城区的狭窄街巷。

晚上：导游将带您前往莲花剧院（Lotus Theatre）观看水上木偶戏，这是越南独特的传统艺术表演。欣赏色彩缤纷的木偶灵巧的动作，以及艺人们在“水上舞台”后操控木偶的精湛技艺。

夜宿河内

餐食：（含早餐）

itinerary.title: 河内 – 乘俄罗斯明斯克摩托车体验小众路线
itinerary.html:
您将乘坐俄罗斯明斯克摩托车体验河内，这条路线将带您走进河内的“生活博物馆”，探索河内的不同街区，参观河内主要且鲜为人知的本地市场，品尝美味的街头小吃。

注意：如果您不喜欢摩托车，您的家人也可以选择乘坐敞篷战争时期吉普车。

上午：早餐后，专车和导游按约定时间在酒店大堂接您，乘坐1952年俄罗斯产150cc摩托车出城观光。途中将为您介绍沿途的美丽风景。

  • 穿过小巷参观黑市，与友善的当地人见面交流。在市场后方的美食区停留，品尝一些街头小吃。
  • 抵达一户当地人家，听主人讲述河内的故事。
  • 前往铁轨旁，导游会掐准时间，让您看到统一号列车呼啸而过，欣赏这一景象并捕捉最精彩的瞬间。
  • 返回市区，穿行于被称为法国区的法式殖民建筑之间。途经法式别墅、越南历史博物馆、历史悠久的Metropole Legend Hotel以及河内大剧院……
  • 前往河内老城区，探索迷宫般的小巷和窄街。这座城市的多元交融定会让您惊叹。在小餐馆和美食摊停留，品尝河内最好的地方美食和特色小吃。
  • 驶出市区前往龙编桥，这座宏伟的大桥由法国人于一百多年前横跨红河而建。
  • 过桥后抵达Bai Giua，俗称香蕉岛，这是红河中央一片24公顷的狭长土地，四周成排的香蕉树环绕，河水清澈，空气清新。随后返回市区。最后一站是一家隐秘的咖啡馆，品一杯鸡蛋咖啡，欣赏风景。
  • 中午前后，导游送您返回酒店，行程结束。

下午：当天余下时间自由活动。可以休息，或漫步老城区的隐秘小巷。

夜宿河内

餐食：（含早、午餐）

itinerary.title: 河内 – 沱北 – 松村
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐后，导游和司机接您前往距河内100公里、以少数民族聚居为主的和平省沱北县（Da Bac），探访当地人并体验他们的生活。

  • 穿过如画的乡村，约三小时车程后抵达钱瑶族（Tien Dao）聚居的松村（Sung）。村里约有75户、350位居民，以务农为生。
  • 入住当地人家。房屋设计精美，屋内和卧室的横梁均有雕刻和彩绘。标配干净的床单和新毛巾，床垫和枕头非常舒适。每张床都配有蚊帐和可拉上的帘子，保护您的隐私。

下午：享用主人亲手烹制的午餐后，在村中悠闲漫步，品尝山雪茶（Shan Tuyet）。您还可以参观当地手工艺作坊，观看村民织布和传统染布技艺。

  • 短途步行（约2公里）前往松洞，参观一片百年茶园，山路略为难行，请注意安全。
  • 返回民宿放松休息，舒舒服服地洗个热水澡，品尝当地美食。

晚上：与寄宿家庭共进晚餐，体验高原文化。

夜宿松村

餐食：（含早、午、晚餐）

itinerary.title: 松村 – 达碑村
itinerary.html:
早餐后，开始约五小时（约12公里）的徒步。您将穿过繁茂的玉米地和稻田，途经湖泊和壮观的石山，沿途可随时停下拍摄群山、山谷和碧绿湖泊的绝美风光。

  • 抵达芒族（Muong）聚居的达碑村（Da Bia）。在这里，您将在寄宿的芒族人家享用美味午餐。

下午：自由休息。您也可以在沱江水库游泳或划皮划艇。

晚上：与寄宿家庭共进晚餐，度过轻松的夜晚。

夜宿达碑村

餐食：（含早、午、晚餐）

itinerary.title: 达碑村 – 通奈 – 宁平
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐后，离开达碑村返回沱江湖，乘坐私人船只（约1-1.5小时）前往通奈港（Thung Nai）。司机在此接您，穿过葱翠的乡村，前往宁平省的山河村（Son Ha）。

  • 抵达后开始乡村骑行，穿行于绿油油的田野和狭窄的小巷之间，观看当地人劳作。

下午：午餐后，乘坐手划船沿小运河悠闲前往天河洞（Thien Ha），沿途欣赏自然风光。这是一处新近发现的生态旅游景点，被游客誉为宁平最美的溶洞，处处都是拍照的好地方。

  • 继续乘船在原始水道上划行约2.5小时，前往通能（Thung Nang）“暖阳谷”。这是一片被陡峭的石灰岩峭壁和迷人稻田环绕的原始秘境，定会带给您难忘的体验。
  • 抵达通能后，等候的司机将接您前往华闾古都——越南11世纪的古都所在地。历经千年风雨侵蚀，残垣断壁几乎已与壮丽的山水融为一体，营造出神秘的氛围，定能激发您的想象。
  • 抵达后参观仅存的丁先皇祠和黎大行皇祠这两处历史遗迹，两座祠庙于17世纪重修。
  • 离开祠庙，前往舞洞山，沿着风景优美的步道漫步，俯瞰山下穿越群山的Ngo Dong河，景色令人屏息。
  • 行程结束，前往宁平的酒店办理入住，余下时间自由休息。

夜宿宁平

餐食：（含早、午餐）

itinerary.title: 宁平 – 吉婆岛 – 兰夏湾
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐后，导游和司机到酒店接您前往海防市，随后乘渡轮前往吉婆岛。

  • 中午前后登上木船，开始兰夏湾之旅。兰夏湾位于吉婆岛南部和东部，约300座喀斯特岛屿和石灰岩礁石与下龙湾一样美丽。兰夏湾的独特之处在于喀斯特岩块彼此紧邻，是划皮划艇和游泳的理想之地。
  • 中午前后，游船驶至海湾中央停泊用午餐。在令人惊叹的全景中享用美味的越南菜肴。

下午：穿过水上养鱼场，继续前往Ba Trai Dao海滩。游船停靠后，您可悠闲地划皮划艇进入石灰岩山峦环绕的海湾，然后在海滩上游泳、晒日光浴。

  • 返回帆船，跟随厨师学做菜，了解当地食材以及经典越南菜肴的做法。

晚上：夕阳西下时，游船抵达停泊地。如您愿意，可以从船上下水游泳。

  • 晚餐后，在顶层甲板上小酌几杯，或与船员一起钓鱿鱼，然后回舱休息。

夜宿兰夏湾游船

餐食：（含早、午、晚餐）

itinerary.title: 兰夏湾 – 深度探索
itinerary.html:
上午：早起观赏日出并享用早餐。随后游船起锚，前往Dua海滩和Vung Kiem Lam区域。您可以划皮划艇环湖游览，感受这片美景的宁静。

下午：继续前往越海村（Viet Hai）。抵达越海码头后，近距离感受原始自然，您可以骑自行车欣赏这座海滨村庄的宁静风光。

  • 参观村里的学校和有机菜园，与当地人见面交流。如果您想多运动，可以徒步登上海关山（Hai Quan）山顶，欣赏国家公园和部分下龙湾的壮丽景色。
  • 结束游览返回游船，驶向兰夏湾一处隐秘的停泊点度过第二晚。
  • 享用晚餐，随后体验钓鱿鱼，再回到舒适的船舱休息。

夜宿兰夏湾游船

餐食：（含早、午、晚餐）

itinerary.title: 兰夏湾 – 吉婆岛 – 河内
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐后，乘船游览兰夏湾的陡峭悬崖，前往猴岛，岛上美丽的沙滩非常适合漫步。

  • 返回游船办理退房，在返航途中享用套餐午餐。

下午：在码头下船，专车司机送您返回河内。

  • 入住酒店后，当天余下时间自由休息。可以在城中漫步，或步行前往距酒店不远的还剑湖和玉山祠，夜晚灯光璀璨，格外美丽。

夜宿河内

餐食：（含早、午餐）

itinerary.title: 河内 – 送机离境
itinerary.html:
早餐后从酒店出发，送您前往河内国际机场，搭乘航班回国或继续您的旅程，我们将协助您规划后续行程。

餐食：（含早餐）

included: 私人英文导游、住宿、私人游览及接送、国内航班、空调车辆、部分正餐、所有门票、税费及服务费。

title.en: Vietnam Tour 18 Days 17 Nights
title.zh: 越南18天17晚深度游

summary: Discover the beauty of Vietnam 18 days 17 nights takes tourists to the floating markets of the West with floating markets, visit Cu Chi tunnels, then go to Hoi An to admire the beauty of the old town, and to Da Nang to admire the beauty of the beach and the famous sights of Ba Na cable car... continue the journey to take tourists to explore the beauty of the Northwest arc, conquer the passes, the golden terraced fields, and return to the coastal city of Ha Long to experience the cruise and enjoy the cuisine right on the 5-star…
route: Arrival in Ho Chi Minh City
HCM City – Morning Tour, Food Hunting & Nightlife Discovery
HCM City – Cai Be – Bassac Cruise
Can Tho – Cai Rang Floating Market – HCM City
HCM City – Cu Chi Tunnels & Cao Dai Temple - Flight to Da Nang/ Hoi An
Hoi An – Walking & Food Tour
Hoi An – Fishing and Farming Full day
Hoi An – Day at leisure
Hoi An – Da Nang – Hue
Hue – Half-day City Tour – Overnight Train to Hanoi
Hanoi Arrival – City Sightseeing
Hanoi – Experience Off the Beaten Path by Russian Minsk Motorcycle
Hanoi – Overnight train to Sapa
Sapa – Hill tribe Village Trek
Sapa – Ma Tra and Ta Phin Villages – Hanoi
Hanoi – Hai Phong – Lan Ha Bay
Lan Ha Bay – Hai Phong – Hanoi
Hanoi – Departure

itinerary.title: Arrival in Ho Chi Minh City
itinerary.html:
Welcome to Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, your guide and driver will be waiting for you at the arrival lounge, holding up a sign with your name on it and taking you straight to your hotel in the city centre.

Afternoon free to relax and get acquainted with your new surroundings. After a brief introduction to your tour with your guide, you will have dinner at the Restaurant, enjoying local cuisine.

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City

itinerary.title: HCM City – Morning Tour, Food Hunting & Nightlife Discovery
itinerary.html:
Morning: You wake up early to visit Ho Chi Minh City in the early morning by cyclo (rickshaw) and private car with a guide who will take you away from the traffic jams during rush hour.

Get on a cyclo (three-wheeled bicycle) and start the tour to Notre Dame Cathedral and the Central Post Office (designed by Gustave Eiffel).

Visit the local Tao Dan Park. Get off the cyclo and enjoy a cup of coffee while admiring the natural scenery in the park, where ornithologists gather with their precious birds.

Visit the memorial site dedicated to Buddhist monk Thich Quang Duc. Then the tour guide will take you to eat pho at a famous restaurant (Pho Viet Nam).

The car takes you along Nguyen Dinh Chieu street to visit a traditional market, you visit the stalls and the daily life of the local people here.

Visit the secret weapons bunker used to hide the arsenal of the Saigon Commandos. Among them are about 2 tons of weapons, prepared for the Tet Offensive (January 1968).

End the morning with a walk around Ho Thi Ky Flower Market, you will feel lost among hundreds of flowers and before the natural beauty. Then, the car will take you back to the hotel, rest or freely visit.

Evening: Saigon becomes more vibrant! You can rent a car to explore the splendid Saigon at night.

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City

Meals: (B/_/_)

itinerary.title: HCM City – Cai Be – Bassac Cruise
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast, check out, your tour guide and car will pick you up from the hotel and take you to Cai Be town.

Upon arrival, you will board the Bassac, a sophisticated wooden boat with the style and elegance of the traditional rice barges typical of the Mekong Delta.

Depart for Cho Lach on the Tien Giang River, cruise on the river, enjoy lunch on board. Relax on the sundeck.

Afternoon: Cruise, the boat will glide into Cho Lach canal, between markets and churches, giving you a unique experience.

Then, get off the boat and walk around the villages to learn about the daily life of the people here such as how they grow rice, fruits and vegetables. Visit the local handicraft industries operating along the riverbank, bringing life to the people living along the river.

You will board the boat again, you will be given a free drink to welcome you back to the boat. Relax on deck and watch the sunset. In the evening, enjoy dinner on the boat along the Mang Thit River. Finally, the boat anchors just downstream of Tra On for the night.

Overnight on Bassac Boat

Meals: (B/L/D)

itinerary.title: Can Tho – Cai Rang Floating Market – HCM City
itinerary.html:
Morning: Wake up early to watch the sunrise. Then have breakfast on board.

  • Bassac continues to Can Tho, passing Tra On.
  • Upon arrival in Can Tho, you will transfer to a small boat and then depart for Cai Rang floating market, a floating market with hundreds of boats loaded with local fruits and vegetables for sale.
  • Visit a rice vermicelli factory, where you will see the production process of vermicelli until the product is ready.

Finally, Bassac arrives at Ninh Kieu wharf, where the driver will be waiting to take you back to Ho Chi Minh City. Lunch will be served at a local restaurant on the way.

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City

Meals: (B/L/_)

itinerary.title: HCM City – Cu Chi Tunnels & Cao Dai Temple - Flight to Da Nang/ Hoi An
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast, your car and tour guide will pick you up and take you to Cu Chi, famous for its network of underground tunnels and historical relics.

  • Upon arrival, you will watch original documentary footage and a boat tour of this historical relic, if you are traveling in a large group, visit the secret tunnels with accommodation, storage rooms, temporary hospitals and kitchens… .
  • Try some of the main dishes used during the resistance against the Viet Cong with cassava served with sour tea.
  • Leaving Cu Chi, you will go to Cao Dai Temple in Tay Ninh Province, explore the sacred temple and learn more about the Cao Dai religion, inspired by Buddhism, Christianity, Confucianism, Hinduism, Islam and Taoism. Afterwards, you will attend a noon mass, admire the monks in colorful costumes and listen to enchanting hymns.

Afternoon: After enjoying lunch at a local restaurant, you will travel to Ho Chi Minh International Airport to catch a flight to Da Nang in Central Vietnam.

Upon arrival at Da Nang Airport, you will be met by your guide and transferred to your hotel in Hoi An, a UNESCO heritage town. Hoi An has two beaches just 5 km (3 miles) away with many beautiful beach resorts.

Overnight in Hoi An

Meals: (B/L/_)

itinerary.title: Hoi An – Walking & Food Tour
itinerary.html:
Morning: Get up early to enjoy the scenery and breakfast at the hotel.

Afternoon: The tour guide will pick you up and take you to Hoi An Ancient Town, you will walk to visit places such as: Ong Pagoda, Tan Ky Ancient House, Phuc Kien Assembly Hall and Japanese Bridge.

  • Visit the Precious Heritage Museum, where the Precious Heritage Collection of Réhahn is permanently displayed.
  • Visit the Reaching Out Tea House, a small oasis of peace and tranquility in the middle of the bustling Old Town, you will be treated to delicious cakes and wonderful oriental tea.
  • Continue to the house of a lantern artisan, you can observe the lantern maker’s techniques before practicing each stage of making a lantern under the guidance of the craftsmen: From bending the lantern into the frame, cutting the fabric, gluing, to finishing the lantern. Before the end of the trip, you will have a lantern made by your own hands.
  • Explore Hoi An street food. With your guide, enjoy a meal with the locals at the stalls, at 4pm every day, the streets of Hoi An are filled with countless street food carts, stalls and vendors. The street food tour is a great opportunity to taste some of Hoi An’s local specialties, introduce you to the faces behind the broth and show you how the locals handle those spice trays!

Overnight in Hoi An

Meals: (B/_/D)

itinerary.title: Hoi An – Fishing and Farming Full day
itinerary.html:
You will join a fishing and farming tour in the countryside around Hoi An.

(Note: if you do not know how to ride a bicycle, please use our “XE OM” scooter service with a small additional fee)

  • You will cycle around Hoi An through the rice fields and see the countryside scenery, experience the life of the countryside people with herds of buffalo leisurely grazing, and record the beautiful scenes.
  • Your first stop is Tra Que Vegetable Village, where you will participate in farming activities, you will learn traditional methods of plowing, planting and watering vegetables. Surely, you will have the opportunity to practice some fun activities.
  • From Tra Que Village, you row along the palm-lined roads through the rice fields, admire the scenery, you can ride a water buffalo in the rice fields and enjoy the freshest air of the countryside beauty.
  • Then board a wooden boat and head to the river mouth, where it merges into Cua Dai Beach for a fishing experience, you will learn how to row a bamboo basket boat and row along the waterways, the local fishermen will teach you some traditional net fishing techniques that will definitely be fun to try.
  • Enjoy a Vietnamese lunch on the boat, with delicious dishes delicately decorated from palm leaves.

Return to the hotel where you can relax.

Overnight in Hoi An

Meals: (B/L/_)

itinerary.title: Hoi An – Day at leisure
itinerary.html:
Spend a day relaxing in this UNESCO heritage town, which is known for its food, beautiful architecture and shopping. Hoi An is the perfect place to stroll around, shop at the many tailor shops and dine at the town’s fine restaurants. In this town, you can have a suit/tuxedo tailored within 24 hours at a reasonable price. You can also join a cooking class to learn about Vietnamese culinary arts, visit the local market, choose ingredients and prepare, cook Hoi An specialties. It’s fun.

Overnight in Hoi An

Meals: (B/_/_)

itinerary.title: Hoi An – Da Nang – Hue
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast, your guide will pick you up and take you (approximately 4 hours) to Hue Imperial City via Da Nang, passing Hai Van Pass. Along the way, you will stop to visit the Marble Mountains, the Cham Museum in Da Nang and the sunny white sand My Khe beach.

  • Arrive in Hue around noon and check into your hotel in the city center.

Afternoon: Your guide and car will pick you up and take you to the pier for a romantic dragon boat ride on the Perfume River. During the boat trip, you will stop to visit the iconic Thien Mu Pagoda – a famous religious site in Hue. Explore the pagoda’s landscaped gardens, the seven-story octagonal tower and watch monks chanting sutras.

  • Visit Dong Ba Market located along the north bank of the Perfume River. Here, you will have the opportunity to discover a Noddle shop that was a favorite of Anthony Bourdain – the world-famous chef and television producer. Taste the best Bun Bo Hue “Bun Hue Soup”.

Return to hotel in late afternoon. Free time to sightsee

Overnight in Hue

Meals: (B/_/_)

itinerary.title: Hue – Half-day City Tour – Overnight Train to Hanoi
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast, you will explore the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Hue, where your car and tour guide will take you to visit Hue’s famous landmarks such as:

The ancient and atmospheric walled Citadel including the former Royal Palace and the Forbidden City.

  • The Hue Museum of Royal Antiquities houses a stunning collection of royal antiques.
  • The impressive tomb of Emperor Tu Duc
  • Vietnam’s only ancient Roman arena; where elephant and tiger fights took place.
  • Visit the local Buddhist temple where you will be served a vegetarian lunch by nuns. Learn about Buddhism or just get to know your friendly hosts.

Afternoon: Visit Truc Chi Garden, a bamboo paper handicraft workshop. You will have the opportunity to meet the students there and get a hands-on experience to learn how to use bamboo pulp carving techniques to create works of art.

  • Then the car takes you to Hue train station to board the overnight Reunification Express to Hanoi. You will spend the night on the train in a four-berth soft sleeper cabin with air conditioning, beautiful and comfortable!

Overnight on the air-conditioned train

Meals: (B/L/_)

itinerary.title: Hanoi Arrival – City Sightseeing
itinerary.html:
Morning: Upon arrival in Hanoi, your car and tour guide will pick you up at the train station and take you to your hotel in the city centre for early check-in. Enjoy breakfast and relax as you wish after the long train journey.

Afternoon: Your car and tour guide will take you on a city tour, visiting the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, the Presidential Palace, the historic Stilt House and the One Pillar Pagoda…

  • From the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, you will take a leisurely walk through the small alleys towards Huu Tiep Lake. Explore the grounds of a 400-year-old temple, then stroll through the traditional local market streets to see the B52 crash site at the lake. This US bomber was shot down during the bombing of Hanoi in 1972, a poignant reminder of Vietnam’s recent history.
  • Your car will take you to the outskirts of Hanoi to visit the Museum of Ethnology, which showcases the 54 officially recognised ethnic groups in Vietnam.
  • Return to the City Center and continue to visit the Temple of Literature on the site of Vietnam’s first university.
  • The tour ends at Hoa Lo (also known as the Hanoi Hilton), a prison used by the French colonialists in Vietnam to detain political prisoners, and later by North Vietnam for American prisoners of war during the Vietnam War.
  • In the evening, your guide will take you to the Opera House to watch the spectacular Vietnamese Bamboo Circus show called My Village. This is a delicate combination of tradition and innovation, where the poetic beauty of Vietnamese village life with folk games and the lifestyle of the villagers is recreated through the traditional bamboo medium of our ancestors, in spectacular circus performances.

Overnight in Hanoi

Meals: (B/_/_)

itinerary.title: Hanoi – Experience Off the Beaten Path by Russian Minsk Motorcycle
itinerary.html:
You visit Hanoi gives you a look at the capital with the daily life of Da Thanh people, explore different neighborhoods of Hanoi, go to local markets, you can enjoy great street food an experience by motorbike with friendly drivers will give you the most unforgettable feeling.

Note: If you do not like motorbikes, there is an alternative option for your family to ride an open-air wartime Jeep.

In the morning, After enjoying breakfast, the tour guide and car will pick you up at the hotel at the appointed time, the tour guide will introduce the next journey.

The first stop is the black market, where you will go through small winding alleys. Meet and interact with friendly locals. Stop at a food court at the back of the market and try some delicious street food.

Visit a local house where you are introduced to an old lady in her apartment to hear her life story.

Arrive at the railway tracks. Here, your guide has timed it so that you can see a Reunification Express train passing by! This is a great moment to capture the most beautiful views.

Back in the City, you will visit the French Quarter. You will pass by French-style villas, the Vietnam History Museum, the heritage Metropole Legend Hotel and the Opera House, etc.

Arrive in Hanoi’s Old Quarter (as opposed to the French Quarter) to explore the maze of small alleys and narrow streets. You will stop at various AUTHENTIC eateries and food stalls to enjoy the best of Hanoi including traditional dishes and local delicacies and specialties.

Continuing the journey, you will go to the historic Long Bien Bridge, a magnificent structure built by the French over a hundred years ago across the Red River.

From the bridge, you will go to Bai Giua, also known as Banana Island, a 24ha strip of land in the middle of the Red River covered with lush green banana, papaya and guava trees, interspersed with white reed flowers. This is a world away from the hustle and bustle of the vibrant city you have left behind.

After meeting the locals and having a personal experience, you will return to the City. The last stop will be a hidden Coffee Shop to enjoy a delicious cup of egg coffee.

Around noon, your guide will take you back to the hotel, where you will end the tour.

Afternoon: You are free to rest, relax and enjoy the comfort of the hotel or stroll through the hidden alleys of the Old Quarter.

Overnight in Hanoi

Meals: (B/L/_)

itinerary.title: Hanoi – Overnight train to Sapa
itinerary.html:
The whole day will be free for you to explore more and enjoy everything that Hanoi has to offer.

  • In the evening, your guide and driver will take you to Hanoi Railway Station on Tran Quy Cap Street, where you will board the overnight train to Lao Cai. You will spend the night on the train. The train departs at around 21:00 and arrives in Lao Cai City at 06:00 the next morning, where you will travel 1 hour to Sapa.

Overnight on the air-conditioned train

Meals: (B/_/_)

itinerary.title: Sapa – Hill tribe Village Trek
itinerary.html:
Morning: Arrive at Lao Cai station, the car and tour guide will pick you up and take you to the hotel in Sapa. Check in early for comfort and arrange breakfast.

  • After breakfast and rest, the car and tour guide will take you to Hau Thao village, home to the Black H’Mong ethnic minority. Here, you will start a moderate hiking trip of 2.5 – 3 hours. Along the way, you will see farms, orchards and rice fields carved into the mountains, enjoy breathtaking views and endless photo opportunities.

Afternoon: After a picnic lunch (prepared by the tour guide), you continue your trek to Sa Seng Village. Hidden in the beautiful Muong Hoa Valley, Sa Seng is home to the H’Mong people, you visit and experience the life of the people here.

  • Walking along the length of the valley, you will pass through two other villages. Continue walking until you reach the top of the hill. From the high altitude, you can see the whole Muong Hoa Valley. Take a break here before heading to the main road, where the car is waiting for you and will take you back to your hotel in Sapa town.

You are free to explore and have a meal at one of the many great restaurants.

Overnight in Sapa

Meals: (B/L/_)

itinerary.title: Sapa – Ma Tra and Ta Phin Villages – Hanoi
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast, you will meet your tour guide again and start your day with a 3km hike through the breathtaking scenery to Suoi Ho village.

  • Continue hiking to Matra village. You will pass by the ancient church built in the early 20th century. Take a few minutes to explore this fascinating sight and take some photos if you like.
  • Trek to Ta Phin village, home to the Red Dao ethnic minority, with their beautiful traditional embroidered costumes and the custom of shaving their hair and eyebrows as a sign of respect. Home to the Black H’Mong minority, experience the H’Mong culture.
  • Stop at a Red Dao family and have a cup of tea, chat with them to learn about the way of life of the people here. Enjoy lunch at the homestay, cooked by the locals.

Afternoon: After lunch, you have time to walk around the village, take photos and shop. The Red Dao are famous for their expertise in herbal medicine as well as using plants from the land to treat many diseases. If you are a little sore after the day’s activities, try a traditional Red Dao herbal bath.

  • Leaving Ta Phin, the car will pick you up and take you back to Sapa town. Take a rest before catching the five-hour limousine back to Hanoi.

Evening: Arrive at your hotel in Hanoi around 21:00. Pack your bags for the overnight trip to Lan Ha Bay tomorrow.

Overnight in Hanoi

Meals: (B/L/_)

itinerary.title: Hanoi – Hai Phong – Lan Ha Bay
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast, your car and guide will pick you up from your hotel and take you to the port city of Hai Phong, where you board a stylish Junk Boat, where you will spend the evening.

  • Arriving around noon, you board your boat, each of which begins its journey around Lan Ha Bay, whose limestone outcrops are as beautiful as Ha Long Bay but more isolated and pristine.
  • After checking in, you will be served a delicious lunch, enjoying delicious Vietnamese cuisine.
  • Relax on the deck or private balcony and soak up the captivating atmosphere emanating from the surreal seascape.

Afternoon: Continuing the journey, you experience a Junk Cruise winding past the islands of Con Vit and Gia Luan, their limestone formations rising dramatically from the bay.

  • In the late afternoon, you experience a bike ride to Cat Ba Island, visiting along the small paved roads towards Viet Hai village. Set in a valley within Cat Ba National Park and surrounded by forests and mountains, you will meet local residents, learn about the fruits and vegetables grown in the valley and sample some homemade wine.
  • Return to the Junk boat to watch a cooking demonstration by the chef. Learn about local ingredients and how to prepare classic Vietnamese dishes.

Evening: As the sun sets, you will arrive at a quiet anchorage for the night. Here you can soak up the day’s adventures with a cocktail under the stars.

  • After dinner, you can relax at the bar with a glass of wine, watch a movie in the cinema or have some fun squid fishing before retiring to your room.

Note: If time permits, we highly recommend staying an extra night on board to have more time to relax and take in the stunning scenery. You will be taken deeper into the Bay, where it is more beautiful and less crowded.

Overnight on board in Lan Ha Bay

Meals: (B/L/D)

itinerary.title: Lan Ha Bay – Hai Phong – Hanoi
itinerary.html:
Morning: Wake up early and join a Tai Chi session on the deck to relax. Enjoy coffee, tea and pastries for breakfast to start the day.

  • It’s time for the Junk to weigh anchor and head towards Frog Lake, a beautiful afternoon spot. Try a refreshing “swim in the bay” or explore the charming seascape by kayak. The cliffs stretch out for a captivating view.
  • Return to the Junk to check out. Then, enjoy a full breakfast buffet as you sail back to the pier.

Afternoon: Alight at Got Wharf in Hai Phong City, your private driver is waiting for you and will take you back to Hanoi.

  • After checking in at your hotel, you are free to explore, visit Hoan Kiem Lake & Ngoc Son Temple, a short walk from your hotel. This place is beautifully lit at night.

Overnight in Hanoi

Meals: (B/_/_)

itinerary.title: Hanoi – Departure
itinerary.html:
Check out of the hotel, transfer to Hanoi International Airport, you can take a flight home or continue your adventure, we will help you plan.

Meals: (B/_/_)

zh.summary: 越南18天17晚美景探索之旅将带您前往西南部的水上市场，参观古芝地道，随后前往会安欣赏古镇之美，再到岘港领略海滩风光和巴拿山缆车等著名景点……继续旅程，带您探索西北弧形山区的壮美，征服险峻山口，欣赏金色梯田，最后回到海滨城市下龙，体验游船之旅，在5星级……上享用美食

itinerary.title: 抵达胡志明市
itinerary.html:
欢迎来到越南胡志明市，导游和司机将在到达大厅手举写有您姓名的接机牌迎候，直接送您前往市中心的酒店。

下午自由休息，熟悉周边环境。导游简要介绍行程后，您将在餐厅享用晚餐，品尝当地美食。

夜宿胡志明市

itinerary.title: 胡志明市 – 上午游、美食寻味及夜生活探索
itinerary.html:
上午：清早起床，在导游陪同下乘坐人力三轮车和专车游览清晨的胡志明市，避开早高峰的交通拥堵。

坐上人力三轮车，前往西贡圣母大教堂和中央邮局（由古斯塔夫·埃菲尔设计）。

参观本地的陶坛公园（Tao Dan）。下车喝杯咖啡，欣赏公园的自然风光，鸟类爱好者们常带着心爱的鸟儿在此聚会。

参观纪念佛教僧人释广德的纪念地。随后导游将带您到一家著名的餐厅（Pho Viet Nam）品尝河粉。

专车沿阮廷炤街（Nguyen Dinh Chieu）带您参观一座传统市场，逛逛摊位，感受当地人的日常生活。

参观西贡特工队用来藏匿武器的秘密地下武器库，这里曾储存约2吨武器，为1968年1月的春节攻势做准备。

上午的行程以漫步何氏己花市（Ho Thi Ky）结束，您会沉醉在数百种鲜花和自然之美中。随后专车送您返回酒店，休息或自由游览。

晚上：西贡变得更加热闹！您可以包车探索璀璨的西贡夜景。

夜宿胡志明市

餐食：（含早餐）

itinerary.title: 胡志明市 – 丐背 – Bassac游船
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐后办理退房，导游和专车到酒店接您前往丐背镇（Cai Be）。

抵达后登上Bassac游船，这是一艘精致的木船，具有湄公河三角洲典型传统运米船的风格与优雅。

出发沿前江（Tien Giang）前往Cho Lach，在河上巡游并在船上享用午餐，在日光甲板上放松休息。

下午：游船驶入Cho Lach运河，穿行于市场和教堂之间，带给您独特的体验。

随后下船漫步村庄，了解当地人的日常生活，如他们如何种植水稻、水果和蔬菜。参观沿河岸经营的本地手工作坊，感受河畔居民的生活气息。

再次登船时，您将获赠一杯免费饮品，欢迎您回到船上。在甲板上放松，欣赏日落。晚上沿Mang Thit河航行，在船上享用晚餐。最后，游船停泊在Tra On下游过夜。

夜宿Bassac游船

餐食：（含早、午、晚餐）

itinerary.title: 芹苴 – 丐冷水上市场 – 胡志明市
itinerary.html:
上午：早起观赏日出，随后在船上享用早餐。

  • Bassac游船经过Tra On，继续驶向芹苴。
  • 抵达芹苴后换乘小船，前往丐冷水上市场。这里有数百艘满载当地水果和蔬菜的船只在水上叫卖。
  • 参观一家米粉厂，了解米粉从制作到成品的全过程。

最后，Bassac游船抵达宁桥码头（Ninh Kieu），司机已在此等候，送您返回胡志明市。午餐安排在途中的当地餐厅。

夜宿胡志明市

餐食：（含早、午餐）

itinerary.title: 胡志明市 – 古芝地道及高台教圣殿 – 飞往岘港/会安
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐后，专车和导游接您前往以地下地道网络和历史遗迹闻名的古芝。

  • 抵达后观看原始纪录片，并乘船游览这一历史遗迹；如果是大团出行，还可参观设有住宿区、储藏室、临时医院和厨房的秘密地道……
  • 品尝抗战时期越共的主食——木薯配酸茶。
  • 离开古芝，前往西宁省的高台教圣殿，探索这座神圣的庙宇，深入了解融合了佛教、基督教、儒教、印度教、伊斯兰教和道教思想的高台教。随后参加正午弥撒，欣赏身着彩色服饰的教士，聆听动人的圣歌。

下午：在当地餐厅享用午餐后，前往胡志明市国际机场，搭乘航班飞往越南中部的岘港。

抵达岘港机场后，导游接机并送您前往联合国教科文组织世界遗产古镇会安的酒店。会安附近5公里（3英里）处有两片海滩，坐落着许多美丽的海滨度假村。

夜宿会安

餐食：（含早、午餐）

itinerary.title: 会安 – 徒步及美食之旅
itinerary.html:
上午：早起欣赏风景，在酒店享用早餐。

下午：导游接您前往会安古镇，步行参观关公庙、进记古宅、福建会馆和日本桥等景点。

  • 参观珍贵遗产博物馆，这里常设展出摄影师Réhahn的“珍贵遗产”系列作品。
  • 参观Reaching Out Tea House，这是热闹古镇中一片宁静祥和的小绿洲，您将品尝美味的糕点和上好的东方茶。
  • 继续前往一位灯笼手艺人的家，观看匠人制作灯笼的技艺，然后在他们的指导下亲手完成制作灯笼的每道工序：从弯制灯笼骨架、裁剪布料、上胶到最后完工。行程结束前，您将拥有一盏亲手制作的灯笼。
  • 探索会安街头美食。跟随导游在小摊上与当地人一同用餐。每天下午4点，会安街头便摆满了无数的小吃车、小摊和流动小贩。街头美食之旅是品尝会安地方特色美食的绝佳机会，您将结识熬制高汤的摊主，并了解当地人如何使用那些调料盘！

夜宿会安

餐食：（含早、晚餐）

itinerary.title: 会安 – 全天捕鱼及农耕体验
itinerary.html:
您将参加会安周边乡村的捕鱼及农耕之旅。

（注意：如果您不会骑自行车，可使用我们的“XE OM”摩的服务，需另付少量费用）

  • 骑自行车环游会安，穿过稻田，欣赏乡村风光，体验水牛群悠闲吃草的田园生活，记录下美丽的画面。
  • 第一站是茶桂菜村，您将参与农耕活动，学习传统的犁地、种菜和浇水方法，一定有机会亲手体验一些有趣的农活。
  • 从茶桂菜村出发，沿着棕榈树夹道的小路穿过稻田，欣赏风景，您还可以在稻田里骑水牛，呼吸乡村最清新的空气。
  • 随后登上木船，驶向汇入Cua Dai海滩的河口体验捕鱼。您将学习如何划簸箕船并沿水道划行，当地渔民还会教您一些传统的撒网捕鱼技巧，一定会乐趣无穷。
  • 在船上享用越式午餐，美味佳肴以棕榈叶精心装饰。

返回酒店休息。

夜宿会安

餐食：（含早、午餐）

itinerary.title: 会安 – 全天自由活动
itinerary.html:
在这座以美食、精美建筑和购物而闻名的联合国教科文组织世界遗产古镇中悠闲地度过一天。会安是漫步、在众多裁缝店购物以及在镇上高档餐厅用餐的理想之地。在这里，您可以以合理的价格在24小时内定制一套西装/礼服。您也可以参加烹饪课，了解越南烹饪艺术，逛当地市场、挑选食材，亲手烹制会安特色菜，乐趣多多。

夜宿会安

餐食：（含早餐）

itinerary.title: 会安 – 岘港 – 顺化
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐后，导游接您经岘港、翻越海云关，前往顺化皇城（约4小时）。途中参观五行山、岘港占婆雕刻博物馆以及阳光明媚的白沙美溪海滩。

  • 中午前后抵达顺化，入住市中心酒店。

下午：导游和专车接您前往码头，乘龙舟浪漫游览香江。游船途中参观标志性的天姥寺——顺化著名的宗教圣地。游览寺内园林、七层八角塔，观看僧侣诵经。

  • 参观位于香江北岸的东巴市场（Dong Ba）。在这里，您有机会探访世界知名厨师兼电视制作人安东尼·波登（Anthony Bourdain）钟爱的米粉店，品尝最正宗的顺化牛肉粉（Bun Bo Hue）。

傍晚返回酒店，自由观光。

夜宿顺化

餐食：（含早餐）

itinerary.title: 顺化 – 半天市区游 – 乘夜车前往河内
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐后探索联合国教科文组织世界遗产地顺化，专车和导游将带您参观顺化的著名地标，如：

古老而富有氛围的顺化皇城，包括昔日的皇宫和紫禁城。

  • 顺化宫廷文物博物馆收藏着精美绝伦的皇家古董。
  • 气势恢宏的嗣德皇陵
  • 越南唯一的古罗马式斗兽场，昔日曾在此举行象虎相斗。
  • 参观当地佛教寺院，品尝尼师准备的素斋午餐。您可以了解佛教文化，或与热情的主人交流。

下午：参观Truc Chi Garden竹纸手工艺作坊。您将有机会与那里的学员见面，亲身体验如何运用竹浆雕刻技艺创作艺术作品。

  • 随后专车送您前往顺化火车站，搭乘统一号夜车前往河内。您将在舒适美观的空调四人软卧包厢中过夜！

夜宿空调列车

餐食：（含早、午餐）

itinerary.title: 抵达河内 – 市区观光
itinerary.html:
上午：抵达河内后，专车和导游在火车站接您，送您前往市中心酒店提前办理入住。经过长途火车旅行，享用早餐后随意休息。

下午：专车和导游带您游览市区，参观胡志明陵、主席府、历史悠久的高脚屋和独柱寺……

  • 从胡志明陵出发，漫步穿过小巷前往友谊湖（Huu Tiep）。参观一座有400年历史的古庙，再沿着传统的本地市场街道前行，观看湖中的B52轰炸机残骸。这架美国轰炸机在1972年轰炸河内期间被击落，令人深刻地追忆越南的近代历史。
  • 专车带您前往河内郊区参观民族学博物馆，馆内展示了越南官方认定的54个民族。
  • 返回市中心，继续参观建于越南第一所大学旧址上的文庙。
  • 行程在火炉监狱（又称“河内希尔顿”）结束。这里曾是法国殖民者在越南关押政治犯的监狱，越战期间又被北越用来关押美国战俘。
  • 晚上，导游将带您前往河内大剧院，观看精彩的越南竹子马戏表演《我的村庄》（My Village）。这是传统与创新的精妙结合，以祖先传承的竹子为媒介，通过精彩的马戏表演，再现越南乡村生活的诗意之美、民间游戏和村民的生活方式。

夜宿河内

餐食：（含早餐）

itinerary.title: 河内 – 乘俄罗斯明斯克摩托车体验小众路线
itinerary.html:
这次河内之旅将带您领略首都居民的日常生活，探索河内的不同街区，逛本地市场，品尝美味的街头小吃。由友善的司机骑摩托车带您体验，定会给您留下最难忘的感受。

注意：如果您不喜欢摩托车，您的家人也可以选择乘坐敞篷战争时期吉普车。

上午，享用早餐后，导游和专车按约定时间到酒店接您，导游将介绍接下来的行程。

第一站是黑市，您将穿过蜿蜒的小巷，与友善的当地人见面交流。在市场后方的美食区停留，品尝美味的街头小吃。

拜访一户当地人家，与一位老奶奶在她的公寓里见面，聆听她的人生故事。

抵达铁轨旁。导游会掐准时间，让您看到统一号列车呼啸而过！这是捕捉最美画面的绝佳时刻。

返回市区，游览法国区。途经法式别墅、越南历史博物馆、历史悠久的Metropole Legend Hotel以及河内大剧院等。

抵达河内老城区（与法国区相对），探索迷宫般的小巷和窄街。您将在多家地道的小餐馆和美食摊停留，品尝河内最好的传统菜肴、地方美食和特色小吃。

继续前往历史悠久的龙编桥，这座宏伟的大桥由法国人于一百多年前横跨红河而建。

过桥后前往Bai Giua，又称香蕉岛，这是红河中央一片24公顷的狭长土地，长满了茂盛的香蕉树、木瓜树和番石榴树，其间点缀着白色的芦苇花。这里与您刚刚离开的喧嚣都市仿佛是两个世界。

与当地人见面并亲身体验后，返回市区。最后一站是一家隐秘的咖啡馆，品一杯美味的鸡蛋咖啡。

中午前后，导游送您返回酒店，行程结束。

下午：自由休息，享受酒店的舒适时光，或漫步老城区的隐秘小巷。

夜宿河内

餐食：（含早、午餐）

itinerary.title: 河内 – 乘夜车前往沙坝
itinerary.html:
全天自由活动，您可以进一步探索，尽享河内的一切美好。

  • 晚上，导游和司机送您前往陈贵钗街（Tran Quy Cap）的河内火车站，搭乘夜车前往老街，在火车上过夜。列车约21:00发车，次日早上06:00抵达老街市，再乘车约1小时前往沙坝。

夜宿空调列车

餐食：（含早餐）

itinerary.title: 沙坝 – 山地部落村寨徒步
itinerary.html:
上午：抵达老街站，专车和导游接您前往沙坝的酒店。为方便起见提前办理入住，并安排早餐。

  • 早餐并休息后，专车和导游带您前往黑苗族聚居的Hau Thao村。在这里，您将开始一段2.5至3小时的中等强度徒步。沿途可见农田、果园和依山开垦的梯田，景色令人屏息，处处都是拍照的好地方。

下午：享用野餐午餐（由导游准备）后，继续徒步前往Sa Seng村。Sa Seng村隐匿于美丽的勐花山谷（Muong Hoa）中，是苗族的家园，您将在此探访并体验当地人的生活。

  • 沿着山谷一路前行，途经另外两个村庄，继续步行直至抵达山顶。站在高处，整个勐花山谷尽收眼底。在此稍作休息后前往主路，专车已在此等候，送您返回沙坝镇的酒店。

您可以自由探索，并在众多优质餐厅中任选一家用餐。

夜宿沙坝

餐食：（含早、午餐）

itinerary.title: 沙坝 – 玛查村和达平村 – 河内
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐后与导游会合，徒步3公里穿过令人惊叹的美景前往Suoi Ho村，开启新的一天。

  • 继续徒步前往玛查村（Matra），途经一座建于20世纪初的古老教堂。花几分钟探索这一迷人景点，如您喜欢可拍照留念。
  • 徒步前往达平村（Ta Phin），这里是红瑶族的家园，她们身着精美的传统刺绣服饰，并有剃去头发和眉毛以示尊重的习俗。这里也是黑苗族的家园，您可以体验苗族文化。
  • 在一户红瑶族人家停留，喝杯茶，与他们聊天，了解当地人的生活方式。在民宿享用当地人亲手烹制的午餐。

下午：午餐后，您有时间在村中漫步、拍照和购物。红瑶族以精通草药闻名，善于利用当地植物治疗多种疾病。如果一天的活动让您有些酸痛，不妨试试传统的红瑶族草药浴。

  • 离开达平村，专车接您返回沙坝镇。稍作休息后，乘坐约五小时的豪华商务车返回河内。

晚上：约21:00抵达河内酒店。收拾行李，为明天前往兰夏湾的过夜游船之旅做准备。

夜宿河内

餐食：（含早、午餐）

itinerary.title: 河内 – 海防 – 兰夏湾
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐后，专车和导游到酒店接您前往港口城市海防，登上一艘时尚的帆船，并在船上度过这一晚。

  • 中午前后抵达并登船，开始环游兰夏湾。兰夏湾的石灰岩礁石与下龙湾一样美丽，但更加幽静、原始。
  • 办理入住后，您将享用一顿可口的午餐，品尝美味的越南菜肴。
  • 在甲板或私人阳台上放松身心，沉浸在如梦似幻的海景所散发的迷人氛围中。

下午：继续航程，乘帆船蜿蜒驶过Con Vit岛和Gia Luan岛，岛上的石灰岩地貌拔海而起，蔚为壮观。

  • 傍晚，骑自行车游览吉婆岛，沿着铺砌的小路前往越海村（Viet Hai）。村庄坐落在吉婆国家公园内的山谷中，四周森林和群山环绕。您将与当地居民见面，了解山谷中种植的水果和蔬菜，并品尝自酿的米酒。
  • 返回帆船观看厨师的烹饪示范，了解当地食材以及经典越南菜肴的做法。

晚上：夕阳西下时，游船抵达一处宁静的停泊地过夜。在这里，您可以在星空下手持一杯鸡尾酒，回味一天的冒险。

  • 晚餐后，您可以在酒吧小酌一杯葡萄酒，在影院观看电影，或钓鱿鱼娱乐一番，然后回房休息。

注意：如时间允许，我们强烈建议您在船上多住一晚，有更多时间放松身心、饱览绝美风光。游船将带您深入海湾更深处，那里更加美丽，游客也更少。

夜宿兰夏湾游船

餐食：（含早、午、晚餐）

itinerary.title: 兰夏湾 – 海防 – 河内
itinerary.html:
上午：清晨早起，在甲板上参加太极晨练放松身心。享用咖啡、茶和糕点作为早点，开启新的一天。

  • 帆船起锚，驶向风景优美的青蛙湖（Frog Lake）。您可以在海湾中畅快游泳，或划皮划艇探索迷人的海景，绵延的悬崖构成一幅动人的画卷。
  • 返回帆船办理退房，在返回码头途中享用丰盛的自助早餐。

下午：在海防市Got码头下船，专车司机已在此等候，送您返回河内。

  • 入住酒店后自由活动，可步行前往距酒店不远的还剑湖和玉山祠，夜晚灯光璀璨，格外美丽。

夜宿河内

餐食：（含早餐）

itinerary.title: 河内 – 送机离境
itinerary.html:
办理酒店退房，送您前往河内国际机场，搭乘航班回国或继续您的旅程，我们将协助您规划后续行程。

餐食：（含早餐）

title.en: Vietnam Tour 18 Days 17 Nights From Hanoi
title.zh: 河内出发越南18天17晚之旅

summary: Let's explore the beauty of Vietnam with Vietlook Travel, admire the capital's scenery through French villages, the old quarter, or enjoy street food, the journey takes you to Ha Long Bay to experience a 5-star cruise, learn to cook with a professional chef, or cycle to visit the villages will bring you the most enjoyable…
route: Arrival in Hanoi
Hanoi – Experience Off the Beaten Path by Russian Minsk Motorcycle
Hanoi – Halong Bay
Halong Bay – Hanoi
Hanoi – Mai Chau
Mai Chau – Pu Luong Natural Reserve
