Pu Luong – Ninh Binh
Ninh Binh – Nam Dinh
Nam Dinh – Day Train to Hue
Hue – Full day City Tour
Hue – Day train to Hoi An – Walking & Food tour
Hoi An – Fishing and Farming Full day
Hoi An – Day at leisure
Hoi An / Da Nang – Flight to Ho Chi Minh City – Cu Chi Tunnels
HCM City – Vung Liem
Vung Liem – HCM City
HCM City– Departure

itinerary.title: Arrival in Hanoi
itinerary.html:
Hello! Welcome to Hanoi, Vietnam.

  • Arrive at Noi Bai Airport – Hanoi, car and tour guide pick you up and take you straight to your hotel in the Old Quarter.
  • After checking in, you are free to relax and enjoy the scenery of Hanoi, then go enjoy food at Koto restaurant.

Overnight in Hanoi

Meals: (_/_/D)

itinerary.title: Hanoi – Experience Off the Beaten Path by Russian Minsk Motorcycle
itinerary.html:
You will experience Hanoi off the beaten track by Russian Minsk motorbike, you visit the museum in Hanoi, with your guide, you explore different neighborhoods of Hanoi, and visit the market in Hanoi, then you will enjoy street food, you explore Hanoi by safe, and friendly cub 50 motorbike.

Note: If you do not like motorbikes, there is an alternative for your family to ride an open-air wartime Jeep.

Morning: After breakfast, the car and guide will pick up your family at the hotel lobby at the scheduled time, you will ride on a 1952 Russian-made 150cc motorbike heading out of the city. The car, you will introduce some beautiful views of their city.

  • Visit the black market to meet and interact with friendly locals. Stop at a food court at the back of the market and try some delicious street food.
  • Continuing the journey you will visit a local house, meet the elders and hear thrilling stories.
  • The train tracks, the guide has timed it so that you can see a Reunification Express train passing by! This is your Kodak moment.
  • Returning to the City, you pass through the French colonial architecture of the French Quarter. You will pass by French-style villas, the Vietnam History Museum, the heritage Metropole Legend Hotel and the Opera House…
  • Arriving in Hanoi’s Old Quarter (as opposed to the French Quarter) you will explore the maze of small alleys and narrow streets. Stop at various eateries and food stalls to enjoy the best of Hanoi such as traditional dishes and specialties of Ha Thanh.
  • The car takes you out of the city towards Long Bien Bridge, a magnificent architectural work built by the French over a hundred years ago across the Red River.
  • You will arrive at Bai Giua, also known as Banana Island, a 24ha strip of land in the middle of the Red River, the island is covered with lush green banana, papaya and guava trees, interspersed with white reed flowers. You will meet the locals, then head back to the City. The last stop will be a hidden Coffee Shop to enjoy a cup of egg coffee with a view.
  • Around noon, your guide will take you back to the hotel.

Afternoon: You are free to relax and enjoy the comfort of the hotel or stroll through the hidden alleys of the Old Quarter.

Overnight in Hanoi

Meals: (B/L/_)

itinerary.title: Hanoi – Halong Bay
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast, your guide will pick you up and take you through the fertile fields of the Red River Delta to Halong Bay, where you will board a boat, where you will spend the evening.

  • Upon arrival, you will board a sailing boat for a safety briefing, and the journey will begin with a sightseeing tour around the islets and limestone caves of the bay.

Afternoon: After lunch on board, you will experience sunbathing on the deck and enjoy the peaceful tranquility of the bay.

  • Then, you will visit the “Grotte des Surprises” Cave, a hidden gem of Mother Nature. As the boat gently drifts through the beautiful limestone formations with thousands of stalactites and stalagmites, the boat takes you through the islands, you will encounter deserted bays, white sand beaches and floating villages.
  • You will enjoy the activities on board and take in the beautiful scenery of the Bay. Relax at the spa on board or swim in the emerald waters.
  • At the end of the day, your crew will take you to the overnight anchorage. You can attend a cooking demonstration by the chef or watch the sunset on the deck before dinner.
  • The rest of the evening will be at your leisure. You can watch a movie or join the crew in squid fishing before retiring to your cabin.

Overnight on board in Ha Long Bay

Meals: (B/L/D)

itinerary.title: Halong Bay – Hanoi
itinerary.html:
Morning: You will join Tai Chi exercises, you will feel relaxed in the morning. Join a morning class with a ‘Local Expert’ on the Junk’s deck in a beautiful natural setting. You will enjoy the scenery on Ha Long Bay in the morning or you can kayak and row through the Bright and Dark Caves to admire the scenery here.

  • Return to the Junk. Check out of the cabin and then enjoy a buffet before you return to the port. Get off the boat around noon to drive back to Hanoi.

Afternoon: Arrive at your hotel in Hanoi, you can relax on your own, or you can go to the Lotus Theatre to watch the unique traditional Water Puppet Show.

Overnight in Hanoi

Meals: (B/L/_)

itinerary.title: Hanoi – Mai Chau
itinerary.html:
Morning: Your guide and driver will pick you up at your hotel and start a 4-hour scenic drive through the picturesque countryside of green rice fields and majestic mountains to Mai Chau, home to ethnic minorities, surrounded by hills, Mai Chau is a peaceful scene.

  • Arrive in Mai Chau around noon and check in at Mai Chau Ecolodge. Nestled in the heart of Mai Chau valley surrounded by mountains and rice fields, this eco-resort is a peaceful oasis.

Afternoon: Your guide will take you on a walk (or bike ride if you wish) to Pom Coong and Lac villages, visit stilt houses and lush green rice fields, Lac and Pom Coong villages are ancient Thai ethnic villages where you will visit and experience the daily life of the people here.

  • Visit Mo Luong cave and Chieu cave. Two natural cave systems with stalactites and stalagmites thousands of years old are beautiful works of art of Mother Nature, these caves give you the feeling like you are lost in the ancient world of primitive creations.

Visit the Thai Ethnology Museum. More than 1000 artifacts are displayed associated with the daily life of Thai people, with hunting tools, ceremonial costumes, bowls, plates, ancient coins, musical instruments, hundreds of years old books, … The works exude Thai culture over the centuries.

Evening: You enjoy chef Gordon Ramsay’s dishes on the Mai Chau trip, which are local dishes, and rice wine made in the village.

  • After dinner, you will return to Mai Chau Ecolodge to watch the traditional dance performance performed by the White Thai people.

Overnight in Mai Chau

Meals: (B/L/D)

itinerary.title: Mai Chau – Pu Luong Natural Reserve
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast, the car and tour guide will pick you up and take you to Pu Luong with its towering limestone peaks and lush green terraced fields and many villages of the Thai ethnic people.

  • Upon arrival, you will check in at the bungalows of Pu Luong Resort, a paradise on the mountain top, surrounded by terraced rice fields, palm trees and banana trees with stunning views.

Noon: You enjoy lunch, then free time to explore the beautiful resort with its tranquil setting.

Afternoon: The tour guide will take you hiking (5 km/ 3 hours) around the resort area. You will interact and meet the local people, walk through the rice fields, rice paddies and learn more about the local culture.

Evening: Free to explore. Enjoy dinner and the comfort of the resort.

Overnight in Pu Luong

Meals: (B/L/D)

itinerary.title: Pu Luong – Hiking and Cycling
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast, your guide will take you hiking (4km) and cycling (40 minutes) around the most beautiful terraced rice fields valley in front of the Retreat.

  • Arriving at the beautiful valley opposite the Retreat, you will walk around the terraced rice fields or wind through small paths covered with vegetation, admiring the picturesque Uoi villages hidden at the foot of the mountain, you will record the beautiful scenery.
  • You will visit a local house, where you will rest for a while and then cycle around the village. If time permits, you will visit a local family, where you can learn about their traditional brocade weaving.
  • Continue cycling through the rice fields and to another village to explore the surrounding landscape. Return to the local house, where the driver will be waiting for you and take you back to the resort.

Afternoon: Free time for you to explore as you like. Enjoy lunch and dinner at the resort.

Overnight in Pu Luong

Meals: (B/L/D)

itinerary.title: Pu Luong – Ninh Binh
itinerary.html:
Morning: From Pu Luong, you go to Ninh Binh. Only 3 hours from Pu Luong, surrounded by beautiful limestone ranges.

  • Upon arrival, you will begin to explore the Trang An eco-tourism area (a UNESCO World Heritage Site) with its beautiful scenery, secret caves, high peaks, and quiet streams. You will board a boat to explore the network of caves and arches of Trang An, including Sang Cave, Toi Cave, Ba Giot Cave, and Sinh Cave.

Afternoon: After enjoying lunch, you will continue to visit the ancient capital of Hoa Lu dating back to the 11th century, the spectacular scenery creates a mysterious atmosphere that will surely bring you a sense of excitement

  • Upon arrival, immerse yourself in history at the two remaining temples of King Dinh and King Le. Renovated in the 17th century, the temples are believed to have been built on the original foundations of the old palaces from the 11th and 12th centuries.
  • Take a leisurely bike ride through the towering limestone mountains, along narrow roads and scenic views. Reach Hang Mua Mountain, where a short hike leads to a stunning viewpoint with breathtaking views of the Ngo Dong River below, cutting through the towering mountains.
  • Stay overnight at the boutique resort Tam Coc Garden. Surrounded by rice fields and stunning limestone formations, Tam Coc Resort is an oasis of tranquillity away from the hustle and bustle of the city.

Overnight in Ninh Binh

Meals: (B/L/_)

itinerary.title: Ninh Binh – Nam Dinh
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast, you will depart from Ninh Binh and drive 3 hours to Xuan Thuy National Park in Nam Dinh province, 150 km southwest of Hanoi in the coastal region of the Red River Delta. On the way, you will visit the ancient Co Le Pagoda dating back to the 10th century.

  • You will visit Vi Khe Village, one of the largest bonsai villages in Vietnam. You will see bonsai trees in many different shapes, such as phoenix, dragon, horse, unicorn… or the symbol of the Temple of Literature.
  • Visit Xuan Thuy National Park, formerly known as the Regional Nature Reserve and later became Vietnam’s first Ramsar site, to preserve wetlands. Xuan Thuy National Park is part of the UNESCO-recognized Red River Biosphere Reserve. This is a rich, biodiverse coastal wetland, home to around 220 species of birds, 110 species of aquatic plants and 500 other aquatic species.
  • Around noon, you will arrive at Xuan Giao Commune near the National Park, where you will board a boat to explore the wetlands. After a one-hour boat ride through the National Park, you will arrive at the Clam House, where you will be served a delicious seafood lunch. Take a break and relax in the Clam House before boarding the vehicle back to the mainland.

Afternoon: After a short break, you will begin a tour around Giao Xuan Commune and through the villages. Walk along the country roads to see the lives of the local people and stop to watch farmers working in the rice fields using traditional farming methods. You will also visit ancient houses, a Catholic church and the Agricultural Museum. If it is sunny, you can visit the salt fields to see the locals making salt. You can try your hand at becoming a salt farmer!

  • Visit the bird station (applicable for winter from November to March) to see many birds flying from East Asia to Australia such as Black-faced Spoonbill, Spoonbill, Spotted Green-billed Sandpiper, Saunders Gull and Asian Yellow-billed Sandpiper…

Evening: Transfer to a local house in Xuan Giao Commune, where you will enjoy a family-hosted dinner and stay overnight with the family. Clean and comfortable bedding is provided throughout your stay.

Overnight in Xuan Giao Nam Dinh

Meals: (B/L/D)

itinerary.title: Nam Dinh – Day Train to Hue
itinerary.html:
Morning: Enjoy a relaxing bike ride (or car ride) around the village, watch the beautiful sunrise over the sea, then visit the local Fish Market. Here, you can watch fishermen bring in their overnight catch. Hundreds of people from surrounding villages flock to this wholesale market to buy the best of the day.

  • Return to the local homestay. Along the way, you will stop to visit a local fish sauce family, where you can see the traditional method of making the delicious dipping sauce.
  • After breakfast and check out of the homestay, you will be taken to Nam Dinh station to catch the day train to Hue. The train ride lasts 11 hours and you will be in a nice and comfortable air-conditioned four-berth soft sleeper compartment. You will enjoy the beautiful scenery along the way and especially cross the former Demilitarized Zone (DMZ) of Vietnam.

Evening: Arrive in Hue, your tour guide and driver will pick you up at the train exit and take you to your hotel in the city center for the night.

Overnight in Hue

Meals: (B/_/_)

itinerary.title: Hue – Full day City Tour
itinerary.html:
Morning: Start your day with a cyclo (rickshaw) ride through the ‘Citadel’ to Tinh Tam Lake, where you will explore the Imperial City (the fifth UNESCO World Heritage Site on your list) with its palaces, mandarin halls and the ruins of the Forbidden City.

  • Head into the countryside to see the final resting place (tomb) of King Khai Dinh, designed in traditional Vietnamese style.
  • Visit Uu Dam Orphanage, which is home to around 50 orphans. Learn more about the daily activities and efforts to care for the children. Chat with the children to learn about their school life and their dreams, before teaching them basic English or playing some games with them. Prepare a vegetarian lunch for the children and join them for lunch.

Afternoon: After lunch, you will visit Vietnam’s only ancient arena “Tiger Fight” which was dedicated to battles between elephants and tigers. Most of the time, the arena is held for the pleasure of the royal family and the people here.

  • Take a dragon boat down the Perfume River. Along the way, you will stop to visit Thien Mu Pagoda – Hue’s most famous religious site. Explore the pagoda’s landscaped garden, the seven-storey octagonal tower and watch monks chanting sutras.
  • End the day at Truc Chi Garden, a bamboo paper handicraft workshop founded by a talented young artist. You will have the opportunity to meet the students and have a hands-on experience to learn how to use the bamboo pulp carving technique to create works of art. Try making your own Truc Chi painting and take it home as a souvenir.

Overnight in Hue

Meals: (B/L/_)

itinerary.title: Hue – Day train to Hoi An – Walking & Food tour
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast, your car will pick you up from your hotel and take you to Hue train station to catch the daytime train (soft seat with air conditioning) to Da Nang, on the Vietnam route. The train takes three hours.

  • Upon arrival in Da Nang, your guide will pick you up and take you to your hotel in Hoi An, a UNESCO heritage town. Hoi An has two beaches just 5 km (3 miles) away with many beautiful beach resorts, so please let us know if you would like to stay at the beach.

Afternoon: Your guide will take you to Hoi An Ancient Town, where you will walk to visit Ong Pagoda, Tan Ky Ancient House, Phuc Kien Assembly Hall and Japanese Covered Bridge.

  • Visit the Heritage Museum, which houses Réhahn’s precious Heritage Collection. Admire the paintings of ethnic minorities.
  • Visit Reaching Out Tea House, a small oasis of welcome tranquility in the bustling Old Quarter, owned and run by deaf and mute people. Here, you will be treated to delicious cakes and wonderful oriental tea.
  • Visit a lantern artisan’s house, you can observe the lantern making techniques of the craftsmen before practicing each stage of lantern making under the guidance of enthusiastic craftsmen: From bending the lantern into the frame, cutting the fabric, gluing, to finishing the lantern. Before the end of the tour, you will have a lantern made by your own hands.
  • Explore Hoi An street food through the small streets, you will enjoy local dishes. Every day at 4pm, the streets of Hoi An are filled with countless street food carts, stalls and vendors, you enjoy some Hoi An specialties prepared by locals, introduce you to the faces behind the broth pots and teach you how locals handle those spice trays!

Overnight in Hoi An

Meals: (B/_/D)

itinerary.title: Hoi An – Fishing and Farming Full day
itinerary.html:
You will join a fishing and farming tour in the beautiful countryside around Hoi An, you experience close to the people here.

(Note: if you do not know how to ride a bike, please use our “XE OM” scooter service with a small extra charge)

  • Tour Hoi An by cycling through the rice fields and enjoy the countryside scenery, see and experience the life of the people here.
  • Visit Tra Que Vegetable Village you join farming. This organic vegetable and herb farm is beautifully presented and provides many fresh products for Hoi An. You will learn the traditional methods of plowing the land, planting and watering vegetables with the people.
  • From Tra Que Village, you row along the palm-lined roads through the rice fields, you will ride a water buffalo in the rice fields and enjoy the freshest air of the countryside beauty.
  • You will board a wooden boat and head to the river mouth where it meets Cua Dai Beach. The fishing part begins. First, you will learn how to row a bamboo basket boat and row along the waterways, before meeting some local fishermen who will teach you some traditional net fishing techniques that are sure to be fun to try.
  • Your tour ends with a delicious Vietnamese lunch on board, cooked by the crew.
  • Return to your hotel, free to relax.

Overnight in Hoi An

Meals: (B/L/_)

itinerary.title: Hoi An – Day at leisure
itinerary.html:
You are free to explore Hoi An, and enjoy the food to your liking at the local market and street food (try Lao Cau and White Rose Buns), do 24-hour sewing, join a hands-on cooking class.

  • The beautiful An Bang Beach is only 5km from the Old Town. You can cycle there to swim and relax.

Overnight in Hoi An

Meals: (B/_/_)

itinerary.title: Hoi An / Da Nang – Flight to Ho Chi Minh City – Cu Chi Tunnels
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for a short flight to Ho Chi Minh City (HCMC), formerly known as Saigon.

  • Upon arrival, your guide and driver will pick you up and take you to Cu Chi, located northwest of Ho Chi Minh City, with a network of deep underground tunnels that are a historical site.
  • Upon arrival, you will watch original documentary footage, then walk through the reserve. The tunnels contained living quarters, storage rooms, makeshift hospitals and kitchens… . you will tour the underground tunnels with your guide.
  • Try some of the staple food of the Viet Cong soldiers, including cassava and sour tea. Afterwards, transfer to your hotel in Ho Chi Minh City.

Afternoon: You are free to explore, either strolling around the city centre or visiting the night market and enjoying some authentic local food.

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City

Meals: (B/_/_)

itinerary.title: HCM City – Vung Liem (Mekong Delta)
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast and check out, your guide and driver will take you on a three-hour tour to Vung Liem (Mekong Delta), where you will enjoy the Mekong Delta experience.

  • Upon arrival, you will check into the bungalows at Co Co Riverside Lodge. Nestled on the banks of the Mekong River surrounded by coconut forests and rice fields, the lodge makes you feel relaxed

Afternoon: After lunch, take a bike ride along the peaceful village roads through coconut farms, green rice fields and small villages. Along the way, you will stop to visit one of the many dragon fruit plantations where you can enjoy the garden.

  • Return to the lodge to shower and rest, you will walk with the locals using traditional torches made from dried coconut leaves to the neighbor’s house, where you will enjoy a traditional music performance.
  • Return to the lodge and join a fun cooking class with the chef. Then sit back and enjoy what you have cooked together.
  • Enjoy the rest of the evening at your leisure.

Overnight at Co Co Riverside Lodge in Vung Liem

Meals: (B/L/D)

itinerary.title: Vung Liem – HCM City
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast, you will visit a local school and visit the market. Then take a leisurely boat ride through the small palm-lined canals to visit the local handicraft industries with small coconut processing operations. Once the coconuts are dehusked, the coir is separated from the shell to make rope, which is then used to weave mats.

  • Take a local ferry to visit a Cao Dai temple, a fascinating insight into a local religion.
  • Back to the Lodge. If time permits, try weaving with nipa palm leaves. Leaves are the main building material in the Mekong Delta and are used to build walls and roofs. The locals will show you how they use the leaves and how to make ‘poon’ sticks which glow on the last night with a musical performance.

Afternoon: Check out and return to Ho Chi Minh City, you are free to relax and enjoy the night scene in Ho Chi Minh City

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City

Meals: (B/L/_)

itinerary.title: HCM City– Departure
itinerary.html:
Pick you up from your hotel after breakfast and transfer to Ho Chi Minh International Airport, where you can catch your flight home or continue your adventure, we’ll help you plan.

  • Not ready to go home yet? Extend your stay with a trip to the pristine island of Phu Quoc, where you can end your Vietnam adventure with a relaxing stay at one of its many beautiful beaches and resorts.

Meals: (B/_/_)

included: Private English-speaking guide, accommodation, private tours and transfer, domestic flights, A/C train, some main meals, all entrance fees, tax, and service charge.

itinerary.title: 抵达河内
itinerary.html:
您好！欢迎来到越南河内。

  • 抵达河内内排机场，司机和导游接机后直接送您前往老城区的酒店。
  • 办理入住后，您可自由休息、欣赏河内风光，随后前往Koto餐厅享用美食。

夜宿河内

餐食：（含晚餐）

itinerary.title: 河内 – 乘俄制明斯克摩托车体验小众路线
itinerary.html:
您将乘坐俄制明斯克摩托车，体验河内鲜为人知的一面：在导游陪同下参观河内的博物馆，探索河内不同的街区，逛当地市场，品尝街头美食，并乘坐安全友好的Cub 50摩托车畅游河内。

注意：如您不喜欢摩托车，全家也可选择乘坐敞篷战时吉普车。

上午：早餐后，司机和导游按约定时间在酒店大堂接您一家，您将乘坐1952年俄制150cc摩托车驶出市区，沿途导游会为您介绍这座城市的美丽风景。

  • 参观“黑市”，与友善的当地人见面互动。在市场后方的美食区停留，品尝美味的街头小吃。
  • 继续行程，拜访一户当地人家，与老人们见面，聆听扣人心弦的故事。
  • 来到铁轨旁，导游已精心安排好时间，让您亲眼看到统一号列车呼啸而过！这正是您拍照留念的绝佳时刻。
  • 返回市区途中，您将穿过法租界的法式殖民建筑，途经法式别墅、越南历史博物馆、具有历史意义的Metropole Legend Hotel以及大剧院……
  • 抵达河内老城区（与法租界相对），探索迷宫般的小巷和窄街。沿途在各色小吃店和美食摊停留，品尝河内最地道的传统菜肴和河城特色美食。
  • 随后驱车出城前往龙边桥——这座横跨红河的宏伟建筑由法国人于一百多年前修建。
  • 您将抵达白洲，又称香蕉岛，这是红河中央一片面积24公顷的狭长土地，岛上遍布郁郁葱葱的香蕉树、木瓜树和番石榴树，其间点缀着白色芦苇花。在这里与当地人见面后返回市区。最后一站是一家隐秘的咖啡馆，边赏景边品尝一杯鸡蛋咖啡。
  • 中午前后，导游送您返回酒店。

下午：自由活动，您可以在酒店舒适休息，或漫步于老城区的隐秘小巷。

夜宿河内

餐食：（含早、午餐）

itinerary.title: 河内 – 下龙湾
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐后，导游接您出发，穿过红河三角洲肥沃的田野前往下龙湾，登上您当晚将入住的游船。

  • 抵达后，登上帆船听取安全说明，随后开启观光之旅，环游海湾中的小岛和石灰岩溶洞。

下午：在船上享用午餐后，您可在甲板上享受日光浴，感受海湾的宁静祥和。

  • 随后参观“惊讶洞”（Grotte des Surprises），这是大自然隐藏的瑰宝。游船缓缓驶过遍布成千上万钟乳石和石笋的秀美石灰岩地貌，穿行于岛屿之间，您将看到幽静的海湾、白沙滩和水上渔村。
  • 您可参加船上的各项活动，欣赏海湾的美景；也可在船上水疗中心放松身心，或在翡翠般的海水中畅游。
  • 傍晚，船员将带您前往过夜停泊点。晚餐前，您可观看厨师的烹饪示范，或在甲板上欣赏日落。
  • 晚间自由活动。回舱休息前，您可以观看电影，或与船员一起钓鱿鱼。

夜宿下龙湾游船

餐食：（含早、午、晚餐）

itinerary.title: 下龙湾 – 河内
itinerary.html:
上午：参加太极晨练，在清晨放松身心。在美丽的自然环境中，与“当地专家”一起在帆船甲板上上一堂晨课。您可欣赏下龙湾的晨景，也可划皮划艇穿越明洞和暗洞，欣赏这里的风光。

  • 返回帆船，退舱后享用自助餐，然后返回码头。中午前后下船，乘车返回河内。

下午：抵达河内酒店，您可以自行休息，也可前往Lotus剧院观看独特的传统水上木偶戏。

夜宿河内

餐食：（含早、午餐）

itinerary.title: 河内 – 梅州
itinerary.html:
上午：导游和司机到酒店接您，开始约4小时的风景驾车之旅，穿过稻田青翠、山峦雄伟的如画乡村，前往梅州。梅州是少数民族聚居地，群山环抱，一派宁静祥和的景象。

  • 中午前后抵达梅州，入住Mai Chau Ecolodge。这家生态度假村坐落于梅州山谷中心，四周群山与稻田环绕，宛如一片宁静的绿洲。

下午：导游带您步行（如您愿意也可骑自行车）前往蓬寇村和拉克村，参观高脚屋和郁郁葱葱的稻田。拉克村和蓬寇村是古老的泰族村落，您将在这里走访并体验当地人的日常生活。

  • 参观莫良洞和刁洞。这两处天然溶洞拥有数千年历史的钟乳石和石笋，是大自然的美丽杰作，置身其中仿佛迷失在原始的远古世界。

参观泰族民族学博物馆。馆内陈列着1000多件与泰族人日常生活相关的文物，包括狩猎工具、礼服、碗盘、古钱币、乐器、数百年历史的古书等……这些藏品展现了泰族数百年来的文化。

晚上：在梅州之旅中品尝厨神Gordon Ramsay曾品鉴过的当地菜肴，以及村里自酿的米酒。

  • 晚餐后返回Mai Chau Ecolodge，观看白泰族人表演的传统舞蹈。

夜宿梅州

餐食：（含早、午、晚餐）

itinerary.title: 梅州 – 普隆自然保护区
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐后，司机和导游接您前往普隆。这里有高耸的石灰岩山峰、青翠的梯田和众多泰族村落。

  • 抵达后入住Pu Luong Resort的小木屋。这是一座山顶上的世外桃源，四周梯田、棕榈树和香蕉树环绕，景色令人叹为观止。

中午：享用午餐，之后自由探索这座环境静谧的美丽度假村。

下午：导游带您在度假村周边徒步（5公里/3小时）。您将与当地人交流互动，穿过稻田，深入了解当地文化。

晚上：自由活动。享用晚餐，尽享度假村的舒适。

夜宿普隆

餐食：（含早、午、晚餐）

itinerary.title: 普隆 – 徒步与骑行
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐后，导游带您徒步（4公里）并骑行（40分钟），游览度假村对面最美的梯田山谷。

  • 抵达度假村对面的美丽山谷，您将绕着梯田漫步，或穿行于草木覆盖的蜿蜒小径，欣赏隐藏在山脚下如诗如画的Uoi村落，用镜头记录美景。
  • 拜访一户当地人家，稍作休息后骑车环游村庄。如时间允许，还将拜访一户当地家庭，了解他们的传统织锦工艺。
  • 继续骑行穿过稻田，前往另一个村庄探索周边风光。返回当地人家，司机在此等候并送您返回度假村。

下午：自由活动，随心探索。在度假村享用午餐和晚餐。

夜宿普隆

餐食：（含早、午、晚餐）

itinerary.title: 普隆 – 宁平
itinerary.html:
上午：从普隆前往宁平，距普隆仅3小时车程，四周环绕着秀美的石灰岩山脉。

  • 抵达后开始游览长安生态旅游区（联合国教科文组织世界遗产），这里风景优美，有神秘的溶洞、高耸的山峰和静谧的溪流。您将乘船探索长安的洞穴和石拱网络，包括Sang洞、Toi洞、Ba Giot洞和Sinh洞。

下午：午餐后，继续游览始建于11世纪的古都华闾古都，壮观的景色营造出神秘的氛围，定会让您兴奋不已。

  • 抵达后，在仅存的丁先皇祠和黎大行皇祠中沉浸于历史。两座祠庙于17世纪重修，据信建在11至12世纪旧宫殿的原址之上。
  • 骑自行车悠闲穿行于高耸的石灰岩山间，沿着窄路欣赏沿途美景。抵达舞洞山，短途攀登即可到达绝佳观景点，俯瞰山下穿过巍峨群山的五洞河，景色令人叹为观止。
  • 入住精品度假村Tam Coc Garden。该度假村被稻田和壮观的石灰岩地貌环绕，是远离城市喧嚣的宁静绿洲。

夜宿宁平

餐食：（含早、午餐）

itinerary.title: 宁平 – 南定
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐后从宁平出发，驱车3小时前往南定省春水国家公园。公园位于河内西南150公里处的红河三角洲沿海地区。途中参观始建于10世纪的古利古寺。

  • 参观渭溪村，这是越南最大的盆景村之一。您将看到形态各异的盆景，如凤凰、龙、马、麒麟……或文庙的标志造型。
  • 参观春水国家公园，其前身为地区自然保护区，后成为越南首个拉姆萨尔湿地保护地。春水国家公园是联合国教科文组织认定的红河生物圈保护区的一部分，这片生物多样性丰富的沿海湿地栖息着约220种鸟类、110种水生植物和500种其他水生物种。
  • 中午前后抵达国家公园附近的春交社，乘船探索湿地。乘船游览国家公园约一小时后抵达“蛤蜊屋”，在这里享用美味的海鲜午餐。在蛤蜊屋稍作休息后乘车返回陆地。

下午：短暂休息后，开始游览交春社及周边村庄。沿着乡间小路漫步，感受当地人的生活，驻足观看农民用传统耕作方式在稻田里劳作。您还将参观古宅、天主教堂和农业博物馆。如遇晴天，可参观盐田，观看当地人晒盐，还可以亲自体验当一回盐农！

  • 参观观鸟站（适用于11月至次年3月的冬季），观赏许多从东亚飞往澳大利亚的候鸟，如黑脸琵鹭、琵鹭、小青脚鹬、黑嘴鸥和亚洲黄嘴鹬等……

晚上：前往春交社的一户当地人家，享用主人家准备的晚餐并在其家中留宿。住宿期间提供干净舒适的床品。

夜宿南定春交

餐食：（含早、午、晚餐）

itinerary.title: 南定 – 乘日间火车前往顺化
itinerary.html:
上午：骑自行车（或乘车）悠闲环游村庄，观赏海上美丽的日出，然后参观当地鱼市。在这里，您可以看到渔民带回一夜的渔获，周边村庄数百人涌向这个批发市场，购买当天最好的海产。

  • 返回当地民宿。途中拜访一户制作鱼露的当地家庭，了解这种美味蘸料的传统制作方法。
  • 早餐并退房后，送您前往南定火车站乘坐日间火车前往顺化。车程约11小时，您将乘坐舒适的空调四人软卧包厢，沿途欣赏美丽风光，尤其是穿越越南昔日的非军事区（DMZ）。

晚上：抵达顺化，导游和司机在出站口接您，送往市中心的酒店入住。

夜宿顺化

餐食：（含早餐）

itinerary.title: 顺化 – 全天市区游
itinerary.html:
上午：乘坐人力三轮车穿过“皇城”前往静心湖，开启新的一天。随后游览顺化皇城（您此行的第五处联合国教科文组织世界遗产），参观宫殿、官员殿堂以及紫禁城遗址。

  • 前往郊外参观启定皇陵，这座陵墓采用传统越南风格设计。
  • 参观收养约50名孤儿的优昙孤儿院，了解孩子们的日常生活以及照顾他们的努力。与孩子们聊天，了解他们的学校生活和梦想，教他们基础英语或一起做游戏。为孩子们准备一顿素食午餐，并与他们共进午餐。

下午：午餐后参观越南唯一的古代斗兽场“虎圈”，这里曾专门用于象虎相斗，多数时候是为皇室和百姓娱乐而举办。

  • 乘坐龙船沿香江而下，途中参观顺化最著名的宗教圣地天姥寺。游览寺内的园林、七层八角塔，观看僧人诵经。
  • 最后前往Truc Chi Garden，这是一家由才华横溢的青年艺术家创办的竹纸手工艺工坊。您将有机会与学员见面，亲手学习用竹浆雕刻技法创作艺术品。尝试制作属于您自己的竹纸画，带回家作纪念。

夜宿顺化

餐食：（含早、午餐）

itinerary.title: 顺化 – 乘日间火车前往会安 – 徒步及美食之旅
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐后，车辆到酒店接您前往顺化火车站，乘坐越南铁路线日间火车（空调软座）前往岘港，车程约三小时。

  • 抵达岘港后，导游接您前往联合国教科文组织遗产小镇会安的酒店。会安在5公里（3英里）外有两处海滩，拥有众多美丽的海滨度假村，如您希望入住海边，请告知我们。

下午：导游带您前往会安古镇，步行参观关公庙、进记古宅、福建会馆和日本廊桥。

  • 参观遗产博物馆，馆内收藏着Réhahn珍贵的遗产系列，欣赏少数民族的肖像作品。
  • 参观Reaching Out Tea House，这是熙熙攘攘的老城区中一片宁静的小绿洲，由聋哑人士经营。在这里，您将品尝美味的糕点和上好的东方茶。
  • 拜访一位灯笼匠人的家，观摩匠人制作灯笼的技艺，然后在热情匠人的指导下亲手完成每一道工序：从弯制骨架、裁布、上胶到成品。行程结束前，您将拥有一盏亲手制作的灯笼。
  • 穿行于小街探索会安街头美食，品尝当地菜肴。每天下午4点，会安街头便摆满了数不清的小吃车、摊档和小贩，您将品尝当地人烹制的会安特色美食，认识汤锅背后的面孔，并学习当地人如何搭配那些香料盘！

夜宿会安

餐食：（含早、晚餐）

itinerary.title: 会安 – 全天渔耕体验
itinerary.html:
您将参加会安周边美丽乡村的渔耕之旅，近距离体验当地人的生活。

（注意：如您不会骑自行车，可使用我们的“XE OM”摩的服务，需支付少量额外费用）

  • 骑自行车穿过稻田游览会安，欣赏乡村风光，了解并体验当地人的生活。
  • 参观茶桂菜村，参与农耕。这座有机蔬菜和香草农场景色优美，为会安提供大量新鲜农产品。您将与村民一起学习传统的耕地、种菜和浇菜方法。
  • 从茶桂菜村出发，沿着棕榈树夹道的小路穿过稻田，在稻田中骑水牛，呼吸乡村最清新的空气。
  • 登上木船前往与咕哒海滩交汇的河口，捕鱼环节由此开始。首先学习划竹编簸箕船，沿水道划行，随后与当地渔民见面，他们将传授传统撒网捕鱼技巧，体验起来定会妙趣横生。
  • 最后在船上享用船员烹制的美味越南午餐，结束行程。
  • 返回酒店，自由休息。

夜宿会安

餐食：（含早、午餐）

itinerary.title: 会安 – 全天自由活动
itinerary.html:
您可自由探索会安，在当地市场和街头随心品尝美食（推荐尝尝高楼面和白玫瑰饺），体验24小时量身定制服装，或参加一堂亲手实践的烹饪课。

  • 美丽的安邦海滩距古镇仅5公里，您可以骑车前往游泳和放松。

夜宿会安

餐食：（含早餐）

itinerary.title: 会安/岘港 – 飞往胡志明市 – 古芝地道
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐后送往机场，乘短途航班飞往胡志明市（旧称西贡）。

  • 抵达后，导游和司机接您前往位于胡志明市西北部的古芝，这里有一套深入地下的地道网络，是一处历史遗址。
  • 抵达后先观看原始纪录片，然后步行游览保护区。地道内设有生活区、储藏室、简易医院和厨房……您将跟随导游参观地下地道。
  • 品尝越共士兵当年的主食，包括木薯和酸茶。之后送往胡志明市的酒店。

下午：自由活动，您可以在市中心漫步，或逛夜市品尝地道的当地美食。

夜宿胡志明市

餐食：（含早餐）

itinerary.title: 胡志明市 – 永林（湄公河三角洲）
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐并退房后，导游和司机带您踏上约三小时的永林之旅（湄公河三角洲），尽享湄公河三角洲体验。

  • 抵达后入住Co Co Riverside Lodge的小木屋。度假屋坐落于湄公河畔，四周椰林和稻田环绕，让您倍感放松。

下午：午餐后，沿着宁静的乡间小路骑行，穿过椰子园、青翠的稻田和小村庄。途中参观众多火龙果种植园之一，漫步园中。

  • 返回度假屋沐浴休息，随后与当地人一起手持用干椰叶制成的传统火把，步行前往邻居家，欣赏传统音乐表演。
  • 返回度假屋，与厨师一起参加趣味烹饪课，然后坐下来品尝大家一起做的菜肴。
  • 晚间自由活动。

夜宿永林Co Co Riverside Lodge

餐食：（含早、午、晚餐）

itinerary.title: 永林 – 胡志明市
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐后参观当地学校和市场。随后乘船悠闲穿行于棕榈树夹岸的小运河，参观当地的椰子加工小作坊等手工业。椰子去壳后，椰棕从壳上剥离，搓成绳子，再用来编织席子。

  • 乘坐当地渡船参观高台教寺庙，深入了解这一引人入胜的本土宗教。
  • 返回度假屋。如时间允许，尝试用水椰叶编织。水椰叶是湄公河三角洲的主要建筑材料，用于搭建墙壁和屋顶。当地人将向您展示如何使用这些叶子，以及如何制作“poon”火把——最后一晚的音乐表演中它们将被点亮。

下午：退房后返回胡志明市，自由休息，感受胡志明市的夜景。

夜宿胡志明市

餐食：（含早、午餐）

itinerary.title: 胡志明市 – 离境
itinerary.html:
早餐后从酒店接您前往胡志明市国际机场，搭乘航班回国或继续您的旅程，我们将协助您规划。

  • 还不想回家？可以延长行程前往原始质朴的富国岛，在岛上众多美丽的海滩和度假村中享受悠闲时光，为您的越南之旅画上完美句号。

餐食：（含早餐）

included: 私人英文导游、住宿、私人行程及接送、国内航班、空调火车、部分正餐、所有景点门票、税费及服务费。

summary: Vietnam tour 16 days 15 nights that Vietlook Travel will accompany tourists to visit the beautiful view of Ho Chi Minh City, or visit and experience the life of peaceful villagers, immerse yourself in the clear blue water of Cat Ba beach... Especially enjoy the culinary flavors of…

itinerary.title: Arrival in Ho Chi Minh City
itinerary.html:
Hello! Welcome to Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.

  • Upon arrival, your tour guide and driver will be waiting to meet you and your family at the arrival lounge, holding up a welcome sign with your name on it and taking you straight to your hotel in the city center.
  • After checking in, you will be free to relax and enjoy the view of Saigon, your tour guide will introduce your and your family’s tour schedule, you will visit the Vietnamese culinary training facility, enjoy local food.

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City

Meals: (_/_/D)

itinerary.title: HCM City – Cu Chi Tunnels & City Sightseeing
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast, your guide will pick you up and take you to Cu Chi, located in the northwest of Ho Chi Minh City, famous for its deep tunnel network and memorable historical site.

  • Upon arrival, you will watch the original documentary footage, then walk through the reserve with its network of Viet Cong tunnels housing accommodation, storage rooms, temporary hospitals and kitchens…etc. Although initially very narrow, some sections have been opened to tourists and you will have the opportunity to explore some parts of the system.
  • Try some of the staple food of the Viet Cong soldiers, including cassava served with sour tea. Then, the vehicle will take you back to the city.

Afternoon: You will visit some of the main highlights of Ho Chi Minh City. We recommend visiting the Notre Dame Cathedral, the ornate City Hall (Hotel De Ville), the old Opera House, the historic Rex Hotel, the Central Post Office, famous for its architecture, and Ben Thanh Market, where vendors display a wide range of goods and handicrafts, appealing to all tastes.

  • Then, stop at the Reunification Palace and the War Remnants Museum to learn about Vietnam’s military history and turbulent past.
  • Visit the atmospheric Jade Emperor Pagoda before ending the day in style with a sunset cocktail atop the Bitexco Financial Tower, Vietnam’s tallest building.

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City

Meals: (B/_/_)

itinerary.title: HCM City – Ben Tre (Mekong Delta)
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast, your guide and driver will take you to Ben Tre Town in the Mekong Delta, famous for its vast rice fields, many waterways and beautiful landscapes.

  • After a two-hour drive you will arrive in Ben Tre, you will board a motorboat to go through the canals, coconut forests, you will stop and experience the life of the people here, and learn about their crafts that have been passed down through generations.
  • Take a relaxing stroll along the village roads, visit local houses to taste fresh fruits, enjoy delicious honey tea while enjoying a traditional musical performance, visit another workshop, where local coconut candy and many products from coconut shells and coconut fibers are handmade.
  • Take a boat trip through small canals shaded by palm trees, gently glide along the hidden waterways surrounded by tropical plants. The quiet countryside scenery is a place for relaxation.
  • Enjoy riding on the back of a rickshaw, passing through villages, rice paddies, coconut forests and lush fruit orchard farms while meeting the locals.

Afternoon: After the tour, your guide will take you to a riverside restaurant for lunch featuring local specialties, then return to the pier and drive back to Ho Chi Minh City.

  • In the evening, you will be free to explore the night market to discover authentic local cuisine or simply enjoy a cocktail at the rooftop bar of the historic Rex Hotel.

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City

Meals: (B/L/_)

itinerary.title: HCM City – Flight to Tuy Hoa – Whale Island
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast and check out, the driver will pick you up at the hotel and take you to the airport for a short flight to Tuy Hoa, a coastal city on the South Central Coast of Vietnam.

  • Arrive at Tuy Hoa airport, the driver will pick you up and take you to the tropical island resort Whale Island, located along the beautiful white sand beach of Van Phong Bay.
  • After a 1.5 hour drive, you will arrive at the Pier to board a 20-minute boat to Whale Island Resort on the Island for check-in. Whale Island Resort is an idyllic tropical paradise. The resort can accommodate all guests in private bungalows, double rooms, family rooms or connecting rooms, with sea views, each bungalow has a private bathroom, fan and bed equipped with mosquito nets.

Afternoon: You are free to relax, or swim in the sea.

Overnight at Whale Island

Meals: (B/_/_)

itinerary.title: Whale Island
itinerary.html:
Relax with your family, or go snorkeling, then explore the coral reef near Whale Island. The trip includes lunch and a visit to a local fishing village and Whale Temple.

Overnight at Whale Island

Meals: (B/_/_)

itinerary.title: Whale Island
itinerary.html:
Relax and unwind on the beach. If you want to get active, you can rent snorkeling gear, kayaks, canoes or catamarans from the beach hut. On request, one of the water sports staff can advise you on how to use the equipment or even take you around the island.

Overnight at Whale Island

Meals: (B/_/_)

itinerary.title: Whale Island – Tuy Hoa – Flight to Da Nang/ Hoi An
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast, you will be picked up and transferred back to Tuy Hoa Airport to catch a flight to Da Nang in central Vietnam.

Afternoon: Upon arrival at Da Nang Airport, you will be picked up by a tour guide and transferred to the hotel in Hoi An to check in and relax.

Overnight in Hoi An

Meals: (B/L/_)

itinerary.title: Hoi An – Walking & Food Tour
itinerary.html:
Morning: Enjoy a late breakfast and free time to explore the sights

Afternoon: Your tour guide will pick you up and take you to Hoi An Ancient Town, where you will walk to visit destinations such as Ong Pagoda, Tan Ky Ancient House, Phuc Kien Assembly Hall and Japanese Covered Bridge.

  • Visit the Precious Heritage Museum, where the Precious Heritage Collection of Réhahn is permanently displayed, and admire the rich collection of cultural paintings of ethnic groups
  • Visit the Reaching Out Teahouse, a small oasis of welcome peace in the bustling Old Town, owned and operated by deaf and mute people. Here, you will enjoy delicious cakes and oriental tea.
  • Visit the house of a lantern artisan, where you can observe the artisan’s lantern-making techniques before practicing each stage of making lanterns under the guidance of enthusiastic craftsmen: from bending the lantern into the frame, cutting and gluing the fabric, to completing the lantern. Before the end of the tour, you will have your own handmade lantern.
  • Explore Hoi An street food with your guide, you will enjoy dishes with local people at the stalls. At 4pm every day, Hoi An streets are filled with countless street food carts, stalls and street vendors. The street food tour is a great opportunity for you to enjoy some Hoi An specialties prepared by local people.

Overnight in Hoi An

Meals: (B/_/D)

itinerary.title: Hoi An – Biking to Local Villages
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast, your private guide will pick you up for a cycling tour around the peaceful Cam Kim Island. This car-free island is ideal for cycling.

(Note: if you do not know how to ride a bike, please use our “XE OM” scooter service for a small additional fee)

  • From the hotel, you will be given a short cycling test. The first part starts with a 13 km (8 miles) ride on small paved roads. Cycle through palm forests, bridges and buffalo fields. Ride along the country roads at a peaceful pace to enjoy the scenery and experience life with the local people.
  • When you arrive in Tra Nhieu, you will start to explore the village, rowing a boat around the village and stopping to see the locals making sleeping mats by hand. Then, a local family will welcome you, you will learn how to cook and enjoy lunch with the locals.

Afternoon: After lunch, you will visit a fishing village and join the fishermen in casting their nets to catch fish, shrimp and crabs. Then, continue cycling for another 3km (1.8 miles) to the other side of the island, visiting Kim Bong carpentry village, famous for its shipbuilding and traditional woodworking products. Along the riverbank, there are craftsmen living.

  • Wander around the many workshops, chat with the friendly craftsmen and simply admire the art of visiting some local houses to observe how people make rice wine, rice noodles and rice paper.

At the end of the tour, return to the hotel where you are free to relax for the rest of the day.

Overnight in Hoi An

Meals: (B/L/_)

itinerary.title: Hoi An – Day train to Hue
itinerary.html:
Today, you will have the opportunity to experience the most scenic railway route in Vietnam from Hue to Da Nang.

Morning: After breakfast, your guide will pick you up at your hotel and take you to Da Nang Railway Station to catch the daytime train (soft seat with air conditioning) to Hue. The 3-hour train will travel through the picturesque countryside, winding through the spectacular Hai Van Pass (Sea of ​​Clouds Pass) and then around the mountainside as you travel along the stunning coastline.

  • Arrive at Hue Railway Station and transfer to your hotel for check-in. Enjoy your stay.

Afternoon: Your guide will take you on a tour of the ancient Citadel to enjoy the fresh air built in the early 19th century, including the former Royal Palace and the Forbidden City. The original walls stretched for 10 km and were surrounded by a wide moat. The bombing during the Vietnam War destroyed most of the buildings, but the remaining relics still show the court life of the Nguyen Dynasty, the last feudal dynasty of Vietnam.

  • Leaving the Imperial City, you will visit the morning of Hue people, kite flying, a popular activity in Hue. Except for rainy days, you can see hundreds of kites flying in the sky of the Imperial City every afternoon.
  • The tour guide will take you to visit the traditional Hue kite village, you will meet Mr. Cu, a third-generation kite maker and director of the ‘Kite Flying Club’ in Hue, making and decorating kites. With his support, you will draw and assemble yourself to create a traditional kite – Dong Noi Kite. When finished, you can keep the kite as a souvenir.
  • Visit Dong Ba Market located along the north bank of the Perfume River. You will discover a Noddle shop that Anthony Bourdain – World famous chef and TV producer loved. Taste the best Bun Bo Hue “Sú Bun Hue”.

Return to the hotel in the evening, where you will spend the rest of the day relaxing.

Overnight in Hue

Meals: (B/_/_)

itinerary.title: Hue – Half-day City Tour – Flight to Hanoi
itinerary.html:
In the morning, you will continue to explore the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Hue.

  • Your guide and driver will take you to the pier to take a dragon boat on the Perfume River. During the boat trip, you will stop to visit Thien Mu Pagoda. Explore the pagoda’s landscaped gardens, seven-storey octagonal tower and watch monks chanting sutras.
  • You will travel to the outskirts to visit Minh Mang Tomb, a majestic complex of courtyards, communal houses and temples set in a stunning natural setting.
  • Visit Uu Dam Orphanage, which is home to 50 orphans of all ages. Learn more about their daily activities and efforts to care for the children. Chat with the children to understand their school life and their dreams, before teaching them basic English or joining them in some games. Prepare a vegetarian lunch for the children and eat lunch with them.

Afternoon: Visit the only ancient arena in Vietnam “Tigers Arena” which is dedicated to the battles between elephants and tigers. Most of the time, it is held to serve the fun of the royal family and local people.

  • Arrive at Hue Airport, take a short flight to Hanoi, upon arrival, the tour guide and driver will pick you up and take you to the hotel in the Old Quarter to check in. Spend the rest of the evening relaxing.

Overnight in Hanoi

Meals: (B/L/_)

itinerary.title: Hanoi Backstreet Tour – Local Touch, Local Food & Local Culture by Gaz69 Jeep
itinerary.html:
You will take a Jeep tour, enjoy the sights, sounds and flavors of Hanoi on an open-air wartime Jeep. This promises to be a unique experience.

  • After breakfast, the tour guide and driver will pick you up at the hotel lobby, you will hear an introduction to the Hanoi Jeep tour schedule, you will explore the REAL HANOI with a day of experiencing life, going through small streets, small alleys, local houses, schools, markets, experiencing the lives of local people.
  • You will pass by & stop at places such as Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum – The Holy Land of Vietnamese people, Tran Quoc Pagoda & 1000-year-old Toast Pagoda, Temple of Literature, historic Chinatown, charming French Quarter, bustling Old Quarter, West Lake, Hanoi Opera House & famous Long Bien Bridge…
  • You will come to peaceful & charming suburban villages around West Lake & Truc Bach Lake in the harmony of life between the city center and the suburbs.
  • You will stop at restaurants, eateries and food stalls to enjoy delicious Hanoi dishes including traditional dishes, local delicacies and specialties.
  • The tour will end at the hotel after noon. The rest of the day is free for you to explore this beautiful city as you wish. You can even visit the traditional water puppet show, folk tales performed by skillful puppeteers.

Overnight in Hanoi

Meals: (B/L/_)

itinerary.title: Hanoi – Hai Duong – Being a Farmer for a Day
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast, your guide will pick you up and take you by private car for a two-hour drive to the picturesque village of Ngoc Hoa in Hai Duong province.

  • Upon arrival, you will be warmly welcomed by your host family with a cup of tea, you will change into traditional Vietnamese farmer’s clothes, bring your working tools, including a shovel and rake, and walk with water buffalo to the rice fields. Here, you will learn how to perform some agricultural activities.
  • Return to the local family’s house to prepare lunch. You will pick fresh vegetables from the garden, prepare all the ingredients and cook lunch under the guidance of your host. You will be surprised at how well you did when you enjoy the food you prepared for lunch.

Afternoon: Take a leisurely bike ride along the village roads to see the village from up close and interact with the friendly villagers. You will see beautiful villages and warm-hearted locals. You will also visit the Ca Temple, an ancient temple that represents the history and spirit of Ngoc Hoa Village.

Note: if you do not like bicycles, we can replace them with motorbikes, you can sit in the back. The tour takes place in the village so there will be no traffic at all.

  • Return to the local people’s house. You will row a bamboo boat with the local people, Learn how to fish with nets with the fishermen, the spectacular river, with its banks lined with lychee trees, will give you great photo opportunities.
  • Saying goodbye to your host family, you will drive a short distance to Stork Island, in Thanh Mien Commune. The island is located in the middle of a large natural lake and is home to flocks of storks and herons and many different species of birds such as pelicans and teal ducks. Take a boat closer to the island to see the birds closer but do not walk.
  • At the end of the tour, you will return to Hanoi. End your tour at the hotel around 17:00. Spend the evening at your leisure. Pack for an overnight trip to Lan Ha Bay tomorrow.

Overnight in Hanoi

Meals: (B/L/_)

itinerary.title: Hanoi – Hai Phong – Lan Ha Bay
itinerary.html:
Morning: After breakfast, your guide and driver will pick you up from your hotel and take you to the port city of Hai Phong, where you board a Junk Boat for an evening of relaxation.

  • At around noon, you will board a boat, each of which will begin its journey around Lan Ha Bay. Located south and east of Cat Ba Island, Lan Ha Bay’s approximately 300 karst islands and limestone outcrops are beautiful.
  • After checking in, you will enjoy a delicious Vietnamese lunch and take in the stunning panoramic views. Relax on the deck or private balcony and soak up the peaceful atmosphere.

Afternoon: The Junk Boat will take you past Con Vit and Gia Luan islands, limestone formations (limestone formations) that rise from the bay.

  • In the late afternoon, you will arrive at the shore of a small lagoon on Cat Ba Island, cycling (electric cars are also available) along the small paved roads to Viet Hai village. Located in Cat Ba National Park and surrounded by forests and mountains. Here you will have the opportunity to meet the local residents, learn about the fruits and vegetables grown in the valley, try some homemade wine with the locals.
  • Return to the Junk boat to watch the chef’s cooking demonstration. Learn about local ingredients as well as how to prepare classic Vietnamese dishes.

Evening: you will arrive at a quiet anchorage for the night, you can soak up the memories of the day’s adventures with a cocktail under the stars.

  • After a sumptuous dinner, you can relax at the bar with a digestif, watch a movie in the cinema or have fun squid fishing before retiring to your room.

Overnight on board in Lan Ha Bay

Meals: (B/L/D)

itinerary.title: Lan Ha Bay – Hai Phong – Hanoi
itinerary.html:
Morning: Wake up early and join a Tai Chi session on the deck to relax and watch the sunrise, enjoy coffee, tea and breakfast pastries waiting for you in the dining room to start your day.

  • The Junk weighs anchor and heads towards Frog Lake, a secluded spot, where you can enjoy a refreshing “bay swim” or explore this charming seascape by kayak. The cliffs rise vertically out of the water and the small islands are covered with trees.
  • Return to the Junk to check out. Then, enjoy a full breakfast buffet as you sail back to the pier.

Afternoon: Return to Got Pier in Hai Phong City, your private driver is waiting for you and will take you back to Hanoi.

  • After checking into your hotel, spend the rest of the day at leisure. Stroll around the Old Quarter or visit Hoan Kiem Lake & Ngoc Son Temple, a short walk from the hotel. They are beautifully lit up at night.

Overnight in Hanoi

Meals: (B/_/_)

itinerary.title: Hanoi – Departure
itinerary.html:
Your private transfer greets you at the hotel after breakfast and escorts you to Hanoi International Airport where you board your flight home or travel on to more adventures, we will help you with the planning.

Meals: (B/_/_)

included: Private English-speaking guide, accommodation, private tours and transfer, domestic flights, A/C vehicles, some main meals, all entrance fees, tax, and service charge.
Your international flights from and to Vietnam, the entry visa to Vietnam, personal expense, tips to guide and driver.

itinerary.title: 抵达胡志明市
itinerary.html:
您好！欢迎来到越南胡志明市。

  • 抵达后，导游和司机将手持写有您姓名的接机牌，在到达大厅迎接您和家人，并直接送您前往市中心的酒店。
  • 办理入住后，您可自由休息、欣赏西贡风光。导游将向您和家人介绍行程安排，随后您将参观越南烹饪培训机构，品尝当地美食。

夜宿胡志明市

餐食：（含晚餐）

itinerary.title: 胡志明市 – 古芝地道及市区观光
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐后，导游接您前往位于胡志明市西北部的古芝，这里以纵深的地道网络和令人难忘的历史遗址而闻名。

  • 抵达后先观看原始纪录片，然后步行游览保护区。越共地道网络内设有住所、储藏室、临时医院和厨房等……地道原本十分狭窄，部分路段已扩建向游客开放，您将有机会探索其中的一些区域。
  • 品尝越共士兵当年的主食，包括木薯配酸茶。随后乘车返回市区。

下午：游览胡志明市的主要亮点。推荐参观西贡圣母大教堂、华丽的市政厅（Hotel De Ville）、老歌剧院、历史悠久的Rex Hotel、以建筑闻名的中央邮局，以及滨城市场——这里商贩云集，商品和手工艺品琳琅满目，可满足各种喜好。

  • 随后前往统一宫和战争遗迹博物馆，了解越南的军事历史和动荡过往。
  • 参观氛围独特的玉皇殿，最后在越南最高建筑Bitexco金融塔顶层品一杯日落鸡尾酒，为这一天画上完美句号。

夜宿胡志明市

餐食：（含早餐）

itinerary.title: 胡志明市 – 槟知（湄公河三角洲）
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐后，导游和司机带您前往湄公河三角洲的槟知镇，这里以广袤的稻田、纵横的水道和秀美的风光而闻名。

  • 驱车约两小时抵达槟知，乘坐摩托艇穿行于运河和椰林之间，沿途停留体验当地人的生活，了解他们世代相传的手工技艺。
  • 沿着乡间小路悠闲漫步，到当地人家中品尝新鲜水果，边欣赏传统音乐表演边享用美味的蜂蜜茶；再参观另一家作坊，这里手工制作当地椰子糖以及许多椰壳和椰棕制品。
  • 乘船穿过棕榈树荫下的小运河，在热带植物环绕的隐秘水道中缓缓滑行。宁静的乡村景色令人身心放松。
  • 乘坐人力车穿过村庄、稻田、椰林和茂盛的果园，与当地人见面交流。

下午：游览结束后，导游带您前往河畔餐厅享用当地特色午餐，随后返回码头，驱车返回胡志明市。

  • 晚上自由活动，您可以逛夜市寻觅地道的当地美食，或在历史悠久的Rex Hotel屋顶酒吧小酌一杯鸡尾酒。

夜宿胡志明市

餐食：（含早、午餐）

itinerary.title: 胡志明市 – 飞往绥和 – 鲸鱼岛
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐并退房后，司机到酒店接您前往机场，乘短途航班飞往越南中南部沿海城市绥和。

  • 抵达绥和机场后，司机接您前往位于云峰湾美丽白沙滩畔的热带海岛度假村——鲸鱼岛。
  • 驱车约1.5小时抵达码头，乘船20分钟前往岛上的Whale Island Resort办理入住。Whale Island Resort是一座田园诗般的热带天堂，可为所有宾客提供独立小木屋、双人房、家庭房或连通房，均享海景。每间小木屋配有独立卫浴、风扇及带蚊帐的床铺。

下午：自由休息或下海游泳。

夜宿鲸鱼岛

餐食：（含早餐）

itinerary.title: 鲸鱼岛
itinerary.html:
与家人一起放松身心，或去浮潜，探索鲸鱼岛附近的珊瑚礁。行程包含午餐，并参观当地渔村和鲸鱼庙。

夜宿鲸鱼岛

餐食：（含早餐）

itinerary.title: 鲸鱼岛
itinerary.html:
在海滩上放松休憩。如想活动一下，可在海滩小屋租用浮潜装备、皮划艇、独木舟或双体帆船。如有需要，水上运动工作人员可指导您使用装备，甚至带您环岛游览。

夜宿鲸鱼岛

餐食：（含早餐）

itinerary.title: 鲸鱼岛 – 绥和 – 飞往岘港/会安
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐后接您返回绥和机场，搭乘航班飞往越南中部的岘港。

下午：抵达岘港机场后，导游接机并送您前往会安的酒店办理入住、休息。

夜宿会安

餐食：（含早、午餐）

itinerary.title: 会安 – 徒步及美食之旅
itinerary.html:
上午：享用一顿悠闲的晚早餐，自由活动游览景点。

下午：导游接您前往会安古镇，步行参观关公庙、进记古宅、福建会馆和日本廊桥等景点。

  • 参观Precious Heritage博物馆，馆内永久展出Réhahn的“珍贵遗产”系列，欣赏丰富的民族文化肖像作品。
  • 参观Reaching Out Teahouse，这是熙熙攘攘的古镇中一片宁静的小绿洲，由聋哑人士经营。在这里，您将品尝美味的糕点和东方茶。
  • 拜访一位灯笼匠人的家，观摩匠人制作灯笼的技艺，然后在热情匠人的指导下亲手完成每一道工序：从弯制骨架、裁布上胶到完成灯笼。行程结束前，您将拥有一盏亲手制作的灯笼。
  • 跟随导游探索会安街头美食，与当地人一起在摊档品尝美食。每天下午4点，会安街头便摆满了数不清的小吃车、摊档和流动小贩。街头美食之旅是您品尝当地人烹制的会安特色美食的绝佳机会。

夜宿会安

餐食：（含早、晚餐）

itinerary.title: 会安 – 骑行探访当地村庄
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐后，私人导游接您骑行环游宁静的锦金岛。这座无汽车通行的小岛非常适合骑行。

（注意：如您不会骑自行车，可使用我们的“XE OM”摩的服务，需支付少量额外费用）

  • 从酒店出发前，将为您进行简短的骑行测试。第一段骑行约13公里（8英里），沿着铺装小路穿过棕榈林、小桥和水牛田。沿着乡间小路悠然骑行，欣赏风景，体验当地人的生活。
  • 抵达Tra Nhieu后开始探索村庄，划船环游村子，驻足观看村民手工编织草席。随后一户当地家庭将热情接待您，您将学习烹饪，并与当地人共进午餐。

下午：午餐后参观渔村，与渔民一起撒网捕鱼、虾和蟹。随后继续骑行3公里（1.8英里）到达岛的另一端，参观以造船和传统木工制品闻名的金蓬木雕村，河岸边居住着许多手艺人。

  • 漫步于众多作坊之间，与友善的手艺人聊天，欣赏他们的技艺；再走访几户当地人家，观看人们如何酿米酒、制作米粉和米纸。

行程结束后返回酒店，当天余下时间自由休息。

夜宿会安

餐食：（含早、午餐）

itinerary.title: 会安 – 乘日间火车前往顺化
itinerary.html:
今天，您将有机会体验越南风景最美的铁路线——岘港至顺化段。

上午：早餐后，导游到酒店接您前往岘港火车站，乘坐日间火车（空调软座）前往顺化。3小时的火车之旅将穿过如画的乡村，蜿蜒越过壮观的海云关（云海关），再沿山腰绕行，沿途饱览壮丽的海岸线。

  • 抵达顺化火车站后送往酒店办理入住，稍事休息。

下午：导游带您游览建于19世纪初的古老皇城，呼吸清新空气，参观昔日的皇宫和紫禁城。皇城原城墙绵延10公里，四周环绕着宽阔的护城河。越战期间的轰炸摧毁了大部分建筑，但现存遗迹依然展现了越南最后一个封建王朝——阮朝的宫廷生活。

  • 离开皇城后，您将感受顺化人的日常生活——放风筝，这是顺化一项很受欢迎的活动。除雨天外，每天下午都能看到数百只风筝在皇城上空飞舞。
  • 导游带您参观顺化传统风筝村，与第三代风筝匠人、顺化“风筝俱乐部”负责人Cu先生见面，观看他制作和装饰风筝。在他的帮助下，您将亲手绘制并组装一只传统风筝——Dong Noi风筝，完成后可留作纪念。
  • 参观位于香江北岸的东巴市场。您将找到世界著名厨师兼电视制作人Anthony Bourdain钟爱的一家米粉店，品尝最正宗的顺化牛肉粉。

傍晚返回酒店，当天余下时间自由休息。

夜宿顺化

餐食：（含早餐）

itinerary.title: 顺化 – 半日市区游 – 飞往河内
itinerary.html:
上午，继续探索联合国教科文组织世界遗产顺化。

  • 导游和司机送您前往码头，乘龙船游香江。途中停留参观天姥寺，游览寺内园林、七层八角塔，观看僧人诵经。
  • 前往郊外参观明命皇陵，这是一座由庭院、殿堂和祠庙组成的宏伟建筑群，坐落于绝美的自然环境中。
  • 参观收养50名不同年龄孤儿的优昙孤儿院，了解他们的日常生活以及照顾孩子们的努力。与孩子们聊天，了解他们的学校生活和梦想，教他们基础英语或一起做游戏。为孩子们准备一顿素食午餐，并与他们共进午餐。

下午：参观越南唯一的古代斗兽场“虎圈”，这里曾专门用于象虎相斗，多数时候是为皇室和当地百姓娱乐而举办。

  • 抵达顺化机场，乘短途航班飞往河内。抵达后，导游和司机接您前往老城区的酒店办理入住，晚上自由休息。

夜宿河内

餐食：（含早、午餐）

itinerary.title: 河内小巷之旅 – 乘Gaz69吉普车体验当地风情、美食与文化
itinerary.html:
您将乘坐敞篷战时吉普车游览河内，感受这座城市的景致、声音与风味。这必将是一次独一无二的体验。

  • 早餐后，导游和司机在酒店大堂接您，向您介绍河内吉普车之旅的行程安排。您将用一整天探索“真正的河内”，穿行于小街小巷，走访当地民居、学校和市场，体验当地人的生活。
  • 沿途经过并停留于胡志明陵——越南人民心中的圣地、镇国寺及千年历史的独柱寺、文庙、历史悠久的唐人街、迷人的法租界、热闹的老城区、西湖、河内大剧院以及著名的龙边桥……
  • 来到西湖和竹帛湖周边宁静迷人的城郊村落，感受市中心与郊区和谐交融的生活。
  • 沿途在餐厅、小吃店和美食摊停留，品尝美味的河内菜肴，包括传统菜、当地佳肴和特色美食。
  • 中午过后行程在酒店结束。当天余下时间您可随心探索这座美丽的城市，还可以观看传统水上木偶戏，欣赏技艺娴熟的木偶艺人演绎民间故事。

夜宿河内

餐食：（含早、午餐）

itinerary.title: 河内 – 海阳 – 当一天农民
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐后，导游乘专车接您，驱车约两小时前往海阳省风景如画的玉华村。

  • 抵达后，接待家庭将奉上一杯热茶热情欢迎您。换上越南传统农民服装，带上铁锹、耙子等农具，牵着水牛走向稻田，在这里学习一些农活。
  • 返回当地人家中准备午餐。您将在菜园采摘新鲜蔬菜，备好所有食材，在主人指导下烹制午餐。品尝自己做的午餐时，您一定会惊讶于自己的好手艺。

下午：沿着村路悠闲骑行，近距离感受村庄，与友善的村民互动。您将看到美丽的村落和热情的当地人，还将参观代表玉华村历史与精神的古庙——Ca庙。

注意：如您不喜欢骑自行车，可改乘摩托车，坐在后座即可。行程在村内进行，完全没有车流。

  • 返回当地人家中，与村民一起划竹船，跟渔民学习撒网捕鱼。河岸两旁种满荔枝树，壮美的河景将为您带来绝佳的拍照机会。
  • 告别接待家庭后，驱车不远即可到达青沔社的鹳鸟岛。小岛位于一个大型天然湖泊中央，是成群鹳鸟、鹭鸟以及鹈鹕、绿翅鸭等多种鸟类的栖息地。乘船靠近小岛近距离观鸟，但不登岛步行。
  • 行程结束后返回河内，约17:00在酒店结束行程。晚上自由活动，并为明天的兰夏湾过夜之旅收拾行李。

夜宿河内

餐食：（含早、午餐）

itinerary.title: 河内 – 海防 – 兰夏湾
itinerary.html:
上午：早餐后，导游和司机到酒店接您前往港口城市海防，登上帆船，开启一段悠闲的海上之夜。

  • 中午前后登船，各船开始环游兰夏湾。兰夏湾位于吉婆岛南部和东部，约300座喀斯特岛屿和石灰岩礁石美不胜收。
  • 办理入住后，享用美味的越南午餐，饱览壮丽的全景风光。在甲板或私人阳台上放松，沉浸于宁静的氛围之中。

下午：帆船将载您驶过从海湾中拔地而起的Con Vit岛和Gia Luan岛等石灰岩地貌。

  • 傍晚抵达吉婆岛一处小潟湖的岸边，沿铺装小路骑行（也可乘电瓶车）前往越海村。村庄位于吉婆国家公园内，四周森林和群山环绕。在这里，您将有机会与当地居民见面，了解山谷中种植的水果和蔬菜，与村民一起品尝自酿酒。
  • 返回帆船观看厨师的烹饪示范，了解当地食材以及经典越南菜的做法。

晚上：抵达宁静的停泊点过夜，在星空下手持一杯鸡尾酒，回味一天的探险。

  • 丰盛的晚餐后，您可以在酒吧小酌一杯餐后酒，在影院看场电影，或在回房休息前体验钓鱿鱼的乐趣。

夜宿兰夏湾游船

餐食：（含早、午、晚餐）

itinerary.title: 兰夏湾 – 海防 – 河内
itinerary.html:
上午：早起在甲板上参加太极晨练，放松身心、观赏日出。餐厅为您备好咖啡、茶和早餐点心，开启美好的一天。

  • 帆船起锚驶向僻静的青蛙湖，您可以在海湾中畅游一番，或乘皮划艇探索这片迷人的海景。悬崖从水中垂直耸立，小岛上林木葱郁。
  • 返回帆船退房，随后在返航码头途中享用丰盛的自助早午餐。

下午：返回海防市的Got码头，私人司机在此等候并送您返回河内。

  • 入住酒店后，当天余下时间自由活动。您可以漫步老城区，或步行不远前往还剑湖和玉山祠，夜晚灯光璀璨，格外美丽。

夜宿河内

餐食：（含早餐）

itinerary.title: 河内 – 离境
itinerary.html:
早餐后，专车在酒店迎接您，送往河内国际机场，搭乘航班回国或继续前往下一段旅程，我们将协助您规划。

餐食：（含早餐）

included: 私人英文导游、住宿、私人行程及接送、国内航班、空调车辆、部分正餐、所有景点门票、税费及服务费。
往返越南的国际航班、越南入境签证、个人消费、导游和司机小费。

summary: Vietnam tour 16 days 15 nights takes tourists to explore Vietnam's heritage, following the S-shaped route, tourists visit the capital Hanoi, visit Uncle Ho's mausoleum and enjoy dishes in the Old Quarter, go to Ha Long to experience a 5-star cruise on the sea through famous caves, go to Da Nang, Hue Quang Binh to immerse yourself in the clear blue water, participate in games or mysterious…
