title.en: Hoang Su Phi Ripe Rice Season Tour 3 Days 2 Nights
title.zh: 黄树皮稻熟季3天2夜之旅

summary: Coming to Hoang Su Phi, visitors can visit Phung village where there are golden terraced fields, or immerse themselves in the sea of ​​clouds of Suoi Thau grassland, visit the highland market where visitors can buy brocade products as gifts or freely check in at Hoang A Tuong…
route: Ha Noi – Bac Quang – Phung Village– Hoang Su Phi
Phung Village – Coc Pai – Suoi Thau Steppe
Chợ Phiên Bắc Hà – Dinh Hoàng a Tưởng – Hà Nội

itinerary.title: Ha Noi – Bac Quang – Phung Village– Hoang Su Phi ( Meal, Lunch, Dinner)
itinerary.html:
05:30: The tour guide and driver pick up you at Hanoi Opera House and depart for Hoang Su Phi – Ha Giang province. On the way you will stop to rest and have breakfast ( the breakfast is independent).

11:30: Arrive in Bac Quang district Ha Giang province. Lunch will be served at a local restaurant with many specialties prepared by local people.

  • After lunch, you continue your journey to Phung village – Hoang Su Phi, where there are around 120 hectares of terraced fields stretching across the hills, slopes and valleys. This commune is considered to have the most beautiful terraced fields compared to neighboring communes. Although the terraced fields are randomly shaped, they blend harmoniously together, creating a beautiful scene. You will visit and take pictures of Phung village’s terraced fields with soft curves that captivate photographers and roofs scattered among layers of fields mixed with many colors, creating a peaceful, serene picture.

18:00: You check in the homestay at Phung village, have dinner at the restaurant with specialties of the Northeast region, after dinner you can walk around the village .

Stay overnight at homestay in Phung village.

itinerary.title: Phung Village – Coc Pai – Suoi Thau Steppe ( Meal: Lunch, Dinner)
itinerary.html:
Morning: You get up early to watch the sunrise and walk around the road surrounded by terraced fields, taking the most beautiful photos for yourself. Then have breakfast and check out the room.

08:00: You depart for Thau stream steppe – “Europe steppe” in the heart of Ha Giang. Thau stream grassland has an area of more than 90 hectares, located at an altitude of 1200 meters above sea level, the air is fresh and cool all year round. This place is blessed by nature with wild, majestic and fresh beauty like a small corner of Europe. That’s why this steppe is considered the most beautiful steppe in Ha Giang.

12:00: You have lunch in Coc Pai town.

13:00: Driver and tour guide continue the journey to take the group to depart Bac Ha.You check in the hotel and restor you can walk around Bac Ha town.

  • Have dinner at the hotel restaurant, enjoy specialties of Bac Ha. You can walk around to experience the town at night or may be try some things for fun. Such as: karaoke services, medicinal baths, coffee…

Overnight in Bac Ha

itinerary.title: Chợ Phiên Bắc Hà – Dinh Hoàng a Tưởng – Hà Nội ( Ăn Sáng Trưa)
itinerary.html:
Morning: You have breakfast. Then you will depart to visit the famous market of Bac Ha, this is the largest highland market in Lao Cai province, many traders from near and far and ethnic groups gather here to exchange products and trade, but Bac Ha is more famous for its pristine, ethnic look. The market has been newly built on a concrete foundation, no longer on a gentle hill, but trade still retains many traditional features.

08:30: You depart to visit Hoang A Tuong Palace, which has existed for nearly 100 years. The moss-covered house still stands out majestically in the middle of the town.

11:30: You check out the hotel. have lunch at the restaurant. Then get on the bus to go back Hanoi along the Lao Cai – Hanoi highway.

18:30: Arrive in Hanoi and end the trip Hanoi – Ban Phung – Hoang Su Phi – Thau stream steppe – Bac Ha 3 days 2 nights.

rows: Community Homestay in Phung village & hotel in Bac Ha
Private room in Phung village & hotel nin Bac Ha

zh.summary: 来到黄树皮，游客可以探访拥有金色梯田的Phung村，或沉浸于Suoi Thau草原的云海之中，逛高原集市选购织锦产品作为礼物，或在黄阿祥府尽情打卡…
route: 河内 – 北光 – Phung村 – 黄树皮
Phung村 – Coc Pai – Suoi Thau草原
北河集市 – 黄阿祥府 – 河内

itinerary.title: 河内 – 北光 – Phung村 – 黄树皮（含午、晚餐）
itinerary.html:
05:30: 导游和司机在河内大剧院接您，出发前往河江省黄树皮。途中停车休息并享用早餐（早餐自理）。

11:30: 抵达河江省北光县，在当地餐厅享用午餐，品尝当地人烹制的多种特色美食。

  • 午餐后，继续前往黄树皮Phung村，这里约有120公顷梯田绵延于山丘、坡地和山谷之间。与周边乡镇相比，这里被认为拥有最美的梯田。梯田形状虽不规则，却和谐交融，构成一幅美丽的画卷。您将参观并拍摄Phung村的梯田，其柔美的曲线令摄影师着迷，民居屋顶点缀在层层叠叠、色彩斑斓的梯田之间，勾勒出一幅宁静祥和的画面。

18:00：入住Phung村民宿，在餐厅享用东北地区特色晚餐，晚餐后可在村中漫步。

夜宿Phung村民宿。

itinerary.title: Phung村 – Coc Pai – Suoi Thau草原（含午、晚餐）
itinerary.html:
早晨：早起观赏日出，漫步于梯田环绕的小路上，为自己拍下最美的照片。随后享用早餐并退房。

08:00：出发前往Suoi Thau草原——位于河江腹地的“欧洲草原”。Suoi Thau草原面积超过90公顷，海拔1200米，全年空气清新凉爽。这里得天独厚，拥有原始、壮丽而清新的美景，宛如欧洲的一隅，因此被誉为河江最美的草原。

12:00：在Coc Pai镇享用午餐。

13:00：司机和导游继续带领团队前往北河。入住酒店休息，或在北河镇四处漫步。

  • 在酒店餐厅享用晚餐，品尝北河特色美食。您可以四处走走，感受小镇夜色，或尝试一些娱乐活动，如卡拉OK、药浴、咖啡……

夜宿北河

itinerary.title: 北河集市 – 黄阿祥府 – 河内（含早、午餐）
itinerary.html:
早晨：享用早餐。随后出发参观著名的北河集市，这是老街省最大的高原集市，远近商贩和各民族同胞聚集于此交换和买卖商品，而北河集市更以其原汁原味的民族风貌而闻名。集市已在混凝土地基上新建，不再位于缓坡之上，但交易仍保留了许多传统特色。

08:30：出发参观已有近100年历史的黄阿祥府，这座布满青苔的建筑依然巍然屹立于小镇中央。

11:30：退房，在餐厅享用午餐。随后乘车沿老街 – 河内高速公路返回河内。

18:30：抵达河内，结束河内 – Phung村 – 黄树皮 – Suoi Thau草原 – 北河3天2夜之旅。

rows: Phung村社区民宿 & 北河酒店
Phung村独立房间 & 北河酒店

title.en: Cao Bang – Bac Can 3 Days 2 Nights Tour
title.zh: 高平 – 北件3天2夜之旅

summary: Cao Bang 3 days 2 nights tour will take visitors to admire the beauty of the majestic Ban Gioc waterfall, or the clear Lenin stream, and experience rafting to see the beautiful scenery of Ba Be lake surrounded by high mountains, visit the villages hidden on the mountainside, a peaceful…
route: Hanoi - Cao Bang - Pac Bo
Cao Bang - Ban Gioc Waterfall - Tiger Cave - Ba Be
Babe Lake - Thai Nguyen - Hanoi

itinerary.title: Hanoi - Cao Bang - Pac Bo ( - / L / D )
itinerary.html:
07:00: The car will pick you up at your hotel in Hanoi Old Quarter and depart for Cao Bang.

12h00: You will have lunch at the restaurant. After lunch, the car will take you to Cao Bang. You will stop to take pictures of Gio Pass, Khau Khang Pass, Cao Bac Pass and Tai Ho Sin Pass.

15h30: Arrive at Pac Bo historical site (50km from Cao Bang). You will visit the place where President Ho Chi Minh lived and led the Vietnamese revolution from 1941 to 1945. You will visit and take photos at Lenin Stream, Karl Marx Mountain and visit Coc Bo Cave.

18.30: Upon arrival in Cao Bang, check in to the hotel, rest and then have dinner. After dinner, you are free to explore. Overnight at a hotel in Cao Bang city.

itinerary.title: Cao Bang - Ban Gioc Waterfall - Tiger Cave - Ba Be (B/l/d )
itinerary.html:
06.30: You check out of the hotel, have breakfast and the car takes you to Chongqing. Have the opportunity to admire the wild and majestic beauty of Ma Phuc Pass.

09.00: Visit Tiger Cave, one of the largest caves.

10.00: Visit Ban Gioc Waterfall, located at an altitude of 53m, the waterfall is divided into 3 levels, one of the beautiful waterfalls and also the fourth largest waterfall in the top 10 majestic waterfalls located between 2 countries in the world.

12h00: Have lunch. After lunch, visit Phuc Sen Knife Village, which is famous for making knife tradition.

Continuing to Ba Be, you will admire the wild and majestic beauty of Tai Ho Sin Pass, Cao Bac Pass, Khau Khang Pass and especially Gio Pass.

18.00: Arriving at Pac Ngoi village, checking in hotel and relaxing. Enjoy a cup of coffee (self-paid) at the end of the afternoon.

19.00: Have dinner. After dinner, tourists can participate in some activities, such as: performing art activity, campfire activity or listening to Then music (self-paid).

itinerary.title: Babe Lake - Thai Nguyen - Hanoi ( B / L )
itinerary.html:
07h00: You have breakfast at the hotel or stilt house. Then pack your luggage, get on the car, walk along the small road along the lake leading to Pac Ngoi boat station. Sitting on the boat, you can admire the lake view, then the boat will stop at the following points:

  • Visit Fairy Pond located in the third corner of Ba Be Lake, located between a high mountain above the lake. It is said that in the past, fairies used to play chess here.
  • An Mạ Temple: According to legend, in the Le-Mac war, Mac generals lost the fight. They ran to Puong Cave and ended their lives there to protect their loyalty and pride. To eulogize Mac generals’ spirit, people built a temple to worship the Mac family. Worried that Le soldiers would destroy this temple, they changed its name to An Ma. The word “An Ma” means “peaceful and beautiful grave” in Tay people’s language.
  • Widow Island – a small island located in the middle of the lake, associated with the lake’s formation. You can take a boat ride around the island slowly so you can take pictures and enjoy the scenery.

12h00: You will have lunch at the restaurant, after lunch the car will take you back to Hanoi.

18.30- 19:00: Arrive Hanoi. Tour ends. See you again!

Price: 185 USD dollar/ person.

zh.summary: 高平3天2夜之旅将带您欣赏雄伟壮丽的板约瀑布、清澈的列宁溪，体验泛舟游览群山环抱的三海湖美景，探访隐匿于山腰的村落，一片宁静…
route: 河内 – 高平 – 北坡
高平 – 板约瀑布 – 虎洞 – 三海湖
三海湖 – 太原 – 河内

itinerary.title: 河内 – 高平 – 北坡（含午、晚餐）
itinerary.html:
07:00：专车前往您位于河内老城区的酒店接您，出发前往高平。

12h00：在餐厅享用午餐。午餐后，乘车前往高平，途中停车拍摄Gio山口、Khau Khang山口、Cao Bac山口及Tai Ho Sin山口。

15h30：抵达北坡历史遗址（距高平50公里）。参观胡志明主席于1941年至1945年间居住并领导越南革命的地方。您将参观并拍摄列宁溪、马克思山，并游览Coc Bo洞。

18.30：抵达高平后入住酒店，稍事休息后享用晚餐。晚餐后自由活动。夜宿高平市酒店。

itinerary.title: 高平 – 板约瀑布 – 虎洞 – 三海湖（含早、午、晚餐）
itinerary.html:
06.30：退房，享用早餐后乘车前往重庆县，沿途欣赏马伏山口原始而壮丽的美景。

09.00：参观虎洞，这是当地最大的洞穴之一。

10.00：游览板约瀑布，瀑布位于海拔53米处，分为3层，是一座美丽的瀑布，也是世界十大壮观跨国瀑布中规模排名第四的瀑布。

12h00：享用午餐。午餐后参观以传统制刀工艺闻名的Phuc Sen制刀村。

继续前往三海湖，沿途欣赏Tai Ho Sin山口、Cao Bac山口、Khau Khang山口，尤其是Gio山口原始而壮丽的美景。

18.00：抵达Pac Ngoi村，入住酒店休息。傍晚可享用一杯咖啡（费用自理）。

19.00：享用晚餐。晚餐后，游客可参加一些活动，如文艺表演、篝火晚会或聆听岱依族天曲（Then）音乐（费用自理）。

itinerary.title: 三海湖 – 太原 – 河内（含早、午餐）
itinerary.html:
07h00: 在酒店或高脚屋享用早餐。随后收拾行李上车，沿湖边小路前往Pac Ngoi码头。乘船欣赏湖景，游船将停靠以下景点：

  • 参观位于三海湖第三湖区、坐落于湖畔高山之间的仙女池。相传古时仙女常在此下棋。
  • 安马庙：相传在黎莫之战中，莫朝将领战败，逃至Puong洞并在此自尽，以守护忠诚与尊严。为颂扬莫朝将领的精神，人们修建了一座祭祀莫氏家族的庙宇。因担心黎朝士兵毁坏此庙，人们将其改名为“安马”。在岱依族语言中，“安马”意为“安宁美丽的坟墓”。
  • 寡妇岛——位于湖中央的一座小岛，与湖泊的形成传说相关。您可以乘船慢慢绕岛一周，拍照并欣赏风景。

12h00：在餐厅享用午餐，午餐后乘车返回河内。

18.30- 19:00: 抵达河内，行程结束。期待与您再次相见！

价格：185 美元/人。

title.en: Ha Giang tour Buckwheat Flower Season 3 Days 2 Nights
title.zh: 河江荞麦花季3天2夜之旅

summary: Coming to Ha Giang in buckwheat flower season, visitors will be immersed in the beauty of blooming flowers, conquer winding mountain passes filled with flowers or visit villages, experience the culture of ethnic minorities in the Northwest mountains and immerse themselves in the melodious sounds of trumpets and flutes calling you on the…
route: Ha Noi - Ha Giang - Quan Ba - Yen Minh
YEN MINH - LUNG CU- MA PI LENG - ĐONG VAN
ĐONG VAN – PAO HOUSE - HA GIANG - HA NAI

itinerary.title: Ha Noi - Ha Giang - Quan Ba - Yen Minh (Meal Lunch, Dinner)
itinerary.html:
05:30: The tour guide and driver pick you up at Hanoi Opera House depart to the Ha Giang province. on the way the car will stop for you to rest and have breakfast at the stop over (your own expense).

10:30: You get off to visit Vi Xuyen Cemetery to commemorate the heroes who sacrificed for the independence and freedom of the country.

11:30: Arriving in Ha Giang city, the group took souvenir photos at Milestone 0 Ha Giang, the connecting point of National Highway 2 with National Highway 34 and National Highway 4C on the road named happiness.

12:00: Lunch at a restaurant in the center of Ha Giang city with Northwest specialties.

1:30 p.m.: car to take you sightseeing

15:00: Stop at Quan Ba ​​Heaven Gate, also known as Fairy Twin Mountains Quan Ba ​​Twin Mountains to take photos and enjoy the panoramic view of Tam Son town.

17:00: Arrive in Yen Minh town, you check in hotel.

19:00: You will have dinner at a local restaurant. Then you are free to explore the town at night or enjoy street food such as: Pho Trang Kim, thang co, men men, corn wine are dishes you should try once when coming to Ha Giang…

Overnight in Yen Minh Town.

itinerary.title: YEN MINH - LUNG CU- MA PI LENG - ĐONG VAN (Breakfast, lunch, dinner)
itinerary.html:
06:00: You will have breakfast, then depart to admire the beauty of Dong Van Karst Plateau Global Geopark, and visit famous attractions.

  • Tham Ma Pass: the winding road surrounded by cat-ear cliffs looks like a silk sheet lying gracefully between majestic mountains.
  • Palace of Vuong Chinh Duc ( he was a King of
  • Meo ethnic group): located in a valley of Sa Phin commune, This family was the richest and most powerful in Dong Van Area in the early twentieth century.
  • Lo Lo Chai Village: inhabited by the Mong and Lo Lo ethnic groups throughout the decades.

11:30: Lunch at a local restaurant. After lunch, you are free to relax. Then go sightseeing in the afternoon.

  • On the way to Lung Cu, you will stop to take pictures of the beautiful buckwheat flower garden.
  • Visit Lung Cu National Flag pillar: – the starting point of the Fatherland, the point with the highest latitude on the map of Vietnam.
  • On the way to Meo Vac district, you stop at the top of Ma Pi Leng pass. From here, you can see the whole view of nature on the road of happiness. Take pictures, and enjoy coffee while watching the scenery (mountains, valleys, flowers, a river surrounding the mountain with clear blue water. All blend together to create a beautiful natural picture.
  • Cruise on Nho Que River to see the beauty of Tu San Alley, the deepest alley in Vietnam, located on Nho Que River.
  • Taking photoes in Pa Vi village of H’Mong ethnic group.
  • The cultural beauty of the ancients is still preserved, from architecture, houses, costumes, with traditional houses, roofed with yin-yang tiles and images of Mong girls in splendid traditional brocade costumes.
  • (Depend on time permit the tour guide will arrange to go to this destination if it is possible)

17:00: Return to Dong Van town, check in the hotel and rest.

19:00: Dinner at the restaurant, then free to explore Dong Van ancient town, or enjoy coffee while admiring the Old Town (at your own expense).

Overnight in Dong Van Town.

itinerary.title: ĐONG VAN – PAO HOUSE - HA GIANG - HA NAI (Breakfast, lunch, dinner)
itinerary.html:
You can enjoy the scenery here early, and visit Dong Van market which takes place every Sunday morning.

07:00: Have breakfast, check out and get on the bus to visit:

  • Lung Cam Cultural and Tourism Village: visit the ancient house of the H’mong people with earthen walls – the place that was used to make the movie “Pao’s Story” .Which won 4 Golden Kite awards. (Rent ethnic clothes here – at your own expense).
  • Check in the buckwheat flower garden at Pao’s house, right at the gate of Lung Sung La valley with children carrying colorful flower baskets. You can chat and take pictures with the highland children.

12:00: You have lunch in Ha Giang city. After lunch, continue to get on the bus to go back to Hanoi.

19:30: Arrive in Hanoi, end of the trip.

rows: In Yen Minh: Phương Đông Hotel 3 sao In Đong Vann: Hoàng Ngọc Hotel 2 sao
In Yen Minh: Thanh Hưng Hotel, Thao Nguyen Hotel 2 sao In Đong Van: Lam Gia Hotel, Hai Yen Hotel

zh.summary: 荞麦花季来到河江，游客将沉浸在繁花盛开的美景中，征服开满鲜花的蜿蜒山口，或探访村寨，体验西北山区少数民族文化，沉醉于悠扬的号角与笛声中，召唤您踏上…
route: 河内 – 河江 – 管坝 – 安明
安明 – 龙骨旗台 – 马皮冷山口 – 同文
同文 – 阿宝之家 – 河江 – 河内

itinerary.title: 河内 – 河江 – 管坝 – 安明（含午、晚餐）
itinerary.html:
05:30：导游和司机在河内大剧院接您，出发前往河江省。途中停车休息并在服务区享用早餐（费用自理）。

10:30: 下车参观渭川烈士陵园，缅怀为国家独立与自由而牺牲的英雄。

11:30: 抵达河江市，团队在河江0公里里程碑前合影留念，这里是2号国道与34号国道、4C号国道（即“幸福之路”）的交汇点。

12:00: 在河江市中心的餐厅享用午餐，品尝西北特色美食。

1:30 p.m.：乘车前往观光

15:00：停留管坝天门，又称管坝仙女双峰山，拍照并俯瞰三山镇全景。

17:00：抵达安明镇，入住酒店。

19:00: 在当地餐厅享用晚餐。之后您可自由探索小镇夜景或品尝街头小吃，如Trang Kim河粉、马肉汤锅（thang co）、玉米蒸糕（men men）、玉米酒，都是来河江时值得一试的美食……

夜宿安明镇。

itinerary.title: 安明 – 龙骨旗台 – 马皮冷山口 – 同文（含早、午、晚餐）
itinerary.html:
06:00：享用早餐后出发，欣赏同文喀斯特高原世界地质公园之美，并游览著名景点。

  • Tham Ma山口：蜿蜒的山路被猫耳状的石崖环绕，宛如一条丝带优雅地横卧在雄伟的群山之间。
  • 王正德府（他曾是
  • 苗族之王）：坐落于Sa Phin乡的山谷中，这个家族在二十世纪初是同文地区最富有、最有权势的家族。
  • Lo Lo Chai村：数十年来一直是赫蒙族和倮倮族的聚居地。

11:30: 在当地餐厅享用午餐。午餐后自由休息，下午继续观光。

  • 在前往龙骨旗台的途中，停车拍摄美丽的荞麦花园。
  • 参观龙骨旗台：——祖国的起点，越南地图上纬度最高的地方。
  • 在前往苗旺县的途中，您将在马皮冷山口顶停留。从这里可以饱览幸福之路沿途的自然全景。拍照留念，一边品咖啡一边欣赏美景（群山、山谷、鲜花，以及一条清澈碧绿、环绕群山的河流，共同交织成一幅美丽的自然画卷）。
  • 泛舟侬桂河，欣赏位于侬桂河上、越南最深的峡谷——Tu San峡谷之美。
  • 在赫蒙族Pa Vi村拍照留念。
  • 这里仍完好保留着先民的文化之美，从建筑、房屋到服饰：传统民居覆盖着阴阳瓦，赫蒙族姑娘身着华丽的传统织锦服饰。
  • （视时间而定，导游将在条件允许时安排前往此景点）

17:00: 返回同文镇，入住酒店休息。

19:00: 在餐厅享用晚餐，之后自由探索同文古街，或一边品咖啡一边欣赏古镇（费用自理）。

夜宿同文镇。

itinerary.title: 同文 – 阿宝之家 – 河江 – 河内（含早、午、晚餐）
itinerary.html:
您可以早起欣赏这里的景色，并逛一逛每周日早晨开市的同文集市。

07:00: 享用早餐，退房后乘车参观：

  • Lung Cam文化旅游村：参观赫蒙族夯土墙古屋——电影《阿宝的故事》的拍摄地，该片曾荣获4项金风筝奖。（可在此租借民族服装——费用自理）。
  • 在阿宝之家的荞麦花园打卡，这里就在Lung Sung La山谷入口处，还有背着五彩花篮的孩子们。您可以与高原的孩子们聊天合影。

12:00：在河江市享用午餐。午餐后乘车返回河内。

19:30: 抵达河内，行程结束。

rows: 安明：Phương Đông Hotel 3星 同文：Hoàng Ngọc Hotel 2星
安明：Thanh Hưng Hotel、Thao Nguyen Hotel 2星 同文：Lam Gia Hotel、Hai Yen Hotel

title.en: Halong Ambassador Cruise 5 Stars 2 Days 1 Night
title.zh: 下龙湾Ambassador五星游船2天1夜

summary: Experience on the 5-star Halong Ambassador cruise will bring visitors the most comfortable vacation, with luxurious amenities, attentive service, and enjoy delicious dishes with Asian and European…
route: Hanoi - Hanoi - Halong Cruise
Surprise Cave - Halong Bay

itinerary.title: Hanoi - Hanoi - Halong Cruise
itinerary.html:
08:00 – 8-30: You will be picked-up at your hotels in Hanoi Old Quarter are or in Ha Noi opera house. Depart to to Ha Long city. The bus will travels on high way and go through red river delta.

10:00- 12:00: Check in at Ambassador’s Lounge .

12:00 – 12:30 You get on the tender to transfer to mother cruise.check in the cabin. Then you enjoy a delicious lunch buffet while the cruise go throuht the majestic scenery of Ha Long Bay – a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

14:30: Your first excursion is a visit to Luon Cave – one of the most unique caves in Halong Bay featuring the self-contained lake inside a closed arch-shaped mountain, where you can go Kayaking or sit on a bamboo boat rowed by a local peaple .

16:00: Visit Titov Island – a splendid destination encompassing a crescent moon-shaped beach, where you can immerse yourself in the turquoise water or climb up the top of the Island to see panorama view of the bay.

15:45: For guests who are not participating in any excursions, we will serve home-made cakes at the Piano Lounge. Guests can also stay onboard and choose an afternoon between of pampering at Atelier de Beauté Spa* or immersing yourself in the outdoor Jacuzzi pool.

17:30: At sundown, Ambassador Cruise will anchor overnight.
This is the great time for you to experience cooking class, live music or Happy Hour and Canapes at the Piano Lounge or on the Sundeck (depends on weather conditions)

19:00: Dinner wil be served with Chef’s special menu at the restaurant

21:00 (except Monday) you have some activities such as: squid fishing, a spa treatment at Atelier de Beauté Spa*, or movies at your cabin, you also can order a drink to enjoy and looking Ha Long bay at night.

itinerary.title: Surprise Cave - Halong Bay
itinerary.html:
6:30 -7:00: Start your day early with a Taichi session on the sundeck or at the Piano Lounge (depends on weather conditions). And then enjoy a light breakfast with coffee, tea, and freshly baked pastries at the Piano Lounge.

7:30 – 8:20: Explore Sung Sot Cave – the largest and most beautiful cave in Ha Long bay featuring marvelous and mysterious thousand-year-old stalactites in a variety of unique forms.

8:30: Full breakfast is served at the restaurant of the cruise.

9:30: Bill settlement and check-out at the reception at the first deck.

10:30: Disembark at the Halong International Cruise Port.

11:00 – 11:30: Disembark for your return drives to Ha Noi. 3:00 PM arrive in ha noi. End of the trip.

zh.summary: 体验五星级Halong Ambassador游船，将为您带来最舒适的假期：奢华的设施、贴心的服务，并可品尝亚洲与欧洲…的美味佳肴…
route: 河内 – 下龙湾游船
惊讶洞 – 下龙湾

itinerary.title: 河内 – 下龙湾游船
itinerary.html:
08:00 – 8-30: 在您位于河内老城区或河内大剧院附近的酒店接您，出发前往下龙市。巴士沿高速公路行驶，途经红河三角洲。

10:00- 12:00: 在Ambassador’s Lounge办理登船手续。

12:00 – 12:30 乘接驳船前往游船主船，入住客舱。随后享用美味的自助午餐，游船同时穿行于联合国教科文组织世界遗产——下龙湾的壮丽景色之中。

14:30：第一站游览Luon洞——下龙湾最独特的洞穴之一，一座封闭的拱形山体内环抱着一片独立的湖泊，您可以在此划皮划艇，或乘坐当地人划的竹筏。

16:00: 游览天堂岛(Titop岛)——一处拥有新月形沙滩的绝美胜地，您可以畅游碧蓝海水，或登上岛顶俯瞰海湾全景。

15:45: 未参加任何岸上游览的游客，可在Piano Lounge享用自制蛋糕。游客也可留在船上，选择在Atelier de Beauté Spa*享受悠闲的下午时光，或沉浸于户外按摩泳池中。

17:30: 日落时分，Ambassador游船停泊过夜。
这是体验烹饪课、欣赏现场音乐，或在Piano Lounge或阳光甲板享受欢乐时光与小食的绝佳时刻（视天气情况而定）

19:00: 在餐厅享用主厨特别菜单晚餐

21:00（周一除外）您可以参加夜钓鱿鱼、在Atelier de Beauté Spa*享受水疗，或在客舱观看电影，也可以点一杯饮品，欣赏下龙湾夜景。

itinerary.title: 惊讶洞 – 下龙湾
itinerary.html:
6:30 -7:00: 清晨在阳光甲板或Piano Lounge参加太极课程，开启新的一天（视天气情况而定）。随后在Piano Lounge享用咖啡、茶和新鲜出炉糕点的简易早餐。

7:30 – 8:20: 探索惊讶洞——下龙湾最大、最美的洞穴，洞内千年钟乳石形态各异，奇妙而神秘。

8:30: 在游船餐厅享用丰盛早餐。

9:30：在一层甲板前台结账并退房。

10:30: 在下龙国际游船码头下船。

11:00 – 11:30：下船后乘车返回河内。 3:00 PM 抵达河内，行程结束。

title.en: Halong Paradise Cruise 2 Days 1 Night
title.zh: 下龙湾Paradise游船2天1夜

summary: Experience a 5-star registered cruise, with luxury services, visitors can join overnight cruises and day cruises with perfect amenities, on the cruise there are restaurant and hotel services, visitors can organize events right on the…
route: Cruise Hanoi - Halong
Sung Sot Cave - Thien Cung Cave, Dau Go Cave, Fighting Cock Islet - Ha Long Bay - Tuan Chau Marina.

itinerary.title: Cruise Hanoi - Halong
itinerary.html:
8:00 – 8:30: Pick-up guests at your hotels in Hanoi Old Quarter or in Ha Noi opera house. Traveling on expressway and go through rich farm land of red river delta shortly arrive at Tuan Chau Marina.

12:00 Arrival in Tuan Chau Island and check-in at Paradise Suites Hotel.

12:15 Transfer to Paradise Elegance cruise by Electric cart.

12:30 You will be given a short briefing about your cruise itinerary and safety regulations while sipping your welcome drink aboard the Paradise Elegance.

13:00 – 14:30 Time to enjoy your lunch at Le Marin Restaurant while Paradise Elegance passes by beautiful islets of Halong Bay.

14:30 – 15:30 Visit Titov Island – the island is named after the Russian cosmonaut Gherman Stepanovich Titov. You can either choose to hike the mountain to get an overview of Halong Bay or swim at the beach on the island.

16:00 – 17:00 Visit Luon Cave – a fascinating natural wonder located in the heart of Halong Bay. You will have the chance to travel undеr thе limеstоnе mоuntаin and admire at the amazing rock formations and crystal-clear waters via bamboo boat or kayak*.

17:15 – 19:00 At sunset, Paradise Elegance will anchor overnight. It is the perfect time to enjoy Happy Hour (buy 1 get 1 free from 17:30 to 18:30) and a cooking class on the notable Vietnamese dish while being serenaded by a live music performance by Philippines band** at L’Odyssée Sundeck or Piano Lounge.

19:00 – 22:00 Savor your Western set dinner, which is prepared by our talented chef, at Le Marin restaurant.

20:30 – 23:00 After dinner, indulge in drinks* and a spectacular live band** at Piano Lounge, join the squid fishing at the back of the boat or enjoy fantastic movies in your cabin.

itinerary.title: Sung Sot Cave - Thien Cung Cave, Dau Go Cave, Fighting Cock Islet - Ha Long Bay - Tuan Chau Marina.
itinerary.html:
06:30 Boost the energy for the new day with a Tai Chi session at L’Odyssée Sundeck.

07:00 Enjoy a light breakfast with some freshly baked pastries, coffee, and tea at Le Marin Restaurant.

07:45 – 08:45 Visit Sung Sot cave – The most beautiful and largest cave in Halong Bay. Let your imagination run wide with stalactites and stalagmites at various shapes and sizes. At the end of the way out, you can have an amazing panoramic view from the viewpoint.

08:50 Breakfast will be served at Le Marin Restaurant while the cruise passes by Thien Cung and Dau Go Cave and the Fighting Cock Islet.

09:40 – 10:15 After breakfast, you may settle your bills and return the room keys at the reception area. Then you may enjoy your remaining moments at Piano Lounge or on the sundeck looking at the astonishing view of Halong Bay.

10:15 – 10:30 Paradise Elegance returns to Tuan Chau Marina. You will disembark and finish your journey here.

11:00-11:30 Disembark for your return drives to Ha Noi. 3:00 PM arrive in ha noi. End of the trip

zh.summary: 体验注册五星级游船的奢华服务，游客可参加设施完善的过夜游船与日间游船行程，船上设有餐厅和酒店服务，游客还可直接在…上举办活动…
route: 河内 – 下龙湾游船
惊讶洞 – 天宫洞、木头洞、斗鸡石 – 下龙湾 – 巡州岛码头。

itinerary.title: 河内 – 下龙湾游船
itinerary.html:
8:00 – 8:30：在您位于河内老城区或河内大剧院附近的酒店接客。沿高速公路行驶，途经红河三角洲富饶的农田，很快抵达巡州岛码头。

12:00 抵达巡州岛，在Paradise Suites Hotel办理登记手续。

12:15 乘电瓶车前往Paradise Elegance游船。

12:30 在Paradise Elegance船上品尝迎宾饮品，同时聆听游船行程及安全须知简介。

13:00 – 14:30 在Le Marin餐厅享用午餐，Paradise Elegance同时驶过下龙湾秀美的岛屿。

14:30 – 15:30 游览天堂岛(Titop岛)——该岛以俄罗斯宇航员格尔曼·斯捷潘诺维奇·季托夫的名字命名。您可以选择登山俯瞰下龙湾全景，或在岛上沙滩游泳。

16:00 – 17:00 游览Luon洞——位于下龙湾中心的奇妙自然景观。您将有机会乘坐竹筏或皮划艇*穿行于石灰岩山体之下，欣赏令人惊叹的岩石景观和清澈见底的海水。

17:15 – 19:00 日落时分，Paradise Elegance停泊过夜。这是享受欢乐时光（17:30至18:30买一送一）和参加越南特色菜烹饪课的绝佳时机，同时可在L’Odyssée阳光甲板或Piano Lounge欣赏菲律宾乐队**的现场演出。

19:00 – 22:00 在Le Marin餐厅品尝由我们才华横溢的主厨精心烹制的西式套餐晚餐。

20:30 – 23:00 晚餐后，可在Piano Lounge畅享饮品*并欣赏精彩的现场乐队**演出，也可在船尾参加夜钓鱿鱼，或在客舱观看精彩电影。

itinerary.title: 惊讶洞 – 天宫洞、木头洞、斗鸡石 – 下龙湾 – 巡州岛码头。
itinerary.html:
06:30 在L’Odyssée阳光甲板参加太极课程，为新的一天注入活力。

07:00 在Le Marin餐厅享用简易早餐，包括新鲜出炉的糕点、咖啡和茶。

07:45 – 08:45 游览惊讶洞——下龙湾最美、最大的洞穴。形态大小各异的钟乳石和石笋将激发您无限的想象。在出口处，您还可以从观景点饱览令人惊叹的全景。

08:50 在Le Marin餐厅享用早餐，游船同时驶过天宫洞、木头洞和斗鸡石。

09:40 – 10:15 早餐后，您可在前台结账并归还房卡。随后可在Piano Lounge或阳光甲板上度过余下的时光，欣赏下龙湾的绝美风光。

10:15 – 10:30 Paradise Elegance返回巡州岛码头。您将在此下船，结束旅程。

11:00-11:30 下船后乘车返回河内。下午3:00抵达河内，行程结束

title.en: Halong Sea Stars Cruise 2 Days 1 Night
title.zh: 下龙湾Sea Stars游船2天1夜

summary: Experiencing the Sea Stars cruise, visitors will enjoy the poetic scenery of a place likened to a resort paradise. Let's experience it with Vietlook on this 5-star Ha Long…
route: Sung Sot Cave - Titop Island
Tung Sau Pearl Farm

itinerary.title: Sung Sot Cave - Titop Island
itinerary.html:
8:00 – 8:30: Driver pick-up guests at your hotels in Hanoi Old Quarter or in Ha Noi opera house. Traveling on highway and go through rich farm land of red river delta shortly arrive at Tuan Chau Marina.

11:30 – 12.00: arrive at Sea Stars Lounge (2nd floor – Ha Long international cruise port) for check-in. get on the cruise
Enjoy a welcome drink while listening about the special itinerary crossing both Bai Tu Long Bay & Ha Long Bay, along with safety regulations.

12.45 – 14:00: Enjoy a savory buffet lunch at the restaurant on the 2nd floor while the cruise passing unique landscapes and thousands of limestone islands such as Am Tich islet, Mat Quy islet… Relax and admire the masterpiece scenery of the World Natural Heritage.

14:30 – 15:30: The first destination to discover is Surprise Cave. This is the most beautiful and largest cave in Ha Long Bay with a system of stalactites and stalagmites formed over thousands of years, transforming countless rich and fancy shapes.

15:45 – 16:45: Continue to visit Titop Island. Here, you can freely swim in the sea, enjoy the cool water of the ocean and the white sand beach or climb up the top of the mountain to see panorama of the bay.

17:00 – 18:00: The cruise moves to parking area to set anchor at Lom Bo. Enjoy the Sunset Hour with a drink offer, along with complimentary snacks, in the luxurious ambiance of the sundeck and behold the beautiful sunset descending over the magnificent bay. You can also join the cooking class at 17:30 with our expert guidance about
Vietnamese traditional food

19:00 – 20:30: Indulge in a sumptuous dinner at the restaurant .

20:30 – 22:30: After the dinner, guests have free time amidst the peaceful ocean scene with some activities. Such as:squid fishing, spa services (with surcharge) to relax after a full day of exploration, Experience karaoke with family and friends (please contact the management to make reservations in advance, with surcharge). Guests also can order a drink and sit on the sundeck to enjoy and look ha long bay at night as a city on the sea.

itinerary.title: Tung Sau Pearl Farm
itinerary.html:
06:15 – 06:45: Start new day with Tai Chi exercises on the sundeck or do morning exercise high-quality gym equipment on the 1st .

07:00 – 07:45: Buffet breakfast is served at the restaurant.

08:00 – 09:00: Visit the Pearl Farm in Tung Sau. Here you can visit the pearl display room, learn about pearl farming, care, and harvesting activities. Guests can also participate in complimentary kayak experiences.

09:00 – 09:30: Return to the cruise, check out and settle bills at the reception desk.

10:00 – 11:00: Enjoy brunch at the restaurant on the 2nd floor while the Cruise returning back to the Ha Long international cruise port.

11:00 – 11:15: Disembark the cruise, end of services.

11:00-11:30: Disembark for your return drives to Ha Noi. End the trip.

Note: Itinerary is subject to change due to weather conditions or tides without prior notice. Wi-Fi is available throughout the cruise areas; however, internet connection may be intermittent in some areas within the bay.

zh.summary: 乘坐Sea Stars游船，游客将尽享堪比度假天堂的诗意风光。与Vietlook一起体验这趟五星级下龙湾…
route: 惊讶洞 – 天堂岛(Titop岛)
Tung Sau珍珠养殖场

itinerary.title: 惊讶洞 – 天堂岛(Titop岛)
itinerary.html:
8:00 – 8:30: 司机在您位于河内老城区或河内大剧院附近的酒店接客。沿高速公路行驶，途经红河三角洲富饶的农田，很快抵达巡州岛码头。

11:30 – 12.00：抵达Sea Stars Lounge（下龙国际游船码头2楼）办理登船手续，登上游船
品尝迎宾饮品，同时聆听横跨拜子龙湾与下龙湾的特色行程介绍及安全须知。

12.45 – 14:00：在2楼餐厅享用美味的自助午餐，游船同时驶过独特的景观和成千上万座石灰岩岛屿，如Am Tich岛、Mat Quy岛……放松身心，欣赏世界自然遗产的绝美画卷。

14:30 – 15:30: 第一个探索目的地是惊讶洞。这是下龙湾最美、最大的洞穴，洞内钟乳石和石笋历经数千年形成，造型千姿百态、丰富奇幻。

15:45 – 16:45: 继续游览天堂岛(Titop岛)。在这里，您可以自由畅游大海，享受清凉的海水和白色沙滩，或登上山顶俯瞰海湾全景。

17:00 – 18:00：游船驶往Lom Bo停泊区抛锚。在奢华的阳光甲板上享受日落时光，享用饮品优惠及免费小食，欣赏夕阳缓缓落入壮丽海湾的美景。您还可在17:30参加烹饪课，由专业人员指导制作
越南传统美食

19:00 – 20:30：在餐厅享用丰盛晚餐。

20:30 – 22:30: 晚餐后，游客可在宁静的海景中自由活动，参加一些活动，如：夜钓鱿鱼、水疗服务（需额外付费），在一整天的探索后放松身心；与家人朋友一起唱卡拉OK（请提前联系管理人员预订，需额外付费）。游客也可点一杯饮品，坐在阳光甲板上欣赏夜色中宛如海上城市的下龙湾。

itinerary.title: Tung Sau珍珠养殖场
itinerary.html:
06:15 – 06:45：在阳光甲板上练习太极开启新的一天，或在1楼使用高品质健身器材进行晨练。

07:00 – 07:45: 在餐厅享用自助早餐。

08:00 – 09:00: 参观Tung Sau珍珠养殖场。在这里，您可以参观珍珠展示厅，了解珍珠的养殖、养护和采收过程。游客还可免费体验皮划艇。

09:00 – 09:30: 返回游船，在前台办理退房并结账。

10:00 – 11:00: 在2楼餐厅享用早午餐，游船同时返回下龙国际游船码头。

11:00 – 11:15: 下船，服务结束。

11:00-11:30: 下船后乘车返回河内，行程结束。

注意：行程可能因天气或潮汐情况而变更，恕不另行通知。游船各区域均提供Wi-Fi，但在海湾部分区域网络连接可能不稳定。

title.en: Essence Grand Cruise Halong 6 Stars 2 Days 1 Night
title.zh: 下龙湾Essence Grand六星游船2天1夜

summary: Ha Long 2 days 1 night cruise tour, visitors will experience the most interesting things, with luxurious design inspired by Europe, explore the beauty of the sea and islands and enjoy Asian and European cuisine with delicious and irresistible…
route: Hanoi – Halong Bay – Cua Van Fishing Village
Halong Bay – Sung Sot Cave – Hanoi

itinerary.title: Hanoi – Halong Bay – Cua Van Fishing Village (L,d)
itinerary.html:
08:15 – 08:45 Pick up.

  • Guests at your hotels in Hanoi Old Quarter or in Ha Noi opera house. Traveling on expressway and go through rich farm land of red river delta shortly arrive at Tuan Chau Marina.

09:50 Comfort Stop.

  • A short break on route for refreshments (about 20 minutes)

11:30 – 11:45 Tuan Chau International Cruise Port

  • You will be present at Tuan Chau International Port, where Essence Grand Cruise staff will welcome and assist with check-in procedures.

12:00 – 12:15 Embark – Cruise briefing – Check-in Essence Grand Cruise

  • Once on board our Essence Grand Cruise, enjoy a welcome drink in restaurant during the cruise briefing. Check-in to your luxury spacious suite

13:00 Lunch – Restaurant

  • Lunch will be served in the restaurant as the Essence Grand Cruise travels through the countless islands and islets of Halong Bay.

15:15 – 16:30 Exploring the vibrant culture of fishermen in the enchanting Cua Van fishing village on Ha Long Bay. Choose between an exhilarating kayaking adventure or bamboo boating experience to immerse yourself in the local way of life.

14:30- 17:30 For clients who do not engage in experiential activities

  • On the Cruise, you can choose to relax, enjoy leisure and massage services, swimming pool facilities, a bar, cigar and wine lounge, billard and a kid’s club area designed for children.

17:30 Sunset & Happy Hour time

  • Halong Bay has been rated as one of the most beautiful sunset spots in Asia. You can enjoy the best moments of the day at our sky bar as the sun hits the water between the dramatic limestone peaks and emerald-green coves, enjoying cocktails and a cooking demonstration

19:00 Dinner at Restaurant

  • Tantalize your taste buds with a selection of Western and Vietnamese cuisine. After dinner, chill out in your suite; pamper yourself at spa; try some squid fishing; or spend time with your fellow companions at our poker club, cigar and wine lounge, karaoke club, sky bar or the pool bar

Overnight at Essence Grand Cruise.

***some activities may incur an additional charge – see the exclusions

itinerary.title: Halong Bay – Sung Sot Cave – Hanoi (B,l)
itinerary.html:
05:30 – 06:00 Amazing sunrise time

  • Observe the dawn over Halong Bay

06:00 Tai Chi on Sundeck

  • Start the day on our Essence Grand Cruise with a Tai Chi session on the sundeck or a work-out in the gym; or you may just want to sleep in.

06:30 Light Breakfast

  • A light breakfast will be served in restaurant

07:30 – 08:30 Excursion to Sung Sot Cave

  • Our speed boat will transport you to Sung Sot Cave – the biggest and most stunning cave in Halong Bay. Discovering the magnificent majesty of stalactites formed over thousands of years by visiting Sung Sot Cave, the largest and most attractive cave in Ha Long Bay.

09:00 Room check-out

  • You complete check-out procedures and pay your bill at the front desk. Then, admire the natural beauty of Ha Long Bay before the cruise returns to port.

09:30 Brunch at restaurant

  • Cruise back through the bay to Ha Long harbor over a delicious morning brunch

10:45 Farewell & Disembark

  • Goodbyes and transfer back to the harbor

11:00 Arrive at the harbor & return to Hanoi

  • Once back on land, our staff will meet you and arrange your transportation back to Hanoi

11:00-11:30 Disembark for your return drives to Ha Noi. 3:00 PM arrive in Ha Noi. End of the trip.

zh.summary: 下龙湾2天1夜游船之旅，游客将体验最精彩的旅程：游船设计奢华，灵感源自欧洲，探索海洋与岛屿之美，品尝美味诱人的亚洲与欧洲美食…
route: 河内 – 下龙湾 – Cua Van渔村
下龙湾 – 惊讶洞 – 河内

itinerary.title: 河内 – 下龙湾 – Cua Van渔村（含午、晚餐）
itinerary.html:
08:15 – 08:45 接客。

  • 在您位于河内老城区或河内大剧院附近的酒店接客。沿高速公路行驶，途经红河三角洲富饶的农田，很快抵达巡州岛码头。

09:50 途中休息。

  • 途中短暂休息，享用茶点（约20分钟）

11:30 – 11:45 巡州岛国际游船码头

  • 抵达巡州岛国际码头，Essence Grand Cruise工作人员将热情迎接并协助您办理登船手续。

12:00 – 12:15 登船 – 游船简介 – 入住Essence Grand Cruise

  • 登上Essence Grand Cruise后，在餐厅品尝迎宾饮品，同时聆听游船简介。入住宽敞奢华的套房

13:00 午餐 – 餐厅

  • Essence Grand Cruise穿行于下龙湾星罗棋布的岛屿之间时，您将在餐厅享用午餐。

15:15 – 16:30 在迷人的下龙湾Cua Van渔村探索渔民的多彩文化。您可选择刺激的皮划艇探险或乘坐竹筏，沉浸于当地的生活方式之中。

14:30- 17:30 不参加体验活动的游客

  • 可留在船上放松休闲，享受按摩服务、游泳池设施、酒吧、雪茄红酒廊、台球以及专为儿童设计的儿童俱乐部。

17:30 日落与欢乐时光

  • 下龙湾被评为亚洲最美的日落观赏地之一。当夕阳洒落在壮观的石灰岩山峰与翡翠绿色的海湾之间时，您可在我们的空中酒吧享受一天中最美好的时刻，品尝鸡尾酒并观看烹饪示范

19:00 餐厅晚餐

  • 精选西式与越南美食，满足您的味蕾。晚餐后，您可在套房中放松休息、在水疗中心犒劳自己、尝试夜钓鱿鱼，或与同伴一起在扑克俱乐部、雪茄红酒廊、卡拉OK俱乐部、空中酒吧或泳池酒吧共度美好时光

夜宿Essence Grand Cruise。

***部分活动可能需额外付费——请参阅不含项目

itinerary.title: 下龙湾 – 惊讶洞 – 河内（含早、午餐）
itinerary.html:
05:30 – 06:00 绝美日出时光

  • 观赏下龙湾的黎明

06:00 阳光甲板太极

  • 在Essence Grand Cruise上以阳光甲板的太极课程或健身房锻炼开启新的一天；您也可以选择睡个懒觉。

06:30 简易早餐

  • 在餐厅享用简易早餐

07:30 – 08:30 游览惊讶洞

  • 快艇将送您前往惊讶洞——下龙湾最大、最令人惊叹的洞穴。在这座下龙湾规模最大、最具魅力的洞穴中，探索历经数千年形成的钟乳石的壮丽风采。

09:00 退房

  • 在前台办理退房手续并结账。随后在游船返港前欣赏下龙湾的自然美景。

09:30 餐厅早午餐

  • 一边享用美味的早午餐，一边乘船穿越海湾返回下龙港

10:45 告别与下船

  • 互道再见，接驳返回码头

11:00 抵达码头并返回河内

  • 上岸后，我们的工作人员将迎接您并安排返回河内的交通

11:00-11:30 下船后乘车返回河内。 下午3:00抵达河内，行程结束。

title.en: Aspire 5 Star Cruise Ha Long – Lan Ha 2 Days 1 Night
title.zh: Aspira五星游轮 下龙湾 – 兰夏湾 2天1晚

summary: Ha Long Cruise 2 days 1 night, visitors will experience on the luxurious 5-star ASPIRA CRUISES boat with a perfect combination of modern and traditional design, bringing you a comfortable journey and taking you to explore natural wonders with many interesting activities such as: kayaking, swimming, relaxing,…
route: Ha Noi – Halong - Lan Ha Bay
Lan Ha Bay – Ha Noi

itinerary.title: Ha Noi – Halong - Lan Ha Bay (L/D)
itinerary.html:
8:00 – 8:30: Pick up guests in Hanoi Old Quarter, or Ha Noi opera house then transfer to Ha Long city.

11:45: Upon arrival at waiting room, Tuan Chau international tourist port, check-in process.

12:15: Guest board the tender to transfer to the Aspira Cruise.

12:30 – 12:45: You check into your cabin, listen to instructions and safety instructions and the Ha Long tour itinerary, relax and enjoy drinks on board.

13.00 – 13.30: Lunch will be served at the lavish restaurant,while the cruise navigates Lan Ha Bay.

14:30 – 15:30: You can explore the Bright and Dark Caves or participate in sea activities such as kayaking or rowing bamboo boats or bamboo boats with the islanders, which will bring you a sense of excitement.

16:30 – 17:30: Back on board the Aspira, you will have the option of taking part in water activities by swimming near the yacht or indulging in a relaxing hot tub right on board.

17:30 – 18:30: You are free to admire the scenery of Lan Ha Bay, or relax at the bar, massage…

18:15: You can join a cooking class with a professional chef in the ship’s dining room, and enjoy the dishes you have just learned.

19:15: You enjoy Vietnamese cuisine.

20:45: The boat docks at the pier, you are free to admire the scenery from the yacht, or experience relaxing services, or enjoy tea ceremony right on the 3rd floor of the yacht.

Overnight on board

itinerary.title: Lan Ha Bay – Ha Noi (B/L)
itinerary.html:
6:30: You can watch the sunrise or take a Tai Chi class from the deck or exercise right on the boat, taking in the view right across the bay.

7:00 – 7:30: Light breakfast is served in the restaurant.

7:30 – 8:30: You can join kayaking to see the poetic sea and island scenery.

9:30: Go back to the cruise and complete check-out process.

9:30 – 9:45: You have lunch on the boat, then check out.

10:45: Guests move to the tender boat and return to the port.

11:30: Arrived in Tuần Châu international tourist port.

11:40 – 12:00 You get on the bus to go back .

15:00: Arrive in to Hanoi. End of the trip.

zh.summary: 下龙湾游轮2天1晚之旅，您将登上豪华的五星级ASPIRA CRUISES游轮，现代与传统设计完美融合，为您带来舒适的旅程，带您探索自然奇观，参与皮划艇、游泳、休闲放松等丰富有趣的活动……
route: 河内 – 下龙湾 – 兰夏湾
兰夏湾 – 河内

itinerary.title: 河内 – 下龙湾 – 兰夏湾（含午、晚餐）
itinerary.html:
8:00 – 8:30：在河内老城区或河内大剧院接客人，随后前往下龙市。

11:45：抵达巡州岛国际旅游港候船室，办理登船手续。

12:15：客人搭乘接驳船前往Aspira Cruise游轮。

12:30 – 12:45：入住船舱，聆听船上须知、安全说明及下龙湾行程介绍，在船上放松享用饮品。

13:00 – 13:30：游轮驶入兰夏湾，同时在奢华餐厅享用午餐。

14:30 – 15:30：您可以探访明暗洞，或参加海上活动，如划皮划艇，或与岛民一起乘坐竹筏，带来一份刺激与兴奋。

16:30 – 17:30：返回Aspira游轮后，您可以选择在游轮附近游泳戏水，或在船上的热水按摩池中尽情放松。

17:30 – 18:30：自由欣赏兰夏湾美景，或在酒吧小憩、享受按摩……

18:15：您可以在船上餐厅参加由专业厨师指导的烹饪课，并品尝自己刚学会的菜肴。

19:15：享用越南美食。

20:45：游轮停靠码头，您可以在船上自由欣赏夜景，体验休闲服务，或在游轮3楼品味茶道。

夜宿游轮

itinerary.title: 兰夏湾 – 河内（含早、午餐）
itinerary.html:
6:30：您可以在甲板上观赏日出、参加太极课程或在船上锻炼，饱览海湾风光。

7:00 – 7:30：在餐厅享用简易早餐。

7:30 – 8:30：您可以划皮划艇，欣赏如诗如画的海岛风光。

9:30：返回游轮，办理退房手续。

9:30 – 9:45：在船上享用午餐，随后退房。

10:45：客人换乘接驳船返回港口。

11:30：抵达巡州岛国际旅游港。

11:40 – 12:00 乘车返程。

15:00：抵达河内，行程结束。

title.en: Hanoi – Cat Ba 2 Days 1 Night Tour
title.zh: 河内 – 吉婆岛 2天1晚游

summary: Cat Ba will attract tourists with its clear blue beaches, long stretches of white sand, surrounded by high rocky mountains and caves with eye-catching stalactites. Especially when soaking in the Cat Co, Cat Dua…
route: Hanoi - Catba National Park - Trung Trang Cave
Full Day Cruise to Cat Ba - Lan Ha Bay - Hanoi

itinerary.title: Hanoi - Catba National Park - Trung Trang Cave (Lunch, Dinner)
itinerary.html:
7:00-7:30: Car and tour guide pick you up at the Old Quarter or Hanoi Opera House to depart for Lan Ha Bay Tour
11:30-12:00: Arrive at Cat Ba town, check in at the hotel, then have lunch at the restaurant.


14:00: Tour guide takes you to visit Cat Ba National Park by motorbike/car depending on the number of guests registering for the tour, you can take beautiful photos on Ngu Lam peak. Then, we move to visit Trung Trang Cave, which has a diverse ecosystem such as bats, birds… and a diverse ecosystem
Evening: Have dinner and stay overnight at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Full Day Cruise to Cat Ba - Lan Ha Bay - Hanoi (Breakfast/lunch).
itinerary.html:
8:00-8:30: The car picks you up from your hotel in Cat Ba Island and takes you to Ben Beo, board the boat to cruise through Beo fishing village, one of the largest fishing villages in Lan Ha Bay and Ha Long Bay

10:30: Arrive near Ha Long Bay and experience kayaking to explore the beauty of the bay.


12:30: Enjoy lunch on the boat, with Vietnamese cuisine.
Afternoon: The boat takes you to the beach, enjoy swimming.
15:30-16:00: Arrive at Ben Beo, the car takes you back to Hanoi
19:00-19:30: Arrive in Hanoi, end of Cat Ba 2 days 1 night tour. See you again!

zh.summary: 吉婆岛以清澈湛蓝的海水、绵长的白色沙滩吸引着游客，四周环绕着高耸的石山和布满迷人钟乳石的洞穴。尤其是在Cat Co、Cat Dua海滩畅游时……
route: 河内 – 吉婆国家公园 – 忠庄洞
全天游船前往吉婆岛 – 兰夏湾 – 河内

itinerary.title: 河内 – 吉婆国家公园 – 忠庄洞（含午、晚餐）
itinerary.html:
7:00-7:30：车辆和导游在老城区或河内大剧院接您，出发前往兰夏湾
11:30-12:00：抵达吉婆镇，入住酒店，随后在餐厅享用午餐。


14:00：导游根据报名人数安排摩托车或汽车，带您参观吉婆国家公园，您可以在五林峰拍下美照。随后前往忠庄洞参观，这里拥有蝙蝠、鸟类等丰富多样的生态系统
晚上：享用晚餐，入住酒店过夜。

itinerary.title: 全天游船前往吉婆岛 – 兰夏湾 – 河内（含早、午餐）
itinerary.html:
8:00-8:30：车辆在吉婆岛酒店接您前往Beo码头，登船游览Beo渔村——兰夏湾和下龙湾最大的渔村之一

10:30：抵达下龙湾附近，体验皮划艇，探索海湾之美。


12:30：在船上享用越南美食午餐。
下午：游船带您前往海滩，尽情游泳。
15:30-16:00：抵达Beo码头，乘车返回河内
19:00-19:30：抵达河内，吉婆岛2天1晚之旅圆满结束。期待与您再会！

title.en: Ninh Binh And Ha Long – 2 Days 1 Night
title.zh: 宁平与下龙湾 – 2天1晚

summary: Ninh Binh – Ha Long 2 day, 1 night tour is the perfect journey for travelers who want to uncover the breathtaking natural beauty and rich cultural heritage…
route: Ninh Binh – Ha Long Bay – Hanoi
highlights: Mua Cave and Ngoa Long Mountain
Explore the Highlights of Ha Long Bay

title.en: Quang Phu Cau Incense Village 1 Day Tour
title.zh: 广富求制香村一日游

summary: Discover the beauty of traditional Vietnamese craft villages, tourists visit Ha Thai lacquer village, visit bell village to learn about traditional craft villages, especially check in at Quang Phu Cau incense…
route: Hanoi - Ha Thai Lacquer Village - Chuong Village Hats - Quang Phu Cau Perfume Village

itinerary.title: Hanoi - Ha Thai Lacquer Village - Chuong Village Hats - Quang Phu Cau Perfume Village
itinerary.html:
7:45 – 8:15 AM: Pick up from the Old Quarter or the Hanoi Opera House, then depart for Ha Thai Lacquer Village, renowned for its lacquerware since the 17th century. Experience the process of lacquerware making.

11:30 AM: Arrive in Chuong Village, known for its 300-year history of conical hat making.

  • Visit a family with a long-standing tradition in this craft, one of the few that still
  • preserves a wooden house with traditional Northern Delta architecture.
  • Participate in a cooking class guided by the host.
  • Have lunch, then take a rest.
  • Following lunch, you’ll delve into the process of making conical hats.

Join the artisans in crafting these iconic conical hats, or unleash your creativity by painting your own masterpiece.

14:00 PM:

  • Welcome to Quang Phu Cau Village, renowned for its centuries-old tradition of incense-making.
  • Stroll through the charming alleys of the village, you’ll be greeted by the enchanting aromas wafting from the local workshops.
  • Witness the incense making process.
  • Craft the incenses yourself.

15:30 PM: Hop on the car, get back to The Old Quarter.

zh.summary: 探索越南传统手工艺村之美：游客将参观河泰漆器村、钟村，了解传统手工艺，尤其是在广富求制香村打卡拍照……
route: 河内 – 河泰漆器村 – 钟村斗笠 – 广富求制香村

itinerary.title: 河内 – 河泰漆器村 – 钟村斗笠 – 广富求制香村
itinerary.html:
上午7:45 – 8:15：在老城区或河内大剧院接客，随后前往河泰漆器村，该村自17世纪起便以漆器闻名。体验漆器制作过程。

上午11:30：抵达拥有300年斗笠制作历史的钟村。

  • 拜访一户世代传承这门手艺的家庭，这是为数不多仍
  • 保留着北部平原传统建筑风格木屋的人家之一。
  • 在主人指导下参加烹饪课。
  • 享用午餐，然后稍作休息。
  • 午餐后，深入了解斗笠的制作过程。

与手艺人一起制作这顶标志性的越南斗笠，或发挥创意，亲手绘制属于自己的杰作。

下午14:00：

  • 欢迎来到广富求制香村，这里有着数百年的制香传统。
  • 漫步村中迷人的小巷，当地作坊飘来的阵阵迷人香气扑面而来。
  • 观看制香过程。
  • 亲手制作香。

下午15:30：乘车返回老城区。

title.en: Cu Chi 1 Day Tour
title.zh: 古芝一日游

summary: The 1-day Cu Chi tour will take tourists to visit the beautiful Reunification Palace in HCM, stop by the Notre Dame Cathedral and the historic Central Post Office, the Museum displaying historical artifacts, and continue the journey to visit Cu Chi…
route: Ho Chi Minh City Tour – Cu Chi Tune

itinerary.title: Ho Chi Minh City Tour – Cu Chi Tune ( Meal Lunch )
itinerary.html:
Breakfast at the hotel. 8 oclock the guide and driver pick up you fot city tour

  • Independence Palace was known as the Reunification palace, which was built on the sight of the former Norodom palace. The Independence palace is a widely known landmark of Ho Chi Minh City and was designed by the architect Ngo Viet Thu.
  • You continue seeing the beautiful structures from the French. Colonial times such as the Notre Dame Cathedral, and the historic Central Post Office.If time permit you can visit War Remnants Museum the museum has a vast display of both the Indochina wars.

Afternoon

13:30 you star to go to Cu Chi tunel – The tunnels is an underground zigzag network of over 200 Km, is a symbol of the will and the creativity of the Vietnamese. Located about 60 Km from Saigon, Cu Chi was a fierce battlefield during 1960- 1972.

  • Visiting Cu Chi, you will see how guerrillas drug, lived, and fought the tunnel, you will learn how the strength of will is against sophisticated weapons. You will watch the documentary films and see self-made weapons, bamboo traps,…And crawl in the tunnel as you like. We will also know how the locals make rice – paper, and rice – wine.

Ever wonder what it feels like to fire Ak- 47, Visit Cuchi Tunnel you have a chance to find out. Comeback Ho Chi Minh city.

zh.summary: 古芝一日游将带领游客参观胡志明市美丽的统一宫，途经西贡圣母大教堂和历史悠久的中央邮局，参观陈列历史文物的博物馆，然后继续前往古芝……
route: 胡志明市观光 – 古芝地道

itinerary.title: 胡志明市观光 – 古芝地道（含午餐）
itinerary.html:
在酒店享用早餐。8点导游和司机接您开始市区观光

  • 独立宫又称统一宫，建于原诺罗敦宫旧址之上。独立宫是胡志明市广为人知的地标，由建筑师吴越书设计。
  • 继续欣赏法国殖民时期留下的精美建筑，如西贡圣母大教堂和历史悠久的中央邮局。如时间允许，还可参观战争遗迹博物馆，馆内展出了两次印度支那战争的大量展品。

下午

13:30 出发前往古芝地道——这是一个总长200多公里、曲折蜿蜒的地下网络，是越南人民意志与创造力的象征。古芝距西贡约60公里，在1960-1972年间曾是激烈的战场。

  • 参观古芝，您将了解游击队员如何挖掘地道、在地道中生活和战斗，体会坚强的意志如何对抗先进的武器。您将观看纪录片，参观自制武器、竹制陷阱等……还可以随意钻入地道体验。此外还将了解当地人如何制作米纸和米酒。

是否好奇射击AK-47是什么感觉？参观古芝地道，您将有机会一探究竟。返回胡志明市。

title.en: Quang Phu Cau Incense Village & Chuong Conical Hat Village
title.zh: 广富求制香村与钟村斗笠村

summary: Quang Phu Cau Incense Village attracts visitors not only for its aesthetic beauty, but also for its traditional culture. Coming here, visitors can also experience the way the locals make incense, and take beautiful photos. Let's explore the beauty with Vietlook…
route: Quang Phu Cau Incense Village & Chuong Conical Hat Village

itinerary.title: Quang Phu Cau Incense Village & Chuong Conical Hat Village
itinerary.html:
08:00: Start your day with a pick-up from Hanoi and head to Quang Phu Cau Incense Village. Discover a quieter side of Hanoi as you pass through serene villages and expansive rice paddy fields.

10:00 Arrive at Quang Phu Cau Village, renowned for its century-old incense-making tradition. Capture picture-perfect moments with beautifully arranged incense bunches and engage with friendly locals to learn about process of making traditional incense.

12:00 Arrive in Chuong village, you start to visit a traditional rural house in Northern Vietnam. Appreciate the original wooden house architecture with high technic by old craltsmans and you also have opportunity to participate in a cooking class led by locals. Enjoy a satisfying lunch featuring dishes you’ve prepared yourself.

13:00 After the lunch, enjoy fresh green tea. Which is not easy to be seen and enjoy in the city. Relax and indulge in the peaceful scenery of rural Vietnam.

14:00 In order to know more about Chuong village, you can ride bicycle to go around the village, stop at an pagoda with old architecture near by a dyke. Which was built in the past to protect the villages from flood season. Next one will be a temple. Which worships village tutelary god and also a cuitural center for almost activities of villagers in the past.You learn more about the custom of Viet namese people in the past.

14:30 Start to experience traditional conical hat making of Chuong Village. Which celebrated for crafting Vietnam’s iconic conical hats. Learn the art of conical hat-making from local artisans. Especially you will be instructed to make conical hat- A very interesting experience,Then you get colours to draw your ideas on the hat. This is also a memorable gift to bring home. At the end you take some great pictures of conical hats and friendly local artisans.

At the end of the afternoon you get on the bus to go to visit Van Phuc silk villeage – a well known silk village with over one thousand years. Van Phuc silk were used for Kings and royal families. Under French priod time Van Phuc silk were. Where you have opportunity to get informations from the tour guide and see step by step of making traditional silk : Silkworms eat mulberry leaves and then spin silk to make nests. The silk is then woven into silk fabric.You may choose some nice silk presents as memory of the trip.

17:00 Board the bus for your return to Hanoi’s city center. End of the trip.

zh.summary: 广富求制香村吸引游客的不仅是其美学之美，还有其传统文化。来到这里，游客还可以体验当地人的制香方式，拍下美丽的照片。快跟随Vietlook一起探索这份美丽吧……
route: 广富求制香村与钟村斗笠村

itinerary.title: 广富求制香村与钟村斗笠村
itinerary.html:
08:00：从河内接您出发，前往广富求制香村。沿途穿过宁静的村庄和广袤的稻田，发现河内安静的另一面。

10:00 抵达以百年制香传统闻名的广富求制香村。在排列精美的香束前留下完美照片，与友善的村民交流，了解传统制香的过程。

12:00 抵达钟村，参观越南北部传统乡村民居。欣赏老工匠以精湛技艺建造的原汁原味木屋建筑，您还将有机会参加由当地人指导的烹饪课，享用由自己亲手烹制的丰盛午餐。

13:00 午餐后品尝新鲜绿茶，这在城市中难得一见、难得一尝。放松身心，沉浸在越南乡村的宁静风光中。

14:00 为了更深入了解钟村，您可以骑自行车环游村庄，在堤坝附近一座古老建筑风格的寺庙稍作停留，这条堤坝过去是为保护村庄免受汛期洪水侵袭而修建的。接下来参观一座供奉村庄城隍的亭庙，这里过去也是村民各类活动的文化中心。您将进一步了解越南人过去的风俗习惯。

14:30 开始体验钟村的传统斗笠制作，这里以制作越南标志性的斗笠而闻名。向当地手艺人学习斗笠制作技艺，您还将在指导下亲手制作斗笠——一次非常有趣的体验。随后您可以用颜料在斗笠上绘出自己的创意，这也是一份值得带回家的难忘礼物。最后，与斗笠和友善的当地手艺人合影留念。

傍晚时分，乘车前往万福丝绸村——一座拥有千年以上历史的著名丝绸村。万福丝绸曾专供帝王和皇室使用，在法属时期也享有盛名。在这里，您将听导游讲解，并逐步观看传统丝绸的制作过程：蚕吃桑叶后吐丝结茧，蚕丝再被织成丝绸面料。您可以挑选一些精美的丝绸礼品作为旅途纪念。

17:00 乘车返回河内市中心，行程结束。

Breakfast in the hotel,

8:30 the guide and driver pick up you to Ba Na Hills

09:30: Arrive at Ba Na – Suoi Mo cable car station. Board the cable car to DeBay station. See Mo Stream with white foaming waterfalls, primeval forests, and red-leaved trees.

  • Visit the Golden Bridge, visit Le Jardin Area with French relics such as Tinh Tam Garden, a French horse-binding area, a nearly 100-year-old pomelo tree, and traces of ancient villas. Visit Linh Ung Ba Na Pagoda to admire the 27m-high statue of Shakyamuni Buddha, visit Loc Uyen Garden, Quan Am Cac.

Leaving the top of Chua mountain, follow the trail to visit the ancient villa ruins in the forest, the ruins of the outdoor Opera house, and the Debay Suspension Bridge…

  • The tour guide takes the delegation to visit: The world’s third largest indoor amusement park called FANTASY PARK (Love wheel, SKIVER pilot, Fire race track

Tramcar crash,Haunted house, Mortar). Windmill, Spider-Man, Free-falling Tower… Go back the hotel.

zh.summary: 跟随Vietlook Travel探索巴拿山之美，游客将体验破纪录的缆车线路，乘坐缆车欣赏清澈碧蓝的梦溪风光，在金桥(佛手桥)自由拍照打卡，参观神圣的灵应寺，征服隐藏在……中的巴拿山之巅
route: 岘港 – 巴拿山 – 金桥(佛手桥)

itinerary.title: 岘港 – 巴拿山 – 金桥(佛手桥)（含午餐）
itinerary.html:
在酒店享用早餐，

8:30 导游和司机接您前往巴拿山

09:30：抵达巴拿 – 梦溪缆车站，乘缆车前往Debay站。沿途可见白浪翻腾的梦溪瀑布、原始森林和红叶林。

  • 参观金桥(佛手桥)，游览Le Jardin花园区，欣赏法国遗迹，如静心花园、法式拴马区、近百年的柚子树以及古老别墅遗址。参观巴拿灵应寺，瞻仰27米高的释迦牟尼佛像，游览鹿苑、观音阁。
  • 继续前往Debay站，乘坐第二条缆车线路登上巴拿山顶。

11:30：暂停游览，在餐厅享用自助午餐。

12:30 – 14:00：征服主峰（Chua山）——城市之巅，在海拔1487米的地标处拍照留念。俯瞰岘港市和岘港湾全景，时隐时现于云海之中。离开主峰后，沿小径参观林中古别墅遗址、露天歌剧院遗址及Debay吊桥……

  • 导游带领团队参观：世界第三大室内游乐园FANTASY PARK梦幻乐园（爱情摩天轮、SKIVER飞行员、火焰赛道

碰碰车、鬼屋、迫击炮）、风车、蜘蛛侠、自由落体塔……返回酒店。

title.en: Mekong delta – one day trip
title.zh: 湄公河三角洲 – 一日游

summary: On the 1-day Mekong tour, visitors will experience a boat ride through the canals, surrounded by rows of trees and green coconut trees, to Dragon Island, Unicorn Island, Phoenix Island and Turtle Island... and visit the fishing port, Rach Mieu bridge, stilt houses and boatyards, and fruit gardens where visitors can enjoy seasonal fruits and delicious local…
route: Mekong Delta

itinerary.title: Mekong Delta (Meal - L)
itinerary.html:
8 oclock the Tour guide and car pick you up from the hotel, depart for My Tho.

Arriving in My Tho city, you will board a motorboat with the locals to visit Dragon Island, Ky Lan Island, Phuong Hoang Island and Turtle Island. On the way, you will visit the fishing port, Rach Mieu bridge, stilt houses and boat building workshop. After that, the group will stop at Ky Lan Island, where you can take a short walk to see the orchard, enjoy fruit in the garden, enjoy honey tea and natural wine at the bee farms and watch the performance of Vietnamese folk music of Mekong.

You and the locals row slowly through the cool green canals, surrounded by rows of water coconut trees. Then, you take a motorboat to Ben Tre province, transfer to a small motorboat and cruise along the green canals.

At noon, you enjoy lunch at a local restaurant with Vietnamese dishes. After lunch, you can cycle around the village and visit the crocodile farm or relax in a hammock.

The boat will take you back to My Tho city. Then, the bus will take you back to Ho Chi Minh city. On the way, the group stops at the BONSAI Garden for sightseeing and experience. Then, the bus takes you back to Ho Chi Minh city. End of tour.

title.en: Ha Noi – Ninh Binh One Day Trip
title.zh: 河内 – 宁平一日游

summary: Ninh Binh 1 day tour will take visitors to visit Trang An scenic spot, or visit caves such as: Sang Cave, Toi Cave, Ba Giot Cave and Sinh Cave...continue the journey to take visitors to visit Hoa Lu, Mua…
route: Ha Noi – Ninh Binh

itinerary.title: Ha Noi – Ninh Binh ( One Day Trip)
itinerary.html:
8 o’clock Car and tour guide pick you up at your hotel in Hanoi, depart for Ninh Binh with majestic natural landscapes, limestone mountains, and underground stream caves.

Arriving in Ninh Binh, you will explore Trang An eco-tourism area (a UNESCO World Heritage Site). You will board a sampan boat to visit caves and arches of Trang An, including Sang Cave, Toi Cave, Ba Giot Cave and Sinh Cave. You will enjoy a buffet lunch at a local restaurant with many delicious local dishes.

Afternoon

After lunch, you will visit Hoa Lu, the former capital of Vietnam dating back to the 11th century, enjoying the fresh air and peaceful scenery.

Upon arrival, you will visit the two remaining temples of King Dinh and King Le. Restored in the 17th century, the temples are believed to have been built on the original foundations of the old palaces from the 11th and 12th centuries.

You will conquer the top of Mua Mountain to admire the beautiful view of Ngo Dong River below, cutting across the undulating high mountains.

Late afternoon. You return to Hanoi, ending the 1-day Ninh Binh tour. See you again in the next journey with Vietlook Travel.

zh.summary: 宁平一日游将带领游客游览长安风景区，探访明洞、暗洞、三滴洞和生洞等洞穴……继续前往华闾古都、舞洞山……
route: 河内 – 宁平

itinerary.title: 河内 – 宁平（一日游）
itinerary.html:
8点 车辆和导游在河内酒店接您，出发前往宁平，这里有壮丽的自然风光、石灰岩山峦和地下暗河溶洞。

抵达宁平后，您将游览长安生态旅游区（联合国教科文组织世界遗产）。乘坐舢板船游览长安的溶洞与石拱，包括明洞、暗洞、三滴洞和生洞。在当地餐厅享用自助午餐，品尝多种美味的当地菜肴。

下午

午餐后，您将游览可追溯至11世纪的越南古都华闾，呼吸清新空气，欣赏宁静风光。

抵达后，参观现存的丁先皇祠和黎大行皇祠。这两座祠庙于17世纪重修，据信建于11至12世纪旧宫殿的原址之上。

您将登上舞洞山顶，俯瞰吴同河蜿蜒穿过连绵起伏的高山，美景尽收眼底。

傍晚，返回河内，宁平一日游圆满结束。期待下次与Vietlook Travel再次同行。

itinerary.title: Da Nang City – Hoi An ( Meal - Dinner)
itinerary.html:
14:00 – 14;30 The tour guide and car will pick you up at the hotel and start to visit the marble mountain. This is a beautiful destination. There are 5 mountains standing next to each other and near the sea and beautiful beaches. You can go in to visit the artisans carving exquisite stone products.

Visit the Coconut Forest. You will board a bamboo boat and row along the river with coconut forests covering both sides of the river. You will immerse yourself in the fresh nature of the cool green forest. Then the car will take you to Hoi An night market, you will walk with the tour guide to explore Hoi An at night, visit the highlights of Hoi An, which is recognized as a world heritage site. Dinner will be served at a local restaurant. Then return to the hotel.

游览七亩椰林。您将乘坐簸箕船沿河泛舟，两岸椰林密布，让您沉浸在清凉翠绿的自然之中。随后乘车前往会安夜市，跟随导游步行探索夜色中的会安，游览这座世界文化遗产的精华景点。在当地餐厅享用晚餐，然后返回酒店。
